jobs.title: Sr. Design Program Manager, Worldwide Grocery Real Estate
jobs.description:
Amazon's Worldwide Grocery Retail Growth & Development (WWRGD) organization is seeking a Sr. Design Program Manager, E-Commerce to lead design and program management across our E-Commerce workstreams for the retail grocery store network. This is a high-impact, individual contributor role requiring deep subject matter expertise in grocery retail design, E-Commerce operational integration, and cross-functional program ownership at scale.

This is an exciting, fast-moving role for a design leader who operates at the intersection of design execution and program leadership. You are the right person for this job if you are a highly independent, detail-oriented design professional who thrives in ambiguity, produces designs that satisfy conflicting interests with a high bar for quality, and can drive alignment across multiple stakeholders with competing priorities.

In this role, you will own the end-to-end design and program coordination for E-Commerce workstreams including but not limited to: E-Commerce Hubs, E-Commerce Metro Optimization, Amazon Counter, and Dash Carts. You will serve as the single-threaded owner and primary point of contact for each business owner, tracking deliverables, managing timelines, and ensuring designs meet strict launch deadlines. You will define the standards and processes to optimize E-Commerce design in retail stores and ensure scalability across the fleet. As the program lead, you will influence decisions across Operations, Technology, Construction, and Procurement.

The ideal candidate is a creative problem solver with strong program management instincts, deep E-Commerce fluency, and the ability to build scalable design systems that work across a high-volume, multi-workstream portfolio.

Key job responsibilities
- E-Commerce Workstream Ownership: Own and drive the full portfolio of E-Commerce design workstreams, serving as the subject matter expert and primary point of contact for business owners.
- Design Execution: Produce design deliverables independently while simultaneously managing the output of others to meet strict launch deadlines.
- Tracking and Reporting: Track and report on the status of all active workstreams, proactively identifying risks, dependencies, and blockers to leadership.
- Cross-Functional Coordination: Collaborate with Operations, Technology, Construction, Procurement, Real Estate, Topology Planning, and senior leadership to align design solutions with business objectives.
- Design Standards and Toolkits: Develop and maintain design standards, templates, and best practices for E-Commerce integration across the grocery store network, enabling consistent and repeatable solutions at scale.
- Program Management: Manage the design process end-to-end, interfacing with internal and external design partners to ensure quality and consistency across all workstreams.
- Site-Specific Adaptation: Adapt site-specific conditions, metrics, and standards to store designs while balancing competing operational, customer experience, and cost requirements.
- Scope Development: Build data-driven scopes of work with internal stakeholders focused on enabling E-Commerce operations within existing and new store environments.
- Design Packages: Create design packages (2/5 page sets) to communicate design intent and program status with cross-functional teams and senior leadership.
- Design Phases: Drive Schematic Design and Design Development packages through all phases of design, permitting, and construction administration.
- Budget and Schedule: Coordinate with Construction, Procurement, and Operations on budget, schedule, and value engineering.
- Consultant Management: Manage consultants and external partners throughout all phases of the project lifecycle.
- Construction Administration: Provide CA support as needed, including review and approval of submittals and shop drawings.
- Process Improvement: Develop mechanisms to improve efficiency, reduce ambiguity, and scale E-Commerce design delivery across the network.

A day in the life
If you thrive in a dynamic, high-volume environment where design rigor and operational pace must coexist, then we want to talk to you. A typical day involves triaging new E-Commerce design requests, advancing active design packages, and coordinating with the Capital Planning and Construction teams to ensure design handoffs are clean and complete. You will regularly interface with store operations leaders to ground design decisions in real store context, partner with procurement on equipment specifications, and advance process improvements that help the team scale. This role requires both design judgment and program management discipline, you will need to move quickly, communicate clearly, and maintain quality across a portfolio of hundreds of active projects at any given time.

About the team
Our team is on a mission to raise the bar for design excellence at Amazon. We partner closely with product, engineering, and research teams to deliver experiences that genuinely improve the lives of our customers. We value collaboration, intellectual curiosity, and a commitment to operational rigor. As we continue to grow, we are investing in new tools, processes, and talent to expand our impact. This is an exciting time to join, you will help shape how we work and what we build for years to come.
Basic qualifications:
- 6+ years of design experience
- Have an available online portfolio
- Experience understanding needs of business and end customers and translating them into right solutions
- Experience gathering and analyzing large amounts of data and delivering continuous business improvements
Preferred qualifications:
- Knowledge of project management tools and methodologies (agile to waterfall)
- Experience working and contributing to project playbooks, building schedules, managing issues/risks, establishing communication plans and stakeholder management

jobs.title: Sr. Refrigeration Standards Program Manager, Worldwide Grocery Real Estate Growth & Development (WWRGD)
jobs.description:
Join us as we redefine the future of physical retail! Our goal is to be Earth's most customer-centric company and we're just getting started. We are looking for people who want to join a newly developing business unit full of ambitious and driven professionals that continue to push the boundaries of reality and improve the daily lives of our customers.

This team is seeking a Refrigeration Engineering Standards Program Manager with expertise in Refrigeration and Control systems who will manage the building systems engineering standards for developing prototypes and ongoing construction projects. This position will serve as a department expert and act as a "bridge" between the department and the broader organization. The position requires strong working knowledge in a wide variety of building types and systems (both the design of such systems and also installation and maintenance) with a focus on refrigeration design and controls.

This is a high-visibility, high-impact role for someone who is energized by building structure where there is ambiguity, who can translate complex technical requirements into clear standards, and who thrives in an organization where influence matters more than authority.

Key job responsibilities
Engineering Design Standards Ownership:
- Own refrigeration engineering design standards.
- Establish and maintain standards with cross-functional partners, including basis of design (BOD) for technical disciplines to meet company criteria and cost targets.
- Manage equipment specifications and design coordination.

Technical Innovation & Cost Management:
- Execute refrigeration cost reduction, energy conservation, and sustainability goals.
- Lead technical innovation initiatives for building systems and quality control.

Consultant & Vendor Management:
- Cultivate relationships with 3P engineering consultants and manage production of engineering documents.
- Track consultant quality and cost, own relationships with MEP/R and Controls consultants.

Quality Assurance & Technical Support:
- Conduct site inspections and facility audits. Provide technical expertise to Pre-Construction, Design, Construction, Facilities, and Operations teams.
- Support preventative maintenance SOPs and partner with Facilities to ensure systems align with established standards.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:
- Serve as SME for Refrigeration and Controls topics.
- Work cross-functionally to share best practices, provide engineering solutions for site-specific designs, and review construction documents for accuracy and cost targets.
- Proven ability to efficiently plan and prioritize deliverables and resources across multiple projects
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
- Demonstrated ability to make creative design recommendations and articulate technical justification to diverse stakeholders

A day in the life
You will partner with 3P engineering consultants to develop programmatic Refrigeration design guardrails and articulate design justification to different groups within the organization. You will value-engineer Refrigeration systems and reduce overall program costs while ensuring the customer experience is not affected. You will attend meetings as required to address specific issues, make decisions and find solutions quickly and with confidence. You will take ownership of your work, display a great deal of initiative, and exercise sound judgment.

About the team
The WWRGD Design Standards Team develops and maintains integrated design standards and programmatic design resources for Amazon's retail portfolio enabling architects of record and contractors to efficiently deliver consistent, high-quality store environments at scale. Our products include specifications , construction assemblies, reference architectural sets, and digital tools including Revit/BIM resources. We support all store formats, from Daily Shops to Large Format Suburban stores and new exploratory formats, and we coordinate alignment across format-specific brand experiences.
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Technology, or Reliability Engineering, or 6+ years of refrigeration industry experience
- 6+ years of refrigeration industry experience
- Strong working knowledge of building systems design, installation, and maintenance with focus on refrigeration design and controls
- Experience with value engineering and cost reduction while maintaining quality standards
- Experience managing stakeholder expectations, schedules, budgets, and scopes
- Experience managing 3P engineering consultants
Preferred qualifications:
- Professional Engineer (PE) license
- Experience with Amazon or retail construction projects
- Experience with commissioning standards and processes
- Knowledge of sustainability, energy conservation, and carbon reduction strategies

jobs.title: Manager, Strategy and Capture, ALG
jobs.description:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.

We are seeking an ALG Strategy Lead to own the development of business strategy for all of Amazon Leo Government. As an individual contributor, you will independently develop and drive go-to-market strategy, cross-organizational programs, operational mechanisms, and business analytics across the ALG portfolio—spanning domestic and international government market segments. You will work in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment where the problem and strategy may not yet be defined, using your expertise and judgment to set direction, align stakeholders, and deliver results.
This role influences without authority across teams and functions, presents strategies and recommendations to senior leadership, and translates leadership priorities into actionable plans. The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with strong program management discipline, thrives in ambiguity, and has a proven track record of building and delivering strategy and programs from the ground up across a portfolio.

Key job responsibilities
Strategy Development & Planning
• Own the development of business strategy, go-to-market plans, and growth initiatives for all of ALG, working backwards from customer problems in an environment where the strategy may not be defined.
• Analyze business trends, market demand, and emerging needs across the ALG portfolio to identify opportunities for growth and operational improvement.
• Translate leadership priorities into actionable plans with clear milestones, owners, and success metrics.
• Design strategy frameworks and enabling mechanisms that integrate growth plans with operational execution.
• Define goals and metrics where none exist, and design long-term solutions that deliver the best outcome for ALG.
Cross-Organizational Program Delivery
• Own and deliver strategic programs and initiatives end-to-end—from scoping the problem and defining the approach, through gaining stakeholder buy-in, execution, and measurement.
• Build scalable, repeatable operational mechanisms (MBRs, QBRs, operational reviews, reporting cadences) that improve consistency across the organization.
• Manage multiple concurrent workstreams, proactively identifying risks and clearing blockers—escalating with the right resources when appropriate—to ensure on-time delivery.
• Present a range of simplified solution options, representing the benefits and trade-offs of each, and make trade-offs between short- and long-term needs.
• Develop detailed plans, maintain comprehensive documentation, and mitigate long-term risks.
Business Performance & Analytics
• Build dashboards, analytics frameworks, and reporting solutions that provide visibility into ALG performance.
• Source, analyze, and synthesize quantitative and qualitative data from across the organization; report on pipeline metrics, business forecasts, and initiative effectiveness.
• Provide fact-based insights into variances and trends; quantify business impact of initiatives to inform prioritization decisions.
• Ensure customer outcomes are auditable, decisions are data-driven, and work quality is measurable.
Stakeholder Management & Communication
• Influence across teams, stakeholders, and partners without authority; build credibility and trust through consistent delivery.
• Present strategies, progress updates, and business cases to senior leadership (up to L10) to secure alignment and support.
• Write strategic narratives (6-pagers, MBR/QBR, PR/FAQ) and own inputs into OP1/OP2.
• Foster constructive dialogue, harmonize discordant views, and lead the resolution of contentious issues to build consensus across teams with competing priorities.
• Mentor and develop others across the organization and participate in the recruitment and promotion process.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and candidates must be able to obtain and maintain a US Government security clearance of TS/SCI.
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree, or experience in a relevant field
- 7+ years of experience in strategy, business development, sales operations, or program management.
- Experience developing and executing business strategies, go-to-market plans, and growth initiatives.
- Experience independently owning and delivering cross-functional programs end-to-end in ambiguous environments.
- Experience building dashboards, analytics frameworks, and reporting to drive data-driven decisions.
- Experience writing strategic narratives (e.g., 6-pagers, MBR/QBR, PR/FAQ) and presenting to senior leadership.
- Strong analytical and financial acumen, including experience synthesizing data from multiple sources.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence without authority across teams and functions.
Preferred qualifications:
- Master's degree or advanced degree.
- Experience with SATCOM, satellite communications, or space-based solutions.
- Experience with cloud computing technology (AWS) or government/public sector markets.
- Experience supporting both domestic and international government markets, including allied nations and coalition partners.
- Program or project management certification (e.g., PMP, or equivalent).
- Experience operating in startup or early-stage environments, delivering strategy and programs from the ground up.
- Demonstrated ability to build consensus and drive alignment across senior stakeholders with competing priorities.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager; Catalog Strategy & Execution , Global Manufacturing and Distribution Services
jobs.description:
The Senior Program Manager of Catalog Strategy & Execution is a strategic individual contributor role within the Global Manufacturing & Distribution Services organization. This position owns the critical link between enterprise procurement strategy and measurable buying behavior across Amazon. The role holder will consolidate what were previously separate project management and catalog strategy functions into a single, high-impact position that drives catalog integrity, program execution, spend compliance, and cross-functional alignment. This role also serves as the primary category liaison to the Category Strategy & Insights (CSI) team.

Key job responsibilities
This role directly supports savings targets and contributes to the broader organizational goal of net cost reductions. The position influences procurement decisions, catalog architecture, and purchasing governance across Amazon's global operations. The role holder will be instrumental in transitioning the organization from a fragmented, reactive catalog administration model to a centralized, strategic catalog function.

Essential Job Functions

Catalog Strategy & Governance: Define, own, and execute the end-to-end catalog strategy for Global Manufacturing & Distribution Services. Align catalog governance standards including taxonomy, item classification, supplier mapping, and content quality requirements with the Global Procurement Central Services team.

Program Execution & Delivery: Lead cross-functional programs that translate sourcing decisions, supplier negotiations, and manufacturing investments into measurable catalog outcomes. Manage program timelines, milestones, dependencies, and risk mitigation plans.

Spend Compliance & Adoption: Design and implement frameworks that drive enterprise-wide spend compliance with preferred supplier programs and negotiated contracts. Track, analyze, and report on user adoption rates and buying behavior to identify gaps and opportunities.

CSI Category Liaison: Serve as the dedicated interface between the Global Manufacturing & Distribution Services category team and Strategic Initiatives. Ensure bi-directional alignment on procurement priorities, market intelligence, and category roadmaps.

Savings Realization: Own savings pipeline and contribute directly to annual team savings targets. Develop business cases, track savings delivery, and report on financial performance against plan.

Catalog Operations Transformation: Redesign catalog administration processes to eliminate fragmentation, reduce operational burden, and enable proactive management. Partner with technology teams to automate catalog workflows and improve data quality.

Stakeholder Management: Collaborate with sourcing managers, procurement leaders, operations teams, finance, and technology partners across multiple pillars and regions. Prepare and present program updates, savings reports, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.

Reporting & Analytics: Build and maintain dashboards and reporting mechanisms that provide visibility into catalog health, programs status, adoption metrics, and savings performance. Use data to drive decisions and continuous improvement.

About the team
Global Procurement Operations (GPO) is Amazon's worldwide procurement and facilities services organization, responsible for sourcing, managing, and delivering the operational services that keep Amazon's vast network running. GPO operates at massive scale spanning more than 15 countries across North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, the Middle East, and Latin America.
GPO's mission touches every corner of Amazon's physical operations. The organization manages strategic procurement across categories including facility services, third-party logistics (3PL), supplier management, sustainability, and site launch — ensuring Amazon's fulfillment centers, sort centers, and delivery stations are properly equipped and supported. GPO is also responsible for driving procurement innovation through technology, with a dedicated technology pillar focused on building the tools and systems that make world-class procurement possible at Amazon's scale.
The organization is structured around regional and functional centers of excellence, each led by a senior director-level leader.

GPO's corporate team includes approximately 1,400 procurement and supply chain professionals at levels working alongside a global network of on-site service partners embedded across Amazon's operational facilities. The team is highly global and distributed, with significant presence in the United States, Luxembourg, the United Kingdom, Japan, Spain, Brazil, the UAE, and beyond.

Joining GPO means working at the intersection of strategic sourcing, operational excellence, and global scale — partnering with operations, finance, legal, and sustainability teams to deliver impact across one of the world's largest and most complex supply chains.
Basic qualifications:
- 6+ years of program or project management experience
- 5+ years of supply chain experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
Preferred qualifications:
- 6+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Master's degree, or MBA in supply chain, business, engineering, finance or related technical or quantitative field

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, AWS Marketing Builder Enablement
jobs.description:
AWS Marketing is seeking a Senior Program Manager to lead builder enablement programs within Marketing Strategy, Operations & Enablement (MSOE). In this role, you will serve as the strategic lead for cross-functional programs that develop and empower AWS Marketing builders — including early career talent, people managers, and the broader marketing population — to grow, deliver results, and enable their teams.

You will develop and execute program strategy as the single-threaded owner of three flagship programs: the Early Career Talent (ECT) program, Inside AWS Marketing Spotlight Series (IAMSS), and AWS Marketing Manager Central. These programs share knowledge globally and create experiences that raise the bar for builders at every level.

The ideal candidate is a seasoned program leader who thrives in ambiguity, earns trust across organizational boundaries, and leverages qualitative and quantitative data to continuously evolve programs. You think big about strategy, dive deep into execution, and communicate with clarity and confidence to senior leaders.

Key job responsibilities

Early Career Talent (ECT) Program (~60%)
● Lead the ECT program end-to-end — developing and executing the experience strategy for interns and their managers from post-offer acceptance through offboarding.
● Drive manager enablement across the full lifecycle: preparation, onboarding, intern project planning, performance management resources, and serving as the central point of contact to unblock success.
● Design and deliver intern programming — including pre-Day One communications, org-specific onboarding, skill-building sessions, Ask Me Anythings, and lunch-and-learns — that provides an expansive, diversified experience.
● Inspect program quality through surveys, focus groups, and 1:1 mechanisms; identify and act on improvement opportunities.
● Own year-round program strategy, including postmortems, operating plans, and experience strategy documents that codify execution and think big about amplifying impact.
● Build and execute a brand strategy for the ECT program to improve awareness and engagement across AWS Marketing, including among the Marketing Leadership Team (MLT).
● Lead the ECT Tiger Team with cross-functional partners (AUTA, PXT, Finance, Talent Acquisition, WFP) — owning agendas, tracking milestones, and driving accountability.

Inside AWS Marketing Spotlight Series (~20%)
● Own the IAMSS program strategy and vision, including the content calendar, themes, and tenets grounding each session.
● Partner with the CMO's Communications team to prioritize topics; identify and recruit speakers, serving as the final decision maker on content and program direction.
● Develop promotion mechanisms to drive attendance and prime the funnel for future sessions.
● Inspect attendee feedback and evolve the series format and strategy accordingly.

AWS Marketing Manager Central (~20%)
● Own the Manager Central Quick app, including quarterly content refreshes to keep action items and timelines current.
● Maintain a 2–3 day SLA on responding to manager feedback submitted through the app.
● Partner with PXT bimonthly to review feedback, make go/no-go decisions, and incorporate approved inputs into the manager enablement strategy roadmap.
● Inspect performance via feedback trends and app analytics (unique visitors, engagement patterns) to identify improvement opportunities.
Basic qualifications:
- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
Preferred qualifications:
- 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
- Knowledge of general AI tools
- Experience designing, implementing, and scaling upskilling, apprenticeship, or workforce development programs across large-scale operations or corporate environments, including forecasting workforce needs and leveraging analytics to drive program decisions

jobs.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Do you have the passion to work in the AWS Water industry with a focus on water stewardship and sustainability efforts? Do you have the industry background, technical depth, and business development skills needed to help further establish AWS as the leader in the water industry?
Amazon is seeking a self-starter to join the AWS Water team in pioneering the future for data center water supply in how AWS delivers water projects and partners with water utilities/companies across the United States.

In this role, you will manage multiple, large scale and technically complex water infrastructure projects across multiple geographies by facilitating close collaboration between both internal and external stakeholders. Internally, responsibilities include large portfolio project management, reporting status, risks, mitigations and successes to leadership, as well as influencing multiple cross-functional partner teams in the overall data center water delivery business process. Externally, this role takes ownership of managing utility relationships, and contracting with the utility and/or Owner’s Engineer. The ideal candidate will have both a business and a technology background with demonstrated experience working with utilities and earning customer trust.

- Work collaboratively with Amazon Infrastructure teams to support the development of strategic water sourcing opportunities for large-scale, multi-year development projects

- Analyze trends and regulations in the water space to proactively identify opportunities that benefit AWS or the data center industry.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

jobs.title: Sr. Creative Program Manager, Brand Experience
jobs.description:
Worldwide Operations collectively represents some of the most critical components of Amazon's first-class transportation network. This organization oversees all global middle and last mile products, spanning B2B and B2C, critical partners, enterprise and SMB customers across numerous teams. This includes—but is not limited to—Amazon Supply Chain Services, Amazon Freight, Amazon Relay, Amazon Freight Partners, Amazon Shipping, Amazon Flex, Amazon Hub Delivery and more. Everything we do is aimed at further delighting our shippers, carriers and partners with faster, cheaper, and more efficient means of shipping and receiving packages.

Brand Experience (BEX) is a central shared-services creative studio supporting the portfolio of global supply chain products. The team develops brand strategy and creative solutions that engage global transportation audiences through the human stories behind logistics. We build and own the global brands and their creative expression throughout the customer journey—working closely with marketing, sales, and customer insights partners to test, learn, and ensure our design solutions resonate with target audiences. We have high standards and strive to continuously raise the bar across all creative elements.

We are looking for a Senior Creative Program Manager to own resource management, capacity planning, and creative operations for a team of 25+ creatives (designers, copywriters, production artists, and more) supporting 10+ global businesses. This is a high-impact IC role at the center of how BEX operates—responsible for the systems, processes, and partnerships that enable our studio to deliver excellent creative work at scale.

The right candidate brings deep expertise in creative program management and uses sound judgment to design long-term operational solutions in an environment where strategy is not always defined. They own complex, cross-functional programs end-to-end, create scalable mechanisms that increase studio efficiency, and influence across partner teams and senior leadership to drive alignment. They are both tactical and strategic—equally comfortable triaging today's incoming requests and building the capacity model for next quarter. They develop a strong understanding of Amazon's supply chain products and become the operational backbone of BEX, connecting the dots between business demand, creative capacity, and team health.

This role partners closely with senior leadership on planning, goal development, and resource strategy. The Senior Creative Program Manager may manage contractor project managers in the future.

Resource Management & Capacity Planning

Own end-to-end resource management and capacity planning for the studio, mapping creative skills and availability against a portfolio of programs across 10+ global businesses

Maintain workload balance across all studio members, strategically assigning projects to internal and external resources to optimize the pipeline and mitigate long-term risks

Build and maintain forecasting models that anticipate demand, identify resourcing gaps, and inform headcount and vendor recommendations to leadership

Make trade-offs between short-term delivery needs and long-term team sustainability, escalating appropriately when constraints require senior input

Creative Operations & Process

Own the studio's project management platform (Workfront), ensuring it serves as a reliable source of truth for project status, resource allocation, and reporting.

Triage and traffic all new creative requests submitted to the studio, assessing scope, identifying information gaps, and determining owners and next steps

Own and evolve creative development processes end-to-end (concept to production) across mediums including video, digital, social, OOH, direct mail, events, and sales collateral—ensuring on-time, on-budget delivery

Design, document, and implement scalable mechanisms that systematically improve studio efficiency, throughput, and quality of output

Drive operational excellence best practices across the studio; identify where to simplify, automate, or extend solutions for the best outcome

Program Reporting & Studio Health

Own, develop and maintain studio health dashboards that provide visibility into capacity utilization, delivery performance, and pipeline forecasting

Develop program reporting across finance, business reviews, client satisfaction, and team goals—connecting operational metrics to org-level objectives

Contribute to OP1/OP2 narratives and organizational goal-setting as they relate to creative operations and resource strategy

Stakeholder Management & Communication

Serve as a primary operational point of contact for Creative Garage, building effective partnerships with both the internal creative team and business partners across the global supply chain org

Drive cross-functional alignment across multiple business partners and external agencies globally; educate partners on studio process, SLAs, and capacity constraints

Anticipate bottlenecks, manage escalations, and balance business needs against resource constraints—finding a path forward in difficult situations

Present updates to stakeholders and cross-functional partners, including senior management up to VP level, with clear and concise written and verbal communication

Own change management communications for studio operations updates across creative team and business stakeholders

About the team
We call ourselves the Brand Experience. We are an internal creative studio built to centrally support the global supply chain org. We believe creatives working together on a central team creates a stronger, more collaborative environment—more career growth opportunities and stronger creative solutions for our customers. We make logistics human and love telling the stories of those who make the supply chain work. Most importantly, we make great creative and have fun doing it.

Come build with us.

jobs.title: Market Research Prod. Manager, Strategy and Insights, Reputation Marketing Insights
jobs.description:
Your primary responsibility as a Product Manager on the Reputation Marketing & Insights (RMI) team will be to work with the product lead on the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of Amazon's content testing research program as a product. You will define what this research product measures, how creative and messaging insights are delivered to and adopted by stakeholders, and how the program evolves to meet changing business needs. You own the research capability and its output — the methodology, insights pipeline, and decision-making guidance it produces — while deploying and managing research vendors and third-party testing platforms as tooling rather than owning the technology itself.
The work will challenge you to be resourceful, think big while staying connected to the details, drive cross-functional alignment, and embrace a high degree of change and ambiguity at speed. The scope and scale of what we strive to achieve is immense, but it is also meaningful and energizing. This is an individual contributor role.
The right candidate possesses endless curiosity and passion for understanding perceptions and what drives them. You have proficiency in diving deep into large amounts of data and combining multiple data points to translate research into actionable insights and recommendations. You have a track record of making smart trade-offs, building alignment across teams with competing priorities, and driving crisp decisions when information is incomplete. You are an excellent communicator who can provide status updates, escalate issues, and align stakeholders through written documents, presentations, and other internal communication channels. You are a creative problem-solver who seeks to deeply understand business and communications strategy so you can shape research that informs stakeholder decision-making and messaging tactics.

Key Job Responsibilities
• Partner with the product lead on the product strategy and roadmap for the content testing research program — determining what to measure, how to deliver insights, and what to test next
• Own the end-to-end lifecycle of the content testing offering — from stakeholder management, input gathering, and research design through delivery, adoption measurement, and iteration
• Own the content testing intake queue as a product backlog, prioritizing and making smart trade-offs between depth and speed when demand exceeds capacity
• Own the analytic output and reporting standards that enable stakeholders to make go/no-go decisions with confidence; interpret results into clear, timely guidance
• Own the content testing insights repository and periodic meta-analyses that surface cross-test-round learnings and scale them across the RMI team and broader stakeholders
• Define success metrics that distinguish outputs (tests delivered) from outcomes (stakeholder adoption, measurable improvements in creative and campaign performance)
• Scale the program across CCR and partner teams; educate internal teams on best practices for content testing
• In partnership with product lead, continuously simplify and improve the research product: intake processes, reporting templates, tracking systems, and documentation standards

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager, Enforcement Strategy, Amazon Flex SLS
jobs.description:
At Amazon, we're looking for a Sr. Program Manager for Amazon Flex. Amazon Flex works directly with independent contractors – called delivery partners – to make deliveries to our customers. With Amazon Flex, individuals can now be their own boss delivering Amazon packages. Amazon Flex is powered by a mobile app that works in concert with our advanced logistics systems that allows delivery partners to on-board, schedule delivery times, guide them through their deliveries with in-app mapping and navigation, and more.

The Sr. Program Manager will own the design and execution of evaluation and enforcement frameworks for delivery partners at scale. You will build mechanisms that prevent defects across station and on-road operations — identifying root causes, fixing underlying process failures, and ensuring recurrence does not happen. This includes continuous improvement of how delivery partners receive guidance, how delivery history is surfaced, and how corrective actions are applied consistently across the network.

This role requires troubleshooting, root cause identification, problem-solving, analytical reasoning, and the ability to operate in a fast-paced environment. You will partner cross-functionally with Operations, Legal, and senior leadership (Directors and VPs) to drive technology enhancements, process redesign, policy recalibration, and enforcement governance.

Key job responsibilities
- Manage the full lifecycle of complex cross-functional programs with considerable impact across multiple organizations, developing overall program strategy and tactically driving teams inside and outside your organization to deliver results
- Establish and maintain scalable mechanisms for Service Level Standards (SLS) evaluation processes, including reporting systems, quality metrics, and mitigation processes that maintain program quality and exceptional customer experiences
- Analyze defect data from multiple sources to identify patterns, uncover root causes, and implement mitigation programs that reduce repeat defect rates
- Define program mission, vision, and tenets; set objectives; and drive improvements that are quantified with metrics
- Partner with customers and cross-functional stakeholders to determine project priorities, allocate resources, and resolve ambiguous problems — proactively identifying and mitigating risks before they become roadblocks
- Oversee gaps between teams, processes, and systems; reduce exposure to classic failure modes
- Write and present effective narratives to Directors and VPs, manage executive escalations, and drive consensus across diverse teams
- Work autonomously in an ambiguous environment, seeking to understand business problems, automation limitations, and process enhancement requirements

A day in the life
Your day revolves around analyzing delivery defect data trends and working across teams to improve quality outcomes. You'll dive into defect patterns across Under-the-Roof, On-the-Road, Customer Doorstep, and Return to Station touchpoints, collaborating with Operations and tech teams to understand issues. You'll spend time building dashboards and reporting mechanisms, responding to escalations, and meeting with cross-functional partners including Legal and senior leadership to align on enforcement strategies. You'll also dedicate time to ensuring solutions scale effectively across geographies and business lines.

- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
- Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables & charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)

- Knowledge of general AI tools

jobs.title: Sr. Finance Manager, Amazon Leo Finance
jobs.description:
Amazon Leo is building the world's most advanced low Earth orbit satellite network, delivering fast, affordable broadband to enterprise and consumer customers globally. This is one of the most ambitious infrastructure programs in Amazon's history — combining satellite manufacturing, silicon development, global supply chain, terrestrial infrastructure, and enterprise technology at unprecedented scale. Leo Infrastructure Finance is at the center of it all.

The successful candidate will have effective analytical and communication skills, with an ability to build and articulate financial results and analytical insights to executive level business and finance leaders. You will be entrepreneurial by nature as Leo has a start-up mentality, analytical in approach, have a demonstrated ability to develop financial models that provide intelligence for business decisions and be able to leverage your project management skills to lead simultaneous workstreams. This role requires a self-starter with superb business partnering skills, a keen attention to detail, ability to work in a fast-paced environment with a high degree of ambiguity, and a track record of deep financial analysis. The candidate must have the aptitude to incorporate new approaches and methodologies (including statistical concepts) while dealing with big data, be able to develop and define key business questions and to build data sets that answer those questions.

This role leads the financial architecture, cost accounting, and controllership functions for Amazon Leo's satellite manufacturing operations. The Senior Finance Manager serves as the principal finance partner to manufacturing site leadership, building financial processes, systems, and governance structures in a complex, multi-site production environment. This is an opportunity to build rather than inherit—designing the controllership framework that will scale with production ramp and site expansion.

Key job responsibilities
Controllership:
The Senior Finance Manager manages the income statement and balance sheet of the manufacturing business, monitoring and tracking, cost accruals, tangible assets, monthly close, and all items with material impact on business KPIs. The role monitors free cash flow including working capital drivers and other assets and liabilities. This leader supports adherence to Amazon's financial internal controls through regular monitoring and auditing, drives culture change in developing awareness of how internal controls impact business practices, and ensures compliance with documented financial directives including support of annual internal controls assessment campaigns.

Cost Accounting & Inventory Management:
This leader owns component-to-finished-good cost accounting across complex product structures, from raw component through final satellite assembly, integration, and testing. Responsibilities include managing production variance analysis across high-mix, volume components and standardized platforms, establishing inventory valuation methods for long-lead components, sub-assemblies, and high-value work-in-progress, and leading the financial governance of engineering change orders and their impact on material costs. The role develops and maintains engineered standards, work measurement systems, labor performance metrics, learning curve analysis, and cost estimating methodologies that drive manufacturing cost accountability from the program level down to individual work centers.

Financial Planning, Reporting & Performance Management:
This role creates and executes the Annual Operating Plans and quarterly forecasts in accordance with corporate schedules and governance. The Senior Finance Manager delivers meaningful variance analysis for monthly and quarterly business reviews, providing a coherent business narrative that drives corrective actions. Responsibilities include developing manufacturing cost center budgets, labor forecasts, and program support estimates. The role builds cost and performance management systems measuring labor utilization, manufacturing efficiency/yield, budget performance, cost performance, schedule performance, forecast accuracy, and resource utilization—creating the reporting framework that ensures transparency between operational execution and financial outcomes.

Strategic Partnership & Operational Decision-Making:
The Senior Finance Manager serves as the primary financial advisor to the site operations leadership team, providing strategic guidance on cost management, capital investments, and operational efficiencies. This includes analyzing results, explaining business trends, and recommending improvements. The role partners with plant managers, supply chain leaders, and business on capital investment analysis, productivity initiatives, cost reduction programs, and manufacturing process improvements. The leader provides clear and accurate financial guidance to leaders both on-site and across the broader organization, enabling optimal business decisions at every level.

Capital Planning & Investment Governance:
The role evaluates and prioritizes capital investment opportunities in manufacturing facilities and equipment, leading financial due diligence for new projects and ensuring alignment with ROI and payback criteria. This includes financial oversight and capital expenditure tracking, monitoring adherence to approved budgets, and supporting productivity initiatives that drive return on invested capital across the manufacturing footprint.

New Factory Financial Architecture & Launch Strategy:
The Senior Finance Manager develops the complete financial architecture for the manufacturing site, including labor-routing models, overhead absorption structures, and rate frameworks from inception. This includes modeling production ramp-up phases to analyze capacity constraints, cash flow implications, and break-even timelines. The role evaluates capital expenditure for automated assembly, cleanroom infrastructure, and advanced testing systems, partnering with engineering and supply chain teams to establish target costing and make-versus-buy frameworks that optimize the cost structure across satellite platforms.

ERP & Systems Leadership:
The Senior Finance Manager serves as the principal finance stakeholder for enterprise ERP and Manufacturing Execution System implementation. This includes designing the Chart of Accounts, cost centers, and work breakdown structures that form the digital financial backbone. The role automates inventory tracking, standard cost rollups, and material issuance within the manufacturing execution thread, and builds real-time financial dashboards and operational reporting tools that translate complex factory data into actionable business intelligence for site leadership.

Team Leadership & Development:
The Senior Finance Manager mentors and develops team members, fostering a continuous improvement environment. The role trains and supervises staff, interacts with peers to share ideas and develop best practices across the organization, and leads change management initiatives to improve site-level accounting, analysis, and financial decision-making capability.
Basic qualifications:
- 12+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
- 5+ years of positions that require analysis and reporting financial results experience
- 5+ years of applying key financial performance indicators (KPIs) to analyses experience
- 5+ years of building financial and operational reports/data sets that inform business decision-making experience
- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting or related field
- 10+ years of spearheading strategic cross-functional initiatives that deliver measurable financial results and advance organizational objectives experience
- 10+ years of dissecting financial data and identifying patterns that support business strategy experience
Preferred qualifications:
- 5+ years of hiring, leading and developing teams experience
- 8+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience
- 8+ years of identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan experience
- MBA, or CPA

jobs.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Do you have the passion to work in the AWS Water industry with a focus on water stewardship and sustainability efforts? Do you have the industry background, technical depth, and business development skills needed to help further establish AWS as the leader in the water industry?
Amazon is seeking a self-starter to join the AWS Water team in pioneering the future for data center water supply in how AWS delivers water projects and partners with water utilities/companies across the United States.

In this role, you will manage multiple, large scale and technically complex water infrastructure projects across multiple geographies in the central and southern US regions by facilitating close collaboration between both internal and external stakeholders. Internally, responsibilities include large portfolio project management, reporting status, risks, mitigations and successes to leadership, as well as influencing multiple cross-functional partner teams in the overall data center water delivery business process. Externally, this role takes ownership of managing utility relationships, and contracting with the utility and/or Owner’s Engineer. The individual will be part of an integrated team to implement a fast scaling portfolio of water infrastructure projects that meets and exceeds AWS’ water program requirements, ultimately delivering projects on time, with tangible reliability and cost-saving results.

The ideal candidate will have both a business and a technology background with demonstrated experience working with utilities and earning customer trust.

Key job responsibilities
- Support the development and execution of our water supply and infrastructure strategy for AWS data centers in multiple parts of the Americas
- Work collaboratively with Amazon Infrastructure teams to support the development of strategic water sourcing opportunities for large-scale, multi-year development projects
- Develop and negotiate terms for water and wastewater supply contracts with public and private utilities.
- Analyze trends and regulations in the water space to proactively identify opportunities that benefit AWS or the datacenter industry.
- Work with utility regulators to develop policies and guidelines that enable broader AWS strategies and objectives that support growth and development and water sustainability programming.
- Manage water projects against plans and objectives to ensure commitments are met, delivering against cost savings goals.
- Be a passionate self-starter.

- Up to 30% travel requirements for project planning/delivery.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

- 5+ years cultivating strong relationships with diverse set of internal and externals stakeholders and ability to communicate key messages to leadership.
- Experience building relationships and working with industry stakeholders, such as utilities and regional planning agencies

- Understanding of mechanical cooling systems and data center designs

jobs.title: Finance Manager, Customer Operations Strategy, Amazon Leo
jobs.description:
Amazon Leo is seeking an experienced Finance Manager to drive financial strategy and cost optimization across our global Customer Operations organization. This role is central to our mission of delivering fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities worldwide through our constellation of Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellites.

As a member of our Global Customer Operations (GCOPS) Finance team, you will own high-impact cost lines that directly influence Leo's customer experience economics – including post-sale cost management, financial modeling for emerging service lines, and strategic analysis that shapes leadership decision-making. You will partner directly with senior operational leaders to translate complex customer behavior data into actionable financial strategies.

This role offers the rare opportunity to build financial frameworks from the ground up for a business scaling toward commercial launch – combining the analytical rigor of cost controllership with the strategic influence of business partnership.

Key job responsibilities
- Build and own financial models for one or more customer operations cost domains – including customer service, concessions, bad debt, or adjacent operational cost lines – with full accountability for forecasting accuracy and variance analysis

- Partner with senior operational leaders to translate customer behavior metrics, service quality data, and operational KPIs into financial impact analysis and actionable recommendations

- Drive cost optimization initiatives by identifying root causes of cost leakage, quantifying improvement opportunities, and building the financial business case for investment decisions

- Lead financial analysis for strategic decisions – vendor pricing evaluations, make-vs-buy tradeoffs, outsourcing economics, and new market entry cost modeling

- Develop financial frameworks for emerging cost categories as Leo scales – building processes that don't exist yet rather than inheriting established playbooks

- Own annual and long-range planning cycle deliverables for your domains – including cost loads, rate card development, and executive-ready narratives

- Quantify Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) impact of operational initiatives and build the financial case for defect reduction and customer retention investments

- Contribute to Leo-wide strategic planning – multi-year investment modeling, scenario analysis, and executive presentations that span Leo's global business

A day in the life
You might start your morning analyzing a spike in concessions data, segmenting by customer type and channel to pinpoint the root cause. Mid-morning, you're stress-testing a scenario model for bad debt exposure in a new market. After lunch, you present cost optimization findings to senior leadership – highlighting savings from a vendor renegotiation you identified and modeled. Later, you join a cross-functional session to quantify the financial impact of defect elimination candidates. Before wrapping up, you coordinate with the strategic planning team on how your domain fits into the consolidated P&L narrative.

About the team
You'll join the Global Customer Operations (GCOPS) Finance team within Amazon Leo – one of two finance teams led by this manager, alongside the Commercial Strategy & Planning (CS&P) team. Together, the teams span field services, customer support, cost of payments, bad debt, and multi-year strategic planning across the world, with members in Bellevue/Seattle and London. As Leo scales toward commercial launch, you'll shape frameworks that balance operational efficiency with exceptional customer experience.
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business, economics, or a related analytical field (e.g., engineering, math, computer science)
- 5+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
- 5+ years of building financial and operational reports/data sets that inform business decision-making experience
- 5+ years of leading cross-functional initiatives that drive financial performance and strategy experience
- 5+ years of dissecting financial data and identifying patterns that support business strategy experience
- Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.
Preferred qualifications:
- Knowledge of SQL/ETL
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)
- Experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, and data interpretation of results
- 5+ years of solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits) experience
- Understanding of subscription-based business models and customer lifetime value frameworks
- Experience with cost-per-contact analysis, handle time optimization, and workforce management metrics
- Background in bad debt management, concessions/refund analysis, or payment operations finance

jobs.title: Sr. Energy Strategy Manager, AWS Energy Team
jobs.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon is seeking a self-starter to join the AWS Energy team in pioneering the future for data center utility power by developing and executing the strategy by which AWS delivers energy projects and partners with electric utilities and energy companies across the Americas. This individual will define the end to end (generation, transmission, distribution, backup power) power strategy for scaling and operating AWS’ diverse, low-cost energy supply. In this role, you will manage multiple, large scale and technically complex power infrastructure projects across multiple geographies by facilitating close collaboration between both internal and external stakeholders. Within the overarching strategy, this individual must be resilient in exploring and discovering new supply opportunities (that delivery both near term capacity with an accelerated path to net-zero carbon supply), ultimately converting them into tactically sound and executable energy projects while working to reduce energy capital and operating expenses. Internally, responsibilities outside of implementing the defined strategy include reporting status, risks, mitigations and successes to C level and VP level leadership, as well as influencing multiple cross-functional partner teams in the overall data center capacity delivery business process. Externally, this role takes ownership of managing utility interactions, coordinating efforts between real estate, engineering and planning teams in site evaluation, project engineering, scheduling and budgeting, including influencing and contracting with the utility, EPC and/or Owner’s Engineer to meet AWS’ needs. The individual will work in an integrated team to implement a strategy that meets and exceeds AWS’ energy program requirements while delivering projects on time, with tangible reliability and cost-saving results.

The ideal candidate will possess a strong energy background and a proven track record of developing and delivering on innovative energy projects. Experience working with regulated electric utilities to develop, contract and deliver medium and high voltage power infrastructure, including related tariffs and supply agreements, is a must. In this role, you will negotiate and execute power supply contracts across AWS regions and create innovative supply structures that integrate our renewable energy portfolio and Support the growth of clean energy via utility partnerships. The right candidate will have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about the business, operations, and technical challenges, with the skill-set to drive tactical execution of project schedules, contracts, initiatives and team goals.

The candidate must have experience in reliably driving initiatives to completion in high speed, constrained and ambiguous environments, with practice in escalating and reporting to many organization leaders and teams across multiple levels. By establishing and growing business and technical relationships, and managing the day-to-day interactions with these partners, you will be responsible for ensuring energy requirements needed to support AWS’s global infrastructure expansion are met.

Key job responsibilities
• Lead the development and execution of a comprehensive utilities strategy for AWS data centers for AMER regions.
• Manage multiple Utilities, EPC and Owner's Engineers to deliver MV and HV power infrastructure, including negotiations and contracting.
• Develop and execute energy strategies that leverage capital projects (utility grid connections, high voltage substations, energy storage, etc) to reduce long term energy costs. Manage capital budgets for electrical infrastructure and energy projects.
• Work collaboratively with Amazon CFE/RE team to support the development of strategic energy sourcing opportunities
• Execute electricity supply contracts that create new clean energy capacity on the grid (through utilities), reduce cost, minimize risk and leverage opportunities that benefit Amazon
• Manage a portfolio of complex energy projects
• Collaborate with internal teams and regulated utilities on the implementation and management of energy projects to meet the business timelines.
• Identify and develop innovative cost savings projects (capital and operational) and initiatives related to energy infrastructure and supply.
• Responsible for completing due diligence on in-market opportunities and developing those opportunities into cost savings for the business.
• Work with utility regulators to develop policies and guidelines that enable broader AWS strategies and objectives.

A day in the life
Think like a group CEO of Generation, transmission, distribution and backup power companies. We are the ones who are developing the Vision, Strategy and Execution plan of what the future looks like and helping every one in the Energy Value chain to do things differently.

About the team
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Basic qualifications:
- 3+ years of power transaction or contracting experience in US energy markets (preference for ERCOT, SPP & MISO), performing financial models and analysis on rates and energy cost, negotiation interconnection agreements and related contracts with utilities and contractors
Preferred qualifications:
- Master’s Degree (MBA) preferred
- Experience planning, engineering, developing or constructing substations or other 34.5kV or greater energy infrastructure
- Experience evaluating and implementing innovative infrastructure and operational strategies within the energy sector, such as energy storage, demand response, fuel cells, etc.
- Experience working directly with public utility commissions and other energy regulators
- Experience with IT infrastructure, data centers and cloud services

The Global Real Estate and Facilities (GREF) team provides real estate transaction expertise, business partnering, occupancy planning, capital investment management, workplace strategy and facility operations for Amazon’s corporate office portfolio globally. This role is on the GREF Business Partnering (GBP) team who’s overarching purpose is to create a bridge between each business unit and GREF to align real estate strategies in support of business objectives. As a Manager on GREF’s Business Partnering team, you will serve as a Business Partner (BP) for AI and Security business units, working with the org's and GREF’s senior leaders.

- Partner with GREF teams and external stakeholders to drive the successful development, implementation, and execution of GREF and business strategies across organizations and regions
- Provide thought leadership, industry best practices and market insights to business leadership to inform recommendations and decisions

You'll develop plans and strategies that align with AI and Security headcount, specialty space (i.e., labs), and location requirements globally. These will be created and approved in partnership with AI/Security leadership, business finance and GREF cross-functional stakeholders.

Own project management and problem solving for compliance and risk related issues.

jobs.title: Sr Program Manager, Retail Business Services
jobs.description:
Senior Program Manager, Purchase – Retail Business Services
We are seeking a Senior Program Manager to lead strategy and execution for Shopping Mission Completion, ensuring customers can seamlessly discover, evaluate, and purchase products across the Amazon store.

About Amazon
Amazon.com, Inc. seeks to be Earth's most customer-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they might want to buy online, and endeavors to offer its customers the widest of selection at low price that drives Amazon’s flywheel.

About the Team
The vision of Retail Business Services (RBS) Organization at Amazon is to accelerate Amazon’s flywheel by improving customer experience and enabling our Selling Partners (SPs) to grow their business with Amazon. RBS provides catalog augmentation and correction technologies for the Amazon selling community. Our solutions ensure information in Amazon's catalogs is both complete and comprehensive enough to give our customers a great shopping experience every time.

Role Overview
RBS is looking for a Senior Program Manager to lead a Strategy for Shopping Mission Completion for Customers. Amazon Store Walk analysis uncovers critical defects across the Amazon shopping journey; spanning across product discovery, evaluation, and purchase completion. These systemic problems impact the customer shopping journey, from how customers discover and evaluate products to their ability to complete purchases. These issues are categorized into four key defect themes: Data, Search, Catalog and Customer Experience. To resolve these issues, we recommend a coordinated, cross-functional engagement with partner teams that will improve overall customer shopping experience . This role will be at the center of collaboration between multiple world wide teams in re-imagining the purchase experience for customers.

Key job responsibilities
Shopping Mission is an essential part of the consumer experience and can fundamentally influence the way customers shop on Amazon as well as shape their perception of Amazon.
As a Senior Program Manager - Purchase, you will
- Think Big and own vision for building a Strategy that enables customers to complete their shopping journey.
- Disambiguate the problem space and size the problem and opportunity for RBS
- Be responsible for end-to-end business strategy, goal setting, program management, review and collaboration mechanisms.
- Break down ambiguous problems into clear abstract use cases and solution workflows for Tech and Product teams.
- Be responsible for end to end program management with multiple parallel tasks.
- Establish accountability with partner teams and influence them without authority on a common goals.
- Identify risks and develop strategies to mitigate them.
- Be responsible for reporting and review mechanisms and communication to Leadership (Flash updates, WBR, QBR, Deep dives)

To be successful in this role, you should be comfortable and confident liaising with remote global teams in business, design and technology at senior leadership levels. You will solve ambiguous problems and proactively identify and mitigate risks (before they become roadblocks). You will be data-driven and demonstrate good judgment in how and when to escalate (without damaging relationships).

Representing the voice of customers, you will be an evangelist for the program vision, maintaining support for your cause, keeping engineering teams energized and excited, and driving your program roadmap at all levels. You will be very comfortable with written communication skills and a proven track record of delivering projects from concept to launch.

About the team
The 'Shopping Mission' program is part of the Customer Experience vertical of RBS. The program is responsible for defining the Vision and long term strategy of improving Customer Experience through improving the quality of Amazon products. RBS is the global sponsor of the program, bringing together multiple world-wide product, design and engineering teams to execute in a federated manner.
Basic qualifications:
- 5+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- 5+ years of delivering cross functional projects experience
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
Preferred qualifications:
- 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
