jobs.title: Energy Strategy Manager, AWS Infrastructure Energy Team
jobs.description:
Australia's cloud infrastructure is expanding at pace, and the demand for reliable, cost-effective power has never been greater. As an Energy Strategy Manager in AWS's APAC Energy team, you'll be at the center of this growth, leading the connection of data centers to the electricity grid in Melbourne and navigating one of the most dynamic energy markets in the world.
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain, and we're looking for talented people who want to help.
In this role, you'll work with utilities, regulators, and local authorities to deliver high-voltage transmission and substation infrastructure on time, on budget, and to specification. You'll manage grid compliance across a growing portfolio of sites, structure and negotiate energy contracts, and develop strategies that keep pace with Australia's evolving regulatory landscape as the grid decarbonizes and decentralizes.
This role offers the opportunity to shape how AWS connects to the Australian grid at scale, balancing rapid infrastructure expansion with technical compliance and long-term energy strategy. If you're energized by the intersection of energy infrastructure and technology and want to work on problems that directly enable the next generation of cloud services, we'd like to hear from you.

This role is based in Melbourne. 10% travel may be required.

Key job responsibilities
• Serve as the single-threaded owner for grid connection delivery across AWS data centers in Melbourne, from initial due diligence through energization, directly enabling cloud capacity growth.
• Lead relationships with transmission network service providers (TNSPs), distribution network service providers (DNSPs), and regulators to secure grid capacity and negotiate connection agreements that meet AWS timelines.
• Coordinate across internal teams (Planning, Real Estate, Design, Procurement, Construction, Operations, Finance, and Commissioning) to align power infrastructure delivery with broader site schedules, resolving dependencies and removing blockers.
• Conduct power due diligence for new data center sites, assessing grid capacity, connection feasibility, redundancy requirements, and long-term supply reliability.
• Develop and negotiate utility contracts, energy services agreements (ESAs), and connection agreements, ensuring commercial terms align with AWS standards and regional market conditions.
• Own technical grid compliance across the portfolio, ensuring all connections meet National Electricity Rules (NER), grid codes, and relevant Australian standards.
• Interface with government bodies, market operators (AEMO), and regulatory authorities to obtain approvals, influence policy development, and ensure AWS infrastructure expansion objectives are supported.
• Manage capital budgets for power infrastructure delivery, tracking expenditure against forecasts and identifying cost optimization opportunities.
• Develop strategies to reduce energy costs and improve supply resilience, including assessment of emerging grid technologies, tariff structures, and alternative supply arrangements.

A day in the life
Your morning might start with a call to a network service provider, working through connection application timelines or resolving a technical query with the design engineering team for a new substation. By midday, you're reviewing grid compliance documentation with the design team, ensuring submissions to AEMO align with National Electricity Rules. In the afternoon, you could be negotiating commercial terms on an energy services agreement or presenting a capital expenditure forecast to finance stakeholders.
You'll manage multiple concurrent projects at different stages of delivery, from early-stage site due diligence through to energization. No two days look the same, but the thread that connects them is ensuring AWS has the grid capacity it needs, when it needs it, to support growth across Melbourne.

About the team
The APAC Energy & Water team is a multi-disciplinary group covering energy, water, energy procurement, carbon free energy, and strategic partnerships, all working to keep AWS data centers powered, cooled, and connected across the region. This role sits within the energy function, where you'll be part of a team that thrives on solving complex infrastructure problems, building strong utility relationships, and finding creative ways to bring power to some of the most ambitious projects in the country. We work hard, we back each other, and we genuinely enjoy what we do.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

- 6+ years of solving problems with technology in the Energy & Utilities industries experience
- Bachelor's degree, or 5+ years of directly managing and being responsible for multiple large projects experience
- Experience with budgeting, scheduling and cost/benefit analysis
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience in working directly with government officials and regulatory bodies
- Experience in data centers, infrastructure service providers, or related technology companies
- Experience in one of project management, planning, engineering, developing or constructing substations or other 66kV or greater energy infrastructure
- High level technical understanding of MV & HV Transmission Line and substation, with familiarity of local grid code, grid connectivity procedures, grid application procedures and roles and responsibilities, standards of performance of Distribution/Transmission Utilities

- Experience with grid technical compliance frameworks, performance standards and transmission network connection agreements
- Ability to manage complex and/or multiple simultaneous projects requiring frequent communication, strong organization, time management, and problem-solving skills capable of building strategic working relationships with internal and external stakeholders
- Ability to self-start and self-motivate in a dynamic environment with partial information and high levels of ambiguity which requires looking around corners to deliver results for the business

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager, Inbound Strategy, Long Term Network Planning
jobs.description:
Amazon's Inbound Long Term Planning team owns the topology framework that decides what the EU inbound network looks like in 2–3 years: which node types we build, where we place them, how they interact, and what inventory configuration they unlock. This role owns a critical slice of that framework — taking speed ambitions and placement targets and working backwards into the physical network design across 1DCs, RDCs, and IXDs that makes them achievable. It's the kind of problem where getting the answer right saves hundreds of millions of dollars; getting it wrong means we either over-invest or structurally cap our speed ceiling for years.

You'll work at the intersection of network topology, inventory science, and capital allocation — partnering deeply with Finance, IIPO, AIM, and business teams to determine the optimal long-term node configuration that delivers placement targets per outbound node type and selection cohort. This is a single-threaded role with high ambiguity and regular exposure to senior leadership across SCOT, Operations, and Finance.

Key job responsibilities
Key Job Responsibilities

- Own the long-term inbound topology framework — determine the optimal combination of node types, locations, and capacities that achieves placement targets at minimum total cost.

- Define network configuration per selection cohort — decide velocity demarcations between node types, regional zoning, and upstream storage share. Know when the model breaks and why.
- Build the multi-year inbound build plan — sequence node launches, size them against volume trajectories, and own the placement and inventory commitments that justify the investment.
- Resolve structural trade-offs that don't have clean owners. Frame options, quantify impact, and drive decisions when priorities across teams or geographies conflict.
- Align senior leadership to a single answer. Write the strategy documents that SCOT, Finance, IIPO, and Operations commit to. When priorities diverge, you reconcile.

- Experience in program or project management
- Experience in supply chain
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Strategy and Planning - Global Road Safety, Global Road Safety
jobs.description:
Amazon's Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) organization is seeking a Senior Manager to lead Strategy and Planning for the company’s critical Global Road Safety (GRS) team. Global Road Safety owns measuring, reporting, and improving on-road safety performance across Amazon's worldwide delivery and transportation operations, a network that moves millions of packages daily and touches every community we serve.
This leader will own the strategic planning function for road safety: setting the multi-year direction, building the planning mechanisms, authoring the executive-level documents, and ensuring that Amazon's road safety strategy is cohesive, data-driven, and connected to operational execution. You will be the connective tissue between GRS leadership, regional safety teams, operations, engineering, tech, program management, public policy, and finance — synthesizing inputs from across the organization into a unified strategy that is presented at the highest levels of the company.
You will build and lead a team of strategy and planning professionals, set the vision for how GRS plans and communicates its strategic priorities, and hold the organization accountable to published plans. You will own monthly, quarterly, and annual leadership reviews covering GRS performance and strategic direction, including S-team and board-level content. jobs.title: Sr. Energy Strategy Manager, AWS Energy Team
jobs.description:
Amazon is seeking a self-starter to join the AWS Energy team in pioneering the future for data center utility power by developing and executing the strategy by which AWS delivers energy projects and partners with electric utilities and energy companies across the Americas. This individual will define the end to end (generation, transmission, distribution, backup power) power strategy for scaling and operating AWS’ diverse, low-cost energy supply. In this role, you will manage multiple, large scale and technically complex power infrastructure projects across multiple geographies by facilitating close collaboration between both internal and external stakeholders. Within the overarching strategy, this individual must be resilient in exploring and discovering new supply opportunities (that delivery both near term capacity with an accelerated path to net-zero carbon supply), ultimately converting them into tactically sound and executable energy projects while working to reduce energy capital and operating expenses. Internally, responsibilities outside of implementing the defined strategy include reporting status, risks, mitigations and successes to C level and VP level leadership, as well as influencing multiple cross-functional partner teams in the overall data center capacity delivery business process. Externally, this role takes ownership of managing utility interactions, coordinating efforts between real estate, engineering and planning teams in site evaluation, project engineering, scheduling and budgeting, including influencing and contracting with the utility, EPC and/or Owner’s Engineer to meet AWS’ needs. The individual will work in an integrated team to implement a strategy that meets and exceeds AWS’ energy program requirements while delivering projects on time, with tangible reliability and cost-saving results.

The ideal candidate will possess a strong energy background and a proven track record of developing and delivering on innovative energy projects. Experience working with regulated electric utilities to develop, contract and deliver medium and high voltage power infrastructure, including related tariffs and supply agreements, is a must. In this role, you will negotiate and execute power supply contracts across AWS regions and create innovative supply structures that integrate our renewable energy portfolio and Support the growth of clean energy via utility partnerships. The right candidate will have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about the business, operations, and technical challenges, with the skill-set to drive tactical execution of project schedules, contracts, initiatives and team goals.

The candidate must have experience in reliably driving initiatives to completion in high speed, constrained and ambiguous environments, with practice in escalating and reporting to many organization leaders and teams across multiple levels. By establishing and growing business and technical relationships, and managing the day-to-day interactions with these partners, you will be responsible for ensuring energy requirements needed to support AWS’s global infrastructure expansion are met.

Key job responsibilities
• Lead the development and execution of a comprehensive utilities strategy for AWS data centers for AMER regions.
• Manage multiple Utilities, EPC and Owner's Engineers to deliver MV and HV power infrastructure, including negotiations and contracting.
• Develop and execute energy strategies that leverage capital projects (utility grid connections, high voltage substations, energy storage, etc) to reduce long term energy costs. Manage capital budgets for electrical infrastructure and energy projects.
• Work collaboratively with Amazon CFE/RE team to support the development of strategic energy sourcing opportunities
• Execute electricity supply contracts that create new clean energy capacity on the grid (through utilities), reduce cost, minimize risk and leverage opportunities that benefit Amazon
• Manage a portfolio of complex energy projects
• Collaborate with internal teams and regulated utilities on the implementation and management of energy projects to meet the business timelines.
• Identify and develop innovative cost savings projects (capital and operational) and initiatives related to energy infrastructure and supply.
• Responsible for completing due diligence on in-market opportunities and developing those opportunities into cost savings for the business.
• Work with utility regulators to develop policies and guidelines that enable broader AWS strategies and objectives.

A day in the life
Think like a group CEO of Generation, transmission, distribution and backup power companies. We are the ones who are developing the Vision, Strategy and Execution plan of what the future looks like and helping every one in the Energy Value chain to do things differently.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

About AWS

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

- 2+ years managing multiple million dollar power infrastructure contracts with external stakeholders to drive projects to completion

Amazon JapanのSCM部門は、AmazonのEnd-to-EndのFulfillment Networkの中核となるFC (Fulfillment Center：倉庫)のNetwork戦略を担当するSr Program Managerを募集しています。

お客様により早い配送スピードをご提供し、かつOperation Costの適性化を通じてより幅広い商品Selectionをご提供することがJP OperationsのMissionです。そのために、適切な量の在庫をよりお客様に近い場所に配置し、流通過程でのTouch pointと輸送距離の最小化できるNetworkの構築が戦略的に重要なテーマです。このPositionはAmazon Networkの中核であるFCの配置（Topology）に責任を持ち、長期的なVisionの立案と毎年の成長規模を見定めた毎ピークシーズンでのFC　Capacity拡大の投資計画の立案を行います。。そして、入荷、配送スピード、在庫配置、FCオペレーション、幹線輸送、ラストマイル配送といった社内の多様なStakeholderと連携をとることが求められます。またVision達成に向けた新たなNetwork戦略の実現に向けた様々な戦略的InitiativeのProject推進も担います。

FCのCapacityとその配置はNetwork全体のPerformanceに大きな影響を与えるだけではなく、その投資規模から全体のCostへの影響が大きいこともあり、非常に重要な役割を果たすことが期待されます。そのため、活躍していただける方の要件としては以下を想定しています。

・戦略立案に向けた抽象度の高い課題を整理し、Data drivenでより具体的な解決に導いていける方
・新しい取り組みや変化を前向きに捉え、常に自分事として主体的に課題解決やアクションに取り組める方
・社内外のStakeholderと協力し合い、議論を通じてより良い解決策に導いていける方

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

Key job responsibilities
AmazonのFC networkは、取り扱う商品サイズ等で複数に分かれており、このRoleはそのFC Networkのいくつかを担当します。1-4年先という中長期の視点で、まず将来の出荷量と在庫量の需要予測と需要の不確実性に対応できる倉庫のCapacityを確保することに責任を持ちます。同時に、お客様への配送スピード向上とSCMトータルのコストの低減を両立するためのFC Network Design（どこに、どの規模で、どのタイミングで、どのような機能の在庫拠点を配置するか）に責任を持ち、Individual Contributorとして活動します。

具体的には、以下の大きく3つの業務を推進します。
1. FC Network Strategyの立案
・お客様への配送スピードとCost最適化のために、Networkの考え方を常にUpdateし続ける必要があります。Fulfillment Networkそれぞれにおける変化やNW visionの新しい方向性を踏まえて、最適なFC Networkの在り方をFinancialなどの具体的な数字に基づいて提案します。
2．中長期でのFC Capacity Planning
・将来の需要予測に基づき、FCの準備に必要な期間とその間の需要の不確実性（上振れ、下振れ）を考慮し、FC Capacityの増設とその投資計画を策定します。
・FC新設の意思決定を行うタイミングで、その投資の財務インパクトを財務部門とともに計算し、経営層に投資提案を行います。
3．プロジェクト推進
・新しい戦略を具体的なものにするためのInitiative、例えば既存FCの統廃合や位置づけの変更、全く新しい機能の倉庫の設置といったProjectを推進します。

A day in the life
このRoleは、SCM部門のTopology ＆ Capacity Planningチームの一員として活動します。

主な仕事とそのサイクルは以下の通りです。
・FC Capacity Planning：需要予測に基づいて、FC Capacity Planと投資計画を作成して、Leardershipの承認を得ます。
・ピークに向けて必要なタイミングで実際にFC拡張、増設の投資を実行するかどうかの意思決定を行います。これは投資規模によりGlobal Leadershipの承認を必要とします。
・常に新しいNetworkの考え方を反映したり、Costやサービス改善のためのInitiativeの対応を行い、必要に応じてLeadershipのAlighment、承認を得ます。

日常で関係する部門は多岐にわたり、各部門と調整の核としての役割が期待されます。主な関係先は以下の通り
・需要予測とSCM最適化Technology（インド、シアトル）
・Engineering
・SCM他チーム（S&OP、Speed、在庫配置、入荷NW等）
・輸送管理
・不動産管理
・財務
・各カテゴリーの販売、マーケティング部門

About the team
本ポジションはAmazon JapanのSCM部門の中でCapacity Planningチームの一員として活動します。当チームは中長期での視点で入荷・在庫・出荷の需要予測を行い、お客様に豊富な品揃え、十分な在庫量そして素早い配送スピードで商品をお届けできるように、適切なタイミングで、適切な場所に、適切な規模で倉庫を準備するすることが主な役割です。この業務を通じて、お客様の購買体験の向上と倉庫投資における投資対効果を最大化する重要な役割を担っています。当チームは、日本のオペレーション部門の中でも最も遠い将来を見て仕事をしているのが特徴です。

部門・職種紹介
・所属部門: サプライチェーンマネジメント(SCM)・ミドルマイル
・職種: プロジェクトマネジメント
・勤務地: 東京オフィス

- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Business level English and Japanese language in both writing and speaking.
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience in supply chain

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager III, Audits and Insights Team
jobs.description:
Role Overview
The Audit Strategy & Governance Manager will serve as the strategic architect for AIT's planning, governance, and executive reporting mechanisms. This role owns the development and execution of multi-year strategic planning (3YP), annual operating plans (OP1/OP2), quarterly business reviews (QBRs), and director-level deep-dive analyses. The position drives organizational excellence through standardized mechanisms, automation, and innovation across the AIT organization.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Planning & Governance
• Lead the development and execution of AIT's 3-Year Plan (3YP), OP1, and OP2 planning cycles, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and stakeholder commitments
• Own the quarterly business review (QBR) process, delivering executive-ready narratives that connect operational metrics to strategic outcomes
• Design and maintain standardized governance mechanisms across AIT programs, ensuring consistency in planning, reporting, and decision-making frameworks
• Partner with leadership to define and refine kingpin goals, establishing clear measurement frameworks and success criteria
Executive Reporting & Analytics
• Build and maintain executive-level reporting infrastructure that provides VP and Director-level visibility into key performance metrics, strategic initiatives, and program health
• Prepare concise, high-judgment narratives and recommendations for senior leadership reviews, translating complex operational data into actionable insights
• Conduct director-level deep-dive analyses on critical business questions, identifying root causes and recommending data-backed solutions
• Develop measurement frameworks and KPIs to track audit effectiveness, ROI, and stakeholder influence
Automation & Innovation
• Lead the development and implementation of comprehensive reporting automation pipelines to establish "one source of truth" for AIT reporting
• Partner with technical teams to streamline data collection, automate reporting processes, and eliminate manual overhead
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives that leverage technology and innovation to scale governance mechanisms
• Identify opportunities to standardize and automate cross-functional reporting and planning processes
Stakeholder Management & Communication
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Operations, Analytics, Policy, Technology, Risk, Compliance, and Internal Audit to align goals and ensure effective communication
• Support teams in navigating ambiguous situations with clear, data-backed judgment and strategic guidance
• Build strong relationships with business leaders to understand strategic priorities and translate them into actionable plans
• Ensure transparency and alignment across all organizational levels through effective communication of progress, risks, and performance metrics

Key job responsibilities
Key Competencies
• Strategic Thinking: Ability to connect tactical execution to long-term strategic vision
• Executive Presence: Comfort presenting to and influencing senior leadership
• Data-Driven Decision Making: Strong analytical judgment with ability to derive insights from complex datasets
• Innovation Mindset: Proactive problem-solver who anticipates issues and implements creative solutions
• Bias for Action: Ability to work independently, drive results, and seek guidance as needed
• Ownership: Takes end-to-end accountability for strategic planning and governance outcomes

About the team
Amazon.com strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. The AIT (Audits & Insights Team) serves as a strategic partner in protecting revenue, mitigating risk, and scaling with platform growth. The team has evolved from a reactive compliance function into a proactive strategic enabler, driving precision-led enforcement, intelligence-augmented auditing, and seller advocacy across Amazon's marketplace.
The Audit Strategy & Governance Manager will work closely with AIT leadership, program managers, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure the organization operates with strategic clarity, operational excellence, and data-driven decision-making.
Basic qualifications:
- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
Preferred qualifications:
- 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

jobs.title: Business Strategy & Merchandising Manager, Consumer Electronics, Hardlines
jobs.description:
■ このポジションについて

Amazonの「変革とチャレンジに挑み続けるチーム」で、パソコン・家電カテゴリーの事業成長をリードしませんか。

私たちPC/CEチームは、トップダウンの指示を待つのではなく、メンバー一人ひとりが自ら課題を見つけ、チーム全体で変革を起こしていく組織です。社内の関連部門を巻き込みながら、お客様の購買体験を大きく変える数多くのプロジェクトを推進しています。

■ 担当いただく役割

パソコン本体、周辺機器、アクセサリーなどのカテゴリーにおいて、事業責任者（バイヤー）として、以下を主体的に手がけていただきます。

品揃えの最適化 ―― お客様が本当に求める商品ラインナップの構築
売上・利益の最大化 ―― 事業戦略に基づく仕入れ計画の立案と実行
販売計画の策定 ―― ECならではのデータを活用した販売プランニング
販売促進・ブランディング ―― プロモーションやマーケティング施策の企画・実行
裁量を持って一つの事業を動かす、経営に近いポジションです。

■ 事業の魅力とスケール

PC・家電は、Amazonジャパンの中でも大きく、かつ収益性の高い戦略事業領域です。単なる「モノを売る」仕事ではなく、パソコン・カメラ・テレビといった「じっくり検討して購入する高付加価値な商品」を、お客様がより安心して選び、長く使えるようにするための購買体験そのものを設計していきます。

こうした商品は、専門性が高く、価格も高めで、長く使うものだからこそ、お客様は購入前に念入りに情報を集め、購入後のサポートも重視します。この「検討から購入、そしてその後まで」の体験全体を、私たちが変革していきます。

■ 取り組んでいる主なプロジェクト

私たちは、お客様の購買体験を向上させるため、社内外の多様なチーム（国内外の関連事業部、マーケティング、テクノロジーチーム等）と協働し、以下のような施策を展開しています。

おすすめ商品プログラム ―― 数ある商品の中から、お客様の用途にぴったり合う商品を見つけやすくする仕組み（実際に導入したカテゴリーでは購入率が向上）
下取り（Trade-In）サービス ―― 使わなくなった製品を下取りに出して、新しい商品をお得に購入できる体験の拡大
Amazon独自の保証サービス ―― 購入後も安心してお使いいただくための保証プログラム
分割払い（0%金利）の拡充 ―― 高額商品をより購入しやすくする支払い手段の提供
法人向けIT商材の販売拡大 ―― Amazonビジネスと連携した事業拡張
AIの活用 ―― 業務効率化とお客様体験向上の両面での先進的な取り組み

■ このポジションで得られる経験

担当カテゴリーの枠を超えて、事業全体、そしてお客様の購買体験そのものに影響を与えられる、他にはないスケールの大きな環境です。データに基づく意思決定、多部門を巻き込むプロジェクト推進力、そして経営視点での事業マネジメント力を磨くことができます。

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

一緒に、日本のお客様にとって最高の購買体験をつくりませんか?

Key job responsibilities
担当カテゴリーのP&L管理、売上・利益目標の達成
ベンダーとの価格交渉、仕入れ戦略の策定・実行
データ分析に基づく品揃え最適化と顧客ニーズの把握
HDE（Hardlines Deal Event）等のイベント販促の企画・実行
HCTP関連プロジェクト（HPP、Trade-In、Warranty、Customer Trust等）への参画
Amazon Businessと連携したB2B PC拡販の推進
AI・自動化ツールを活用した業務効率化の推進
部門横断のステークホルダー（Marketing、3P、Ops等）との連携

A day in the life
取り扱う商材はPC、ゲーミングデバイス、周辺機器など、どこの家庭にもある身近なものばかりです。お客様は「失敗したくない」という思いが強く、購入までの検討時間も長いため、データを深堀りして顧客ニーズを把握し、Amazonならではの情報提供・施策を立案・展開します。カテゴリーマネージャー制度やTech Marketing Roleなど新しい組織体制のもと、様々なバックグラウンドを持つ社員がそれぞれの強みを活かして活躍できる環境です。

About the team
PC/CE GLは、Amazon Retailビジネスの中で事業部数・売上が最も大きいElectronics & IT Solution事業本部に属しています。チームの特徴は、ボトムアップで変革を推進する文化です。HCTP（HL横断xGLs・JPM・JST・EU5と協働）、Amazon BusinessとのIT Service連携、紙カタログ・Ink回収スキームなど、カテゴリーの枠を超えたビジネスInitiativeを多数推進しています。優秀なLeadersのもと、皆が仲良く楽しく働いているGLです。

【働き方】
Amazonでは、家族と過ごす時間や、趣味に没頭するなど充実したプライベートの時間を大事にすることは、常にInnovativeであり続けるためにとても重要なことと考えます。
Hardlines事業本部でも、出産、育児、介護など、様々なライフステージイベントなどに合わせ、社員が自由な勤務体系を選択できる環境が整備されています。男性社員の育児取得実績もあり、多くの社員がこうした制度を活用しながら活躍しています。

・フルフレックスタイム制度（コアタイムなし）：
Amazonでは社員ひとりひとりの業務量やライフスタイルに合わせて、メリハリのある働き方を推進しています。コアタイムなしのフレックス制度はその一つです。

・産休・育休、時短勤務制度、ファミリーボーナス：
産休・育休の取得は勿論のこと、出産後の育児短時間勤務などを活用した自由な勤務体系が選択できます。
また、Amazonでは新しい家族を迎える社員が安心して子育てができ、育児休業から職場への復帰がより円滑にできるよう、育児支援プログラムとして『ファミリーボーナス』『慣らし勤務プログラム』を導入しています。

・介護休業、介護短時間勤務：
要介護状態にある家族を介護する社員は介護休業や、介護短時間勤務などの制度を活用することができます。

jobs.title: Sr. Sustainability Strategy Manager, Studios Strategy and Operations
jobs.description:
Amazon MGM Studios is seeking a Sr. Sustainability Strategy Manager to lead long-term sustainability planning and investment strategy while delivering operational excellence across our global production footprint.

Key job responsibilities
Sustainability R&D Fund Management
- Manage the Sustainability R&D fund, determining spend allocation by technology type, production, and region
- Identify and evaluate nascent sustainable technologies for testing on productions globally
- Engage with promising vendors and manage successful deployment of innovative solutions
- Conduct comprehensive data analyses and cost-benefit assessments of trials to determine long-term viability and ROI
- Build business cases for scaling sustainable technology solutions across the production portfolio

Strategic Investment & Scaling
- Develop and execute a sustainability investment strategy aligned with Amazon's Climate Pledge commitments
- Think strategically about scaling sustainability solutions globally, from pilot to enterprise deployment
- Evaluate and recommend small and large-scale technology investments (e.g., batteries, electric vehicles, renewable energy systems) for production use
- Drive adoption of sustainable solutions in a cost-effective manner compared to standard rental and procurement models

You will develop innovative sourcing pricing strategies and lead the financial approach to negotiating sustainable, long-term partnerships.

The GCP Finance team supports multiple business areas, including Marketing, Logistics, Global Real Estate, Employee Services, Technology, and Professional Services. Partnering with Strategic Sourcing Managers and leaders across these organizations, you will influence strategic decision-making through data-driven recommendations, challenging business partner assumptions and plans and bringing disruptive ideas that improve outcomes.

This role requires someone who owns complex, often ambiguous problems end-to-end, mitigating long-term risk and finding a path forward in difficult situations while managing multiple priorities across teams and organizations. You will drive best practices and build scalable solutions that simplify and automate financial tools and processes, and you will act as a force multiplier by mentoring others and giving back to the Finance community. The ideal candidate is deeply versed in financial concepts and tools, performs multifaceted analysis with limited guidance, and communicates complex outcomes clearly to senior, non-Finance partners with the backbone to disagree and commit.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a diverse, talented team that has a daily impact on company success. At Amazon, we're building the future through innovation, one product, service, and idea at a time. If you're ready to embrace this challenge and help shape Amazon's future, we invite you to apply and join us in this critical role.

Key job responsibilities

A day in the life
You will partner with Strategic Sourcing Managers across categories and business lines to analyze the economics of upcoming negotiations, validating savings baselines, building pricing models, and completing true-ups to confirm value delivered. A signature challenge is negotiating large, complex contracts spanning hundreds of line items from many suppliers, where you move fast, make judgment calls, and earn senior customers' trust.

jobs.description:
AWS Corporate Strategy & Business Development, Financial Services

AWS is seeking a Corporate Strategy and Business Development leader to join our team with a focus on AWSI Deep Engagements across our Financial Services customers. This role will drive holistic strategies across Amazon's business with some of the largest partners of Amazon, working at the intersection of AWS and broader Amazon. This is a unique opportunity to join a centralized corporate team that manages strategic partnerships across all of Amazon with an AWS lens. The companies we work with are among Amazon's most significant customers and partners, and this role will help them drive technology transformation via AWS tools, technology, and partners.

AWS and Amazon are on the forefront of the AI revolution with partners and the companies building the future of these industries. We are seeking a person who can continuously (and effectively) walk the line between thought leader and executor, every day. The person will be responsible for assessing inbound requests, independently managing opportunities end-to-end (commonly the most complex challenges in never-been-done-before deals), and seeing complex and high-impact partnerships through to completion. An in-depth knowledge of how financial services firms operate, how they engage across Amazon, and what Amazon's strategy is (or could be) with these types of companies is important.

The person will need a strong commercial aptitude and be able to quickly identify best-in-class partnerships that are valuable and high-impact for Amazon, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and our customers. You'll also manage executive relationships and negotiate partnership deals that are unconventional, need a centralized advocate, and/or have broader implications to AWS and other Amazon business units that are not immediately obvious. This includes non-standard deal construction, complex accounting procedures, and deal negotiations that require creative problem-solving and deep commercial expertise.

This role will interact closely with internal AWS and Amazon leaders from various disciplines, requiring confidence and credibility when engaging with the most senior leadership at both AWS and Amazon. This key role will be highly visible at senior levels of the organization and work on some of our most vexing challenges. You will need to work collaboratively with internal management teams to understand relative advantages and risks, if/when major features should be included to existing roadmaps, consolidation, and adoption. You'll at times need to be comfortable moving forward without a clear path, almost always with high degrees of ambiguity.

Communication & Writing: This role demands exceptional written and oral communication skills. You will regularly author strategy documents, build executive-level presentations, and communicate complex partnership narratives to senior leaders. Effective communication (written and verbal) at the executive level is not a nice-to-have; it is core to the role.

Travel & Availability: This role requires willingness to travel often, sometimes with little notice. While travel may reach 75% during peak deal cycles, the typical expectation is approximately 25%, depending on engagement cadence. While we strive for a healthy work-life balance, the highly visible nature of this role and the types of deals we work on mean it is not unusual to work well outside of normal hours, including weekends.

The Ideal Candidate: We are seeking an analytical, technical, and strategic thinker who is passionate and relentless. The ideal candidate enjoys solving complex problems where there is no clearly defined path to success, and isn't frustrated by a lack of clarity when defining how to execute. This individual must be able to work effectively with cross-functional teams and thrives in a fast-paced setting that is constantly evolving and isn't dissuaded when they hear "no" or frustrated by shifting priorities. Finally, as our deals are atypical, we require a leader who is comfortable defining goals that align to the right business outcomes, and is exceptionally comfortable driving the right outcomes with little guidance.

Key job responsibilities
Identify, evaluate, and manage strategic partnership opportunities with financial services firms, helping them drive technology transformation through AWS tools, technology, and partners.

Independently manage complex, end-to-end deal cycles, including non-standard deal construction, creative accounting procedures, and unconventional partnership structures that have no established playbook.

Engage confidently with the most senior leadership at AWS and Amazon, including presenting partnership strategies.

Work closely with AWS, Amazon, and customer stakeholders to align partnership strategies, navigate internal processes, and ensure deals are structured to benefit all parties.

Negotiate high-impact partnership agreements that require a centralized advocate and have broader implications across multiple Amazon business units.

Author strategy documents, executive-level presentations, and written narratives that clearly articulate complex partnership opportunities, risks, and recommendations.

Assess inbound partnership requests, prioritize based on strategic value, and determine appropriate engagement models.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams across AWS and Amazon to understand relative advantages, risks, roadmap implications, and adoption strategies.

Travel to support deal cycles and company engagements (typically 25%, up to 75% during peak periods), sometimes with limited advance notice.

Navigate ambiguity in situations where no clearly defined path exists, often with evolving priorities.

A day in the life
A day in the life involves navigating complex, multi-stakeholder relationships across AWS and Amazon. You'll engage directly with C-suite executives at some of AWS' largest customers, aligning their technology transformation goals with AWS capabilities. Internally, you'll collaborate with account teams, service teams, and Amazon business leaders to build holistic strategies that unlock value across the entire Amazon relationship. No two days look alike, you may be negotiating a non-standard deal structure in the morning and authoring an executive strategy document by afternoon.

About the team
Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud offering. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating. That's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our broad suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Are you ready to transform how Amazon delivers groceries to customers across North America? Join the Rapid and Rural Logistics organization where you'll tackle complex, high-impact problems at scale. This role puts you at the center of Amazon Grocery delivery execution, where your strategic thinking and analytical skills will directly improve the shopping experience for millions of customers.

As a Program Manager, you'll drive end-to-end program ownership for initiatives spanning a wide range of stores across North America. You'll work backwards from customer needs, diving deep into operational challenges and scaling innovative solutions that enhance delivery speed, reliability, and reach. If you're passionate about solving ambiguous business problems through data-driven insights and cross-functional collaboration, this is your opportunity to make a meaningful impact on how customers receive their groceries.

Key job responsibilities
- Manage and prioritize complex, cross-functional program life-cycles that improve Amazon Grocery delivery execution across multiple stores in North America, driving results that impact operations and customer experience
- Proactively identify operational improvement opportunities by analyzing performance data, diving deep into delivery trends, and defining scalable solutions that address systemic challenges across the logistics network
- Collaborate tactically with product, operations, engineering, and field teams to align stakeholder needs, remove blockers, and deliver program milestones on time while managing dependencies and mitigating risks
- Define program scope and objectives for new initiatives, establishing key performance indicators and tracking mechanisms to measure progress and quantify impact with data-driven insights
- Communicate program status and strategic trade-offs clearly to stakeholders at all levels through business reviews, working documentation, and escalations when needed to accelerate decision-making and maintain alignment

A day in the life
You'll start your day analyzing delivery performance metrics across stores, identifying trends that signal opportunities for improvement. Throughout the day, you'll facilitate alignment sessions with cross-functional partners—operations teams, engineers, and field leaders—to scope solutions and clear blockers. You'll spend time diving deep into root causes of delivery challenges, translating complex data into actionable insights. Between stakeholder updates and strategic planning sessions, you'll proactively reach out to partner teams to ensure programs stay on track and risks are mitigated before they impact customers.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment.

The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:
- Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
- Maternity and Parental Leave Options
- Paid Time Off (PTO)
- 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you!

At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
The Rapid and Rural Logistics organization is focused on revolutionizing Amazon Grocery delivery execution across North America. Our team works at the intersection of logistics innovation and customer obsession, building systems and processes that bring fresh groceries to customers faster and more reliably than ever before.

We tackle some of the most challenging problems in last-mile delivery, from optimizing routes in rural areas to scaling operations during peak demand. Our culture thrives on collaboration, data-driven decision-making, and continuous improvement. Join a team where your ideas will shape the future of grocery logistics and where every program you lead directly enhances the lives of customers who depend on Amazon for their daily needs.
Basic qualifications:
- 2+ years of program or project management experience
- 3+ years of advanced Microsoft Word and Excel experience
- Bachelor's degree in relevant field
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience with SQL
- Experience working in an analytical environment with cross-functional teams
- Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables & charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)

jobs.title: SSD/DC Project Manager, One MHS Strategic Planning
jobs.description:
One Material Handling System (OMHS) is building Amazon's in-house material handling capabilities, transforming how Amazon designs, builds, and operates its facilities. As Amazon's internal material handling system integrator, we combine precision in technical project management with the vision needed to revolutionize our material handling capabilities. We are seeking a talented and motivated Senior Technical Infrastructure Program Manager who will exemplify ownership of their assigned material handling projects, ensuring successful implementation across Amazon's network. Our S-TIPM works closely with WWDE, Operations Engineering, strategic suppliers, and cross-functional teams to deliver complex material handling systems. This role requires both strategic vision and tactical execution to standardize project delivery while maintaining the high standards that complex material handling systems demand. You will drive projects through our comprehensive Project Lifecycle Framework, from initiation through commissioning and handover, while helping establish the processes and playbooks that will enable OMHS to scale across Amazon's network.

Key job responsibilities
In partnership with WWDE, Operations Engineering, strategic suppliers, and other functional groups this individual will drive the execution strategy and management for material handling system implementations. This position will provide project leadership throughout the entire lifecycle of specific project(s) of a particular building type (ARS, SSD, AMZL, IXD, 1DC, RDC).
- Serve as the single-threaded leader for material handling system implementation programs, driving end-to-end execution across mechanical engineering, controls integration, power systems, and operational requirements for specific building types (ARS, SSD, AMZL, IXD).
- Lead a multi-disciplined team and sub-contractors; manage conflict, establish priorities, coordinate concurrent and sequencing activities, develop team members, and provide overall project leadership.
- Manage the project master schedule, administrative, contractual, technical, and financial aspects of projects to achieve timely completion, holding all internal teams and external vendors accountable for their commitments.
- Drive cross-functional communications and strategic planning for material handling system deployment, determining KPIs and driving standardization initiatives while building strong relationships with operations, functional groups, vendors, and senior leaders.
- Define and continuously improve technical standards, deployment methodologies, and best practices for material handling system implementations, including the development of the Project Lifecycle Framework and implementation playbooks.
- Coordinate across specialized engineering disciplines (mechanical, electrical, controls) to maintain ownership of system integration approaches, ensuring technical requirements, performance standards, and operational metrics are met throughout all lifecycle phases.
- Manage technical partnerships with OEMs and 3P engineering firms to ensure optimal system design, integration, and commissioning.
- Proactively identify and mitigate technical risks in system design, integration approach, and operational implementation while leveraging knowledge management systems and engineering documentation standards.
- Drive commercial and technical strategy during project execution, creating mechanisms and processes that increase velocity while maintaining quality and execution excellence

A day in the life
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to execute material handling system implementations while establishing standardized processes for future deployments. Provide cross-functional leadership by aligning engineering, operations, procurement, installation and commissioning teams around shared project objectives and milestones. Develop and deliver project execution strategies and detailed plans to drive implementation from initiation through commissioning, ensuring project(s) success. Own and manage project budgets, tracking expenditures against forecasts, identifying cost risks early, and implementing corrective actions to maintain financial targets. Maintain rigorous schedule oversight by developing comprehensive project timelines, monitoring critical path activities, and proactively addressing delays to keep projects on track. Interface with strategic partners to ensure successful integration of Amazon-spec equipment and facilitate cross-organizational collaboration to resolve technical and logistical challenges.
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in engineering or a related technical field
- Minimum of 3+ years experience in contract management
- Minimum 5 years of Project Management experience demonstrating increasing levels of project value and complexity. Inclusive of experience leading projects across multiple stakeholders
- Experience with completion of multiple medium sized projects (up to $40M each) and/or Large projects (excess of $100M) in the Construction and/or Material Handling Industry.
- Must be willing and able to travel up to 50% (Note: Most travel is done on weekdays)
Preferred qualifications:
- PMP, or PMP certificate
- Experience with Lean/Six Sigma
- Experience managing multiple internal stakeholders and advising cross-functional teams
- Experience with Automated Control System and material handing systems
- Master’s degree in project management, engineering or related field

To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

Would you like to join one of the most dynamic organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries gain the best value and service from AWS? Enterprise Support is hiring!

The AWS Enterprise Support Strategy and Operations (ESSO) team for Strategic Industries (SI) is looking for a smart, enthusiastic, and creative thought leader with a strong background in in sales operations and supporting field organizations. As Sr. Sales & Delivery Operations Manager, you will be the senior operations leader for the Strategic Industries Business Development (BD) function owning the end-to-end operating rhythm and delivering strategic initiatives that will enable growth and effectiveness of the business development function. • Own communication and partnership with business stakeholders, finance, recruiting, and HR regarding planning and execution within scope

The AWS Strategic Accounts Business Operations team is seeking an experienced Sales Operations Lead to partner with our account management teams to define, land, and execute against our strategic priorities. You will partner with Sales Leadership and cross-functional teams to develop standard metrics that measure the productivity and success of programs, automate and optimize operational processes, and invent new ways of diving deep with data to uncover actionable insights. You will look around corners, measure the organization's performance, supply sales leadership with timely insights on the health of their business, and manage the operating cadence for the team.

Strategic Accounts is one of AWS's most important and complex businesses — a portfolio of recognized industry leaders unlike any other segment. Working closely with senior sales leaders and executives, this role demands sharp judgment, precision, and executive-level communication: the ability to turn complexity into clear insight and to identify the true business signals that drive confident leadership decisions.

The successful candidate has excellent business and sales acumen, strong communication and collaboration skills, deep analytics experience, broad technical skills, and a demonstrated ability to both execute and influence. They are willing to roll up their sleeves, dive deep to learn, work comfortably within ambiguity, and have a passion for driving operational excellence.

Our business is evolving at the speed of AI, and so is how we work — we want a builder who is relentlessly curious about new AI capabilities (such as Amazon Quick), who invests the time to learn them deeply, and applies them to real problems to work faster and smarter. But curiosity goes beyond AI: it means getting to the bottom of complex business problems with many interdependencies, seeking the root cause rather than treating the symptom, and bringing a constant process-improvement mindset. The right person treats every new capability and hard problem as a chance to eliminate manual toil, surface insights earlier, and quantify the impact — in time saved or quality improved — while sharing what they learn and influencing others to adopt what works.

In this role you will provide thought leadership for the organization. You will develop unique insights that drive dynamic decision making, set high standards, and use advanced technology to enable productivity. jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, AMZL Field Support
jobs.description:
Amazon's middle mile network moves at massive scale, and the technology on every tractor and trailer keeps it running. We are looking for a Senior Program Manager to own the reliability and performance of critical fleet technology platforms deployed across our middle mile transportation network, keeping our fleet connected and packages moving. In this role you will manage complex repair programs, vendor performance, and cross-functional partnerships with product engineering teams, OEM partners, and service providers to maximize device uptime and operational readiness across our tractor, trailer, and intermodal fleet.

You will work backward from network needs to diagnose root causes of device failures, implement systematic repair strategies, and drive continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen fleet technology reliability. You will own vendor relationships, establish performance accountability mechanisms, and coordinate device strategy across transportation networks, aligning shared vendor relationships and measurement standards to unlock scale and consistency.

Key job responsibilities
- Own end-to-end device operations and repair program execution for critical fleet technology platforms across the middle mile tractor, trailer, and intermodal fleet, defining program strategy and driving teams inside and outside the organization to deliver
- Manage third-party vendor relationships and performance — including SLA enforcement, cost efficiency, and repair quality — while partnering with product engineering and OEM teams to diagnose systemic device failures and accelerate resolution
- Analyze device health and failure data to identify root causes, implement preventive maintenance strategies, and build reporting mechanisms that enable proactive issue identification and data-driven decisions
- Coordinate device repair strategy across transportation networks, aligning intake mechanisms, vendor relationships, and measurement standards to capture scale and reduce complexity
- Communicate program status, technical risks, and recommendations clearly to senior leadership through well-structured narratives and regular business reviews

A day in the life
You might start the morning reviewing overnight device health trends and triaging new failure reports with your engineering counterparts. By mid-morning you are on a call with a repair vendor, working through turnaround-time gaps and agreeing on corrective actions. After lunch you pull together data for a leadership review, translating repair metrics into a clear narrative about fleet readiness. Later you join a design review with the product team to weigh in on a hardware change that could reduce a recurring failure mode. Throughout the day you move between strategic planning and hands-on problem solving, keeping multiple programs on track.

About the team
The Middle Mile Fleet Technology team is responsible for keeping Amazon's fleet technology running reliably at scale. We sit at the intersection of hardware engineering, service operations, and vendor management, and our work directly affects delivery performance across the network.

We are a collaborative group that values clear thinking, practical solutions, and a willingness to get into the details. If you enjoy solving complex operational problems and want to see the real-world impact of your work every day, this is a great place to be.
Basic qualifications:
- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
Preferred qualifications:
- 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
- Knowledge of general AI tools
- Experience designing, implementing, and scaling upskilling, apprenticeship, or workforce development programs across large-scale operations or corporate environments, including forecasting workforce needs and leveraging analytics to drive program decisions

Amazon Customer Excellence Systems (ACES) is seeking a Senior Program Manager to build and lead multi-year capability programs across All Miles AU Operations, spanning First Mile, Middle Mile, and Last Mile. This is a founding-level, high-impact role at the heart of Amazon Australia's operational transformation, sitting within the ACES Planning Team.

ACES Planning is the strategic nerve center that connects Amazon Australia's 3-Year Plan and Annual Operating Plan to ground-level operational outcomes. As the ACES All Miles Senior Program Manager, you will be the engine of that translation: standing up new capabilities, owning the multi-year program portfolio, and driving disruptive productivity improvements across a nationally distributed network at different stages of operational maturity.

Key job responsibilities
Strategic Program Ownership

You will own the end-to-end lifecycle of multi-year strategic programs, from problem definition and business case development through to execution, change management, and post-implementation review. You will build and maintain AU's All Miles program roadmap, connecting multiyear planning cycles into a live portfolio with clear milestones, owners, and success metrics visible to ACES leadership and AU senior leadership. You will influence senior leadership investment and prioritisation decisions through rigorous business case development and data-driven recommendations.

New Capability Development

You will stand up new operational capabilities across the AU network, designing programs from the ground up in a high-growth, rapidly maturing environment where frameworks don't always exist yet. This includes scoping capability gaps, building the business case, designing the operating model, and driving adoption through structured change management. Amazon Australia is not a steady-state network. This role requires someone who builds, not just maintains.

Cross-Mile Productivity Optimisation

You will drive end-to-end productivity and cost improvements across First Mile FCs, Middle Mile transportation and sort, and Last Mile delivery stations. Every day, hundreds of millions of e-commerce transactions happen across our global marketplace. Our job? Make sure sellers can trust this platform with their business and that trust never breaks, even when things go wrong.

This role puts you at the center of that resilience.

- Direct line to strategy. Your frameworks feed directly into organizational risk posture and operational planning.

- Get energized by ambiguity and building structure where none exists
- Think in systems, connecting compliance, vendor risk, incident response, and operational continuity into a single resilience model
- Communicate crisply across levels, from analysts on the ground to senior leadership
- Have a bias for action, you'd rather run a 70% solution now and iterate than wait for perfection

jobs.description:
Amazon Access is Amazon's co-branded credit card program in Mexico, operated in partnership with Invex, one of Mexico's leading financial institutions. We are looking for a Program Manager III to own and drive critical workstreams across regulatory influence, payment performance, financial modeling, customer analytics, and operational automation. This role sits at the intersection of product, finance, data, and external partner management, requiring someone who can translate complex data into actionable strategy, influence partners and regulators without formal authority, and deliver measurable business outcomes. You will work directly with Amazon, Invex, payment processors (PROSA), and external partners (Mastercard) to solve high-impact problems end-to-end. SQL proficiency and data analytics are foundational requirements - you will build analytical frameworks, write queries, design dashboards, and use data to drive every decision.

Key job responsibilities
Own end-to-end program delivery across payment performance, customer acquisition, engagement analytics, and operational automation workstreams for Amazon Access Mexico.

Build and maintain analytical frameworks using SQL, QuickSight, and GenAI tools to diagnose business problems, quantify impact, and inform strategy - including cohort segmentation, funnel analysis, and customer persona targeting.

Influence external partners (Invex, PROSA, Mastercard) and regulators (CNBV) via evidence-based analysis and persistent engagement to drive outcomes without formal authority.

Design financial models, unit economics frameworks, and attribution methodologies to evaluate program sustainability and inform funding decisions.

Identify and execute automation opportunities that eliminate manual operational burden across Finance, Accounting, Product, and FinOps teams.

Monitor and recover key payment metrics (PSR, ASR, Share of Wallet) via root cause analysis, transaction-level diagnostics, and cross-company coordination.

Translate complex data into stakeholder-compelling narratives for senior leadership, supporting WBR/MBR/QBR cycles and strategic planning (OP1/OP2).

Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Tech, Finance, BI, and external partners to deliver against the Amazon Access roadmap.

A day in the life
In this role, you shape the financial product that brings credit access to millions of customers in Mexico. One morning you build the evidence case that convinces a banking regulator to change policy - the next, you diagnose a payment authorization anomaly across three companies and drive the fix before it impacts customers. You design the financial architecture behind a rewards program, model its unit economics, and present the go/no-go recommendation to leadership. You write SQL to uncover why acquisition spiked during a High Value Event, then turn that insight into the strategy for the next one. No two days look the same because you own the full spectrum - from regulatory influence and partner negotiation to data analysis and automation design. This is a role where analytical rigor directly translates into business impact at scale, and where you operate with the autonomy of a founder inside one of the world's most customer-obsessed companies.

About the team
Amazon Access Mexico is Amazon's co-branded credit card program, built in partnership with Invex. Our mission is to expand financial access for Mexican customers via a product that combines credit, e-commerce, and rewards. We operate in a complex, regulated fintech environment that requires deep collaboration with banking partners, payment processors, and regulators. Our team is small, high-impact, and data-driven — every team member owns significant workstreams end-to-end. We value analytical rigor, Ownership, and the ability to influence outcomes across organizational boundaries.

jobs.title: Program Manager II, Rapid and Rural Logistics
jobs.description:
Are you ready to transform how Amazon delivers groceries to customers across North America? Join the Rapid and Rural Logistics organization where you'll tackle complex, high-impact problems at scale. This role puts you at the center of Amazon Grocery delivery execution, where your strategic thinking and analytical skills will directly improve the shopping experience for millions of customers.

As a Program Manager II, you'll drive end-to-end program ownership for initiatives spanning a wide range of stores across North America. You'll work backwards from customer needs, diving deep into operational challenges and scaling innovative solutions that enhance delivery speed, reliability, and reach. If you're passionate about solving ambiguous business problems through data-driven insights and cross-functional collaboration, this is your opportunity to make a meaningful impact on how customers receive their groceries.

Key job responsibilities
- Manage and prioritize complex, cross-functional program life-cycles that improve Amazon Grocery delivery execution across multiple stores in North America, driving results that impact operations and customer experience
- Proactively identify operational improvement opportunities by analyzing performance data, diving deep into delivery trends, and defining scalable solutions that address systemic challenges across the logistics network
- Collaborate tactically with product, operations, engineering, and field teams to align stakeholder needs, remove blockers, and deliver program milestones on time while managing dependencies and mitigating risks
- Define program scope and objectives for new initiatives, establishing key performance indicators and tracking mechanisms to measure progress and quantify impact with data-driven insights
- Communicate program status and strategic trade-offs clearly to stakeholders at all levels through business reviews, working documentation, and escalations when needed to accelerate decision-making and maintain alignment

A day in the life
You'll start your day analyzing delivery performance metrics across stores, identifying trends that signal opportunities for improvement. Throughout the day, you'll facilitate alignment sessions with cross-functional partners—operations teams, engineers, and field leaders—to scope solutions and clear blockers. You'll spend time diving deep into root causes of delivery challenges, translating complex data into actionable insights. Between stakeholder updates and strategic planning sessions, you'll proactively reach out to partner teams to ensure programs stay on track and risks are mitigated before they impact customers.

The Rapid and Rural Logistics organization is focused on revolutionizing Amazon Grocery delivery execution across North America. This role presents a unique opportunity to drive Amazon's ambitious goals for expanding and optimizing our SSD network in Japan. The successful candidate will lead programs, partnerships, and innovations to strategically grow our Sub Same Day delivery capabilities, ensuring best-in-class speed, coverage, and customer experience. jobs.title: Finance Manager, Selling Partner Trust and Store Integrity
jobs.description:
This is not a typical finance role. This is a front-line position in one of Amazon's most consequential financial risk domains — Seller Bad Debt (SBD) — where your analysis directly determines how hundreds of millions of dollars flow through Amazon's books, and your insights shape the programs that protect the world's largest marketplace from financial exploitation.

You will own the financial planning, forecasting, and strategic decision support for the Seller Collections ecosystem, with a mandate to reduce gross bad debt and optimize fund recovery. Your work will have direct visibility to VP-level leadership and will influence capital allocation decisions across the Selling Partner Services organization.
If you thrive on ambiguity, love untangling complex data to find the signal in the noise, and want a role where your analysis has real, measurable impact on Amazon's bottom line then this is it.

Transactional Seller Bad Debt is comprised of three interconnected components — Gross Seller Bad Debt (driven primarily by Negative Seller Balance reserves), Bad Actor Fund Recoveries, and Damages — each with its own drivers, levers, and forecasting challenges. You won't just report the numbers; you'll decode why they move.

You'll hunt bad actors — with data. The fraud landscape you'll analyze is sophisticated and constantly evolving. Your analysis will quantify the financial impact of each vector, identify emerging patterns before they become material, and arm the business with the data to act decisively.
You'll build and defend a forecast under a microscope. The Seller Bad Debt forecast has direct visibility at the senior-most levels of finance leadership. You will own the end-to-end forecasting process across planning cycles (OP1, QBR, MBR), building bottoms-up models.

jobs.description:
One Material Handling System (OMHS) is building Amazon's in-house material handling capabilities, transforming how Amazon designs, builds, and operates its facilities. As Amazon's internal material handling system integrator, we combine precision in technical project management with the vision needed to revolutionize our material handling capabilities. We are seeking a talented and motivated Senior Technical Infrastructure Program Manager who will exemplify ownership of their assigned material handling projects, ensuring successful implementation across Amazon's network. Our S-TIPM works closely with WWDE, Operations Engineering, strategic suppliers, and cross-functional teams to deliver complex material handling systems. This role requires both strategic vision and tactical execution to standardize project delivery while maintaining the high standards that complex material handling systems demand. In partnership with WWDE, Operations Engineering, strategic suppliers, and other functional groups this individual will drive the execution strategy and management for material handling system implementations. - Coordinate across specialized engineering disciplines (mechanical, electrical, controls) to maintain ownership of system integration approaches, ensuring technical requirements, performance standards, and operational metrics are met throughout all lifecycle phases.
- Manage technical partnerships with OEMs and 3P engineering firms to ensure optimal system design, integration, and commissioning.
- Proactively identify and mitigate technical risks in system design, integration approach, and operational implementation while leveraging knowledge management systems and engineering documentation standards.
- Drive commercial and technical strategy during project execution, creating mechanisms and processes that increase velocity while maintaining quality and execution excellence.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to execute material handling system implementations while establishing standardized processes for future deployments. Provide cross-functional leadership by aligning engineering, operations, procurement, installation and commissioning teams around shared project objectives and milestones. Develop and deliver project execution strategies and detailed plans to drive implementation from initiation through commissioning, ensuring project(s) success. Own and manage project budgets, tracking expenditures against forecasts, identifying cost risks early, and implementing corrective actions to maintain financial targets. Maintain rigorous schedule oversight by developing comprehensive project timelines, monitoring critical path activities, and proactively addressing delays to keep projects on track. - Experience in contract management
- Experience leading projects across multiple stakeholders
- Minimum 5 years of Project Management experience demonstrating increasing levels of project value and complexity.
