jobs.title: Sr. Production Operations Manager, Live Sports Production
jobs.description:
Come be a part of Amazon's dynamic Live Sports Production team. We are looking for an experienced Sr. Production Operations Manager who brings both strategic business acumen and hands-on production expertise to own the end-to-end lifecycle of multiple live sports properties, from initial financial modeling and vendor strategy through boots-on-the-ground execution.

In this role, you will serve as the centralized operational lead for your assigned properties, driving strategic planning across the full project lifecycle. You will lead financial modeling, shape vendor strategy, and manage engagement with third-party Production Service Partners (PSPs), coordinating backend functions including crewing, payroll, travel, and production accounting while maintaining Amazon's operational standards and ensuring productions launch on time and on budget.

Equally critical is your ability to deliver on the ground. You will work in lockstep with internal crewing, editorial, and technical workstreams to ensure each event or studio show is properly resourced, and will partner directly with PSPs to establish best practices, define operational standards, and ensure alignment across the vendor landscape. You will drive production readiness across all operational workstreams, ensuring each event is prepared for a clean launch and seamless restart.

This role requires deep knowledge of remote, event, and studio production operations, including broadcast positions, industry standard rates, vendor engagement models, and production service agreements. You will be responsible for issue spotting, driving decision making, and escalating matters that carry risk to the Global Head of Production Operations. Our production operation is purpose-built around the needs of an expanding, multi-sport live portfolio rather than modeled after a traditional broadcast network structure. We are defining and building as we evolve, and this person must be excited to roll up their sleeves and help establish the systems, relationships, and workflows that will scale with us.

The successful candidate is a self-starter who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment. You can juggle competing priorities across multiple productions with autonomy, react with urgency when situations demand immediate attention, and bring a proven track record of end-to-end ownership in a fast-paced, evolving business.

Key job responsibilities
• End-to-End Property Lifecycle Management: Own and manage the full project lifecycle for assigned properties, from projected business scope and production roadmap development, through execution and ongoing supervision of day-to-day live event and studio production, to post-mortem and financial reconciliation. Develop milestones, launch schedules, and workback timelines to ensure successful delivery of property launches and season restarts. Lead property transition planning for returning seasons, ensuring operational continuity, vendor re-engagement, and incorporation of prior-season learnings into the restart roadmap.

• Business Strategy and Vendor Management: Develop a deep understanding of organizational business objectives and production priorities to drive vendor evaluation, selection, and strategic recommendations that optimize cost, quality, and scalability across assigned properties. Shepherd the vendor selection process through RFPs and serve as the primary point of contact for vendors defining scope of work, deliverables, and engagement standards. Partner with Legal and Production Finance on contract terms, rate frameworks, and commercial agreements, and monitor vendor performance to ensure accountability against operational standards.

• Budget and Financial Management: Create and manage production budgets from initial scoping through execution. Work closely with Production Finance to track and reconcile all production costs, ensuring external vendors and the production team are aware of overall spend. Coordinate fee reconciliation and payment processing with third-party vendors to ensure accuracy and timeliness. Lead regular financial status updates to senior leadership, flagging variances and recommending corrective action.

• Crewing Coordination via PSPs: Ensure assigned properties are properly staffed by coordinating crew deployment through third-party vendors. Establish consistent frameworks for how Above-The-Line (ATL) and Below-The-Line (BTL) personnel are engaged across productions. Partner with the centralized crewing function to maintain visibility into crew availability, prevent scheduling conflicts, and ensure alignment with creative and editorial vision. Support rate structure consistency and market-competitive positioning across comparable roles.

• On-Site Event Operations and Health & Safety: Oversee on-site event production operations, including venue logistics and coordination with league and arena broadcast groups. Ensure Health & Safety protocols and risk management standards are maintained across all production environments. Work with vendors and internal teams to identify and mitigate operational risks in advance of air, and maintain contingency plans for live production scenarios.

• Labor and Workforce Compliance: Navigate both union and non-union production environments. Ensure third-party PSPs adhere to all applicable labor regulations and collective bargaining agreements. Work closely with Amazon's internal legal and labor teams to stay current on regulatory requirements, workforce compliance standards, and crew classification guidelines across domestic and international markets. Advise on compliance considerations as they arise, including jurisdictional rules and engagement terms.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with Amazon teams including Editorial Production, Technical Operations, Business Development, Production Finance, Accounting, and Legal to operationalize properties and drive synergy. Align regularly with production teams across regions to share best practices and integrate new learnings. Support the Global Head of Production Ops in implementing operational strategy across all Prime Video Live Sports properties.

• Escalation and Risk Management: Proactively identify issues and blockers, providing timely solutions to resolve them. Exercise sound judgment in issue spotting and decision making, escalating to senior leadership when matters carry risk or require broader organizational alignment. Lead regular status updates on project timelines, budgets, and production readiness.

• Operational Process Improvement and Scalability: Seek continuous improvements in execution of existing productions. Recommend changes to operational strategy, seek alignment with stakeholders, and implement at regular intervals. Own and leverage internal production management tools to maintain full visibility into productions, track resource deployment, and surface issues. Contribute to frameworks, SOPs, and systems that enable the team to scale with increasing property volume and complexity.

About the team
The Production Operations team is responsible for delivering high-quality event and studio productions on all global live sports properties to Prime Video customers worldwide. We drive production excellence through purpose-built processes and scalable operational frameworks that empower the team to work more efficiently and grow with increasing demand.
Basic qualifications:
- 6+ years of budgeting, scheduling and cost reporting experience
- Experience as a producer, production manager, line producer or in production risk management
- 6+ years of creative role understanding consumer trends and creating content experience
- 8+ years of experience in live sports production operations, production management, or operational planning, including hands-on, boots-on-the-ground execution across remote, studio, and event productions. Proven experience managing the end-to-end lifecycle of multiple simultaneous live sports properties, from initial scoping and financial modeling through production execution and post-season reconciliation. Strong command of production processes including vendor management, budgeting, roadmap development, and complex cross-departmental problem solving at scale. Track record of working with third-party production companies, including vendor selection, rate negotiation, and contract management; experience defining service requirements and ensuring commercial terms are captured in production service agreements and statements of work. Experience with both union and non-union crew across live productions, with a working knowledge of applicable collective bargaining agreements and labor guidelines. Experience reviewing and interpreting production service agreements, statements of work, and commercial contracts, with the ability to issue-spot and escalate matters that carry risk to the broader organization
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience leading large projects and facilitate group meetings
- Experience working for a production company, studio, or television network

jobs.description:
Amazon is seeking a Sr. Program Manager to join the Startup Integrated Planning team within the Global Engineering, Materials, & Sustainability (GEMS) organization. This Sr. Program Manager will contribute to the strategic evolution of the integrated planning program, helping mature planning as a discipline. The role oversees a team of contracted project planners, setting the bar for quality and ensuring consistent delivery, while balancing program-level strategy, cross-functional influence, and scaling mechanisms.

This is a rapidly scaling environment where processes exist but are still maturing. Success requires strategic thinking, comfort navigating ambiguity, and the judgment to refine and extend existing frameworks. A strong background in integrated scheduling is critical for providing effective program management at this scale.

Key job responsibilities
Program Strategy & Contracted Planner Oversight
• Shape and advance the workforce and vendor strategy for contracted planners, including capacity modeling, skill-mix optimization, and procurement negotiations that scale with portfolio growth.

• Assign and rebalance planners across projects based on priority, complexity, and workload.

• Develop and improve planning tools, templates, and AI-driven automations to boost planner productivity and eliminate manual workflows.
• Identify and lead initiatives that advance planning maturity, including automation, tooling, and capability building.
• Capture lessons learned from completed projects and convert them into repeatable, scalable best practices.

• Ensure planners identify cross-functional dependencies and surface risks early, before they become execution problems.
• Develop and refine risk and reporting frameworks that give leadership the signal needed to make portfolio-level decisions
• Provide clear, data-driven status reporting to senior leadership on portfolio-wide planning performance.

• Serve as the planning liaison with partner functions, championing integrated scheduling practices and ensuring planning inputs are prioritized.
• Drive continuous improvement of integrated planning by gathering feedback from partner functions and refining how planning intersects with their workflows.
• Represent the Integrated Planning program in global and cross-functional forums, aligning planning standards and resolving systemic gaps across disciplines.

- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams

- Experience handling ambiguous or undefined challenges through strong problem solving abilities

- Experience applying AI tools and automation to scale program operations and drive measurable efficiency improvements.

jobs.title: Program Manager I, Flex Advocacy Operations
jobs.description:
The Amazon Flex program uses independent drivers—called delivery partners—to deliver to our customers. Through the Amazon Flex app, drivers sign up for the program, schedule pickup times, are guided during routes with the navigation system, and more.

As the Amazon Flex Program Manager, you will be responsible for the strategy and initiatives aimed at improving the quality and efficiency of the deliveries carried out by the program. To achieve your goals, you'll work with diverse areas of the organization, including technology, operations, and marketing. A successful program manager will work to enhance the experience of hundreds of drivers, both within operations and when carrying out delivery routes, through data analysis, identifying obstacles and problem spots, and implementing effective and well-defined standards. These improvements must be balanced with business needs and take into account key operational metrics. Effective stakeholder management skills are essential to balance these competing priorities and delivering effective solutions for our customers and drivers.

Key job responsibilities
Support long-term strategic planning to improve quality and efficiency.
- Work closely with the areas of finance, marketing, capacity management, operations, engineering, and program management on process improvement and launch initiatives.
- Develop, implement, and oversee reports, ensuring clear visibility of project milestones and performance.
- Effectively influence stakeholders through collaboration and effective prioritization.
- Be responsible for key performance indicators and work closely with stakeholders to understand everyday opportunities and challenges in order to implement short and long-term solutions.
- Monitor the execution of projects and ensure that the delivery is at the appropriate quality level and in compliance with the expected deadline.
- Navigate and resolve ambiguities by applying creative problem solving skills.
- Identify and mitigate risks, preventing them from becoming larger problems.

About the team
Amazon Flex's Advocacy Operations (AO) team is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Program Manager to lead the planning, coordination, and delivery of Amazon Flex programs and initiatives worldwide. As a Program Manager, you will be responsible for defining and executing the program roadmap for the Advocacy Operations, translating strategic goals into structured programs, aligning stakeholders, and driving initiatives to completion across a complex, multi-marketplace landscape.
You will own programs end to end, shaping the charter and success metrics, building mechanisms and roadmaps, managing dependencies and risks, and reporting progress to senior leadership. Throughout this process you will drive continuous innovation and improvement to deliver fast, easy, and rich functionality that supports a best-in-class Delivery Partner (DP) and customer experience. A critical part of this role is working across teams and marketplaces. You will partner with Operations, Analytics, Tech/Product, Finance, Legal, and Compliance stakeholders, and coordinate with regional teams across worldwide Flex-enabled marketplaces (US, CA, UK, IN, JP, AU, SG, MX, BR), to align priorities, drive consistent execution, and land programs that scale globally while respecting local nuances. You will lead through influence rather than direct authority aligned on shared goals across DP lifecycle, bulk communications, compliance workflows, and programmatic support.

You will play a pivotal role in defining and delivering strategic automation initiatives, identifying opportunities to build long-term, scalable solutions that eliminate manual work without negatively impacting the DP experience. You will establish the mechanisms, standards, and reporting cadences that keep programs on track and give leadership clear visibility into progress, risks, and outcomes.
Basic qualifications:
- 2+ years of program or project management experience
- 3+ years of advanced Microsoft Word and Excel experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Knowledge of SQL
Preferred qualifications:
- Knowledge of Lean principles and DMAIC methodology
- Experience in MS Access and SQL
- Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document
- Experience working in an analytical environment with cross-functional teams

jobs.description:
Join our Robotics Delivery and Packaging Innovation International team, where we transform complex automation technologies into efficiently deployable solutions on a global scale. Amazon is seeking an experienced Manager to lead a team of Single-Threaded Leaders (STLs) who own end-to-end program planning, cross-functional orchestration, and delivery governance for complex automation infrastructure deployments across our international fulfillment network.

You will lead and develop a team of program managers who each own full lifecycle delivery of a technology program or cross-functional workstream — from capital approval and planning through deployment execution and steady-state handover. You will design the governance mechanisms, operating cadences, and scalable frameworks that enable your team to drive predictable delivery outcomes across multiple concurrent programs, countries, and stakeholder organizations.

You will influence within a VP organization, advise Senior Managers and Directors on deployment strategy, prioritization trade-offs, and program health, and actively grow the next generation of program leaders.

Amazon's culture encourages an entrepreneurial approach and expects engineers and managers alike to take a high level of ownership in solving complex problems in a fast-paced environment.

The role could be based in Berlin, Munich, Barcelona, or London with ~50% travel across Europe during deployment season, with occasional international travel.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead and develop a team of program managers operating as Single-Threaded Leaders, each owning end-to-end delivery of a technology program or cross-functional workstream across planning, funding, deployment, and handover.
- Own the team's operating model, governance cadences, and delivery mechanisms, designing scalable frameworks that drive predictable outcomes across multiple concurrent programs and geographies.
- Drive cross-functional alignment across diverse stakeholder organizations including finance, operations, supply chain, site selection, and engineering to remove blockers and accelerate delivery.
- Own capital governance and program prioritization for the team's portfolio, ensuring CARs, plans of record, and financial commitments are on track and aligned to organizational goals.
- Build scalable planning mechanisms, launch readiness frameworks, and standard work that convert first-time program complexity into repeatable, predictable delivery paths adopted organization-wide.
- Advise Senior Managers and Directors on program strategy, prioritization trade-offs, resource allocation, and risk mitigation, influencing within a VP organization on cross-functional program decisions.
- Make trade-offs between short-term delivery needs and long-term sustainability using data-driven decision-making, metrics review, and clear RAG-based program health reporting.

- Identify and develop future program leaders through talent reviews and succession planning.

A day in the life
You will set the strategic direction for your team's program portfolio, making prioritization trade-offs and ensuring cross-functional alignment across diverse organizations. You will design governance mechanisms and operating cadences that give your team clear swim lanes and your leadership clear visibility into program health. During deployment seasons, you will coach your program managers through complex stakeholder negotiations and escalation decisions, capturing learnings into team-wide standards.

jobs.title: Finance Manager, Customer Service, Amazon Leo
jobs.description:
Amazon Leo is seeking an experienced Finance Manager to lead financial planning and analysis for our Customer Service organization. This role is central to our mission of providing fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities worldwide through our constellation of Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellites.

As a member of our Customer Operations (GCOPS) Finance team, you will own the end-to-end financial models for B2B and B2C customer support, concessions, and cost of payments. You will partner directly with customer care leadership to translate operational metrics – contact rates, cost per contact, outsourcing mix, and agent productivity – into actionable financial forecasts that anchor the Long-Range Plan and annual operating plans. This role offers the unique opportunity to help scale customer service finance from pre-launch through General Availability and rapid subscriber growth.

Key job responsibilities
- Own and evolve customer service financial models spanning enterprise and consumer segments, including cost-per-contact economics, in-house vs. outsourced delivery trade-offs, and multi-year cost projections that scale with subscriber growth

- Drive annual and long-range financial planning for a multi-billion-dollar customer service cost structure, including rate card development, scenario modeling, and executive-level variance narratives

- Deliver month-end close processes for CS partner invoicing and accruals via self-invoicing mechanisms; maintain accrual-to-actuals accuracy targets (>98%)

- Develop and maintain the concessions model, tracking cost exposure as a percentage of revenue and driving proactive strategies to reduce concession spend over time

- Provide financial analysis for outsourcing strategy decisions – vendor pricing evaluations, make-vs-buy tradeoffs, and recommendations that inform leadership on partner selection

- Support the Defect Elimination initiative by quantifying Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) impact and building the financial case for defect reduction investments

- Build and maintain scorecards and metrics for CS financial and operational performance; present insights to senior leadership and identify improvement levers

- Partner with cost-of-payments and bad-debt teams to ensure holistic customer operations cost visibility

- Drive productivity and automation in financial planning processes, including leveraging AI/ML tools to accelerate model updates and reduce cycle time

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing the latest outsourced contact center invoice reconciliation and confirming month-end accruals are tracking within tolerance.

Mid-morning, you join the weekly CS modeling sync with customer care leadership to align on contact rate assumptions for the next planning cycle.

After lunch, you're deep in the forecast model, layering in a new customer segment that the enterprise sales team just scoped.

Later, you present your cost narrative to senior leadership, highlighting rate improvements driven by vendor productivity gains.

Before wrapping up, you review the latest concessions trend data and flag a spike to your business partner with a recommendation to investigate.

About the team
You'll join the Global Customer Operations Finance (GCOPS) team within Amazon Leo, reporting to a Finance leader who also owns Leo's consolidated long-range financial plan.

This team provides controllership across field services, customer support, cost of payments, and bad debt management. As Leo scales to commercial launch, you'll shape frameworks that balance operational efficiency with exceptional customer experience.

Beyond your core CS remit, you'll contribute to Leo-wide strategic planning – multi-year investment modeling, scenario analysis, and executive narratives that span Leo's global business.

Amazon's Global Specialty Recruiting (GSR) organization is looking for a Senior Program Manager to own HR business operations for Principal Engineering (PE) Recruiting. In this role, you will sit at the intersection of recruiting functions and day-to-day operations, driving long-term strategic planning, operating rhythm, business reviews, and goal alignment to prioritize resources across the team. You will implement processes and strategies with clear communication, align business objectives with key performance indicators, and manage change to keep the organization running smoothly — all while working closely with HR leadership, finance, and talent acquisition partners.

You will drive the business cadence, including business reviews, report-outs, and long-term strategic planning, and communicate priorities to the global team. You will help GSR and PE Recruiting become more operational by implementing continuous improvement best practices, using data analysis, insight generation, and generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) tools to move quickly and tell clear stories. You will manage multiple complex programs, influence cross-functional partner teams, and design solutions that make the organization more efficient. If you are a collaborative, analytical self-starter who thrives in ambiguity and can influence without authority, this role offers meaningful impact and regular visibility with senior leaders at Amazon.

Key job responsibilities
- Improve and simplify standardized mechanisms for PE Recruiting business operations and internal communications, including organizational emails, newsletters, and leadership presentations.
- Lead the annual process for resource and strategic planning, and support the development and reporting of departmental goals and initiatives.
- Design and implement change management strategies with clear communication plans, guiding stakeholders through organizational transitions and process improvements.
- Build and maintain a metrics framework to measure the impact of business operations deliverables, communications, and strategy programs.
- Develop strategic messaging and produce communication content for internal channels, translating data into actionable insights and narratives using Microsoft Office and GenAI tools.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing operational metrics and preparing a data-driven narrative for an upcoming business review with senior leaders. After that, you could spend time partnering with recruiting and finance stakeholders to align on quarterly goals, then shift to refining a change management communication plan for a team initiative. Between meetings, you will use GenAI tools to accelerate analysis and draft internal communications. Your work balances independent deep-dive analysis with collaborative sessions that keep the broader team aligned and moving forward.
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Business, Program Management, Human Resources, Employment Law, Computer Science, Finance, Computer Information Systems, Engineering, Operations Research or a related field
- Experience in making data driven business decisions
- Experience communicating complex concepts clearly and persuasively to different audiences
- 5+ years of HR, talent acquisition, management consulting, or project/program management experience
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience setting business operating rhythms

jobs.title: Program Manager, SSD Planning and Execution, Japan Launch and Expansion
jobs.description:
About Amazon Japan Operations
Amazon Japan Operations (JP Ops) is responsible for Amazon Japan’s end-to-end logistics and operations in Japan, operating a large-scale, highly integrated supply chain spanning from First Mile to Last Mile. Through Fulfillment Centers (FC), Sort Centers (SC), Delivery Stations (DS), and Sub Same-Day Delivery stations (SSD), we continuously challenge ourselves to deliver packages faster, more reliably, and at lower cost.

About End-to-End Supply Chain & Speed Services
End-to-End Supply Chain & Speed Services is the core organization within JP Ops that owns supply chain strategy as well as network design and execution. By integrating Supply Chain, Network Design/Planning, and Transportation Planning, the organization optimizes forecasting, planning, network flow, and execution in an end-to-end manner. It also leads speed-focused services such as Same-Day Delivery, Quick Commerce, freezer and perishable grocery, and micromobility, enabling rapid innovation at scale to continuously elevate customer experience.

About JP Launch and Expansion (L&E)
JP Launch and Expansion (L&E) is the project management organization under End-to-End Supply Chain & Speed Services that turns supply chain strategy into a real, operating network. L&E owns execution end-to-end—from upstream activities such as site selection, investment return analysis, and internal investment approvals, through launch planning, hiring, system configuration, training, and go-live readiness. L&E does not stop at planning or approvals. We make decisions, drive execution on the ground, and build Amazon Japan’s operations as real, operating sites.
Spanning from First Mile to Last Mile, L&E plays a central role in driving Launch & Expansion across JP Ops.

L&E is currently composed of the following teams:
Core Planning and Execution (CPE)
CPE manages the Last Mile Core network composed of DS, XPT, and AMPL, covering new launches, closures, and network configuration changes.
The team leads end-to-end execution, including site selection, investment business case design, internal approvals, and start-up execution, while optimizing the network from a mid- to long-term perspective.
— A team that designs, implements, and optimizes the Last Mile Core network with a long-term view.
SSD Planning and Execution (SPE)
SPE owns SSD and AMZL+ projects from launch through closure. To support the growth of Same-Day Delivery, the team drives project execution that balances speed with repeatability and scalability.
— A team that rapidly scales the Same-Day Delivery network, a key growth area.
Retrofit, Expansion and Initiative (REI)
REI leads end-to-end execution for new and emerging initiatives, with a primary focus on Quick Commerce (QC). Working closely with global teams, REI scales these initiatives in Japan and establishes sustainable standards, including new programs such as Amazon Storage Unit (ASU).
— A team that turns concepts into viable, scalable businesses.
Launch Configuration and Verification (LCV)
LCV is responsible for system configuration and verification across all Last Mile node types. With a strong focus on “Right First Time,” the team supports reliable start-ups with a target of zero DPMO at launch.
— A team that ensures successful launches through robust system design and verification.
Project Management Office (PMO)
PMO operates horizontally across L&E, governing SOPs and playbooks, monitoring project progress, and managing PMIS to ensure execution discipline and visibility.
— A team that raises execution quality across L&E through standardization and continuous improvement.

Career Path
What makes L&E unique is that we do not simply sit between strategy and execution—we own both.
Few organizations within Amazon offer the opportunity to lead end-to-end, from upstream decisions such as network strategy and investment prioritization to on-the-ground execution and operational stabilization.
In L&E, you are not confined to a single site or function. You operate with a network-wide perspective across Japan Operations, constantly balancing local execution with system-level optimization.
This naturally builds the ability to think and decide not in silos, but in terms of overall impact.
With high ownership and accountability, L&E provides hands-on experience in driving complex, ambiguous projects to completion.
This experience accelerates growth not only as a project manager, but as a future leader who can shape and execute strategy.
For those who want to move beyond “delivering tasks” and instead define, decide, and build what comes next, L&E offers a uniquely dense and rewarding environment.

Amazon Japan Operationsは、ファーストマイルからラストマイルに至るまで、複数の物流ノードと輸送ネットワークを組み合わせた大規模かつ高度に統合されたサプライチェーンを運営しています。フルフィルメントセンター（FC）、ソートセンター（SC）、デリバリーステーション（DS）、当日配送拠点（SSD）などを通じて、「速く・正確に・低コストで」商品をお客様に届けることに日々挑戦しています。

End-to-End Supply Chain & Speed Servicesは、JP Opsにおけるサプライチェーン戦略とネットワーク設計・実行を統括する中核組織です。サプライチェーン、ネットワークデザイン／プランニング、輸送プランニングを一体で運営し、予測、計画、ネットワークフロー、実行までをEnd-to-Endで最適化します。また、Same-Day Delivery、Quick Commerce、冷凍・生鮮、マイクロモビリティなど、お客様体験を革新するスピード系サービスを統合的にリードし、規模を持った迅速なイノベーションを可能にしています。

JP Launch and Expansion（L&E）は、Japan OperationsにおけるEnd-to-Endサプライチェーン戦略を、現実のネットワークとして具現化するプロジェクトマネジメント組織です。ネットワーク戦略に基づくサイト選定、投資対効果の設計・分析、社内投資審査の承認取得といった上流工程から、立ち上げ計画策定、採用、システム設定、トレーニング、Go-Liveまでを一気通貫でリードします。L&Eは単なる計画や承認に留まらず、自ら意思決定し、現場を動かし、日本のAmazonオペレーションを「実際に稼働する拠点」として創り上げることをミッションとしています。ファーストマイルからラストマイルまでを横断し、Launch & Expansionに直接貢献する中核組織です。

現在のL&Eは、以下のチームで構成されています。
Core Planning and Execution（CPE）
DS、XPT、AMPLから構成されるラストマイルのCoreネットワークを横断的に管理し、新規立ち上げ、クローズ、ネットワーク構成変更までを担います。物件選定、投資対効果設計、投資承認取得、立ち上げ実行までをエンドツーエンドでリードし、中長期視点でネットワーク全体を最適化します。
― ラストマイル コアネットワークを長期視点で設計・実装・最適化するチーム。
SSD Planning and Execution（SPE）
SSDおよびAMZL+プロジェクトを担当し、新規立ち上げからクローズまでを管理します。Same-Day Deliveryの成長を支えるため、スピードと再現性を両立したプロジェクト運営を推進します。
― 成長領域であるSame-Dayネットワークを高速にスケールさせるチーム。
Retrofit, Expansion and Initiative（REI）
Quick Commerce（QC）を中心とした新規・成長領域をエンドツーエンドでリードします。グローバルチームと連携しながら拡張を進め、Amazon Storage Unit（ASU）など新たな取り組みを日本で定着・標準化します。
― 未成熟な領域を事業として成立させるチーム。
Launch Configuration and Verification（LCV）
すべてのラストマイルノードにおけるシステム設定・検証を担当します。立ち上げ時の「Right First Time」を重視し、ゼロDPMOを目標に確実なスタートアップを支えます。
― 全ノード種の立ち上げをシステム設計面から担保するチーム。
Project Management Office（PMO）
L&E全体を横断し、SOPやプレイブックの管理、プロジェクト進捗モニタリング、プロジェクトマネジメントシステム運用を通じて実行規律と可視性を担保します。
― L&E全体の実行品質を担保し、かつ継続的に改善するチーム。

キャリアパス
L&Eの最大の魅力は、「戦略」と「実行」の間に立つのではなく、その両方を自ら担う点にあります。
ネットワーク戦略や投資判断といった上流の意思決定から、現場での立ち上げ・安定稼働までを一気通貫でリードできる環境は、Amazonの中でも限られた組織だけが持つ特性です。
またL&Eでは、単一拠点や単一機能に閉じることなく、Japan Operations全体のネットワークを俯瞰しながらプロジェクトを推進します。
そのため、局所最適ではなく、全体最適の視点で物事を考え、意思決定する力が自然と鍛えられます。
高い裁量と責任のもとで、複雑で不確実性の高いプロジェクトを動かし切る経験は、プロジェクトマネージャーとしてだけでなく、将来のリーダーとしての成長にも直結します。
「実行するだけ」ではなく、「なぜそれをやるのか」から考え、形にしたい人にとって、L&Eは極めて密度の高い成長機会を提供する組織です。

Key job responsibilities
Strategic Planning
• Lead site selection, design, and budget procurement
• Manage multiple launch projects concurrently
• Conduct ROI analysis for strategic investment decisions
• Optimize site performance throughout the entire lifecycle

Process Optimization and Standardization
• Develop and implement standardized processes
• Set new efficiency benchmarks for the launch planning process
• Collaborate with global teams to share insights

Stakeholder Management and Communication
• Serve as project manager, facilitating effective communication among all stakeholders
• Manage project timelines and provide regular updates to leadership
• Navigate regulatory requirements and foster local partnerships

戦略的計画
• サイト選定、設計、予算調達をリード
• 複数の立ち上げプロジェクトを同時に管理
• 戦略的投資判断のためのROI分析を実施
• サイトのライフサイクル全体を通じてパフォーマンスを最適化

プロセスの最適化と標準化
• 標準化されたプロセスを開発・実装
• 立ち上げ計画プロセスの新しい効率基準を設定
• グローバルチームと協力し、知見を共有

ステークホルダー管理とコミュニケーション
• プロジェクトマネージャーとして、全ステークホルダー間の効果的なコミュニケーションを促進
• プロジェクトのタイムラインを管理し、リーダーシップに定期的な進捗報告を提供
• 規制要件に対応し、地域パートナーシップを構築

About the team
SSD Planning and Execution (SPE)
SPE manages the Core network across DS, XPT, and AMPL, covering new launches, closures, and XPT parent changes. The team leads end-to-end execution, including site selection, ROI design, CAR approvals, and start-up execution, while optimizing the network from a mid- to long-term perspective.
— A team that designs, implements, and optimizes the Core network with a long-term view.

SSD Planning and Execution（SPE）
DS、XPT、AMPLを含むCoreネットワークを横断的に管理し、新規立ち上げ、クローズ、XPT接続元変更までを担います。物件選定、ROI設計、CAR取得、立ち上げ実行までをエンドツーエンドでリードし、中長期視点でネットワーク全体を最適化します。
― Coreネットワークを長期視点で設計・実装・最適化するチーム。

- Bachelor's degree
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience dealing well with ambiguity, prioritizing needs, and delivering measurable results in an agile environment
- 4+ years of logistics experience

jobs.title: Sr Program Manager, EU Supply Chain Long Term Planning, EU LTP
jobs.description:
The Senior Program Manager, Non-Sort Inbound Network Planning in the STEP organization leads non-sortable inbound volumes and topology planning across mid-term (1-year) and long-term (3-year+) horizons for Amazon's EU Non-Sort (NS) Inbound network. The role focuses on two critical areas:
• Developing and executing the CEU+UK non-sort inbound build plan to meet future demand at optimal cost
• Driving strategic EU-wide initiatives to enhance non-sort network design, capacity planning, and operational processes

These responsibilities require managing complex cross-functional programs involving senior-level stakeholders across Finance, Engineering, Operations, Inbound Supply Chain (IBSC), External Fulfillment (3P), Real Estate and Transportation.

The role delivers through the main annual planning cycles (SPS, OP1, OP2, QxG), optimizing Amazon's plan of record for non-sort inbound network investments. The Senior PM owns end-to-end planning processes, from establishing non-sort demand forecasts and capacity requirements to identifying solve options and driving execution through Supply Chain and Engineering teams. This requires deep analysis across vendor/seller behavior patterns, non-sort inbound program trends, and seasonal demand patterns to develop risk-aware build plans that address demand uncertainties.

Working closely with Finance, the role defines optimal investment levels through rigorous evaluation of solutions, including new permanent/temporary sites, retrofits, and determining optimal timing and sequencing of network launches. Critical trade-off decisions balance multiple factors:
• Cost/Risk optimization vs. operational flexibility
• Fixed vs. variable capacity investments
• Short-term operational needs vs. long-term network sustainability

The Senior PM leads complex analytical approaches to evaluate planning challenges, particularly around non-sort node optimization (TNS sites, IXD non-sort flows, 3P solutions, and specialty handling requirements). They articulate recommendations to leadership based on comprehensive analysis of economics and operational viability. Key areas include the Non-Sort DNA framework defining optimal network configurations, floor-stack vs. rack storage trade-offs, heavy/bulky item flow optimization, and depalletization strategies for non-sort volumes.

Beyond cyclical planning, this role requires constantly redefining the non-sort network strategy in response to the rapid evolution in the Inbound space. They ensure that developments are captured via continuous improvement in EU-wide planning processes. This requires:
• Creating frameworks to evaluate complex business problems specific to non-sort operations
• Developing innovative solutions leveraging data-driven insights
• Building consensus across diverse stakeholder groups
• Driving execution through multiple organizations

Examples include developing the Non-Sort solve strategy, and evolving the EU peak non-sort inbound strategy to strengthen network resilience against demand volatility.

The Senior PM must identify high-impact opportunities across the non-sort network, develop comprehensive solutions considering multiple constraints (vendor/seller behavior, real estate, labor, technology, specialty handling requirements), and drive initiatives through complex organizational structures to successful conclusions. This requires careful balancing of upstream supply chain needs with downstream fulfillment requirements while maintaining focus on long-term network optimization.

Key job responsibilities
The role covers the following responsibility areas:
1. Strategic Network Planning & Architecture
2. Partnership with demand forecasting & capacity solve
3. Annual Planning Cycle Leadership (SPS, OP1, OP2, QxG)
4. Cross-Functional Influence & Stakeholder Management
5. Peak Inbound Strategy & Resilience
6. Leadership Communication & Decision Enablement
Basic qualifications:
- Experience in program or project management
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
Preferred qualifications:
- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
- Experience leading process improvements

This role requires comfort with ambiguity, the ability to context-switch between strategic planning and tactical problem-solving, and the judgment to know which mode a situation demands. Regular engagement with senior leadership on strategy, risk, and performance is expected.

• Own the end-to-end operational P&L for our site in London, driving measurable improvements in cost-per-unit economics while maintaining or exceeding quality SLAs across all active programs.
• Drive workforce planning in partnership with Finance, aligning labor capacity models to demand forecasts managing flex strategies (overtime, cross-training, temporary labor) to maintain SLA compliance during volume fluctuations.
• Define and execute a multi-year operational strategy for Data Services at the site, anticipating shifts in program volume, automation adoption, and workforce composition, proactively positioning the site to absorb new workstreams.
• Lead cross-functional initiatives with Engineering, Product, and Program teams to define tooling requirements, influence product roadmaps based on operational friction data, and validate feature releases through structured UAT processes.
• Own the site's quality ecosystem, establishing closed-loop mechanisms where defect root causes are identified within 24 hours, corrective actions are implemented within one sprint cycle, and systemic patterns are escalated with data-backed proposals to Engineering and Product teams.

• Build and lead a high-performing leadership team (Operations Managers, Team Managers), setting differentiated performance expectations, calibrating talent rigorously, and maintaining a ready-now succession pipeline for all critical roles.
• Champion a data-driven culture where every operational decision is grounded in statistical analysis, A/B testing of process changes is standard practice, and anecdotal reasoning is challenged.
• Build and sustain an engagement model that delivers measurable year-over-year improvement in associate retention and engagement scores, with specific interventions tied to root-cause analysis of attrition drivers rather than generic culture programs.
• Serve as the site’s executive voice to senior leadership, translating operational data into strategic narratives, owning regular business review inputs, drafting strategic papers for director-level decision forums, and proactively surfacing risks with mitigation plans rather than reactive escalations.
• Operate as a force multiplier across the cluster, sharing best practices, standardizing processes across sites, and contributing to org-wide mechanisms that raise the performance ceiling for peer sites.

jobs.description:
AWS Global Sales Operations is the strategic operating function that provides insights, mechanisms, and objective recommendations enabling AWS Global Sales to scale, transform, and deliver long-term customer and business outcomes.
At AWS, we celebrate innovation, calculated risk-taking, and new ideas. We are builders who experiment, learn, simplify, and scale what works. You will build mechanisms that surface risks earlier, reduce manual work, improve decision quality, and ensure technical expertise is deployed where it creates the greatest customer and business value.

You will also own the area’s migration strategy and execution end to end, driving progress from opportunity identification through migration launch, modernization, and consumption realization with a large cross functional team across the Area.

This is a cross-functional, hands-on role that requires strong strategic judgment, analytical rigor, commercial awareness, and operational discipline. The ideal candidate can operate effectively in ambiguity, influence senior stakeholders, communicate across technical and non-technical audiences, and build scalable mechanisms that improve how the business operates.

Success in this role requires an owner mindset, strong bias for action, and the ability to turn complex business and technical priorities into clear operating plans that deliver measurable impact for customers and AWS.

Key job responsibilities
Strategic Partnership: Advise Area Tech Leaders on strategy, organizational performance, risks, priorities, and investment decisions.

Strategy and Planning: Develop and execute the Tech operating plan, translating EMEA Tech strategy and Area business priorities into clear priorities, actions, and outcomes.

Business Performance: Establish KPIs, lead business reviews, and provide decision-oriented insights that improve performance, resource allocation, and execution.

Sales and Tech Alignment: Align technical priorities and capacity with the Area business plan and identify gaps requiring leadership action.

Migration and Modernization: Own the Area’s Migration and Modernization strategy and execution end to end, from opportunity identification and prioritization through migration, modernization, launch, and consumption realization.

Strategic Initiatives: Coordinate GenAI, customer adoption, and other Area Tech priorities, recommending when to scale, redesign, simplify, or stop.

Resource Planning: Provide data-backed recommendations on capacity, coverage, skills, and technical resource allocation.

Customer Adoption: Track customer progression from technical engagement to production adoption and business outcomes, distinguishing activity from measurable impact.

Amazon Retail Business Services is looking for an experienced Business Analyst to join our team and help unlock insights which take our business to the next level. - Prepare and deliver business requirements reviews to the senior management team regarding progress and roadblocks.

• Data-Driven Decision-Making: Use advanced analytics tools to uncover inefficiencies, analyze cost and volume drivers, and develop actionable solutions. Drive detailed discussions based on data insights and align cross-functional teams on high-priority initiatives.

Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.

This position serves as the operational right hand to the Aviation Sales Leader within the Leo B2B Commercial Sales organization. Operating as the de facto COO for the Aviation team, this role enables the sales leader to make data-driven decisions, look around corners, and drive predictable business outcomes.
The Field Sales Operations Lead will be responsible for the full operational lifecycle of the Aviation business - from revenue reporting and forecasting to strategic planning and cross-functional partnership. This is a high-visibility role that requires both analytical rigor and strategic business acumen, with direct influence on the trajectory of the Amazon Leo's Aviation business.

Key job responsibilities
Revenue Operations & Financial Management
• Own all aspects of revenue reporting, analysis, and financial management for the Aviation team, ensuring timeliness, completeness, and accuracy
• Develop and deliver business insights encompassing key metrics reviewed with the Aviation Sales Leader and Leo B2B Sales leadership team to inform decisions and drive action
• Lead revenue forecasting cadence - delivering weekly, monthly, and quarterly forecasts with clear assumptions and variance analysis
• Drive pipeline inspection and management processes to ensure pipeline hygiene and coverage ratios align with business targets
Territory Design & Quota Deployment
• Lead territory planning, account segmentation, and quota development for the Aviation team
• Partner with Finance and Compensation teams to design and deploy Account Manager quota plans
• Manage headcount tracking and planning in support of hiring objectives
Rhythm of Business & Strategic Planning
• Design, develop, and own the full Rhythm of Business cadence for the Aviation team - including MBR, QBR, and annual planning cycles
• Author strategic vertical narratives and lead the formulation and delivery of Quarterly Business Reviews
• Facilitate Monthly Business Reviews with clear operational insights, trends, and recommended actions
• Coordinate OP1/OP2 planning activities, narrative development, and goal-setting processes
Strategic Partnership & Cross-Functional Leadership
• Serve as the strategic thought partner to the Aviation Sales Leader - providing data-backed recommendations, identifying risks early, and helping the leader look around corners
• Partner cross-functionally with Finance, Legal, Accounting, Tax, Service Teams, Marketing, and Partner organizations to deliver on business objectives
• Coordinate with corporate teams to influence roadmap for enhanced business intelligence, CRM tools, and operational processes
• Evaluate and recommend new ways of managing business operations that can accelerate Leo's growth in Aviation
• Represent the Aviation Team in cross-team strategic initiatives and planning forums

About the team
As a member of the Leo Sales Planning & Compensation (SPC) team, you will be working alongside a group of sales operations professionals to support the Leo B2B Commercial Sales organization. In addition to designing and administering Sales Compensation for the organization, the team also provides end-to-end sales operations support to our sales teams and leaders.

In this role, you will be working with Leo sales team members, as well as related functions including finance, legal, accounting, tax, the Deal Desk, Sales & Partner Products, and more.
Basic qualifications:
- 10+ years of Microsoft Excel experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience developing and implementing systems/tools utilized for CRM, variable compensation, revenue reporting, forecasting, Salesforce automation, etc.
- Experience defining, refining and implementing sales processes, procedures and policies or equivalent
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience presenting to senior leadership
- Master's degree or equivalent
- Experience completing complex tasks quickly with little to no guidance and react with appropriate urgency to situations that require a quick turnaround, or experience prioritizing and handling multiple assignments at any given time while maintaining commitment to deadlines
- Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders
- 5+ years of Space Vehicle/Satellite Operations, Space Communications or related industry experience
- Experience partnering with senior leaders to deliver results

jobs.title: Senior Event Operations Lead , Strategic Events and Executive Programs
jobs.description:
Amazon Ads' Global Strategic Events (STEEP) team is seeking an operationally excellent and business-minded Senior Event Operations Lead to drive production oversight and business affairs across our growing portfolio of marquee live, virtual, and hybrid events.

This role is central to ensuring our events are delivered on time, on budget, and at the highest quality bar — with ownership spanning vendor and agency management, event production oversight, budget and financial operations, strategic planning, and logistics coordination. You will serve as the connective tissue between internal stakeholders and external production partners, ensuring accountability, financial rigor, and seamless execution.

This is a high-visibility individual contributor role reporting to the Global Event Operations Lead. The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity — proactively identifying needs, bringing ideas without waiting to be directed, and operating with full autonomy. You will influence without authority, galvanize cross-functional teams, and bring the operational leadership needed to manage complex vendor ecosystems and production workstreams in a fast-paced, document-driven environment.

Key job responsibilities
Vendor and Agency Management
-Own end-to-end vendor and agency relationship management: SOW development, performance oversight, and contract negotiations
-Manage the full procurement journey — onboard suppliers, execute contracts, process spend approvals, open POs, and approve invoices
-Drive compliance and legal coordination across international markets
-Serve as the primary business affairs liaison between internal event leads and external production partners

Strategic Planning & Reporting
-Contribute to the annual planning cycle: calendar, budget, and goals mapped to business priorities
-Support Leadership review documentation and help shape how the ops team maps to evolving priorities
-Synthesize registration, attendance, and ROI insights into strategic recommendations

Budget & Financial Operations
-Develop and manage event budgets within a large-scale program
-Track expenses, lead invoice management, and ensure delivery within approved allocations

Operations & Process Development
-Drive process development and lead operational workstreams across the events team
-Identify and implement AI tools and automation solutions to scale operations
-Build and maintain scalable frameworks, templates, and SOPs
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience with end-to-end procurement processes including RFPs, vendor onboarding, and contract execution
- Experience developing and managing large-scale event budgets
- Willingness to travel for onsite event support across domestic and international markets
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience managing multiple projects and meeting aggressive deadlines
- Background in the technology industry, digital marketing, or a global consumer brand
- Familiarity with event registration tools and reporting infrastructure

jobs.title: Senior Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Our Senior Operations Managers play a crucial role in exceeding expectations and providing a superb customer experience; critical to Amazon’s success which is built on a foundation of customer obsession, and innovation. This position is a multi-faceted role requiring the ability to balance strategy and execution. The Senior Operations Manager is responsible for all aspects of the operations of a functional area for one of our Fulfillment Centers including, people management and development, process, and meeting or exceeding the expectations and promise made to our customers. You will lead a dynamic team of Operations and Area Managers to achieve operational excellence through coaching and mentoring the team; driving employee engagement, and building leadership bench strength within the Fulfillment Center.

As a senior leader you will oversee upwards of 1,000+ salaried and hourly employees, in a fast-paced, complex operations facility up to a million square feet.

Our Senior Operations Managers serve as the face of the organization to potentially thousands of employees and the community where the center is located. This position offers unlimited career potential as we continue to grow our global footprint.

Key job responsibilities
- Owns and delivers the operational budget for functional area, including safety, productivity, financial and labor planning, and operational goals for outbound, or inbound operations
- Responsible for providing strategic level/long-term planning (3, 6, and 12 months out) including labor planning, rate forecasting, and peak season planning
- Drives continuous improvement projects to optimize operations and improve productivity to meet and exceed business objectives; works on strategic projects that have total building and network-wide impact. Effectively leverages the Operations and Area Managers to solicit ideas and understand problems and challenges in the building.
- Networks with other leaders across the network to solicit and share process improvements and drive efficiencies and cost savings.
- Establishes objectives and metrics for safety, quality, productivity, and customer experience
- Sets clear goals and expectations for Operations and Area Managers. Measures performance, provides feedback, and holds leaders accountable
- Mentors and develops leaders and staff
- Participates in recruiting to identify and evaluate associates and internal/external candidates for promotion and hire.
- Works closely with support staff (HR, Finance, Maintenance Engineering, Safety, IT and other leaders) to build and secure support and resources for projects and initiatives

Additional Job Elements:
- Lift and move totes up to 49 pounds each
- Regular bending, lifting, stretching and reaching both below the waist and above the head
- Must be able to stand/walk for up to 10-12 hours
- Should be able to work in environments with variable noise levels, lighting conditions and temperature variation.
- Able to access all areas of building (ascending and descending ladders, stairs, gangways safely and without limitation
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Direct management experience, including a salaried workforce, in a manufacturing, production, distribution, or logistics environment
- Experience with performance metrics, process improvement, and Lean methodologies
- Experience with the full staffing lifecycle, including interviewing, hiring, performance management, promotions and terminations
- Candidates must be flexible to work a variety of hours as business demands, including overnight, weekends and holidays
Preferred qualifications:
- Degree in Engineering, Operations or related technical field; MBA or Master’s degree preferred
- Ability to handle changing priorities and use good judgment in stressful situation
- Interest in long-term career development through assignments in multiple FCs across the nation
- Prior leadership development training or participation
- Track record of effectively leading an operation comprising both salaried and hourly staff of at least 100
- Demonstrated ability to successfully develop others into higher levels of leadership in an organization

jobs.title: Strategic Finance Manager, AWS AI and Cloud Finance
jobs.description:
Come join Amazon Web Services (AWS) Finance — a high-performing organization supporting a $125B+ annual revenue business that is redefining how the world builds and operates technology. AWS is investing over $100B in capital expenditures to expand its global infrastructure footprint, and our Finance team is at the center of those critical investment decisions that drive long-term customer value at a global scale.

WHY AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform — offering the greatest choice of innovative cloud and AI capabilities on the most extensive global infrastructure in the world. Today, AWS is at the forefront of the generative AI revolution, investing at unprecedented scale — over $100 billion in capital expenditures — to expand its global infrastructure footprint, bring the power of the cloud and AI closer to customers everywhere, and build the foundation for the next generation of technology. AWS is also committed to sustainability, working toward net-zero carbon by 2040, and investing in renewable energy and innovative data center designs to power the most demanding AI workloads efficiently. If you want to work at the intersection of technology, business, and sustainability — where your decisions shape the future of cloud computing and AI for millions of customers worldwide — AWS is the place to be.

WHY AWS FINANCE

AWS Finance is a critical pillar of the Finance & Global Business Services (FGBS) organization — the team that provides end-to-end financial support for all of AWS. But this isn’t traditional finance. At AWS, finance leaders are strategic business partners and trusted advisors who sit at the table where the biggest decisions are made.

As a finance business leader at AWS, you will partner directly with engineering, product, sales, and operations leaders to influence multi-billion dollar investment decisions, evaluate the economics of new services and regions, structure complex enterprise deals, optimize go-to-market strategies, and drive the financial discipline that enables AWS to grow responsibly at massive scale. Whether you’re building the business case for a new data center, modeling the unit economics of a generative AI service, or advising sales leadership on compensation strategy — your work directly impacts how AWS serves customers around the world.

Key job responsibilities
As a Finance Manager, you will join one of our dynamic teams supporting areas such as infrastructure investment, cloud services, AI solutions, sales and marketing, partner ecosystems, central planning, enterprise deals, risk management or sustainability.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:
• Own end-to-end financial planning, analysis, and strategic recommendations for a high-growth business area — spanning capital investments, P&L management, pricing strategy, and go-to-market optimization
• Build financial models that inform multi-billion dollar decisions across infrastructure expansion, product launches, enterprise deal structures, and generative AI investments
• Partner directly with senior business leaders as a trusted advisor on investment priorities, resource allocation, and long-term growth strategy
• Develop and present insights to senior leadership through business reviews, translating complex financial data into clear, actionable recommendations
• Influence long-term business strategy through scenario modeling, business case development, and economic analysis
• Work cross-functionally with engineering, product, sales, and operations teams to translate business priorities into financial frameworks
• Drive operational excellence and controllership across your business area, utilizing automation and AI-powered tools to enhance financial processes and accelerate decision-making
• Partner with business and operations leaders to provide financial strategy and controllership for AWS’s sustainability commitments — including renewable energy investments, carbon emissions reporting, and water stewardship — ensuring financial rigor for sustainable, long-term growth
• Grow your career across multiple finance disciplines — all within one organization
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business, economics, or a related analytical field (e.g., engineering, math, computer science)
- 5+ years of finance or a related analytical field experience
- 5+ years of building financial and operational reports/data sets that inform business decision-making experience
- Experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, and data interpretation of results
- Experience building and managing financial models for business forecasting and problem solving
- Experience in solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits)
- Experience communicating results to senior leadership
Preferred qualifications:
- MBA, or CFA
- CPA, or CMA
- 5+ years of dissecting financial data and identifying patterns that support business strategy experience
- Experience delivering results for large, cross-functional initiatives/projects
- Experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)

jobs.description:

アマゾンでは日本のAmazon Logistics （AMXL）チームの家具家電配送を行うデリバリーステーション・オペレーションとソートセンターのデュアルオペレーションセンターのマネージャーを募集しています。AMXLのゴールはお客様に荷物をお届けする物流の最後の区間、ラストマイルにおいて、世界水準のオペレーションを構築することです。アマゾンではお客様により速く、正確に、そして効果的な方法でお届けすることで、お客様の期待を上回るサービスを提供することに重点的に取り組んでおり、日本でもAMXLが急速に拡大しています。

オペレーションマネージャーは、出入荷、ソートオペレーションに対する責任を負い、大きな裁量を任される仕事です。デリバリーステーション（DS）のオペレーションマネージャーはセンター長として、マネージャーレベルの部下を持ち、ソート（仕分け）やディスパッチ（配送ドライバーへの荷物の引き渡し）のオペレーションを指揮します。また、DSで働くメンバーのエンゲージメントを高め、日々のオペレーションの目標を確実に遂行することに加え、さらなる高みを目指してオペレーションの改善や新しいサービスの導入を進めていく改善スキル、推進力が期待されています。
===================================
*Working location for this position is Ibaraki Osaka.

Amazon seeks a Senior Operations Manager to join our Japan Amazon Logistics team. The goal of Amazon Logistics (AMXL) is to build a world class last mile operation delivering to customers. Amazon aims to exceed the expectations of our customers by ensuring that their orders are delivered as quickly, accurately, and in the most cost effective way as possible and we are expanding rapidly in Japan.

The Station Operations Manager has complete responsibility for inbound, outbound and sortation operations. Delivery Stations (DS) represent the last leg of our delivery network. Customer packages travel from our Fulfillment Centers to regional Sort Centers and finally end up at our local DS where packages are sorted and dispatched directly to the customer via delivery service providers (couriers). Station Operations Managers are the right hand person for the Site Leaders and will lead the entire sortation and dispatch operations leading multiple mangers in their reporting line. They will engage all members working at the station and ensure achievement of daily and longer-term operation goals. Additionally, they will actively engage with site and regional operations leadership to implement new operational improvements and new services. We expect our managers to continually identify ways to improve our operations.
【具体的な業務内容】
・ソートおよびディスパッチオペレーションのリードおよび監督
・シフト全体の安全性、品質、パフォーマンス、カスタマーサービス向上
・組織の方針と手順に従っての監督責任
・オペレーション目標の達成、および、それを上回る成果の実現
・物量等の予測に基づく、戦略的な計画立案、パフォーマンスの評価、問題の解決および人材配置に関するニーズへの対応
・チームメンバーのキャリア向上、指導、トレーニングおよび育成
・Learning and Talent Developmentチームとのパートナーシップにより、人材の獲得、パフォーマンスとキャリア開発、育成、サクセッションプランに関する計画の立案と実行
・シフトとネットワーク全体にわたってのベストプラクティスの創出・展開

このポジションに求められるのは、経験に裏打ちされたプロセスの改善能力と、アマゾンの成長速度に合わせ、メンバーのモチベーションを高めながらさまざまなチャレンジに対して短期間で成果を出していく能力を持つ候補者です。また、さまざまな経験、バックグラウンドを持つ多様なメンバーと協業していく柔軟性が求められます。
まだ若い組織であり、組織やビジネスとともに成長できる高い意欲とポテンシャルをもった方を求めています。

※こちらの職種は日勤帯を中心としたシフト勤務（土日祝日含む交替制勤務）となりますが、職務遂行上必要な場合には夜勤帯で勤務していただく場合もございます。
Responsibilities:
Lead and supervise a team of managers and associates in sortation and dispatch operations
Responsible for the overall safety, quality, performance and customer experience of the shift.
Carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization’s policies and procedures.
Accountability for meeting and exceeding operational goals.
Strategic planning and forecasting; appraise performance, resolve problems; and address staffing needs.
Mentor, train and develop teammates for career progression and learning
Partner with Learning and Talent Development Team on creating and implementing talent plans for their sites including talent acquisition, performance and career management, learning and development, succession planning, and employee engagement.
Ability to develop and share best practices across the shifts and network.

This position requires a candidate with the proven ability to drive process improvements and the ability to keep pace with our growth while motivating others to meet challenges in a deadline-driven environment. We are also looking for a candidate who excel in an environment where talents with diverse experience and background work together. Our organization is still young and we are looking for a talent who has enthusiasm and high potential to growth with our organization and business.

※This position has to work in shift including weekends and holidays, mainly during the day, but may also cover night shifts as needed.

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
• Own and deliver operational budget for functional area, including safety, productivity, financial and labor planning, and operational goals for delivery station and sort center
• Responsible for providing strategic level/long-term planning (3, 6, and 12 months out), including labor planning, rate forecasting, and peak season planning
• Be accountable for operational leadership by measuring performance, offering feedback, and providing development support
• Drive continuous improvement projects to optimize operations and improve productivity to meet and exceed business objectives; work on strategic projects that have total building and network-wide impact
• Communicate with other leaders across the network to solicit and share process improvements and drive efficiencies and cost savings
• Establish objectives and metrics for safety, quality, availability, productivity, cost and customer experience
• Works closely with support staff (HR, Finance, Facilities, Safety, IT and Other Team manager) to build and secure support and resources for projects and initiatives, as well as providing needed support and resources for other network initiatives

A day in the life
You spend time visiting or building multiple Amazon owned Delivery Station and sort centers in Japan reviewing the operations and setting up the right processes and mechanisms to drive safety, cost, speed and availability at every instance. You hire, develop and motivate your team to deliver against the same goals using the Amazon leadership principles that you truly embody with all your actions.

About the team
AMXL JP team is a single threaded organization that owns Amazon's end-to-end Heavy & Bulky (H&B) logistics network with our willing and equally customer obsessed partners, offering shipping, service & support for consumers and companies in a safe, reliable, seamless, standardized, and sustainable way that surprises and delights our customers. Our delivery partners are experienced in H&B deliveries, providing special handling services such as Room of Choice Delivery, Installation/Assembly and Recycling/Haul-Away.
Our team is made up of a diverse group of individuals across operations, supply chain, tech, finance, planning, customer experience, business intelligence and program management that work closely and collaboratively across Amazon to constantly improve and scale our operations, always insisting on the highest standards and obsessing over delivering bigger smiles for our customers.
Basic qualifications:
- 3+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Business level of English
Preferred qualifications:
- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
- Business level of Japanese

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. This role’s scope necessitates the ability to solve ambiguous issues and provide effective solutions to gaps between teams, processes and systems.
