jobs.title: Operations Manager, Work Auth, Work Authorization
jobs.description:
Amazon's Talent Solutions organization is working to build the earth's best employer — and Work Authorization (WA) is at the center of that mission. The WA team is a group of seasoned subject matter experts who, in close partnership with Legal, Risk & Compliance, Immigration, Technology, and Product teams, protects Amazon from the financial, reputational, and legal risks of unauthorized working across every country in which we operate. Our work is not incidental — it is a front-line defense against regulatory exposure and a foundational pillar of compliant, scalable global hiring.
As Manager III, HR Specialist for Work Authorization Operations, you will serve as a single-threaded owner for the operational delivery of work authorization compliance services worldwide. You will lead team managers and process leads who together oversee HR Specialists providing global production support.
This is a strategic L6 leadership role — you are expected to set vision and direction, define success, own the multi-year roadmap for your delivery organization, and represent WA Operations with authority in meetings with Legal, Risk & Compliance, Immigration, Technology, and Product stakeholders. You will build and sustain an organization that understands work authorization compliance at a deep, substantive level and that holds itself to an uncompromising standard of accuracy, process integrity, and SOP adherence.
You will work in close daily partnership with Regional HR Managers who own the program design and regional compliance strategy. Your accountability is for operational execution, team capability, and the delivery systems that make compliant, high-quality outcomes possible at scale. Together, you and the Regional HR Managers form the leadership backbone of Work Authorization.

Key job responsibilities
People Management & Leadership Development
- Lead, coach, and develop Manager-level direct reports as emerging and established leaders — not just operational supervisors. Invest in their growth as independent problem-solvers, communicators, and people leaders.
- Define clear performance expectations for each Manager aligned to both business outcomes and leadership competencies; conduct regular structured feedback conversations and annual calibrations.
- Build a succession pipeline within the management team; proactively identify high-potential talent across the organization for development.
- Foster a culture of psychological safety, accountability, and continuous improvement. Model the standard you expect: deep curiosity, intellectual honesty, and zero tolerance for compliance shortcuts.
- Own the org health of the broader team — including engagement, attrition, capacity planning, and workload equity — and develop mechanisms to proactively surface and address issues before they affect performance.
- Partner with your Managers to navigate complex performance management situations, building their capability to have hard conversations and reach fair, documented outcomes.
- Drive consistent onboarding and role-readiness standards across all team levels, ensuring new team members are equipped with substantive compliance knowledge — not just process scripts — before handling live casework.

Compliance Expertise & Knowledge Management
- Develop genuine, deep fluency in work authorization law, regulatory frameworks, and compliance obligations across all operating jurisdictions — not surface-level familiarity. Understand the "why" behind every control, not just the "what."
- Champion a compliance-first culture throughout your organization. Make it unambiguously clear that SOP deviations, unauthorized workarounds, and process shortcuts carry serious legal and regulatory risk — and hold that standard consistently.
- Partner with Legal and Risk & Compliance to remain current on regulatory changes, and translate those changes into updated operational guidance, retraining, and revised SOPs in a timely and thorough manner.
- Build structured knowledge management systems — including tiered training curricula, knowledge assessments, compliance playbooks, and escalation guides — that give the team durable, accessible tools for handling complex, ambiguous situations correctly.
- Establish a compliance quality framework: define defect categories, track defect rates by manager and process stream, root-cause recurring issues, and drive targeted remediation programs.
- Proactively identify compliance blind spots — areas where the team's knowledge or processes are insufficient to handle emerging business scenarios, regulatory changes, or technology shifts — and address them ahead of risk materialization.
- Act as an escalation resource for complex, novel compliance questions that require judgment beyond standard SOPs; partner with Legal when matters exceed operational authority.

Operational Excellence & Process Improvement
- Own end-to-end accountability for WA operational delivery metrics — including SLA attainment, case quality, throughput, error rates, and customer experience — across all regions and vendor-supported workflows.
- Design and maintain a rigorous operating rhythm: daily/weekly/monthly reviews with each Manager layer, structured escalation paths, and clear accountability for metric ownership at each tier.
- Lead continuous improvement initiatives using lean and kaizen methodologies; identify and eliminate process waste, redundancy, and error-prone manual steps.
- Own the identification and prioritization of process improvement opportunities across all operational streams, including intake, document review, verification, escalation handling, and vendor coordination.
- Manage vendor team coordination and performance; ensure vendor SLAs, quality standards, and compliance obligations are met and that escalation paths between vendor teams and internal teams are clear and effective.
- Drive standardization across regions to the extent compliance frameworks allow, while accommodating legitimate jurisdictional variation. Eliminate unnecessary divergence that creates training burden or quality risk.
- Maintain accurate, real-time visibility into capacity, volume trends, and staffing adequacy; proactively flag and address resource gaps before they affect service levels.

Stakeholder Management & Communication
- Serve as a confident, knowledgeable representative of WA Operations in cross-functional meetings with Legal, Risk & Compliance, Immigration, Technology, Product, Workforce Staffing, and senior PXT leadership — speaking with authority on operational processes, SLA capabilities, team capacity, and compliance posture.
- Maintain a close, trust-based partnership with Regional HR Managers who own program design and regional compliance strategy. Provide them with clear, honest, and timely operational intelligence so they can make well-informed programmatic decisions.
- Actively participate in technology and product roadmap discussions; provide substantive input on operational and compliance requirements, edge cases, and scalability needs — not just react to what is built.
- Build executive-quality communications —business reviews, escalation narratives — that deliver clear findings, data-backed conclusions, and actionable recommendations to senior stakeholders.
- Earn trust with cross-functional partners through demonstrated expertise, consistent follow-through, and straightforward communication about what is and is not operationally feasible.
- Represent WA Operations in OP planning, headcount discussions, and budget processes; clearly articulate the operational implications of business growth, regulatory changes, or technology gaps.
- Own and manage escalation intake from internal business partners including recruiters, HRBPs, Workforce Staffing, and senior business leaders; ensure escalations are triaged, routed, and resolved promptly with proper root cause capture.

Strategic Planning & Execution
- Define, instrument, and regularly review success metrics for the WA Operations organization — including compliance defect rates, SLA attainment, team capability benchmarks, and experience outcomes for candidates and employees.
- Contribute substantive input to OP1/OP2 planning cycles: author or co-author sections covering operational health, investment needs, risk landscape, and capacity requirements with precision and strategic clarity.
- Partner with Technology and Product teams to shape the WA technology roadmap; ensure that planned technology investments solve real operational and compliance problems and that the team is prepared to adopt and leverage new capabilities effectively.
- Identify and proactively address structural risks to program continuity: knowledge concentration, single points of failure, vendor dependency, and compliance gaps in emerging business areas.
- Build the case for organizational investment — headcount, tooling, training, process redesign — with rigorous data, clear business rationale, and connection to compliance risk reduction and operational performance improvement.
- Maintain awareness of regulatory and business trends globally; partner with Legal, Regional HR Managers, and Global WA Service Leader to ensure the operational organization stays ahead of — not reactive to — changes in the compliance landscape.

We are seeking an experienced Reverse Logistics Program Manager to join our Supply Chain team. This role will be responsible for optimizing the end-to-end reverse logistics process, ensuring efficient handling of customer returns, vendor returns, and removal volumes while maintaining operational excellence across our fulfillment network.

Key job responsibilities

jobs.title: Program Manager Ⅲ , Production Planning Team
jobs.description:
Production Planning Team (PPT) within Amazon Japan Operations is seeking a Program Manager to lead strategic production planning initiatives across our nationwide network.

Amazon’s mission is to be Earth’s most customer-centric company and to offer the Earth’s widest selection. We continuously enhance the customer experience through selection, price, and convenience, powered by data-driven decision-making and operational innovation.

Established in 2023, PPT is a strategic organization responsible for advancing production planning capabilities and network optimization across more than 100 Fulfillment Centers (FCs) and External Fulfillment (EF) sites in Japan.

As a Program Manager, you will own the end-to-end strategy and execution of production planning across the FC/EF network. This role goes beyond short-term labor and capacity alignment; you will design scalable, long-term mechanisms that optimize accuracy, productivity, and cost efficiency at network scale.

You will be expected to challenge existing processes constructively, operate effectively in ambiguous environments, and make data-driven decisions with high judgment. Success in this role requires strong analytical capability, strategic thinking, and the ability to influence senior cross-functional stakeholders to drive large-scale operational transformation.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

アマゾンジャパンオペレーションのプロダクションプランニングチーム（PPT）では、プログラムマネージャーを募集しています。

Amazonは「地球上で最も豊富な品揃え」と「地球上で最もお客様を大切にする企業」をミッションに掲げ、Selection・Price・Convenienceを中核とした顧客体験の向上を追求し続けています。その実現のため、データドリブンな意思決定と継続的なイノベーションを通じて、オペレーションネットワークを進化させてきました。

PPTは2023年に設立された戦略組織であり、日本全国100以上のフルフィルメントセンター（FC）および外部フルフィルメント（EF）拠点を対象に、生産計画の高度化とネットワーク最適化を推進しています。

本ポジションでは、日本全国のFC/EFネットワーク全体を対象とした戦略的生産計画の策定・実行に対してオーナーシップを持っていただきます。短期的な需給調整に留まらず、中長期視点でスケーラブルな仕組みを設計し、精度・生産性・コスト効率の最適化を実現することが求められます。

既存プロセスを建設的に見直し、曖昧さの高い環境下においてもデータと論理に基づいた意思決定を行い、社内外のシニアステークホルダーを巻き込みながら変革を推進できるリーダーを求めています。

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

Key job responsibilities
[Important responsibilities of the program manager]
Own the strategy and execution of labor optimization across the JP FC/EF network, ensuring the right balance between cost efficiency and customer experience (CX), while driving sustainable improvements across short-term (3 months), mid-term (6 months), and long-term (1–3 years) horizons.

Design, implement, and continuously improve scalable labor cost management mechanisms that enable both operational network expansion and structural cost efficiency.

Lead the alignment of labor cost management practices with global standards while ensuring effective localization to meet the specific needs of Japan operations.

Identify, evaluate, and adapt global best practices to improve productivity, planning accuracy, and operational efficiency across the Japan FC/EF network.

Drive cross-regional collaboration to scale successful practices developed in Japan to other regions and contribute to the evolution of global planning standards.

Influence senior stakeholders across operations, finance, and global teams through data-driven insights, enabling aligned decision-making and effective execution of strategic initiatives.

[プログラムマネージャーの責任]
JP FC/EFネットワーク全体におけるLabor最適化の戦略策定および実行をリードし、コスト効率とCustomer Experience（CX）の両立を図りながら、短期（3ヶ月）、中期（6ヶ月）、長期（1～3年）の各時間軸で持続的な改善を推進する。

・ネットワークの拡大とコスト効率の両立を可能にする、スケーラブルなLabor Cost Managementの仕組みを設計・構築し、継続的な改善を行う。

・Labor Cost Managementにおけるグローバルスタンダードとの整合をリードするとともに、日本のオペレーション環境に適した形でのローカライズを推進する。

・海外のベストプラクティスを特定・評価し、日本のFC/EFネットワークに適用することで、生産性、計画精度、およびオペレーション効率の向上を推進する。

・日本で生まれた成功事例や新しいプランニングの仕組みをグローバルに展開し、グローバルな計画標準の発展に貢献する。

・データに基づく分析とインサイトを通じて、オペレーション、ファイナンス、およびグローバルチームのシニアステークホルダーに影響力を発揮し、戦略的な意思決定と施策の実行を推進する。

A day in the life
[Working style] ・Flextime ※ Standard working hours 8 hours/day and business hours is 9-18 (also consider personal circumstances). All business days are spent in the designated office or other company location.

[勤務形態] ・フレックスタイム制 ※標準労働時間帯は1日8時間、営業時間は9:00～18:00（個人の事情も考慮）。 原則すべての営業日で所定の拠点に出社。

This position works as a member of the PPT(Production Planning Team) within Amazon Japan's FNP team. Our team is in charge of a wide range of tasks, from short to long-term ranges, so that we can operate our ever-expanding Operation Network more efficiently, and we are making improvements day by day so that we can deliver products with a rich selection of products, sufficient inventory volume, and quick delivery speed to our customers. Amazon aims to create a diverse and inclusive workplace. Amazon complies with the Equal Employment Opportunity Act. We provide equal recruitment and selection opportunities without discrimination based on race, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, disability, age, or other attributes.

Customer packages travel from our Fulfillment Centers to regional Sort Centers and finally end up at our local DS where packages are sorted and dispatched directly to the customer via delivery service providers (couriers). Station Operations Managers are the right hand person for the Site Leaders and will lead the entire sortation and dispatch operations leading multiple mangers in their reporting line. We expect our managers to continually identify ways to improve our operations.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. - シフトとネットワーク全体にわたってのベストプラクティスの創出・展開

このポジションに求められるのは、経験に裏打ちされたプロセスの改善能力と、アマゾンの成長速度に合わせ、メンバーのモチベーションを高めながらさまざまなチャレンジに対して短期間で成果を出していく能力を持つ候補者です。
また、さまざまな経験、バックグラウンドを持つ多様なメンバーと協業していく柔軟性が求められます。
まだ若い組織であり、組織やビジネスとともに成長できる高い意欲とポテンシャルをもった方を求めています。

===================================
- Lead and supervise a team of managers and associates in sortation and dispatch operations.
- Responsible for the overall safety, quality, performance and customer experience of the shift.
- Carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization’s policies and procedures.
- Accountability for meeting and exceeding operational goals.
- Strategic planning and forecasting; appraise performance, resolve problems; and address staffing needs.

Our organization is still young and we are looking for a talent who has enthusiasm and high potential to growth with our organization and business.

They will be an integral part of the business team which owns a broad range of solutions for our customers.

This role is strategic in nature (business partnering skills and curiosity are a must!). If you're interested in learning about and shaping the Pickup and Returns experience of the customers and thrive in complex, ambiguous environments - this may be the role for you!

The successful candidate has demonstrated the following abilities: they influence business owners, support thoughtful decision-making, and adapt to a rapidly-evolving environment. They collaborate with executives and various business units across Amazon. They bring excellent verbal and written communication skills.

- Oversee financial reporting for your business area. Understand input drivers and validate integrity of the reporting to influence strategic decision-making and planning.

The vision of the Pickup and Return Points (PARP) team is to provide every customer in every geography a safe, reliable pickup and returns experiences conveniently close to where they live or work with ship speeds, price and selection as good or better than home.

jobs.description:
※このポジションの勤務地は千葉県船橋市のデリバリーステーションです。

Amazonでは日本のAmazon Logistics （AMZL）チームのデリバリーステーション・オペレーションマネージャーを募集しています。AMZLのゴールはお客様に荷物をお届けする物流の最後の区間、ラストマイルにおいて、世界水準のオペレーションを構築することです。Amazonではお客様により速く、正確に、そして効果的な方法でお届けすることで、お客様の期待を上回るサービスを提供することに重点的に取り組んでおり、日本でもAMZLが急速に拡大しています。

デリバリーステーション（DS）のオペレーションマネージャーは、出入荷、ソートオペレーションに対する責任を負い、大きな裁量を任される仕事です。センター長の右腕として、マネージャーレベルの部下を持ち、ソート（仕分け）やディスパッチ（配送ドライバーへの荷物の引き渡し）のオペレーションを指揮します。また、DSで働くメンバーのエンゲージメントを高め、日々のオペレーションの目標を確実に遂行することに加え、さらなる高みを目指してオペレーションの改善や新しいサービスの導入を進めていく改善スキル、推進力が期待されています。

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

===================================
*Working location for this position is Chiba, Funabashi.

Amazon seeks a Operations Manager to join our Japan Amazon Logistics team. The goal of Amazon Logistics (AMZL) is to build a world class last mile operation delivering to customers. Amazon aims to exceed the expectations of our customers by ensuring that their orders are delivered as quickly, accurately, and in the most cost effective way as possible and we are expanding rapidly in Japan.

The Station Operations Manager has complete responsibility for inbound, outbound and sortation operations.Delivery Stations (DS) represent the last leg of our delivery network. Customer packages travel from our Fulfillment Centers to regional Sort Centers and finally end up at our local DS where packages are sorted and dispatched directly to the customer via delivery service providers (couriers). Station Operations Managers are the right hand person for the Site Leaders and will lead the entire sortation and dispatch operations leading multiple mangers in their reporting line. They will engage all members working at the station and ensure achievement of daily and longer-term operation goals. Additionally, they will actively engage with site and regional operations leadership to implement new operational improvements and new services. We expect our managers to continually identify ways to improve our operations.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

Key job responsibilities
【具体的な業務内容】
・ソートおよびディスパッチオペレーションのリードおよび監督
・シフト全体の安全性、品質、パフォーマンス、カスタマーサービス向上
・組織の方針と手順に従っての監督責任
・オペレーション目標の達成、および、それを上回る成果の実現
・物量等の予測に基づく、戦略的な計画立案、パフォーマンスの評価、問題の解決および人材配置に関するニーズへの対応
・チームメンバーのキャリア向上、指導、トレーニングおよび育成
・Learning and Talent Developmentチームとのパートナーシップにより、人材の獲得、パフォーマンスとキャリア開発、育成、サクセッションプランに関する計画の立案と実行
・シフトとネットワーク全体にわたってのベストプラクティスの創出・展開
このポジションに求められるのは、経験に裏打ちされたプロセスの改善能力と、アマゾンの成長速度に合わせ、メンバーのモチベーションを高めながらさまざまなチャレンジに対して短期間で成果を出していく能力を持つ候補者です。また、さまざまな経験、バックグラウンドを持つ多様なメンバーと協業していく柔軟性が求められます。
まだ若い組織であり、組織やビジネスとともに成長できる高い意欲とポテンシャルをもった方を求めています。

==============================

Responsibilities:

Lead and supervise a team of managers and associates in sortation and dispatch operations.
Responsible for the overall safety, quality, performance and customer experience of the shift.
Carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization’s policies and procedures.
Accountability for meeting and exceeding operational goals.
Strategic planning and forecasting; appraise performance, resolve problems; and address staffing needs.
Mentor, train and develop teammates for career progression and learning.
Partner with Learning and Talent Development Team on creating and implementing talent plans for their sites including talent acquisition, performance and career management, learning and development, succession planning, and employee engagement.
Ability to develop and share best practices across the shifts and network.

This position requires a candidate with the proven ability to drive process improvements and the ability to keep pace with our growth while motivating others to meet challenges in a deadline-driven environment. We are also looking for a candidate who excel in an environment where talents with diverse experience and background work together. Our organization is still young and we are looking for a talent who has enthusiasm and high potential to growth with our organization and business.

A day in the life
※こちらの職種は日勤帯を中心としたシフト勤務（土日祝日含む交替制勤務）となりますが、職務遂行上必要な場合には夜勤帯で勤務していただく場合もございます。

==============================

※This position has to work in shift including weekends and holidays, mainly during the day, but may also cover night shifts as needed.

jobs.description:
The Amazon Flex program uses independent drivers—called delivery partners—to deliver to our customers. Through the Amazon Flex app, drivers sign up for the program, schedule pickup times, are guided during routes with the navigation system, and more.

As the Amazon Flex Program Manager, you will be responsible for the strategy and initiatives aimed at improving the quality and efficiency of the deliveries carried out by the program. Effective stakeholder management skills are essential to balance these competing priorities and delivering effective solutions for our customers and drivers.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager - Technical, Visual Reasoning Initiatives
jobs.description:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

Drive the future of computer vision and agentic AI as a Senior Program Manager - Technical on our Visual Reasoning team where you'll coordinate cutting-edge initiatives that transform how businesses leverage advanced visual reasoning and intelligent agents to solve complex operational challenges. Join a startup-like environment within AWS Applied AI Solutions where you'll work with world-class research scientists, engineers, product managers, and UI/UX designers to bring novel visual reasoning solutions—spanning computer vision, agentic AI, and user experiences—from concept to production.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Program Manager - Technical to join our Visual Reasoning New Initiatives team. This person will be responsible for orchestrating the execution of complex multi-year programs that bring our Visual Reasoning solutions from internal pilots to production deployment across customer sites. This person will work closely with cross-functional research scientists, engineers, product managers, and UI/UX designers to define technical roadmaps, manage program milestones, coordinate deployments, and drive the operational readiness required to scale Visual Reasoning solutions. In this startup-like environment you'll tackle problems that haven't been solved at scale before—where much is still unknown and we're moving fast. You'll integrate cutting-edge visual reasoning capabilities using Visual Question Answering (VQA) for computer vision and agentic AI for intelligent user experiences playing a critical role in turning ambitious ideas into production-ready systems.

Key job responsibilities
• Work with engineering, research, UI/UX, and product teams to translate business requirements into technical and functional specifications for Visual Reasoning solutions
• Define technical roadmaps for engineering and research teams by partnering with Science and Software Development Managers to align on priorities, milestones, and delivery timelines
• Support launch of Visual Reasoning solutions across new applications, customer verticals, and deployment formats
• Provide regular updates to senior leadership (VP and SVP level) on program status, risks, dependencies, and mitigation strategies
• Build comprehensive project plans that balance business needs with project risks, resource availability, and technical constraints
• Drive engineering project execution by making technical trade-offs, tracking progress, reporting status, and resolving blocking issues
• Coordinate cross-team efforts across research, engineering, and infrastructure teams

A day in the life
Your day begins with a coordinating stand-up with research scientists, engineers, and product managers to align on program milestones, execution status, and tackle blocking issues. From there you might jump on calls with external customers to understand their operational needs, technical constraints, integration requirements with their existing systems, and deployment strategies-all critical inputs that inform our technical roadmap. You will spend time defining the technical roadmap for the next 3-6 months aligning with principals across all workstreams on priorities, technical challenges, dependencies, and the architectural decisions needed to move forward. You will craft bi-weekly updates and co-author monthly updates for VP/SVP leadership distilling complex program status into strategic insights. But the role is not just strategic-you will also roll up your sleeves to solve hands-on deployment problems whether that is troubleshooting hardware shipments stuck in a warehouse, navigating space constraints in a customer MDF, or writing installation SOPs for local IT teams deploying our systems. In this startup-like environment you will balance strategic planning with tactical execution, moving fluidly between high-level roadmap discussions and on-the-ground problem-solving, all while transforming ambitious ideas into production-ready solutions.

If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

jobs.title: Finance Manager, Finance Transformation and Analytics - North America Customer Fullfillment
jobs.description:
Finance is all about the numbers... unless you work in NACF Finance; here it is knowing the numbers and so much more. Amazon operates the most complex retail fulfillment network in the world, delivering billions of packages to hundreds of millions of homes and businesses every year. North American Customer Fulfillment (NACF) Finance provides the cost controllership, return-on-investment analysis, and financial insight that keep the economics of that network healthy. Come be part of this organization and join a dedicated team committed to operational and financial excellence, where you focus on the inputs, think like an owner, and treat every day as Day One.
This is a perfect role for a finance leader with highly advanced data skills, or a data leader with strong ability and genuine interest in finance. You know how to turn large, messy datasets into advanced analysis, automation, and metrics that move the business. You lead through ambiguity, you dive deep to find the root cause, and you are comfortable when your ideas and mechanisms are tested daily. You will be a senior member of a Hub-and-Spoke analytics team whose mission is to own the outcome of the NACF finance analytics function.

Key job responsibilities
Business Finance Support
- Use solid financial knowledge and business acumen to build financial models and analyses with little guidance, draw conclusions, and make recommendations that deliver results and drive improvements.
- Serve as an expert in both Finance and Data, bridging the gap between finance and data teams and building deep understanding of the cost-of-fulfillment drivers across the NACF network along with the related finance, accounting, and controllership systems and data.
- Partner with Finance and Operations leaders to develop, execute, and continuously innovate weekly and monthly financial reviews, forecasting, and reporting models, and communicate the results clearly.

Controllership
- Own the efficiency of financial reporting for a business area, identify and solve complex data-integrity issues with stakeholders, and insist on the highest standards.
- Identify the need for improved controls to address risk driven by business, industry, policy, and regulatory change, and proactively propose control solutions.
- Develop and execute data-analysis processes that are scalable and auditable.

Business Analysis
- Identify and implement opportunities to resolve finance issues and to improve, scale, automate, or simplify finance tools, technology, and processes across teams and organizations.
- Understand how data flows through our financial platforms, know the right data to use for analysis, and establish a source of truth.
- Apply AI to raise team productivity and automate financial workflows: use large language models and agentic development tools (for example AWS Kiro, Claude Code, and similar) to build analyses, tooling, and automation faster than traditional methods allow.
- Write systems queries and perform data mining and analysis using Excel, SQL (required), and Python; find creative solutions using large-scale data-mining tools.
- Solve complex problems that affect company-wide strategic decision-making, lead through ambiguity, and identify high-priority work to maximize results for key stakeholders.
- Simplify and centralize process improvement and reporting so business partners and customers can take action quickly, and enable stakeholders to self-service their data needs.

People
- Take part in hiring and developing activities and mentor new team members.
- Seek, value, and leverage diverse perspectives.
- Challenge business-partner plans and assumptions when needed.
- Communicate data clearly, concisely, and unambiguously, verbally and in writing, and articulate complex finance issues to non-Finance partners.
- Positively contribute to work/life harmony on your team and find creative solutions to close gaps for your team.

A day in the life
No two days in NACF Finance look alike. You will work in a fast-paced, high-energy, and ever-changing environment alongside Operations, Product, Tech, and Procurement partners. One day you may be building a cost model for a network initiative, the next automating a reporting process with an AI-assisted toolchain, the next root-causing a data defect that is distorting a leadership metric or mentoring an analyst through their first deep-dive. You move with purpose and speed, think like an owner, and treat every day as Day One.

About the team
NACF Finance Transformation & Analytics is a centralized, Hub-and-Spoke analytics team that supports the North American Customer Fulfillment network. The team is the front door for finance analytics: rationalizing the reporting landscape into one source of truth, delivering advanced analytics and deep-dive root-causing, and building AI-first automation that lets finance spend less time assembling data and more time answering the hard questions. You will partner with Senior Leaders across Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Engineering, Procurement, Accounting, and Technology as a trusted financial advocate and business partner.
Basic qualifications:
- 5+ years of multiple finance and accounting roles experience
- Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, tax, economics, or a related analytical field
Preferred qualifications:
- 6+ years of identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan experience
- 6+ years of solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits) experience

- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)

jobs.title: Program Manager - PMO/Chief of Staff, Amazon Transportation Services Mexico
jobs.description:
Amazon is seeking a Chief of Staff to the Director of ATS Mexico, 3P Carriers and US Out of Country for LATAM. You will be the Director's proxy and closest advisor across a business that spans Middle Mile Transportation, Sort Centers, US Fulfillment, and the support functions behind them, in one of Amazon's fastest growing markets.

This is not a coordination role. You will hold delegated decision authority, represent the Director in forums they cannot attend, and own the mechanisms that determine what the leadership team decides and when. You will frame the hard calls: assemble the options, surface the dissent, force a decision, and make sure it survives contact with the organization. When a problem crosses three teams and belongs to none of them, it becomes yours until an owner exists.

You will also carry the Director's talent and planning agenda. That means org design and headcount, the annual operating plan cycles, the performance and promotion calibration cycles, and the culture mechanisms that keep a distributed organization pointed in the same direction.

You will be the AI champion for the organization. The bar here is not automating existing work faster. It is asking which steps should exist at all. Most of our processes were designed for a pre AI world, and the real gains come from redesigning them end to end rather than bolting tooling onto a workflow that was already broken. You will push leaders to do that harder thinking, help them tell the difference between a genuine reinvention and an expensive shortcut, and model the behavior in your own work before asking anyone else to adopt it.

The role demands unusual range. In a single day you will move from a confidential org design conversation, to authoring a narrative that a VP will read, to coaching a new leader on how to run their own weekly business review. You will influence senior leaders who do not report to you, and you will be trusted with information that is not shared widely.

The person who thrives here is right a lot. They see the pattern in scattered signals before anyone has assembled the data, and they have strong instincts for what deserves attention now versus what can wait. Those instincts have to hold across four different lenses at once: what is right for the business, for the individual leaders, for the org, and for the country. Much of the value of this role is knowing which of the ten problems on the table is the one that actually matters this week.

If you are a structured thinker who is comfortable with ambiguity, willing to respectfully challenge senior leaders when you see it differently, and able to earn trust fast across functions and countries, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
Act as the Director's proxy in leadership forums, deciding on their behalf as trust is established and escalating only what needs their judgment.

Own the decision queue: frame the options, surface the dissent, force the call, communicate the outcome.

Own the rhythm of the business, including leadership forums, WBRs, MBRs, and QBRs, plus the commitment tracker that makes decisions stick.

Own OP1, OP2, and 3YOP end to end, from inputs through VP review to the goal cascade.

Own the talent and org agenda with HR and Finance: org design, headcount, performance and promotion calibration, succession.

Run the culture mechanisms: engagement survey action plans, Connections follow through, townhalls.

Integrate the problems that cross teams and belong to none. Assign owners, unblock, escalate.

Represent Mexico in worldwide forums and convert what you hear into regional plans.

Pressure test the Director's thinking, and disagree before the decision rather than after.

Coach leaders on building mechanisms that scale.

Handle confidential org, people, and financial matters with discretion.

Champion AI transformation across the org, pushing leaders to redesign processes end to end rather than automate broken ones faster.

A day in the life
No two days look the same. You might align with the Director on open decisions, then handle a confidential HR conversation about an org change. Later, you represent the Director on a regional call, draft an OP1 narrative section, lead a cross-functional sync to unblock a stalled initiative, coach a new leader on their weekly review, and clear last week's commitment tracker. You toggle constantly between strategic framing and detailed follow-through, between the Director's agenda and the organization's. Success is measured by whether decisions get made and stick, not by meetings attended.
Basic qualifications:
- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience communicating and presenting to senior leadership
- Experience organizing, prioritizing and scheduling work assignments
- Experience converting insights into strategy and communicating complex ideas clearly and logically in written communication
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
Preferred qualifications:
- 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Experience working closely with and advising senior executives of an organization or equivalent
- Experience managing a budget or P&L
- Advanced degree, or MBA

jobs.title: Program Manager, AWS Marketing, AWS Launch Operations
jobs.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) brings new services and features to customers at an unprecedented cadence — more than 3,000 launches a year, and accelerating as the AI landscape evolves. Behind that velocity is the Launch Operations team, which owns the process that governs the lifecycle of bringing every AWS capability to customers, from intake through customer availability. We turn AWS’s innovation velocity into a durable Marketing advantage: driving operational scale so service teams and stakeholders can focus on innovation, and improving signal-to-noise so the most important news reaches customers and enables field sales and partner teams to engage around the launches that matter most.

We are looking for a Program Manager to help run the programs that make this possible. Working closely with senior program managers and stakeholders, you will help keep launches moving on time and at a high quality bar — coordinating across product managers, marketing, engineering, security, legal, and field teams, tracking deliverables, and surfacing risks early. This is a role for someone who is organized, resourceful, and eager to grow in a high-visibility, cross-functional environment where the details matter and the scale is significant. You will learn the launch process end to end, and as you do, you will spot where manual coordination slows launches down and help implement the improvements that make the next cycle smoother.

Key job responsibilities
1. Support the end-to-end launch operations program including tracking milestones and deliverables, maintaining schedules, and surfacing risks across multiple concurrent launches.

2. Coordinate with product managers, marketing, engineering, security, legal, and field teams to keep launches moving from intake to customer availability and help remove blockers.

3. Help identify process gaps in how launches move through the pipeline and contribute to improvements that raise quality and reduce cycle time.

4. Maintain program dashboards and status reporting, ensuring stakeholders have accurate, timely visibility into launch progress.

5. Track program metrics and help improve signal-to-noise so the most important launches are elevated to customers.

6. Apply generative AI tools including Amazon Quick to streamline documentation, status reporting, and program analysis.

You start your morning reviewing the launch pipeline and flagging any launches at risk of slipping, then follow up with the relevant task owners to keep them on track. Mid-morning, you join a working session with product and marketing partners to walk through upcoming launches and capture next steps. After lunch, you update the program dashboard and pull together a status summary for the team, highlighting progress and any open items that need attention. Between meetings, you look for small ways to remove friction in the intake process often using generative AI tooling to speed up the documentation and reporting that used to take up much of your day.

jobs.title: Finance Manager, Fixed, Capital, Analytics, and Planning (FCAP)
jobs.description:
Amazon's Fulfillment Network is one of the most complex and dynamic operating environments in the world, and the Fixed, Capital, Analytics, and Planning (FCAP) team sits at the financial center of it all. FCAP manages fixed costs across US and Canada Operations spanning fulfillment, sortation, last mile delivery, reverse logistics, grocery, and sub same day networks. We are looking for a Finance Manager to join our E2E Hub and lead the technical integration of new networks into centralized fixed cost governance while partnering with the Standardization and Automation (S&A) team to test, validate, and deploy the next generation of finance automation platforms. This role connects across every pillar of the team, partnering with E2E Category subject matter experts who own account level fixed cost expertise, the Headcount Center of Excellence, Core Controllership, upstream FP&A teams and the Business Unit Partnership leads to bring the complete fixed cost picture together as each new network integrates. This role requires someone who thrives in ambiguity, builds where no playbook exists, and gets energy from replacing manual processes with scalable, automated solutions that work across the entire organization.

Key job responsibilities
Own network integration end to end. As FCAP expands, new networks enter with different systems, different cost structures, and different ways of working. Assess, design, configure, build, and validate until the network is running on the standard framework. Partner across E2E Category SMEs, Headcount, Controllership, and the BU lead to ensure every dimension of the fixed cost picture is connected during integration. Partner alongside the BU lead through their first planning cycle, first close, and first weekly submissions until they are self sufficient. Every integration makes the E2E system more complete.
Partner with S&A to test, validate, and deploy new finance automation platforms for planning, bridging, and close. Serve as primary UAT tester ensuring tools produce accurate outputs against real financial data within the real FP&A calendar. Translate business requirements from across the organization, including E2E Category account requirements, HC planning inputs, and BU lead reporting needs, into technical specifications for S&A. Push for the right design decisions. Identify risks before production. This is a sustained partnership that continues as platforms evolve.
Invent and simplify at scale. Design automated templates, dashboards, standard bridge schemas, and cost center mapping frameworks that eliminate manual work and replace fragmented legacy tools across every network. Build solutions that work across all pillars, not just one. The standard you set is what every BU lead, every Category SME, and every HC planner executes on. Build it once, build it right, and build it so it scales as the team grows.
Build the end to end fixed cost system. Connect integrated networks, deployed automation platforms, and standardized processes into a single data flow that brings together BU level reporting, E2E Category account detail, and HC Opex into one consolidated fixed cost view for leadership across US and Canada Operations. This system does not exist today. You are building it with the team!
Drive change and adoption. New tools and processes only create value when people use them. Partner alongside each BU lead during onboarding, coordinate with E2E Category and HC to ensure their processes are reflected in new tools, build SOPs, run enablement, and bring the team forward as the operating model evolves. Own the launch model for new site cost assumptions and capacity planning as the network footprint expands.

A day in the life
Success in this role is measured through the ability to integrate new networks cleanly and on time, deploy automation platforms that work against real financial data in the real FP&A cadence, and build the tools and standard processes that the entire team depends on. You will work across every pillar of FCAP. When a new network integrates, you partner with E2E Category SMEs to understand how each fixed cost account behaves in that network, with Headcount to ensure HC planning and fixed HC Opex align, with Controllership to ensure close and accrual processes are configured correctly, and with the BU Partnership lead to ensure they can deliver their first weekly cost review, first month end close, and first planning cycle on the standard methodology. The ideal candidate will demonstrate impact through scalable integration playbooks, the simplification and standardization of reporting and planning infrastructure across networks, and the sustained partnership with S&A to move new platforms from prototype to production. You will be evaluated on your ability to bring all of these pieces together into a single, consolidated end to end fixed cost system that gives leadership one view across US and Canada Operations.

About the team
The FCAP team manages strategy and execution of fixed costs and headcount across US and Canada Operations through four pillars: Business Partnership, Core Controllership, E2E Category and Headcount Center of Excellence. This role sits within the Business Partnership Pillar alongside a Platform Lead driving centralized tools and dashboards and a Transformation Lead driving automation with S&A. BU Partnership leads each own a network end to end across weekly cost reviews, monthly close, and five annual planning cycles including OP1, OP2, Q2 Guidance, Q3 Guidance, and Q4 Guidance. E2E Category SMEs own the account level expertise across all fixed cost categories. The Headcount Center of Excellence owns HC planning and HC Opex.

- Bachelor's degree
- 5+ years of multiple finance and accounting roles experience
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)
- 6+ years of identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan experience

jobs.description:

Our products abstract complexities from the world of accounting, invoicing, audit, payment, taxation, and allocation at the required level of fidelity and insights to build generic solutions scalable to multiple businesses and geographies. We ensure that financial functions are complete, accurate, timely and compliant with worldwide regulatory and tax requirements. Our software systems include services that handle thousands or requests per second and make decisions to pay billions of dollars a year and ensure that transportation's liabilities and revenues are correctly accounted. Our current team comprises of ~200+ engineering organization and Program management team of 10+ TPMs and Program Managers with great growth and lateral opportunity.

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager, AMXL CX, AMXL CX & Growth
jobs.description:
Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) is a single-threaded organization that owns the end-to-end customer experience for heavy and bulky products, from supply chain and fulfillment through transportation, last mile delivery, and post-purchase resolution. AMXL currently operates across North America, Europe, Japan, and is expanding into emerging markets. Within AMXL, the CX and Growth org is a centralized, worldwide team organized across five pillars designed to ensure that every customer who purchases a large, high-value product receives a reliable experience.

The Execution Excellence pillar is where planning meets the customer. It houses two complementary teams: our AMXL Operations Center and our AMXL Proactive Execution program. These teams serve as the real-time network execution backbone, translating strategic decisions into daily network performance across our end-to-end network and also as the mechanism that identifies delivery failures before they become visible to the customer and intervenes proactively to save the delivery or manage the recovery directly with the customer. Together, these teams form a closed loop: detect upstream, prevent where possible, intervene proactively where not, and feed root causes back so defects are resolved at the source.

We are seeking a Senior Program Manager to lead the integration and transformation of this combined organization. This is not a steady-state program management role. The program strategy is being built. You will inherit a consolidation in progress and own the lifecycle of making it work: assessing what the combined org should look like, defining how we measure success, building the mechanisms that make it sustainable, and driving the hard conversations required to get there. You will use process lifecycle evaluation methodologies to categorize the team's portfolio (automate, simplify, reallocate, or deprecate), and build automation roadmaps in partnership with technical teams.

This role requires someone who can operate in high ambiguity, make trade-offs between short-term operational needs and long-term strategic goals, and communicate persuasively across teams. The right candidate sees automation and AI as something they use today, not something they plan to use later, and will set the standard for how this team uses technology to scale impact without scaling headcount.

Key job responsibilities
- Define the operating model for the combined organization: org design, process rationalization, scope definition, and mechanisms that make it self-sustaining.
- Build the process lifecycle evaluation framework, determining which workflows to automate, simplify, reallocate, or retire, and manage the pipeline of new use cases from scoping through launch.
- Own the automation roadmap in partnership with data science, engineering, and technology teams, establishing accountability mechanisms with clear timelines for every manual process.
- Drive cross-functional stakeholder alignment across supply chain, quality, and operations, navigating complex organizational dynamics and building trust where needed.
- Scale this capability into new geographies by adapting the operating model to local carrier ecosystems, regulatory environments, and workforce availability.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing program metrics dashboards, identifying areas that need attention, and preparing a status narrative for a director-level review. By mid-morning you are facilitating a working session with partners to align on priorities for the quarter. After lunch you dive into data to validate assumptions behind a proposed solution, then draft a decision document that frames trade-offs for leadership. You close the day mentoring a newer program manager and connecting with cross-regional counterparts to keep workstreams on track.

About the team
The AMXL Customer Experience and Growth team takes a 360-degree approach to the customer journey:

- **Eliminate**: detect, solve, and resolve customer-impacting issues upstream by providing relevant and timely insights for operations teams, transportation, and product development.
- **Automate**: continuously assess and identify opportunities to replace manual processes with automated, scalable solutions.
- **Optimize**: when a customer does need support, ensure AMXL stakeholders have the tools, resources, policies, and protocols to deliver a perfect experience.

The operations center translates strategic decisions into daily network performance. The proactive execution team ensures that when defects occur, customers are protected through early intervention. The Sr. Program Manager will be the link that makes both teams operate as one system.

- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Knowledge of general AI tools
- Experience defining and executing program requirements
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English

- Experience managing programs across multiple countries and time zones

jobs.title: Sr Integration Experience Mgr, Corporate Development Integration
jobs.description:
Corporate Development Integration is seeking an experienced integration communications and onboarding leader to drive adoption of functional and business integration activities in Amazon's mergers and acquisitions (M&A).

Amazon's integration leaders in this space are called Integration Experience (IX) Leads as they focus on minimizing disruption and driving engagement for acquired employees through internal communications, onboarding, training, cultural integration, and employee engagement strategies.

The IX Lead plans, creates, and executes integration enablement programs across the full integration lifecycle, from due diligence through approximately 90-100 days post-acquisition close. This role supports integrations of all sizes, both private and public company transactions, across multiple geographies, and managing multiple concurrent integration programs. Leveraging change management best practices, the IX Lead focuses on accelerating time to productivity for acquired organizations by delivering pragmatic, scalable support that is directly aligned to deal goals, navigating the ambiguity of M&A transactions and synthesizing input from business and cross-functional teams. Central to this role is supporting a culture of inclusion, trust, and respect in all working relationships—with acquired employees, cross-functional partners, and leadership alike.

This role supports global transactions, requiring domestic and international travel approximately 30% of the time. Due to the dynamic nature of M&A timelines, travel may occasionally be planned on short notice.

Key job responsibilities
Change Enablement & Integration Strategy
- Apply change management best practices to assess change readiness, identify potential friction points, and develop tailored enablement strategies based on deal complexity and anticipated change impact
- Translate functional and business integration activities into people-focused experiences through sequencing, prioritization, and stakeholder engagement
- Conduct cultural and change readiness assessments during due diligence, translating findings into actionable recommendations for communication, onboarding, and engagement strategies
- Define the scope of change support required for each transaction in partnership with the Integration Manager and Business Sponsor
- Identify opportunities to improve internal integration processes and scale best practices across the IX portfolio

Internal Communications
- Own the end-to-end employee communication strategy across the integration lifecycle, including employee newsletters and FAQs, leader briefing materials, and targeted messaging for specific employee groups
- Develop and execute comprehensive communication plans for key milestones (Deal Sign & Announcement, Deal Close & Day 1 Orientation), coordinating inputs from cross-functional teams (Business, Legal, PR, HR, IT, Finance, and Real Estate)
- Write and review all employee-facing communications ensuring clarity, consistency, and cross-functional alignment across stakeholders
- Develop executive communications that distill complex integration details into clear, compelling narratives
- Advise on organizational design communications, including sequencing and timing of reporting structure changes to manage employee experience

Onboarding & Training
- Plan and execute Day 1 Orientation events and customized onboarding experiences, including structured onboarding programs, leader onboarding programs, establishing a support network for the acquired population (onboarding buddies and key individuals to meet), and role-specific training
- Design and deliver comprehensive training plans in partnership with cross-functional teams, coordinating timing and sequencing to ensure a cohesive employee experience
- Equip Amazon and acquired company leaders to deliver integration messages through leader briefings and one-on-ones, enabling them to guide their teams through the transition
- Educate cross-functional partners and business teams on IX workstreams, integration milestones, and employee experience considerations

Cultural Integration
- Identify gaps between the acquired organization's operating norms and Amazon's ways of working, and develop integration strategies to bridge them
- Design and execute cultural integration approaches, including education on Amazon's Leadership Principles, Working Backwards methodology, business writing, and other ways of working
- Implement Change Champion Networks for large, complex transactions to support peer-to-peer adoption and sustained engagement

Stakeholder Engagement
- Build trusted relationships with senior leaders (Business Sponsors, VPs, acquired leadership) through direct engagement and consistent, communication
- Influence, advise, and build consensus among senior leadership in ambiguous situations, determining how to achieve the best outcome and knowing when and how to escalate effectively
- Keep cross-functional teams up-to-speed with proactive communication that anticipates questions

Employee Engagement & Measurement
- Own employee engagement measurement, including employee engagement pulse surveys, onboarding surveys, and integration surveys (~90-100 days post-close)
- Analyze employee sentiment data, identify themes, and present recommended actions to leadership, benchmarking results against historical acquisition data
- Use feedback loops to proactively address concerns, remove productivity barriers, and inform ongoing change support

About the team
The Corporate Development Integration team leads Amazon and acquired teams through the definition and enablement of the acquisition rationale and acquired business growth. Integration Experience (IX) Leads support this mission by planning, creating, and executing communications, onboarding, training, cultural integration, and employee engagement strategies that enable acquired organizations to adopt functional and business integration activities. Leveraging change management best practices, IX creates pragmatic integration enablement plans focused on ensuring acquired employees are informed, engaged, and supported throughout their initial integration journey with Amazon. We apply what's helpful, skip what's not, and stay solution-oriented, tailoring our approach based on deal complexity and business need.
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree
- 5+ years of developing, negotiating and executing business agreements experience
- 5+ years of professional or military experience
- Experience in advising and influencing executive leadership
- 8+ years of experience in change management, internal communications, employee engagement, organizational development, learning & enablement, or M&A integration – including designing and executing large-scale communication or onboarding programs
- Strong writing skills with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear, compelling written narratives for executive audiences
- Experience applying change management methodologies to support organizational transitions
- Experience managing cross-functional programs with multiple concurrent workstreams
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience in M&A integration, organizational transformation, or large-scale business change
- Experience with employee engagement measurement, survey design, and data-driven action planning
- Track record of managing programs across multiple geographies and cultures
- Certification in change management (e.g., Prosci, CCMP), program management (e.g., PgMP, PMP), or strategic communications (e.g., IABC CMP, ABC)

jobs.title: Program Manager, eDiscovery and Legal Operations
jobs.description:
Amazon's Legal Operations organization is looking for a Program Manager to lead eDiscovery program delivery at a global scale. In this role, you will own the technology roadmap for eDiscovery, drive cross-functional programs across engineering, legal, and vendor teams, and stand up AI-powered capabilities that transform how Amazon manages litigation support. You will report to the Head of eDiscovery and lead programs spanning the full eDiscovery lifecycle—from data collection through production—while building the systems and vendor partnerships that reduce cost and accelerate outcomes.

The Legal Operations team is data-driven and systems-oriented— we measure what matters, automate what we can, and build for scale. This role requires someone who can troubleshoot an eDiscovery escalation, run an AI pilot, negotiate a vendor SOW, and present results to VP-level stakeholders in the same week. You will operate with high autonomy in ambiguous environments, working across engineering, legal, and vendor teams to deliver without direct authority over resources. This role involves access to confidential legal information and requires a high level of professionalism, integrity, and discretion.

Key job responsibilities
- Program Ownership & Delivery: Own the eDiscovery Transformation Program end-to-end: define the roadmap, set milestones, manage cross-team dependencies, proactively identify risks, and drive resolution or escalation with appropriate judgment. Define success metrics for program initiatives and build reporting frameworks that give leadership visibility into matter health, vendor performance, and operational efficiency.

- Technology & Architecture: Define technical requirements and drive design reviews for vendor integrations, data pipelines, and system interoperability between eDiscovery platforms and internal tools. Collaborate with IT, Security, and Microsoft 365/Purview teams on legal hold automation, custodian data collection, and preservation workflows. Drive process automation by identifying opportunities to eliminate manual steps through scripting, API orchestration, or platform configuration.

- AI & Tool Strategy: Lead the evaluation, piloting, and procurement of AI-powered tools (TAR, generative AI, NLP classification) for document review and legal analytics—defining evaluation frameworks, success metrics, and defensibility standards, and building business cases that quantify ROI.

- Vendor & Standards: Own the vendor strategy: manage the preferred partner program, drive RFP processes, negotiate rate cards and SLAs, conduct performance reviews, and define quality standards for ESI processing, review, and production workflows.

- Stakeholder Alignment & Communication: Drive alignment across legal, engineering, and vendor stakeholders with competing priorities; author program narratives and business cases for senior leadership. Mentor team members and contribute to hiring, interview processes, and talent development within the organization.

A day in the life
Your morning might be a program review for a vendor API integration you're managing. By mid-morning you're configuring an AI pilot—tuning recall thresholds on a document review model. After lunch you're drafting a business case for a platform migration, pulling cost and throughput data into a narrative for senior leadership. Late afternoon, a legal hold workflow breaks and you're coordinating the fix across IT and compliance before a preservation deadline. jobs.title: Head of APJC Tech Strategy and Operations, Global Sales Operations
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Leader of APJ Field Tech Operations to help drive the long-term growth of the APJ Tech business through a period of significant change. The ideal candidate is a hands-on, motivated self-starter who is passionate about using data, fluent enough in technology to operationally lead a technical field credibly, and has a track record of driving transformation, not just running operations.
In this role, the leader will work out what the APJ Tech organization must prioritize from an operations perspective to help the business scale, and then drive that change through the field. This is not a role to run the operating cadence well and keep the reporting clean; it is to lead the organization through its transition as the AI business scales and the most fundamental roles, from how we sell to how we deliver, are reshaped. The mandate is to carry the org through that change rather than defend the current model, and it holds even if the team gets leaner, because the game is productivity and leverage, not size.
Considered a close operational partner to APJ Tech leadership and a member of the APJ Tech leadership team, this leader will develop, implement, and manage the business processes, systems, insights, and strategies that optimize how the organization works to meet its goals along with geographically dispersed team reporting to them. They will own and drive the management of business cadences across cross-functional teams, and will have the capacity to absorb and lead change through their direct team as well as by earning trust and influencing others across the APJ and WW Tech business and worldwide stakeholders who do not report to the role.
The role drives improvements to the reporting tools, mechanisms, and business insights the team relies on, increasing the availability and granularity of actionable, decision-ready data and building a single source of truth leaders can trust. Crucially, it reaches for automation and AI as the primary lever to redesign how operations work gets done, so the organization produces materially more without adding people. It also manages the proposal, administration, and execution of the region’s targets, goals, and headcount plans, and continuously proposes improvements that increase the organization’s effectiveness in driving desired results.
The successful candidate must be able to roll up their sleeves and work directly with models and data, and thrive in ambiguity of various challenges encountered daily in a fast-moving Tech company. You will be passionate about your work, analytical, and a strong problem-solver, with the technical depth to earn the trust of a technical field and the judgment to know where technology creates the most leverage. You will have superb communication and relationship skills, hold a firm and well-reasoned line with senior leaders on what the data says even when it is unwelcome, and stay open to disconfirming input rather than anchoring on prior ways of working. You will drive toward simple, scalable solutions to difficult problems, have a track record of building high-performing teams and thinking big, and be able to communicate complex analytical results, both written and verbally, in a clear and easy-to-understand way.

Key job responsibilities
• Drive org-wide transformation from an operations lens: Look across the APJ Tech org, decide what to prioritize to help it scale, and drive that change through the field - not just describe it. This is the heart of the role.
• Bring technical depth to lead a technical field: Operate with enough technical fluency to lead a Tech organization credibly, earn the trust of a technical field, and make sound calls on where technology creates the most leverage.
• Earn trust and influence across a matrixed org: Land change with Area GMs, Tech leaders across the Geo, and worldwide stakeholders who do not report to this role, and hold a firm line on what the data says even when it is unwelcome.
• Use the FTO platform to drive change at scale: Know the Field Tech Operations function intimately and use it as a platform to lead transformation, with a demonstrated pattern of thinking big rather than optimizing the status quo.
• Drive productivity through automation and AI: Redesign how operations work gets done so the org produces materially more without adding people, using AI and automation as the primary lever, and deliver results at a different scale.
• Build systems and a single source of truth: Design mechanisms, standards, and trusted business insights that scale on their own; build the machine rather than personally running each cycle.
• Run the operating cadence as the foundation: Keep firm command of the current state - business reviews, goals, and decision-ready reporting - as the stable base from which transformation is driven, since business as usual keeps running until the transitions land.
• Build and develop the team: Attract, grow, and retain a high-performing operations and insights team, and raise the bar on talent as the function evolves.
Basic qualifications:
- 10+ years of senior leadership work in sales operations, sales strategy, finance, business development, or other related fields experience
- 7+ years of leading a divisional sales operations team or equivalent responsibilities supporting a mid-to-large-scale, multi-geographical, hi-tech, sales organization experience
- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field
- Experience in leading a divisional sales operations team or equivalent responsibilities supporting a mid-to-large-scale, multi-geographical, high-tech, sales organization
- Experience hiring and leading a high-performance team
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience developing and implementing systems/tools utilized for CRM, variable compensation, revenue reporting, forecasting, Salesforce automation, etc.
- Experience in business-process design
- Experience rapidly growing an organization and attracting, hiring, and maintaining top talent
- Experience working within a high-growth, technology company
