jobs.description:
Amazon is looking for an enthusiastic Sr. Program Manager to join the Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) organization, supporting Environmental Assurance and Protection (EAP) training. We are not an average company, and this is certainly not your average position. This role offers you the opportunity to revolutionize environmental training delivery worldwide. WHS seeks an experienced, self-motivated Program Manager who excels in a fast-paced environment and has a solid background in program management. This role will support the deployment and management of environmental training programs for operations associates and leadership throughout North America.

As a Sr. Program Manager, you will work across teams to collaborate, generate buy-in, develop and execute to a plan. You will drive the expansion and growth of our global environmental training programs. You will play a crucial role in devising strategies, fostering partnerships, and executing initiatives to enhance the program's reach and impact. This entails serving as the main point of contact for stakeholders in coordinating and managing strategic, cross-functional, and business-critical programs and projects. The ideal candidate excels in crafting large-scale global training program strategies, encompassing training design, roadmaps, gap analysis, financial planning, communication, and launch plans in a dynamic and diverse business environment. Effective communication and program management skills are essential, enabling you to manage multiple competing priorities and coordinate work across teams. The successful candidate will be proficient at working with data to identify trends, identify improvement opportunities, and proactively define plans to realize these opportunities.
To be successful in this role, the candidate will effectively multitask and prioritize, utilize data to encourage decisions, and maintain a high level of independence. They will be comfortable working in a growing and ambiguous work environment as we constantly improve and innovate. This leader must have solid written and verbal communications skills, the ability to influence stakeholders, and willingness to dive deep into details.

Key job responsibilities
• Accountable for the overall program strategy and planning for their regions/business units, communicate program requirements, negotiate priorities, and define success metrics
• Apply project management best practices to drive plan execution, mitigate risks, and improve effectiveness to deliver results in a timely manner
• Continuously improve program components and mechanisms to drive results and provide program status communication, deliver clear and concise summaries to leadership teams and effectively answer questions
• Serve as the primary point of contact for coordinating and managing strategic, cross-functional, and business-critical training programs and projects
• Build partnerships with key stakeholders and organizations to promote training program adoption.
• Effectively communicate and manage multiple, competing priorities while coordinating work across teams
• Define, track, and monitor progress against success metrics and project plans. Analyze and report on overall project health using key performance indicators and success metrics, and accurately and clearly report on status against program objectives

A day in the life
As a Sr. Program Manager, you will be responsible for managing environmental training content development and localization. You will drive program implementation, impact, and retention metrics by working closely with BU stakeholders across the globe. You will partner closely with Environmental, WHS, and Operations departments across Amazon to develop and execute pilot and launch plans, drive internal communications, and oversee the continuous improvement of the programs in regions you oversee.
Basic qualifications:
- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience working cross functionally with non-tech teams
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
- Knowledge of global environmental, health and safety regulations
- Bachelor's degree in safety, environmental, or equivalent field of study
Preferred qualifications:
- 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
- Knowledge of general AI tools
- Experience designing, implementing, and scaling upskilling, apprenticeship, or workforce development programs across large-scale operations or corporate environments, including forecasting workforce needs and leveraging analytics to drive program decisions

jobs.title: Finance Manager, Amazon Air Ground Finance
jobs.description:
Own the financial engine of Amazon Air's ground network as a Finance Manager on the Ground Finance team. Ground Finance covers the airport locations where Amazon Air runs its sort centers and ramp operations for aircraft, the physical points where the network's cost is incurred every day. This is a high-impact controllership role that pairs rigorous budget ownership and site financial management with the modeling depth and business partnership that shape how a multi-billion dollar air network spends and scales. You will be the financial owner of your ground sites, working shoulder to shoulder with the site leaders who run them to hold the cost line, sharpen the budget, and turn operational reality into decisions that reduce cost to serve.

You will be the controller your site leaders depend on and the modeler leadership turns to when the questions get hard, diving deep into the cost drivers behind ground operations, framing the trade-offs that matter, and challenging the organization to find better, more affordable ways to run the network. If you are energized by owning a budget end to end, building trust with the leaders you support, and holding a high controllership bar while influencing well above your level, this role offers an exciting platform to make a lasting impact.

Key job responsibilities
Controllership & Budget Ownership: Own the budget, financial performance, and controllership of your ground sites. Manage spend against plan, investigate variances to root cause, and execute financial processes with the attention to detail and controls compliance the role demands.

Site Leadership Partnership: Serve as the embedded finance partner to your site leaders, earning a seat at the table as they run their sort and ramp operations. Build the trust that brings finance in early, and translate the financial picture into decisions on labor, spend, and performance.

Robust Modeling & Business Partnership: Build and maintain the financial models that answer difficult business questions and support senior management decisions. Translate operational change into budgets and forecasts that keep pace with a fast-evolving network.

Cost Management & Continuous Improvement: Dive deep into the operational drivers behind ground cost to surface the "why" behind performance. Partner with site leadership to improve labor efficiency and reduce cost to serve, bringing a Think Big mindset to structural opportunities.

A day in the life
Your typical day is that of a hands-on site controller with the reach of a strategic finance partner. You will manage your budget and review the financial metrics for your sites, identify the variances and trends that matter, and develop the insights that help leadership understand the financial health of operations. You will spend real time with your site leaders, in their operations and in their planning, so that finance is a partner in the decision rather than a scorekeeper after it. You will spend time in your models, pressure-testing assumptions and framing spend trade-offs, and in the room with operations partners where your analysis shapes decisions. Throughout, you will look for the next opportunity to reduce cost to serve while holding the controllership standards Amazon Air is built on.

About the team
Amazon Air is a global, customer-centric transportation provider that safely delivers low cost, high quality service, accomplishing that vision through a talented, inclusive, and diverse team leveraging innovative technologies and a sustainability-aware mindset. The Ground Finance team is the controllership backbone of that network, responsible for the airport locations where Amazon Air runs its sort centers and aircraft ramp operations. We own the budgets and financial performance of those ground sites and partner closely with the site leaders who operate them to reduce cost to serve. We value analytical depth, effective communication, and the ability to influence without authority, and we are committed to developing finance controllers who can grow their scope and impact. You can "take off" and "soar" your career at Amazon Air.

jobs.title: Finance Manager, NA Supply Chain Execution Finance
jobs.description:
The NA Supply Chain Execution Finance team is looking for a Finance Manager to serve as a strategic finance partner within the Supply Chain Execution space. This role will own end-to-end financial controllership for key volume planning processes, partnering closely with Network, Sortable, Non-Sortable, and IXD S&OP teams to optimize the flow of 40B+ units through Amazon's North American fulfillment network. Our inbound supply chain has evolved considerably in recent years — with FC-FC transfers reduced from 20% to 13%, over $300M in validated cost savings delivered in FY2025, and more innovation to come.

This Finance Manager will own the financial narrative for their domain — driving cost transparency, building scalable mechanisms, and delivering insights that influence VP-level decisions. You will operate with significant autonomy, manage ambiguity across multiple planning cycles, and influence outcomes across 4+ partner organizations without direct authority.

This is a perfect role for someone who knows how to lead fast, think strategically, and drive results across multiple stakeholder teams. Your experience in operations finance gives you the perspective to look around corners and proactively avoid problems. You know which details drive millions in impact and which ones don't add value. You can clearly communicate complex trade-offs to senior leadership and effectively influence partners using data-driven recommendations.

Finance is all about the numbers…unless you work at Amazon; it's knowing the numbers and so much more. We seek Finance Managers who combine analytical rigor with strategic business partnership — leaders who don't just report what happened, but shape what happens next. Do you view problems as treasures, and are you willing to dive deep to develop solutions that drive nine-figure impact? Will you challenge the status quo, build mechanisms that scale, and influence cross-functional partners without direct authority? At Amazon, we move with purpose and speed, and this requires working with a dynamic network of Operations, Science and Tech, and Supply Chain partners. We are the trusted business advisors — employing every facet of data and communication to ensure our partners and leaders make the best possible decisions. Come teach us a few things, and we'll teach you a few things as we navigate the most customer-centric company on Earth.

Key job responsibilities
1) Financial Controllership & Mechanism Ownership: Own end-to-end financial controllership for assigned planning systems (e.g., True North, F2P, WTPSS, Skippy), ensuring cost inputs are accurate, current, and driving optimal network outcomes

2) Strategic Business Partnership: Serve as the trusted finance advisor to S&OP business partners — translating operational decisions into financial impact, quantifying trade-offs, and recommending actions that optimize for cost and speed

3) Planning Cycle Leadership: Own metric inputs and financial narratives for quarterly and annual planning cycles (OP2, QXG, OP1/3YF), aligning cross-functional assumptions across SCOT, MTP, Capacity, and Operations teams

4) Cost Savings Identification & Delivery: Identify, validate, and track cost savings opportunities across the inbound and outbound network — building entitlement cases and holding organizations accountable to committed plans

5) Executive Communication: Deliver WBR/MBR insights, variance analyses, and strategic recommendations to Director and VP-level audiences. Translate complex data into clear, actionable narratives.

6) Cross-Functional Influence: Drive alignment across 4+ partner organizations (S&OP, SCOT, NACF Operations, Network Design, Field Finance) without direct authority — using data, relationships, and mechanisms

7) Automation & Scalability: Identify opportunities to automate, standardize, or simplify finance processes — reducing manual effort and improving data accuracy and timeliness

A day in the life
Own the financial narrative for your domain within NA Supply Chain. Lead weekly and quarterly forecasting that optimizes for end-to-end costs across the network. Build cost models that quantify the impact of operational decisions — from inventory placement to transfer routing to capacity utilization. Present recommendations to Directors and VPs in WBR and MBR forums. Partner with upstream and downstream teams to root cause variances, quantify risks and opportunities, and drive corrective actions. Build mechanisms that create accountability and reduce plan-vs-actual variance.

About the team
The NA Supply Chain Execution Finance team is the financial backbone for US and Canada S&OP, providing controllership, strategic partnership, and technical expertise for 40B+ units annually flowing through Cross Docks, Distribution Centers, and Fulfillment Centers. We translate customer demand into executable fulfillment plans that enable inventory to flow at lower cost and faster speed.

We own critical planning systems (True North, Skippy, F2P, WTPSS) and influence five core levers: Volume, Outbound Cost, Ops Variable, Ops Fixed, and Freight Cost In. A 1% variance in our metrics represents $43-51M annually — the decisions we inform matter at scale.

- 5+ years of finance work with progressively increasing levels of responsibility experience
- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business, economics, or a related analytical field (e.g., engineering, math, computer science), or Bachelor's degree or above
Preferred qualifications:
- MBA, or Master's degree
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards), or experience using Oracle
- Bachelor's degree in operations, supply chain or logistics, or 3+ years of Amazon experience
- Amazon Fulfillment Center, Supply Chain Optimisation Technologies, PPT, or large scale end to end inbound supply chain operations

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager, Strategic Accounts
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Sr. Program Manager to join our AWS Strategic Accounts organization. In this external customer-facing program management role, you will support one of our Independent Software Vendor (ISV) strategic customer’s commercial/contract administration activities across multiple internal cross-functional teams (e.g., AWS Strategic Customer Engagements (SCE), Legal, Finance/FinOps, Enterprise Support, Partner organization, Engineering, as well as regional teams). You will engage with the customer’s partner teams to conduct multi-party contract and agreement reviews for execution, evaluate pricing options, perform acquisition integrations, and coordinate across geographies. The PM will manage private pricing agreement (PPA) credits by performing ongoing tracking and resolution of credit process, including reconciliation of discrepancies. Externally, you will serve as the operational bridge to the customer’s partner management organization, ensuring aligned messaging, efficient decision-making, and consistent cadence execution.
Our Strategic Accounts organization supports the largest, most complex customer relationships in AWS. These accounts are unlike any other, with large teams and multiple cross-functional workstreams, and customer requirements extend beyond standard protocols. Account-based program management exists here because the sheer scale and operational complexity of Strategic Accounts demand dedicated, embedded program leadership to coordinate customer specific requirements and account-specific initiatives and mechanisms.
If you are excited about enabling high-performing teams at scale, building mechanisms that create leverage for senior leaders, driving operational excellence across multi-stakeholder programs, and leveraging generative AI to transform how organizations operate, we would love to hear from you.

About the Role
You will be a critical enabler for account leadership, providing comprehensive program management support across the full lifecycle of commercial activities, account operations, and strategic initiatives. You will maintain a holistic view of your supported account, driving consistency, standardization, transparency, and continuous improvement across the organization.
You will interface with customer partner organization and account leadership, ensuring alignment and accountability across complex, multi-stakeholder programs. You will translate leadership priorities into executable program plans, build governance frameworks that create visibility at every level, and design repeatable mechanisms that enable your supported organizations to operate at a higher level than they could without you.
You are encouraged to think big, invent, and take ownership. You will not simply manage programs handed to you, you will identify operational gaps, propose solutions, and build mechanisms that scale. You will champion generative AI adoption within your workflows and across your supported teams, continuously seeking opportunities to automate, accelerate, and improve how the organization operates.
Successful candidates will have a strong program management background, demonstrated ability to operate autonomously at a strategic level, excellent organizational and communication skills, and a track record of driving operational outcomes in ambiguous, fast-paced environments. You will be a peer leader who gains stakeholder buy-in, influences without authority, and creates leverage for the leaders you support.

Key job responsibilities
You will establish a deep understanding of your account's operational rhythms, leadership priorities, and team dynamics. You will be responsible for four core focus areas:
1/ Commercial / Contract Administration
Commercial acumen and contract coordination. Ability to understand and coordinate complex pricing agreements, amendments, and credit mechanisms across internal teams (SCE, Legal, Finance) and external partner counterparts. This includes managing approval workflows, tracking financial reconciliation, and facilitating multi-party commercial reviews.
2/ Customer Stakeholder Relationship Management
Partner and stakeholder relationship management. Experience managing day-to-day cadences and governance rhythms with senior external customer partner managers, including running bi-weekly syncs, QBRs, and joint planning exercises. Ability to represent AWS credibly in commercial conversations with customer partner organizations.
3/ Account-Specific Cadence Management
You will establish, own, and continuously improve account-specific business cadences. You will manage reporting cycles, maintain organizational calendars, and ensure cadence mechanisms drive accountability and decision-making rather than status reporting.
4/ Account-Specific Tooling & Mechanisms
You will own the infrastructure that enables account team productivity. This includes designing and managing tracking systems, knowledge bases, internal sites, automation workflows, technology migrations, and permissions management. You will drive adoption of generative AI tools across account teams, pilot high-impact use cases, and scale best practices across the district.

About the team
The AWSI Strategic Accounts Program Management team operates as strategic partners embedded within district/account teams. We create leverage for the leaders and organizations we support. We are not project coordinators, we are strategic program managers who design governance frameworks, build repeatable mechanisms, and ensure cross-functional teams are coordinated toward shared customer outcomes.
Our engagement model enables leaders to redirect time from operational execution to strategic customer engagement and high-impact decision-making. We serve as the connective tissue for our supported organizations: anticipating needs, connecting cross-functional partners, maintaining institutional knowledge, and driving accountability for deliverables across complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives.

- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

- 5+ years of leading cross-functional initiatives that drive financial performance and strategy experience

jobs.title: Senior Finance Manager, NA CF Inventory Quality
jobs.description:
The Senior Finance Manager, Inventory Quality sits within North America Customer Fulfillment (CF) Finance and owns financial controllership across two high-exposure domains: Defect Cost Controllership and Inventory Quality. This dual-domain scope each with its own risk profile, methodology, audit standard, and stakeholder set defines the role’s structural complexity. The role partners directly with VP-level operations finance stakeholders, and cross-functional leaders across Operations, Supply Chain, Accounting, and Tech, making it the connective tissue between operational execution and financial accountability at the most senior level of NACF.

The Senior Finance Manager owns Defect Cost Controllership across NA, the single source of truth for $3+B in direct defect costs spanning Damages, Concessions, and unsellable inventory. The function provides Operations and Finance leaders with the cost attribution and P&L mapping required to set reduction targets, assess workstream performance, and commit to operating plans. The complexity is threefold: (1) scope spans the full defect cost chain from site-level operational defects through Liquidations account treatment across cost types with no pre-existing standardized financial framework; (2) the function must maintain 100% NA site coverage across a continuously expanding network without gaps in controllership or reporting continuity; and (3) defect cost sits at the intersection of Operations, Accounting, and E2E Supply Chain, requiring this role to ensure financial data is simultaneously actionable for operations leadership, audit-ready for finance, and consistent enough to anchor the kingpin commitments that flow into quarterly and annual operating plans.

This role owns Inventory Quality Finance with controllership accountability across warehouse damages, inventory adjustments, removals and returns, and SOX compliance for global inventory. The function governs approximately $3-4B in inventory adjustments annually, a cost base where accounting treatment gaps carry direct SOX exposure. The role governs inventory controllership at three distinct levels simultaneously: reserve calculation methodology (replacing intuition-based approaches with data-driven models), Inventory Roll-Forward account ownership (serving as the primary coordination point with Accounting), and SOX controllership framework design for global inventory.

The Senior Finance Manager leads and develops a high-performing organization of finance professionals. The role is accountable for organizational design, succession planning, leadership development, and maintaining Amazon’s talent and hiring bar while building scalable capabilities in analytics, business partnership, and operational finance. This includes setting the professional standard for the team, coaching leaders at every level, and ensuring the organization can absorb new controllership domains without degrading quality or coverage.

At Amazon, Finance has the unique challenge of stewarding and bolstering tremendous business growth through applying financial acumen, objectivity and leadership, while staying nimble and adaptive to evolving business needs. Amazon Finance drives direct impact by being a hand-in-hand business partner in developing, measuring, and executing on our long term strategy to invent on behalf of our customers. To do so, we look for exceptional Finance Managers who possess the leadership to influence, a bias for action, and the passion to think big while driving business results. We are looking for an experienced Finance Manager to join the WW Pricing & Promotions Finance team.

Pricing is integral to Amazon’s ability to deliver on its everyday low price promise to customers. With millions of products available on Amazon, Pricing develops technology to compute and publish prices for every retail item in Amazon’s global catalog, delivering competitive prices across full range of products and automating decision-making.

The Finance Manager will be a critical partner to the pricing team, owning the pricing Cost Out Initiative program. This includes supporting financial modeling and decision making processes for strategic initiatives within the pricing product management teams. The successful candidate will have excellent analytical, financial modeling, and communication skills. They will possess strong business partnership and project management skills and collaborate effectively with stakeholders. The candidate will also possess the leadership to influence, bias for action, the passion to think big while driving business results, and developing a world class team.

Key job responsibilities
- Manage the Cost Out Initiative program for WW Pricing.
- Partner with the Pricing Product Management teams to identify and size new strategic initiatives.
- Work closely with pricing team to set up, execute and analyze pricing experiments to drive long term free cash flow.
- Provide critical insights to the Pricing leadership team by owning monthly and quarterly reporting for the program.
- Build and maintain in depth knowledge across key business areas by staying current on initiatives, challenges/opportunities across the business.

A day in the life
This role will own end-to-end financial reporting and analysis for pricing, working backwards from customer needs to deliver actionable insights. This includes building scalable financial models and conducting deep-dive analyses to uncover variance drivers and identify opportunities for optimization. The role will partner with cross-functional teams across multiple geographies to implement best practices and drive standardization at scale. The role will deliver written and verbal communications that are data-driven, concise, and compelling to influence senior leadership decisions.

About the team
The Finance team for this role supports the Global Pricing team, whose vision is to provide customers with low, competitive prices across our entire selection, simplify discovery of our best offers, and earn trust by transparently helping customers understand price quality and value.
Basic qualifications:
- 5+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
- 5+ years of applying key financial performance indicators (KPIs) to analyses experience
- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting or related field
- 5+ years of leading cross-functional initiatives that drive financial performance and strategy experience
- 5+ years of dissecting financial data and identifying patterns that support business strategy experience
Preferred qualifications:
- 6+ years of identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan experience
- 6+ years of solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits) experience
- MBA, or CPA
- Knowledge of SQL/ETL
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)
- Experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, and data interpretation of results

jobs.description:
Amazon seeks a Finance Manager to provide finance leadership for EU Same Day speed programs. In this role, you will be a core part of a small and fast growing team that is in charge of evaluating the launch of delivery programs allowing customers to benefit from speed and convenience across Amazon’s selection. The Sustainability Finance team is looking for a Finance Manager to lead finance support for Amazon’s company-wide Waste partner strategies.

The ideal candidate will be a well-rounded athlete willing to go beyond their core responsibilities, nimbly overcome barriers, and deliver business results. The person must be a constant learner, knowledgeable of industry trends, and effective at partnering with business leadership to accomplish goals. This Finance Manager must be a skilled communicator effective at working through formal and informal channels to set and drive strategy with a proven track record working effectively across geographically dispersed cross-functional teams. The ideal candidate will be a trusted advisor that steadily delivers commitments and is able to influence senior executives to facilitate the achievement of their business partners’ objectives.

The Finance Manager will play a critical role in the Sustainability team's Waste initiatives and as a role model for controllership. This individual will also have experience in designing and enforcing policies and processes that will protect and enhance the integrity of Amazon’s financial records and increase organizational efficiency.

Key job responsibilities
- Driving strategic investment analysis and working to partner teams to drive adoption
- Managing and reporting business performance, including goal development and tracking
- Developing rhythm of business documents (i.e. Annual and 3-year Operating Plans)
- Establish mechanisms and processes that are repeatable and scalable to gain efficiencies across Amazon's diverse businesses

About the team
The Sustainability Finance team supports the management of Amazon’s social and environmental impact globally and partners to drive solutions that enable our customers and our business to become more sustainable. With the Climate Pledge, Amazon publicly committed to measure and report greenhouse gas emissions and to achieve net-zero emissions in 2040 by physically de-carbonizing its business activities and neutralize remaining residual emissions. Executing this plan is a complex strategic and financial undertaking that requires thorough and careful financial consideration.
Basic qualifications:
- 5+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business, economics, or a related analytical field (e.g., engineering, math, computer science), or Bachelor's degree and 5+ years of quantitative role (engineering, process re-engineering, quality assurance) experience
- 5+ years of dissecting financial data and identifying patterns that support business strategy experience
- 5+ years of leading cross-functional initiatives that drive financial performance and strategy experience
Preferred qualifications:
- 6+ years of identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan experience
- 6+ years of solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits) experience
- MBA, or CPA
- Knowledge of SQL/ETL
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)
- Experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, and data interpretation of results

jobs.title: Finance Manager, NA Supply Chain Execution Finance
jobs.description:
Amazon's North American fulfillment network moves 40 billion units annually through Cross Docks, Distribution Centers, and Fulfillment Centers, and the financial decisions that shape this flow directly determine whether customers get faster delivery at lower cost to serve. We are seeking a Finance Manager to own the financial narrative for a critical domain within our Supply Chain Execution Finance team.

In this role, you will serve as the trusted finance partner to Supply Chain Execution leaders, providing controllership and strategic insight across inbound and outbound planning. You will translate operational complexity into clear financial narratives that drive VP-level decisions. The scope is unique: from billion-dollar network cost optimization to weekly execution accountability, you will operate with significant autonomy in a highly ambiguous, cross-organizational environment.

Key job responsibilities
1) Serve as the primary finance partner to S&OP leaders responsible for network planning, building deep working relationships across SCOT, NACF Operations, Network Design, Field Finance, and Science to drive end-to-end optimization

2) Own end-to-end financial controllership for assigned planning systems (e.g., True North, F2P, WTPSS, Skippy), ensuring cost inputs are accurate, current, and driving optimal network outcomes

3) Lead financial planning across OP1, OP2, and QxG cycles, aligning cross-functional assumptions and preparing Director/VP-level narratives and bridges

4) Deliver trade-off analyses and variance deep dives through weekly WBR/MBR support that directly inform execution decisions, helping leaders weigh customer experience against cost to serve

5) Identify, validate, and track cost savings opportunities across the inbound and outbound network, building entitlement cases and holding organizations accountable to committed plans

5) Influence outcomes across 4+ partner organizations without direct authority, using data, relationships, and mechanisms to drive alignment

6) Champion AI and automation adoption to accelerate analysis, reduce manual effort, and continuously explore new ways to deliver insights faster
Basic qualifications:
- 5+ years of finance work with progressively increasing levels of responsibility experience
- Bachelor's degree
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience in a leadership position managing finance, accounting and operational processes
- Experience driving End to End inbound supply chain operations, Fulfillment Center, or cross-organisational finance initiatives

jobs.description:
Join the US Seller Business organization within North America Stores as a Finance Manager, where you'll drive insights that enable the long-term success of our selling partners. This role offers an exciting opportunity to own and analyze the pricing and promotions inputs that shape topline growth within the US 3P business, support strategic initiatives, and provide financial leadership across ASP trends and promotional strategy. You'll build strategic relationships with key leaders while delivering high-quality analyses that explain topline movement and support the promotions team on strategy, forecasting, and reporting.

Working in this role requires exceptional problem-solving skills, comfort with ambiguity, and strong analytical capabilities. You'll collaborate across teams to develop metrics, create forecasts, and build financial models that support critical business decisions. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy frequent interaction with senior leaders, and want to make a meaningful impact on Amazon's seller ecosystem, this position offers the perfect blend of analytical challenge and strategic influence.

Key job responsibilities
- Own topline reporting and analytics for the pricing and promotions inputs within the US 3P business, translating trends into clear insights for business and finance leaders.
- Analyze ASP movement and rate and mix dynamics to explain what is driving topline performance and where the business is trending.
- Partner with the promotions team to support promotional event strategy, including planning, forecasting, and post-event analysis.
- Build and maintain promotions forecasts across the relevant forecast cycles.
- Develop metrics, financial models, and reporting mechanisms that scale and enable business partners to operate independently.
- Deliver executive-ready analyses and commentary that inform strategic decisions and stand up to senior leadership review.
- Build strong relationships with key business and finance stakeholders, acting as a trusted thought partner across the organization.

Your day begins with reviewing topline trends for the US 3P business, with a focus on how ASPs are moving and what is driving performance. You'll collaborate with cross-functional partners, including the promotions team, to build strategic relationships and support the success of promotional events and other key initiatives. Throughout the day, you'll develop forecasts, analyze rate and mix dynamics, and prepare insights for upcoming leadership meetings. You might find yourself diving deep into data to identify trends, building analyses that explain topline movement, or working with teammates to optimize processes and reporting mechanisms.

About the team
The US Seller Business mission is to enable the long-term success of our selling partners by providing the most trusted shopping and selling experience and solutions for accelerating business growth. The US Seller Business organization is responsible for driving the growth and profitability of the US Fulfillment By Amazon (FBA) and Merchant Fulfillment Network (MFN) programs

jobs.title: Finance Manager, Inventory Quality Finance
jobs.description:
Amazon’s North American Customer Fulfillment (NACF) Finance is looking for a Finance Manager to be a trusted partner for IQ (Inventory & Quality) Finance, supporting the NA Quality team. Amazon operates the most complex retail networks in the world, delivering billions of packages to hundreds of millions of homes and businesses annually. Come be part of this tremendous organization and join a dedicated team committed to operational and financial excellence where you will focus on the inputs, think like an owner and where every day is Day One.
IQ Finance supports the NA Quality team in its mission of managing inventory controllership and reducing defects to improve the experiences of our customers. The team accomplishes this by owning the financial planning cycles, monitoring critical metrics and controls, and leveraging trust to influence areas with the largest impact. The ability to learn and be curious while working through a high degree of complex ambiguity in order to think big while inventing and simplifying for process improvement is critical.

• Own critical business reporting for quality spend and performance, including executive-ready dashboards and cost trend analysis to support leadership decision-making
• Earn trust and partner with key stakeholders across NA Quality, AFT Finance, and NACF Central Finance to influence cost optimization decisions and align on strategic priorities
• Drive efficiency in financial processes by automating standard work, reducing cycle times, and improving forecast accuracy

We're looking for a Finance Manager who is curious about how it all works and motivated to make it work better.

What you'll do

You'll join a highly visible team embedded within Transportation operations, working shoulder to shoulder with Operations and Technology leaders to:

-Learn how our network operates at the most granular level and translate that understanding into financial insight
-Partner with business leaders to build the business cases behind network investments and cost initiatives
-Drive programs and projects from concept through execution, measuring tangible impact on both our P&L and the customer experience
-Surface inefficiencies and opportunities that others miss, collaborating with cross-functional teams to turn analysis into action
-Leverage AI-powered tools to accelerate analysis and elevate the quality of recommendations you bring to the table

What makes this role different

This team takes pride in operational excellence — not just in the numbers we produce, but in how deeply we understand the operations behind them. You won't observe from the sidelines. You'll walk the network, learn the business from the ground up, and earn credibility by showing up with insights that reflect genuine operational understanding. The problems are complex, the data is massive, and the results of your work are visible in how we serve customers every day.

You'll thrive here if you

-Are genuinely curious about how things work — you'd rather tour a fulfillment center than read a slide deck about one
-Take pride in getting the details right and producing work you'd put your name on
-See your role as a thought partner to the business, not a reporting function that operates at arm's length
-Want your analysis to drive real action — programs launched, costs reduced, customer experience improved
-View AI and automation as tools to ask better questions, not just get faster answers
-Are energized by seeing your work show up in the metrics, because you helped drive the program that moved them

Key job responsibilities
- Dive Deep into processes and cost drivers to uncover efficiency opportunities.
- Collaborate with business partners to substantiate new strategies through data analysis.
- Think critically while developing cost savings calculation methodologies.
- Think Big to maximize savings opportunities.

Your analytical expertise will be instrumental in developing structured pricing frameworks, while your strong communication skills will enable effective stakeholder management across multiple business units. jobs.title: Senior Technical Infrastructure Program Manager, Field Engineering Portfolio
jobs.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Data Center Field Engineering Team is the engineering owner for the lifecycle of AWS data centers. This includes supporting new designs/innovations through data center end-of-life, with a focus on root cause analysis of failures, capacity and availability improvement, and optimization of the existing fleet.

We're looking for an experienced Senior Technical Infrastructure Program Manager to lead the Global Data Center Performance Indicator (DCPI) Program for AWS Field Engineering. DCPIs turn continuous signals from data center infrastructure into early warning of equipment risk, so the fleet moves from reacting to failures to preventing them. In this role, you will set the global strategy for how AWS measures and protects the health of its data center infrastructure. You will decide which risks the fleet must detect and in what order, expand the program into new domains where regulatory requirements and AWS’s public reputation are at stake, and set the direction for the best way to scale the program so AWS operations become more efficient and intelligent, while delivering world-class uptime for our customers.

You will bring deep technical expertise in data center mechanical, electrical, and controls systems, and use it to set the technical direction for an AI-empowered, machine learning–integrated platform that will lead AWS toward its vision of scaling effortlessly. You will partner closely with multiple engineering disciplines, including mechanical/electrical, reliability and quality, software, data science, and data engineering teams, as well as operations and sustainability partners. You will make strategic decisions on program priorities, investment, and overall direction, connecting long-term program vision with the rapid growth of AWS.

You must be adept at identifying and communicating upcoming risks, issues, and bottlenecks, and be instrumental in resolving them, often across multiple organizational boundaries. You must possess a strong sense of organization, communication, and team-building skills that foster robust working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

Key job responsibilities
• Own the strategy and roadmap for global infrastructure health and performance programs, prioritizing investment by risk, customer impact, and scale.
• Define the performance indicators, signals, thresholds, and data-quality standards that measure the health of data center infrastructure, and hold them to a high technical bar.
• Drive programs across regions and organizational boundaries, aligning engineering, operations, software, and data science partners on priorities, standards, and success metrics.
• Set the technical requirements for the tools and platforms that build, deploy, and scale performance monitoring, and partner with software and machine learning (ML) teams on where automation and anomaly detection add the most value.
• Extend program coverage to new equipment types and domains, and establish mechanisms for transitioning mature capabilities to operational owners.
• Full lifecycle ownership from risk identification to global fleet-wide resolution, including standards and processes for tracking, reporting, and closing actions.
• Prepare narratives for executive leadership with recommendations that articulate decision points relative to cost, timing, availability, and strategic trade-offs.

A day in the life

About AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud
platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers
from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and
services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster
a culture of inclusion that empower us to celebrate our differences. Ongoing events and learning
experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of
sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture.
When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the
cloud.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We have a career path for you no matter what stage you’re in when you start here. We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer.
That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing
resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

About the team
Amazon's vision is to be the world's most customer-centric company, and this role is key to that vision. As a Field Engineering Technical Program Manager, you will be leading teams to optimize global programs to meet ever-evolving customer needs as we continue expanding our data center fleet to hyper-scale. As an ideal candidate you:

• Possess Strong Engineering Judgement and are able to provide recommendations despite uncertainty

If you meet these qualifications, exude passion, and enjoy the challenge of innovative projects at hyper-scale, this job is for you!

Our team is dedicated to supporting new team members. Our team has a broad mix of experience levels and Amazon tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship.

jobs.title: Sr Integration Experience Mgr, Corporate Development Integration
jobs.description:
Corporate Development Integration is seeking an experienced integration communications and onboarding leader to drive adoption of functional and business integration activities in Amazon's mergers and acquisitions (M&A).

Amazon's integration leaders in this space are called Integration Experience (IX) Leads as they focus on minimizing disruption and driving engagement for acquired employees through internal communications, onboarding, training, cultural integration, and employee engagement strategies.

The IX Lead plans, creates, and executes integration enablement programs across the full integration lifecycle, from due diligence through approximately 90-100 days post-acquisition close. This role supports integrations of all sizes, both private and public company transactions, across multiple geographies, and managing multiple concurrent integration programs. Leveraging change management best practices, the IX Lead focuses on accelerating time to productivity for acquired organizations by delivering pragmatic, scalable support that is directly aligned to deal goals, navigating the ambiguity of M&A transactions and synthesizing input from business and cross-functional teams. Central to this role is supporting a culture of inclusion, trust, and respect in all working relationships—with acquired employees, cross-functional partners, and leadership alike.

This role supports global transactions, requiring domestic and international travel approximately 30% of the time. Due to the dynamic nature of M&A timelines, travel may occasionally be planned on short notice.

Key job responsibilities
Change Enablement & Integration Strategy
- Apply change management best practices to assess change readiness, identify potential friction points, and develop tailored enablement strategies based on deal complexity and anticipated change impact
- Translate functional and business integration activities into people-focused experiences through sequencing, prioritization, and stakeholder engagement
- Conduct cultural and change readiness assessments during due diligence, translating findings into actionable recommendations for communication, onboarding, and engagement strategies
- Define the scope of change support required for each transaction in partnership with the Integration Manager and Business Sponsor
- Identify opportunities to improve internal integration processes and scale best practices across the IX portfolio

Internal Communications
- Own the end-to-end employee communication strategy across the integration lifecycle, including employee newsletters and FAQs, leader briefing materials, and targeted messaging for specific employee groups
- Develop and execute comprehensive communication plans for key milestones (Deal Sign & Announcement, Deal Close & Day 1 Orientation), coordinating inputs from cross-functional teams (Business, Legal, PR, HR, IT, Finance, and Real Estate)
- Write and review all employee-facing communications ensuring clarity, consistency, and cross-functional alignment across stakeholders
- Develop executive communications that distill complex integration details into clear, compelling narratives
- Advise on organizational design communications, including sequencing and timing of reporting structure changes to manage employee experience

Onboarding & Training
- Plan and execute Day 1 Orientation events and customized onboarding experiences, including structured onboarding programs, leader onboarding programs, establishing a support network for the acquired population (onboarding buddies and key individuals to meet), and role-specific training
- Design and deliver comprehensive training plans in partnership with cross-functional teams, coordinating timing and sequencing to ensure a cohesive employee experience
- Equip Amazon and acquired company leaders to deliver integration messages through leader briefings and one-on-ones, enabling them to guide their teams through the transition
- Educate cross-functional partners and business teams on IX workstreams, integration milestones, and employee experience considerations

Cultural Integration
- Identify gaps between the acquired organization's operating norms and Amazon's ways of working, and develop integration strategies to bridge them
- Design and execute cultural integration approaches, including education on Amazon's Leadership Principles, Working Backwards methodology, business writing, and other ways of working
- Implement Change Champion Networks for large, complex transactions to support peer-to-peer adoption and sustained engagement

Stakeholder Engagement
- Build trusted relationships with senior leaders (Business Sponsors, VPs, acquired leadership) through direct engagement and consistent, communication
- Influence, advise, and build consensus among senior leadership in ambiguous situations, determining how to achieve the best outcome and knowing when and how to escalate effectively
- Keep cross-functional teams up-to-speed with proactive communication that anticipates questions

Employee Engagement & Measurement
- Own employee engagement measurement, including employee engagement pulse surveys, onboarding surveys, and integration surveys (~90-100 days post-close)
- Analyze employee sentiment data, identify themes, and present recommended actions to leadership, benchmarking results against historical acquisition data
- Use feedback loops to proactively address concerns, remove productivity barriers, and inform ongoing change support

About the team
The Corporate Development Integration team leads Amazon and acquired teams through the definition and enablement of the acquisition rationale and acquired business growth. Integration Experience (IX) Leads support this mission by planning, creating, and executing communications, onboarding, training, cultural integration, and employee engagement strategies that enable acquired organizations to adopt functional and business integration activities. Leveraging change management best practices, IX creates pragmatic integration enablement plans focused on ensuring acquired employees are informed, engaged, and supported throughout their initial integration journey with Amazon. We apply what's helpful, skip what's not, and stay solution-oriented, tailoring our approach based on deal complexity and business need.
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree
- 5+ years of developing, negotiating and executing business agreements experience
- 5+ years of professional or military experience
- 6+ years of complex cross-functional change management experience
- Experience delivering results for large, cross-functional initiatives/projects
- Experience communicating clearly and concisely with leadership, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams
- Experience in balancing conflicting priorities dealing with ambiguity
- 6+ years of M&A integration experience within a Corporate Development function or management consultancy
Preferred qualifications:
- 5+ years of management consulting, strategy, technology, venture capital, or a related industry experience
- Experience in post-close integration
- Experience in Change Management

jobs.description:
The Mexico L&D team is looking for a Learning Program Manager Intern to help run our training programs for associates and managers. These include soft-skills and technical training as well as leadership programs. You will help plan each program, keep it on schedule across sites, track how it is performing, and make sure delivery stays high quality with minimal disruption to operations. You will be matched to a manager and a mentor and will own a program-management project from start to finish.

Key job responsibilities
• Help manage training programs for associates and managers, including soft-skills, technical, and leadership training

• Build and maintain program plans, trackers, and timelines that minimize disruption to operations

• Track program KPIs and report on rollout progress and program performance

• Coordinate across learning teams, operations, and central stakeholders to keep programs on schedule

jobs.title: Technical Infrastructure Program Manager II, Eng Risk Management, GES Start UP
jobs.description:
Amazon created one of the most sophisticated supply chains in the world. From the introduction of Amazon Prime to the use of advanced technology for package delivery, Amazon consistently drives change from the front of the pack.

Are you an innovative leader that wants to lead the cross-functional design and deployment of next-generation sortation and distribution solutions into our world-class fulfillment and logistics network? Do you want to take ownership of solving the industry's most complex construction and integration challenges? Does the challenge of planning and implementing facility network infrastructure — including new builds, retrofits, expansions, and program initiatives — appeal to you? If you're looking to be challenged in a fast-paced and often ambiguous environment, and you have strong technical problem-solving and project management skills, then this job is for you!

Amazon is searching for an innovative and solutions-oriented Tech Infra Program Manager with the Global Engineering Services (GES) North America (NA) Startup Engineering Risk Management (ERM) team who is able to collaborate effectively with internal and external technical teams and be responsible for the planning, development, and delivery of physical distribution systems across multiple building types. The role primarily focuses on managing technology and integration projects end-to-end, delivering turnkey solutions that meet project goals and support a timely handover to operations.

In this role you will be responsible for working with internal customers to define highly ambiguous problem statements, influencing construction and integration strategies across the NA network, writing technical specifications and performing technical evaluations on equipment and systems, generating multiyear budgets, driving project schedules from design to release, and managing multiple large, high-visibility programs simultaneously through the project lifecycle. You will partner with internal customers and internal/external stakeholders — including equipment vendors, customers, and partners — to engage as a team and ensure seamless project delivery. To meet timelines and minimize disruption to support teams, you will manage the overall schedule, proactively mitigate risks, and keep the scope of engineering deliverables under control.

This person will possess a strong engineering and program management background, will have demonstrated experience leading medium to large projects, and will have a well-rounded technical background in fulfillment and distribution center designs, including a solid understanding of design approaches and industry technologies. You must be able to thrive and succeed in an innovative environment, and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities. This means you are not only able to develop and drive high-level strategic initiatives, but can also roll up your sleeves, dig in, and get the job done.

This role requires 50% regional travel on a yearly basis. When not traveling, you must have availability to work from a corporate office. Candidates should either live near or be willing to relocate within a reasonable commuting distance of one of the corporate office locations listed. Relocation assistance may be provided.

Key job responsibilities
- This person will manage multiple large, highly complex programs, solely responsible for driving them through the develop and deployment lifecycle.
- You deeply understand the business and technical requirements of product integration from mechanical, electrical, and controls functions
- You are expected to have fluency in systems level architecture, critique and debate tech design, judge technical viability of the product/solution and tailor communication for tech and non-tech stakeholders.
- Work with the Operations Leadership team to manage the networks strategy and project priority to ensure resources are always focused on the most impactful projects
- Define program/project scope and technical/business requirements, and relay that to the design engineering team concisely to allow for efficient transfer of knowledge
- Evaluate solutions effectively and make decisions that balance business value and technology risk
- Help your customers and the engineering teams make appropriate trade-offs by considering the larger picture (e.g., business goals, throughput expectations, quality requirements, efficiency, maintainability, operability)
- Identify standards and drive consistent application of engineering changes across North America
- Build strong working relationships with Fulfillment Center (FC) leadership and their operations teams across multiple sites including Industrial Engineering, Maintenance Engineering, and Process Engineering stakeholders
- Communicate and present program status to VPs of Engineering and Operations
- Data mine and transform raw thoughts into clear technical documentation
- Ability to travel up to 50% to interact with internal and external business and technical leaders

A day in the life
Each day, you operate as Amazon's Tech Infra Program leader — driving the safe, on-time, and on-budget delivery of complex large scale infra program.

You are managing one or multiple projects that can vary in scope, complexity and duration.
Daily tasks may comprise of site coordination with operations teams and contractors on project execution activities or changes; deep diving project progress, schedule and resources, while identifying barriers, creating solutions and driving resolutions. You may be facilitating the planning and/or implementation meetings with projects’ stakeholders, ensuring alignment in objectives, expectations, and the next steps; you would capture and publish detailed notes after each meeting to drive ownership and follow-through on the actions and decisions. You may be brainstorming and developing workaround solutions while mitigating the project delays or design issues. As a part of the acceptance testing, you may be performing systems installation quality, safety, throughput, and performance qualifications, frequently communicating the progress to internal and external stakeholders. In addition, you may be supporting/training other engineering team members, utilizing the knowledge of Amazon’s safety, mechanical, electrical and controls installation standard and guidelines.

Global Engineering Services (GES) North America (NA) works to deliver Material Handling System launches, retrofits, and innovations. A day in the life can take place on a jobsite, in an active facility, or in one of Amazon’s corporate offices. GES NA is highly team-oriented, working daily be smarter together, be faster together, and to grow together.

About the team
The Engineering Risk Management (ERM) team manages the implementation of GES NA’s new launches and retrofits, bridging conceptual design milestones to operational go-live. Operating under five core tenets, the team coordinates complex projects across multiple internal stakeholders and external vendors, ensuring timely delivery while maintaining quality standards. Through tight collaboration with cross functional teams, we aim to eliminate process gaps to optimize project execution. Success is measured through effective program management, risk mitigation, and stakeholder alignment. The team's value lies in translating these strategic plans into operational reality, by providing clear project visibility, and fostering cross-functional collaboration to remove project barriers and achieve GES's broader network optimization goals.

At Amazon, we are all Owners and leverage unique opportunities presented to us by owning everything from firm engineering to project execution and final hand-off to our customers. We are a diverse, upbeat, creative team of engineers and managers working on a daily basis to ensure that our internal customers have capabilities to deliver on the Customer Promise.
We not only build, but we are also consistently improving our capabilities at Amazon. Continuous improvement is the ongoing enhancement of our systems through incremental and breakthrough developments. We are continually raising the quality bar, and are never satisfied. We seek to improve through captured lessons learned that are incorporated back into our mechanisms as a way to perpetually improve upon the next design and processes iterations. We continually learn, grow, and develop throughout the organization and our Subject Matter Expertise is leveraged globally.

We are the Team! We collaborate, support, help and leverage each other in delivering on the business objectives.

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
- 6+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- Experience with complex MHE and packaging lines or process design based on Lean Manufacturing or Toyota Manufacturing System
- Experience communicating clearly and concisely with leadership, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams
- Experience using Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook)
- Experience with CAD software (AutoCAD, REVIT, BIM 360, etc.)
Preferred qualifications:

- Experience working with material handling equipment (MHE) safety standards in accordance with OEM requirements
- Experience working with customers, technical teams, and management to collect requirements, describe software product features, and technical designs
- Experience in capital project management involving ownership/management of engineering design projects

jobs.title: Operations Manager, FC Operations
jobs.description:
Operations is the beating heart of Amazon. This key part of our business makes sure we fulfil and dispatch orders efficiently so that our customers get their items on time. It’s driven by Operations Managers who bring the team together to push excellence in safety, quality and productivity across our sites. At your site, you’ll lead other managers and create the operational plan that helps your teams meet their targets. This role is all about driving operational excellence to create the Amazon of tomorrow.

The applicable collective agreement (CCNL) for this role is Logistica, Trasporto Merci e Spedizione. The position is classified at Livello Quadro or above, depending on the candidate’s skills, competences and experience.

Key job responsibilities
Manage and develop a team of Area Managers
Lead operational teams on a shift, deal with issues, and positively impact site performance
Analyse shift performance against relevant business objectives, and put in place actions to improve our operational excellence
Work closely with other support teams, including HR, Finance, Health and Safety, and Security
Design and deliver initiatives across the sites to improve operational performance

A day in the life
You’ll lead shifts at one of our operational sites. You’ll also be the key link between a number of teams, including finance, safety and operations integration teams. That means you’ll be close to the day-to-day operations at your site but also contribute to new ways to innovate at your site.

A typical day will involve meetings with different areas of the business, deep diving into performance and risk metrics for sites, and looking ahead to prepare for different levels of demand. Every day will also involve mentoring and coaching your team. You’ll be a source of leadership and support your team to be the best managers they can be.

About the team
Customer Fulfilment, or CF, is where it all started for Amazon. CF has scaled up from a humble team of booksellers to a sophisticated global team which handles more than 1.5 million orders every day. The team is the foundation of our business and its efforts have helped us diversify across new regions and services. With the help of emerging technology, we’re always looking for ways to offer a bigger, better product range – delivered quickly and affordably.

The CF team are the first people in the chain that helps customers get products at the speed we’re known for. We’re based in Fulfilment Centres, which are at the heart of Amazon’s fast-paced Operations network. Our centres are sometimes referred to as the ‘First Mile’ because it’s where most Amazon packages start their journey. We help to manage dynamic inventory and facilitate speedy deliveries round the clock.
Lots of different people work in our Fulfilment Centres, so there are plenty of opportunities for every skillset. Some of us work with physical products, while others analyse data to help everyone across the business make smart decisions.

jobs.title: Global FF&E Program Manager , Amazon Global Real Estate and Facilities
jobs.description:
The Design, Sustainability and Engineering team in GREF seeks an experienced Program Manager with strong cross-functional leadership skills to own GREF’s Global Furniture Fixtures & Equipment (FF&E) Program. This role is the single point of strategic ownership for FF&E lifecycle management, procurement strategy, asset management, and cross-functional coordination across GREF's worldwide workplace portfolio.

The FF&E function within GREF covers four primary responsibilities: defining and maintaining FF&E standards and strategy, stewarding the Workplace FF&E Standards, driving regional procurement strategies, sustainability, and benchmarking against industry practice to identify gaps and improvements.
This role serves as the connective tissue between Global Design, Workplace Guidelines, Construction delivery teams, GREF Finance, Global Corporate Sustainability, Portfolio Management, and Global Corporate Procurement (GCP). The successful candidate will integrate constraints and requirements from cross-functional stakeholders into efficient, scalable, globally-relevant solutions that are fiscally responsible and advance Amazon's sustainability commitments.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the end-to-end FF&E Lifecycle Management Strategy across GREF's global portfolio — from specification and procurement through operations, storage, and end-of-life disposition.
- Own and drive the FF&E procurement strategy, partnering with GCP under the shared-accountability model to co-own joint savings commitments while balancing regional availability, sustainability, and cost caps
- Own global FF&E Asset Tracking (AST) strategy across all GREF-supported sites, including asset storage, product ordering, inventory management, and evaluation of aging products to meet requirements of 100% inventory coverage and >90% data quality accuracy. Develop and enforce governance, risk and compliance controals for FF&E including monthly verification tracking, sadhbaords scopes and compliance evidence documentation
- Establish and maintain furniture asset lifetime guidelines, condition assessment criteria, and refurbishment standards that inform replacement planning, budget forecasting, and warranty alignment
- Collaborate in develop and manage a global FF&E circularity program — identifying, cataloging, and redistributing surplus assets to avoid unnecessary new purchases; establish partnerships with internal reuse functions, donation, resale, takeback programs and recycling partners for end-of-life disposition
- Own the GREF Workplace FF&E Standards (selection, testing, digital catalog) and FF&E Guidelines (design guidance, trade up/down decision logic, playbooks for internal and external teams)
- Develop the FF&E technology strategy, inclusive of disposal method tracking, including evaluating and driving decisions on platform capabilities, integration architecture across regional systems, and AI-enabled asset discovery tools
- Benchmark industry best practices, identify gaps between Global Workplace Design Guidelines and regional trends, and provide solution-oriented recommendations
- Lead cross-functional stakeholder alignment across Design, Construction, MAC, Portfolio Management, Procurement, Finance, IT, AV, Security, and sustainability teams
- Develop cost-avoidance tracking and reporting to quantify savings from procurement consolidation, reuse programs, and vendor strategy; coordinate environmental impact reporting (waste diversion, embodied carbon reduction)

A day in the life
This role is deeply cross-functional. You'll partner daily with Design, Construction, Procurement, Finance, Sustainability, Portfolio Management, and regional operations teams — aligning competing priorities into one global strategy for how Amazon's furniture is specified, procured, tracked, reused, and retired. One conversation might be negotiating a global seating contract; the next, advancing a circular economy partnership or troubleshooting asset data quality with a regional lead across the world. You own the system end-to-end, and you'll measure impact in millions saved and tons diverted from landfill.

About the team
The Global Real Estate and Facilities (GREF) team manages Amazon's real estate and facilities globally. It's organized into Regional Portfolio Management, Global Centers of Enablement, and Global Centers of Expertise. Design, Sustainability and Engineering includes Global Design, Workplace Guidelines, Sustainability, and Engineering teams. These teams develop design concepts, implement workplace standards, and deliver various spaces across Amazon's portfolio. GREF emphasizes inclusive team culture, work-life balance, and career growth. The team values diversity and promotes knowledge sharing and mentorship. GREF strives to create spaces that support Amazonians' work while enhancing employee well-being and aligning with the company's strategic vision.

- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements

- Master's degree
- Knowledge of financial asset classification including capitalization thresholds and Special Economic Zone compliance implications for asset registries
- Experience designing, implementing, and scaling upskilling, apprenticeship, or workforce development programs across large-scale operations or corporate environments, including forecasting workforce needs and leveraging analytics to drive program decisions

jobs.description:
Are you ready to shape the future of Returns operations at Amazon? We're seeking a Program Manager to work at the intersection of product, technology, business, and operations teams to drive strategic decision-making on new investment areas. In this role, you'll assess new program and business intakes based on operational capacity and costs, lead process simplification to improve associate experience, and drive initiatives to reduce variable costs. You'll spearhead new hardware testing and scaling efforts while influencing strategy across cross-functional stakeholder teams.

This position offers the unique opportunity to make a measurable impact on how Amazon handles Returns operations—from designing operational capabilities that support new business needs to implementing performance efficiencies that directly affect Safety, Associate experience, Cost, and Recovery metrics. You'll work with technologies including Computer Vision integration and emerging automation solutions, positioning yourself at the forefront of operational innovation.

Key job responsibilities
* Manage the lifecycle of complex cross-functional programs with considerable impact, defining program mission, vision, and objectives while analyzing data to drive measurable improvements
* Assess new program and business intakes dependent on operational capacity and costs, making data-driven decisions on project prioritization and resource allocation
* Design and implement operational capabilities, processes, and standard operating procedures to ensure compliance, quality, and scalability while reducing variable costs through performance efficiencies
* Collaborate with product, technology, business, and operations teams as well as cross-functional partners including NCRC, ReCommerce, and ROE Programs to influence strategy and drive consensus on new investment areas
* Develop field tools and performance dashboards that support execution excellence, regularly reviewing metrics and proactively seeking improved data mechanisms for visibility across the program lifecycle

A day in the life
Your day begins with scoping and designing operational capabilities that support new business needs across Returns operations. You'll analyze data from site visits and direct surveys to identify process standardization opportunities, then work with cross-functional stakeholders to implement solutions. Throughout the day, you'll lead discussions on operational processes that reduce costs through performance efficiencies, develop Standard Operating Procedures to ensure compliance and quality, and collaborate with technology partners on field tools and dashboards. You'll also engage with shared projects across Worldwide Returns & Recommerce teams, driving alignment and innovation in areas like the TREX application with Computer Vision integration and Problem Solve workflows.

About the team
The Reverse Logistics Operations Integration (RLOI) team within Worldwide Returns & Recommerce innovates across all facets of Returns operations—from process flows and technologies to operator tools—driving performance efficiencies and operational excellence in Safety, Associate experience, Cost, and Recovery. The team's vision centers on building capabilities that deliver intuitive grading experiences for Associates and efficient results for Operators, with complete end-to-end visibility.

RLOI addresses top customer pain points through site visits, data analysis, and direct surveys, focusing on process standardization, improved dashboards, grading simplification, and inventory flow visibility.
