jobs.description:
Application deadline: Oct 14, 2026

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world leader in providing a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud powering hundreds of thousands of businesses in hundreds of countries around the world. As part of the AWS Infrastructure organization, Data Center Planning and Delivery (DCPD) prepares for, plans, and builds the data centers that comprise the AWS cloud.

Dedicated Infrastructure Planning and Delivery are the team responsible for the delivery of physical data center infrastructure to serve government customers. Our team has a diverse background including commercial, prior military service and former government experience. Our team is split between the Seattle Metro and the DMV area and we manage projects across the US, while interfacing with our peers overseas.

We’re seeking an experienced Technical Infrastructure Program Manager in Denver CO, Herndon or Arlington VA, or Seattle WA, to oversee data center infrastructure expansion projects in support of U.S. Government customers. The Technical Infrastructure Program Manager will lead cross-functional and technical teams from conceptual design feasibility through requirements, budget, completed design, implementation, testing, and deployment. Along the way, they will use judgment, negotiation skills, ability to influence without authority, analytical talent, technical aptitude, and leadership to collaborate with a diverse set of stakeholders across multiple time zones, manage capital budgets, eliminate non-value-add activity, design solutions, remove blockers, and find creative ways to accelerate project delivery.

At Amazon, along with technical strength, we expect our leaders to interact with internal and external customers, partners and suppliers to understand our joint business goals and priorities, and to execute rapidly, delivering high-quality functionality.

The ideal candidate will be an exceptionally strong communicator, both written and verbally, and possess experience in tactical project management of highly technical initiatives. Calibrated judgment, negotiation skills, ability to influence without authority, analytical talent and leadership is a must, along with the capacity to thrive and succeed in an entrepreneurial and fast-paced environment. Experience in managing data center infrastructure deployments is a plus. Candidates possessing a Bachelor's degree in architecture/design, mechanical/electrical engineering, software/network engineering, data center infrastructure/operations, and/or construction management, who have transitioned to a program management discipline will have a distinct advantage.

The Technical Infrastructure Program Manager will be fully competent in a variety of project management tools, methodologies and techniques for all phases of the project lifecycle and exhibit demonstrated experience in core project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, resources, quality and risk management, reporting and metric development/tracking. Other requirements include experience with MS Office, MS Project and MS SharePoint. Experience with Tableau, KanBan, Playbook, SQL and systems integration a plus.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance.

If you meet these qualifications, exude passion, and enjoy the challenges of deploying highly technical and innovative projects at massive scale, this job is for you!

Key job responsibilities
Technical Infrastructure Program Managers lead a matrixed team through influence in the execution of data center capacity projects. They are mindful of cost, schedule, and quality during all aspects of their builds. They look around corners to identify risks early and are quick to take action. They effectively balance ownership and holding partner teams to high standards of responsibility. They stand ready to leverage their technical and project-focused backgrounds to deep dive issues and develop mitigations to minimize impact. They strive to ensure data center capacity is delivered ahead of customer demand.

A day in the life
There is no typical day in the life of a Technical Infrastructure Program Manager. On one day, they may review demand forecasts for their assigned region to ensure that future builds are triggered on time. They may ensure that design reviews are effectively conducted. They may deep dive a material delivery issue that threatens their project schedule or resolve a technical challenge uncovered through execution. They work both in corporate offices and on the job site depending on the state of their projects.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

jobs.title: Sr. Construction Program Manager, Worldwide Grocery Stores - Growth & Development
jobs.description:
Amazon's Worldwide Grocery Stores, Growth & Development team is seeking a Sr. Construction Program Manager, a leader who combines deep construction industry expertise with the strategic vision and operational rigor needed to build scalable programs from the ground up. This is a program-focused role, not a Construction Project Manager position. You'll design governance frameworks, formalize what doesn't exist, fix what's broken at a systemic level, and equip hundreds of team members to do their jobs more effectively through disciplined Procore adoption, structured training, and scalable SOPs.

As our portfolio scales, information must flow end-to-end with minimal manual intervention, and every team member from Design to Construction Project Managers to Store Operations must be appropriately equipped to operate within governed, consistent processes. You will own that outcome - not by managing individual projects, but by designing, governing, and continuously improving the systems, standards, and tools that construction teams operate within so that our team can successfully execute individual project outcomes.

Key job responsibilities
This role spans construction program strategy, platform governance, and organizational enablement across a portfolio of more than 600 active pipeline projects and growing. Core responsibilities include:
- Develop and govern company policy, construction standards, and the Whole Foods Market (WFM) standard construction specification book.
- Own end-to-end Procore process governance for execution teams (RFI, Submittals, Bidding Tool, and PCO/CCO workflows) and ensure information flows seamlessly across the construction lifecycle.
- Advocate for system enhancements, integrations, and functionality improvements that drive scalability as the portfolio grows.
- Govern value engineering review processes and cost governance frameworks across the construction portfolio.
- Partner with Strategic Category Management and Vendor Management on GC performance assessment and scorecard frameworks.
- Develop and govern permitting and entitlements coordination frameworks across multiple jurisdictions.
- Define milestone frameworks and scheduling standards that Construction Operations Groups operate within.
- Build and deliver role-based training curricula, SOP libraries, and change management programs for Procore and Coupa adoption.
- Identify AI and automation opportunities within construction workflows and develop roadmaps in partnership with the LSA Product Management team.

A day in the life
No two days look exactly the same. You start your morning reviewing Procore compliance dashboards, flagging a pattern in stalled submittals (a process gap, not a project problem) for leadership. Mid-morning, you're presenting a business case for a Bidding Tool integration to a Procore Steering Committee. After lunch, you're facilitating cross-functional alignment across Pipeline, Indirect Procurement, and Construction teams. Late afternoon, you're delivering a Procore onboarding session using a curriculum you built. By end of week, you've advanced two SOPs, submitted enhancement requests, and documented a training gap to close next quarter.

About the team
Amazon's Worldwide Retail Grocery Development (WWRGD) team manages the full lifecycle of Amazon and Whole Foods Market grocery retail and industrial facilities — from pre-lease due diligence through construction delivery, facilities maintenance, and decommissioning. With more than 600 active sites, 100+ active pipeline locations, and a portfolio scaling toward 2,000+ active projects, we operate at the intersection of construction, technology, and organizational scale. Our mission is to deliver best-in-class facilities faster, at best value, and with greater consistency across every site we build and maintain.

- Bachelor's degree
- 7+ years of project management, real estate development, architecture/design experience
- Experience in construction, or experience developing MOPs and SWMS for planned works
- Demonstrated Procore expertise across RFI, Submittals, Bidding, Change Management, and PCO/CCO financial workflow modules
- Experience developing and governing permitting, entitlements, and regulatory compliance frameworks across multiple jurisdictions
- Proficiency in data analysis and reporting with ability to translate construction program data into executive-facing insights (PowerBI or equivalent)
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience developing and implementing training programs
- Project Management Professional (PMP) certification, or experience in project, program or product management with focus on technical education programs
- Experience using managed ML/AI solutions
- Experience in grocery retail, food service, or temperature-controlled facility construction environments

jobs.title: Sr Program Manager, IB & Replenishment, S&OP
jobs.description:
Sr Program Manager, Replenishment & Inventory

Are you excited to drive high-visibility, strategic supply chain solutions in a fast-growing market? MX Supply Chain is looking for a Sr Program Manager, Replenishment & Inventory who will lead the launch and sustained operation of new fulfillment programs while continuously optimizing inventory flow across the network. This role sits within the S&OP and Inbound team, working at the intersection of planning, execution, and cross-functional coordination to deliver speed and reliability for our customers.

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Amazon is one of the most recognizable brand names in the world and we distribute millions of products each year to our loyal customers. Our Operations environment presents candidates with great challenges in dealing with front-line management and driving scalable, continuous improvements across our Fulfillment Centers, Supply Chain, and Transportation execution teams.

As a Sr Program Manager, you will own the end-to-end planning and execution of new same-day and speed-focused fulfillment programs, including network readiness, replenishment logic, inventory positioning, and re-stock strategies. You will define and drive the operational model from concept through steady-state, partnering with Retail, Operations, Transportation, Finance, and Technology teams to ensure seamless integration into the existing supply chain.

## Key Job Responsibilities

- Own the launch plan and operational readiness for new speed-focused fulfillment programs within the MX network, coordinating milestones across multiple stakeholders
- Design and implement replenishment and re-stock frameworks that optimize inventory availability, placement accuracy, and fill rates across fulfillment nodes
- Develop inventory transfer strategies (reactive, proactive, and automated) to balance network health and meet customer promise
- Build and maintain capacity models, demand signals, and inventory health dashboards to inform weekly and daily planning decisions
- Partner with Retail, FBA, and business teams to translate demand plans into actionable inbound and replenishment schedules
- Drive the S&OP cadence for assigned programs, ensuring alignment between demand forecasts, storage capacity, and operational execution
- Identify risks, define mitigation plans, and escalate blockers with data-backed recommendations to leadership
- Write high-quality documents (business cases, SOPs, post-launch reviews) that inform, align, and drive decisions across the organization
- Continuously improve planning processes by automating manual workflows, reducing cycle times, and increasing forecast accuracy

## A Day in the Life

You start your day reviewing inventory health metrics and replenishment execution for your programs. You connect with operations and transportation teams to resolve inbound exceptions and adjust plans in real time. You spend time building or refining the operational model for upcoming program launches, writing documents that align stakeholders on timelines and trade-offs. You challenge assumptions in demand and capacity plans, propose alternatives backed by data, and drive alignment in cross-functional forums. When new challenges emerge, you take ownership, mobilize the right teams, and deliver solutions at pace.

Key job responsibilities
- Manage the short and medium term forecast, capacity and peak planning for the Amazon MX network
- Work in partnership with operations team to set optimal IB inventory plans, targets and choices to meet on-time delivery goals
- Define a near term vision and plan to deliver it driving continuous delivery customer experience improvement by collaborating with stakeholders on design of new solutions that enhance business performance and achieve established quality and efficiency goals
- Inspect demand forecasts, capacity plans critically and challenge assumptions from business teams
- Provide high quality inputs and garner alignment with finance and leadership teams using a combination of in-person meetings, well written data backed documents, detailed business models or presentations
- Identify and evaluate potential risks/obstacles within both internal and external business environment with minimal direction

A day in the life
You attend daily business reviews and understand whats happening to key network metrics. You spend time with strategy & ops teams to find ways to meet customer expectations. You write quality documents that seek to plan, inform & align internal stakeholders. You challenge the status quo and drive data based decision making within your team. Additionally, you are always ready to jump in and take charge when problems and challenges emerge.
Basic qualifications:
- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- 6+ years of working with external suppliers experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience in supply chain such as contracting, demand management and/or planning and procurement, and supply chain operations
- Knowledge of supply chain management concepts - forecasting, planning, sourcing, optimization and logistics or equivalent
- Experience with advanced use of SQL for data mining and business intelligence, or experience in financial modeling, P&L management or analysis
- Experience with retrofits, launches, or automation deployments, or experience leading cross-functional teams across engineering, operations, and field execution through launch readiness and go-live phases
- MBA, or Master's degree in supply chain management, operations, engineering, analytics or related field
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Spanish

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager, Brand Protections
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about protecting the world's most recognized brands and ensuring customers can shop with confidence on Amazon? Join the Intellectual Property Protections (IPP) team — the central hub for addressing complex brand protection challenges across Amazon's global marketplace.
The IPP team designs and builds high-performance systems leveraging machine learning and cross-functional collaboration to identify, prevent, and remediate intellectual property abuse on behalf of rights owners worldwide. As the single-threaded owner for end-to-end brand protection solutions, IPP ingests and prioritizes critical brand pain points, conducts comprehensive root cause analysis, develops sustainable mechanisms, and drives continuous improvement across Amazon's brand protection ecosystem.

We are seeking a strategic, experienced Senior Program Manager to own the strategy, execution, and cross-organizational integration for Band Protections — turning reactive enforcement into proactive, scalable prevention that directly reduces brand abuse for rights owners globally. In this role, you will:
• Develop and execute comprehensive strategies to address complex, high-ambiguity brand protection challenges with senior leadership visibility
• Lead cross-functional initiatives spanning Product, Engineering, Operations, Science, and Policy teams across multiple geographies
• Establish key mechanisms, dashboards, and self-service tooling that eliminate manual dependencies and enhance Amazon's brand protection capabilities
• Influence roadmap prioritization across multiple organizations, operating as a thought leader in the IP protection space
• Drive clear communication channels and strategic stakeholder engagement for both internal teams and external brand partners globally
• This is a high-impact, high-visibility role requiring exceptional judgment, the ability to shape strategy from scratch, and comfort operating in ambiguity. You will work across 5+ teams and multiple geographies, building solutions that protect millions of brands and strengthen the trustworthiness of Amazon's marketplace.

This is a global role requiring effective communication and understanding of the diverse needs of international brands, operational teams, and stakeholders across countries.

Key job responsibilities
1. Identify and resolve ambiguity across organizational boundaries — scoping problems, proposing solutions, and driving alignment where no playbook exists.
2. Analyze defects trends, policy gaps, and process inefficiencies to design scalable mechanisms that support evolving business needs
3. Author and present program updates to senior leadership, translating complex cross-org dependencies into crisp narratives and actionable decision points.
4. Manage competing priorities across regional teams, making trade-off recommendations and surfacing the right inputs for leadership decisions.
5. Own complex enforcement decisions in ambiguous, high-stakes situations, setting precedents that scale across geographies

About the team
The vision of Intellectual Property Protections (IPP) team is to ensure every Brand’s catalog (ASINs and offers) is clean with no IP infringements while minimizing friction for the Sellers. We do this by proactively identifying infringing content on ASINs and offers through various signals including Brand provided data, Seller behavior, Brand licensee relationships, Brand/Seller appeals, etc. We build highly transparent systems that communicate the impact of our protections clearly and unambiguously to the Brand Owner and earn their trust.

- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager - Decision Platform, Retail Business Services (RBS)
jobs.description:
We are building Amazon's first horizontal self-serve decisioning platform — an intelligence layer that upgrades static rule-based systems into outcome-learning, context-aware decision engines. The platform serves multiple tenants across multiple organizations and domains, each requiring structured onboarding, cross-org coordination, and production launch governance.
We are looking for a Program Manager to own tenant onboarding execution end-to-end — from first contact through production launch and steady-state operations. This role operates at the intersection of platform product, tenant engineering, and business stakeholders — orchestrating complex multi-party programs where each tenant brings a different tech stack, org structure, data readiness level, and decision type.

Key job responsibilities
Tenant Onboarding Execution
• Own the end-to-end onboarding lifecycle — contract → data readiness → prototyping → shadow mode → production launch.
• Manage parallel tracks across multiple tenants simultaneously at different stages.
• Drive timelines against committed milestones, identify blockers early, and escalate decisively across cross-org dependencies.
Cross-Org Stakeholder Management
• Navigate multi-persona commitment structures (builder, system owner, sponsor) across organizational boundaries.
• Coordinate across platform engineering, applied science, BA/RA teams, and tenant-side engineering.
• Serve as the single-threaded owner tenant leadership engages with throughout onboarding.
Process Design & Operational Excellence
• Design and iterate on scalable onboarding processes — playbooks, health dashboards, RACI matrices, milestone trackers.
• Drive process improvements as the platform moves from bespoke onboarding to self-serve at scale.
Data Readiness & Pre-flight
• Drive data readiness (the #1 time sink) by providing clear requirements, checklists, and embedded support.
• Coordinate pre-flight validation: data quality gates, signal checks, and integration testing.
• Ensure contract commitments are met before prototype begins.
Governance & Launch Readiness
• Coordinate shadow mode, launch readiness reviews (circuit breakers, fail-safes, RACI sign-off), and transition to steady-state operations with support handoff and monitoring.
Pipeline & Reporting
• Maintain full pipeline visibility. Report program health with actionable metrics: onboarding velocity, time-to-production, blocker resolution.
• Partner with GTM to convert qualified demand into onboarding-ready tenants.

About the team
We operate at the intersection of product, science, and GTM — building a platform that connects decision systems across Amazon so that one signal makes all of them smarter. The platform is live with founding tenants, scaling to broad GA, and building pipeline for pan-Amazon adoption. This role is critical to ensuring that every tenant that enters the funnel moves through onboarding with velocity, quality, and trust.
You will work directly with platform leadership, applied science, engineering, BA/RAs, and tenant-side stakeholders to drive the operational machinery that turns platform readiness into production impact — one tenant at a time, then many in parallel.
Basic qualifications:
- 5+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
- 5+ years in program management, technical program management, or platform operations roles
- Experience managing multi-party programs with cross-organizational dependencies and competing priorities
- Demonstrated ability to drive programs in environments with ambiguity — where processes don't exist yet and must be built while executing
- Strong stakeholder management skills — comfortable holding senior leaders accountable to commitments and escalating decisively when programs are at risk
- Track record of managing parallel workstreams (5+ concurrent programs) with clear milestone tracking and proactive risk management
- Excellent written communication — able to produce clear program documents, status reports, and playbooks that scale beyond the individual
Preferred qualifications:

- Familiarity with data platform or ML/AI product ecosystems — comfortable navigating conversations about data readiness, model validation, and production governance

- Experience with change management in multi-org environments — driving adoption where commitment requires budget, headcount, and cross-functional alignment

jobs.title: Deal and Contract Ops Manager, eero Business Operations
jobs.description:
We are hiring a Deal and Contract Operations Manager to join our Business Operations team in San Francisco. In this role, you will design and own the end-to-end deal and contracting processes mainly by supporting and training deal owners on contracting workflows, including operational ownership of our contracting tool, acting as the escalation point before deals get stuck, coordinating across internal approver teams such as Legal, Tax, and Finance to keep deals moving forward, and ensuring every signed partner has a smooth onboarding experience by involving the right stakeholders pre- and post-close.

Because you sit at the center of every deal, you will have a unique vantage point to spot what needs to be standardized, automated, or tooled across the deal lifecycle, and coordinate with the rest of the functions under Bizops (i.e. Sales Ops, Order Management, Business Systems etc.) to make it happen. You will use that perspective to build frameworks, drive process automation, and continuously reduce the time it takes to get from contract signing to customer onboarding, ensuring downstream teams like Partner Success, Order Management, and Logistics are engaged at the right time.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and maintain the end-to-end contract operations processes, from template selection support through approval alongside Legal so that deal owners (i.e. Business Development and Partner Success teams) can move deals through the process efficiently and with minimal friction.
- Project-manage deals from contract signing through customer onboarding, ensuring downstream teams (Partner Success, Order Management, RevOps, Logistics) are engaged at the right time prior to deal close, and that non-standard terms are highlighted and passed along to the correct stakeholders.
- Troubleshoot Contract Lifecycle Management (i.e.) workflow issues, advise on routing and approvals, and unblock bottlenecks so deal owners can keep momentum.
- Train and equip Business Development teams to be self-sufficient in the contracting process: how to create CLM workflows, select the right contract template and deal term configuration, route to the correct approvers, and anticipate approval requirements
- Ensure contract templates are properly created and maintained within the CLM system in adherence with the Amazon policy, and assist Business Development with escalating redlines to Legal and driving alignment on accepted terms.
- Use your centralized vantage point across all deals to spot patterns and identify what needs to be standardized, automated, or tooled, translating those insights into process improvements that make the entire deal lifecycle faster and more consistent.
- Lead process automation initiatives with the goal of decreasing contract throughput time and increasing deal signing velocity.
- Develop lightweight tooling and streamlined processes for higher-frequency, lower-complexity deals (e.g., direct Enterprise deals), including enabling 3P sales reps to independently handle NDAs and select contracting workflows on our behalf.
- Develop AI-based mechanisms to handle specialized deals with exception approvals for non-standard requests.
- Collaborate closely with Sales Ops and Order Management to feed process automation ideas and ensure the right tooling gets built to reduce manual effort across the deal-to-onboarding lifecycle.
- Continuously improve the onboarding experience for B2B customers by removing avoidable friction points, with decreasing time-to-onboard as a key success metric.

A day in the life
You might start your morning checking in on active deals in Contract Central, spotting one that's waiting on Tax approval and flagging to the BD owner how long that step usually takes. By midday, you could be helping a Business Development lead pick the right contract template and approval routing for a non-standard deal, or bringing Partner Success and Order Management in ahead of a signing so onboarding starts smoothly. Afternoons often involve working with Legal, Finance, and Sales Ops to clear a recurring bottleneck, followed by turning what you've seen across deals into a standard workflow or an automation idea. You will regularly train deal owners on contracting best practices and present recommendations to leaders on reducing time from signing to onboarding.

About the team
Our team keeps eero's partner deals and orders moving, from contract signing through delivery. As part of eero Business Operations, we work closely with Business Development, Partner Success, Legal, Finance, Order Management, and Logistics teams to build the processes and tools that help ISPs, Enterprise customers, and retail partners around the world get eero into their customers' homes and businesses. We value ownership, creative problem-solving, and using AI and automation to take manual work off our plates so we can focus on our partners. As we grow into new channels and regions, you will have the opportunity to shape how we scale deal and contract operations.
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
- Experience with sales CRM tools such as Salesforce or similar software
- Experience defining, refining and implementing sales processes, procedures and policies or equivalent
- Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
- Experience in verbal and written communication for executive level leaders
- 3+ years of experience in operations or program management that is GTM and business team facing.
- Working familiarity with contracts approval tools, like Amazon’s Contract Central, or the like
- Hands-on experience in ushering deals from contracts signing through successful onboarding by involving the right stakeholders at the right time.
- Experience translating legal, tax and finance requirements into operational guidance for business teams, and speeding up deal approval processes.
Preferred qualifications:
- 5+ years of finance, business management and sales operations experience
- Experience managing multiple internal stakeholders and advising cross-functional teams
- Knowledge of Amazon approval policies and experience writing Amazonian-style documents (6-pagers, narratives).

jobs.title: QAE II, Amazon Business Operations, Amazon Business Operations
jobs.description:
Amazon Business customers place orders that arrive by the pallet: a school district ordering 2,000 chairs, a contractor ordering 900 boxes of fasteners, a hospital restocking a floor. Amazon Business Operations builds the systems that get those orders sourced, consolidated and delivered on the date the customer asked for. When one of these orders goes wrong it does not just degrade a page: a dock appointment is missed, an operator recovers the order by hand, and an enterprise reconsiders how much of its spend comes to Amazon.
We are building a new engineering team in Hyderabad dedicated to bulk fulfilment, and this is its first quality engineering hire. There is no existing test practice to inherit. You will decide what good looks like for every service the team launches.

Key job responsibilities
As a Quality Assurance Engineer on this team, you will:
Own feature quality end to end: design test plans, execute test cases, run bug triage, coordinate with product and engineering stakeholders, and give release sign-off.
Build and maintain automated test coverage inside the team's framework so that regression testing does not grow with the codebase.
Test operator-facing tooling and machine learning assisted decision flows, where correctness means the recommendation a human acts on is right, not only that the service returned a response.
Validate integrations with Amazon supply chain and fulfilment systems, including the data correctness that inventory, transportation and delivery promises depend on.
Set the quality bar for a new team: definition of done, quality metrics, and production monitoring that catches problems before an operator does.
You will work directly with the engineers building the service, the product manager writing the requirements, and the Amazon Business Operations teams who use what you ship. If you want ownership of quality for a product line from its first commit, this is that role.

A day in the life
You will sit with the engineers building the service, not apart from them. A typical day mixes writing and running test cases for the feature in the current sprint, extending automated regression coverage in the team's framework, and triaging yesterday's defects with the SDE who owns the code. You will review requirements with the product manager before a story enters the sprint, so acceptance criteria are testable rather than aspirational. You will spend time with the Amazon Business Operations teams who use the tooling, because they will tell you which failures actually hurt. Before a release ships, your sign-off is the gate.

About the team
Amazon Business Operations builds the systems and processes behind business buying at Amazon, from quoting a large order to landing it on a customer's dock. This is a new engineering team inside it, dedicated to bulk fulfilment, and you are joining at the start. We work in small teams with direct ownership, we measure ourselves on what changed for the customer, and we expect engineers to argue about design in writing. Expect high autonomy, close contact with the operators and customers you build for, and problems that have not been solved anywhere in Amazon yet.

- 4+ years of quality assurance engineering experience
- Experience in automation testing
- Experience in manual testing
- Experience as QA lead on medium to large sized projects
- Experience developing high quality test plans, test designs, test strategies, and test execution
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience scripting or coding
- Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems
Preferred qualifications:

- Experience in penetration testing and exploitability-focused vulnerability assessment

jobs.description:
Amazon Global Corporate Communications (GCC) is looking for a Senior Program Manager to lead the data and AI systems that GCC's teams rely on. You'll build the shared foundation beneath GCC's work: making its data usable by AI, delivering the AI systems on top of it, and connecting the work across GCC and its partners.

jobs.title: Program Manager III, Amazon Cross Border, Amazon Cross Border
jobs.description:
The Amazon Cross-Border Seller Experience team is growing, and we are looking for a Program Manager III to own selection quality improvement across our global stores. In this role, you will start by building the data foundation — designing metrics, writing SQL queries, and creating dashboards that give the team clear visibility into selection throughput and item data quality. From there, you will use those insights to drive programs that remove barriers to cross-border selection growth and improve the customer shopping experience. You will partner with compliance, localization, catalog, product, and sales teams across multiple countries to align priorities and deliver measurable results. If you are someone who is comfortable with ambiguity, skilled at turning raw data into action, and excited to work on problems with global customer impact, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and build data pipelines, dashboards, and metrics using SQL, Excel, and AI tools to provide actionable visibility into selection throughput and item data quality across global stores.
- Partner with compliance, localization, catalog, and product teams across multiple countries to identify and remove barriers to selection growth, improving the speed and volume of selection onboarded.
- Drive programs to improve item data quality — titles, descriptions, attributes, and images — to directly impact product discoverability, conversion, and sales for customers worldwide.
- Coordinate with global stakeholders to align priorities, define roadmaps, and communicate progress through clear narratives and automated reporting for leadership audiences.
- Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and introduce scalable mechanisms that improve operational efficiency across the selection and sales funnel.

A day in the life
You start your morning pulling up your selection quality dashboards, checking for new trends or bottlenecks in the data. By mid-morning, you are on a call with compliance and localization partners in another country, working through a plan to unblock a batch of listings. After lunch, you write a summary of program progress and trade-off recommendations for a director review. Later, you dig into SQL to investigate a data quality issue a teammate flagged, then wrap up by updating your roadmap ahead of a stakeholder sync the next day.

About the team
The Amazon Cross-Border Seller Experience team helps sellers expand internationally and works to bring customers the broadest selection at the lowest price. We operate across geographies and functions to remove barriers to cross-border trade, making it easier for sellers to list, comply, and succeed in stores around the world. Our team is expanding, and this role offers global exposure — you will collaborate with teams across countries and gain visibility with leadership. As you grow, you will build strong analytical and written communication skills and take on increasingly strategic responsibilities.

- Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

jobs.description:
Amazon, a Fortune 500 company based in Seattle, Washington, is the global leader in e-commerce. Since Amazon started in 1995, we have significantly expanded our product offerings, international sites, and worldwide network of fulfillment and customer service centers.

It’s no secret that Amazon relies on its technology to deliver millions of packages every day to its customers – on time, with low cost. We build the complex software solutions that work across our vendors, warehouses and carriers to optimize both the time and cost of getting packages delivered. Our products and services already handle thousands of requests per second, make business decisions impacting billions of dollars a year, integrate with a network of small and large carriers worldwide, manage business rules for millions of unique products, and improve the ordering and delivery experience for millions of online shoppers.

We are looking for a Principal Program Manager to join our growing team in Amazon Shipping (SWA) organization! This position requires influencing across multiple teams, businesses, and senior leaders. The role requires a deep understanding of customer needs and thinking big about how we can make SWA experience for our shippers seamless and delightful. The ideal candidate is excited by product innovation, technology led business excellence, passionate about learning and should view every customer interaction as an opportunity to create an exceptional experience. You will need to be entrepreneurial, and work in a highly collaborative environment.

You have a track record of exceptional performance and love working in a dynamic, ambiguous, fast-paced environment in which managing multiple projects and priorities is the norm. You have expertise in managing programs that span multiple VP organizations, operating independently in highly ambiguous environments where both the problem and the solution are undefined. You are a strategic thinker who connects technical improvements to business outcomes.

You dive deep and like the complexity of systems but drive simple, innovative solutions for customer-facing experiences. You have excellent judgment and high standards. You are an articulate, persuasive communicator and a good writer. People trust and respect you and they like to work with you. You are eager to pioneer new experiences, putting the customer first and challenging conventional wisdom.

Key job responsibilities
We are seeking an innovative, intellectually curious, results-oriented Principal Program Manager to drive broad cross-organizational, cross-regional, critical programs and charter level portfolios in our organization. You should also have the ability to coach, and mentor individuals; build a strong cross-functional organization. Represent the technical organization and evangelize the work to senior leadership. Raise the bar on program management excellence, show thought leadership, and communicate well to different audiences.
• Collaborate and influence team members, product, engineering leaders and work with development teams and other business groups, and presenting projects to senior leadership on a regular basis. This includes building relationships and identifying with stakeholders across the organization.
• Compile, manage, and report on project and portfolio level metrics, post launch adoption, and be responsible for leading many high profile meetings to align on project requirements
• This position requires the ability to operate in ambiguous situations and think outside the box when our customers’ problems may not always have clear solutions. It also requires backbone to lead upward as it will drive program adoption with senior leadership and customers while demonstrating empathy in responding to evolving customer needs.

• Amplify impact by creating and optimizing critical mechanisms that enable teams to deliver independently

• Streamline processes and drive adoption of best practices across multiple organizations
• Use Generative AI for data analysis, generating insights on technical and business metrics, risks, dependencies and program status management

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager, Amazon LATAM Payments Trust
jobs.description:
Lead the fight against fraud and abuse across Amazon's Payments business in Latam. As Senior Program Manager for Payment Integrity, you'll own the strategy, roadmap, and team that protect millions of customers — and the business — from fraud, abuse, and bad debt across BR and LATAM.

You will act as the single-threaded owner for payment integrity in the region, leading a team of program and product managers and owning an ambitious Cost of Business Waste (CoBW) reduction target. You'll stay ahead of a fast-moving fraud and abuse landscape, translate it into a clear multi-year roadmap, extend proven prevention mechanisms to new financial products such as Amazon Credito, and partner deeply with engineering, risk, compliance, and finance teams. If you are energized by ambiguous, high-stakes problems where the mechanisms you build directly protect customers and the business, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead the Integrity / F&AP team: guide, coordinate and develop a team of program and product managers, set priorities, and own the operational drumbeat, incident response, and delivery bar for the pillar.
- Stay ahead of the fraud & abuse landscape — maintain deep, current knowledge of market solutions, industry mechanisms, and emerging fraud/abuse vectors (card fraud, concession/promo abuse, instrument and credential abuse), and bring that outside-in view into our roadmap.
- Define the strategy and roadmap — own the multi-year vision and prioritized roadmap for payment integrity across BR and LATAM, including fraud & abuse coverage for new products (e.g., Amazon Credito) and the extension of proven mechanisms across markets.
- Drive and track projects and metrics — oversee execution of in-flight initiatives (abuse-reduction programs, card-related and bad-debt initiatives), own the LATAM CoBW reduction target, and hold the team accountable to measurable input and output metrics.
- Report status to leadership — provide clear, data-driven updates on roadmap progress, CoBW performance, risks, and trade-offs to senior leadership through the established review cadence (MBR/QBR/OP).
- Partner cross-org — align and influence across engineering, RCS, BRP, BAP, Risk, Compliance, and Finance to unblock delivery and scale prevention mechanisms.

A day in the life
No two days look the same. You might start by reviewing the latest fraud metrics with your team, deciding where to double down and where to cut losses. Mid-morning, you pressure-test the design of a new abuse-prevention mechanism with engineering before it goes to build. In the afternoon, you align with Product and Risk on how a new product launch changes our fraud exposure and what coverage we need . You close by refining the roadmap and preparing a crisp update for leadership on progress against our CoBW target — moving fluidly between deep strategy and hands-on execution.

About the team
Amazon LATAM Payments Trust builds the compliance, identity, and fraud & abuse prevention mechanisms that create trust in payment transactions — letting millions of customers transact safely and enabling Amazon to scale new products in a dynamic payments markets. We own this end-to-end across the region, from setting strategy to shipping the mechanisms that run in production.

We are a small, senior, high-trust team with a lot of ownership and a strong bias for action. We think in mechanisms, not one-offs; we ground decisions in data; and we care about building things that last and replicate across markets.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Sales Operations, Fauna
jobs.description:
Fauna Robotics is seeking a Program Manager to build and run the operational backbone of our go-to-market. You'll own the mechanisms and cross-functional programs that move every customer smoothly from first inbound interest through quoting, contracting, onboarding, and fulfillment — coordinating across sales, product, and legal, with clean data at every step. This is a role for someone who can both run the process today and strategically design and scale the systems behind it.

Key job responsibilities
- Champion the customer experience — obsess over making the buying journey effortless, from first inquiry to delivery: quick responses, clear communication, and friction removed at every step.

- Design and automate a low-friction sales process — own the end-to-end buying journey as a program you continually improve. Standardize the repeatable steps and stand up the CRM, order management, tooling, and automation that scale it.

- Own the customer pipeline and reporting — triage inbound demand, track every opportunity from first contact through close, and maintain visibility on bookings, orders, and fulfillment status.

- Drive the deal lifecycle across teams — coordinate quotes, sales agreements, approvals, and hand-offs across Sales, Product, and Legal; partner with Legal to standardize contracting and IP-sharing.

- Manage onboarding in both directions — get Fauna approved as a vendor in customers' procurement systems, and shepherd new customers through post-purchase setup, delivery, and hand-off to support.

About the team
Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.
We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. 3P Strategy & Path Forward for WFM
•Lead the development of WFM's 3P seafood distributor strategy: defining what the right distributor model looks like across a 2–3 year horizon. •Assess current 3P distributor network against WFM's regional supply requirements: identify coverage gaps, redundancies, cost-to-serve inefficiencies, and capability constraints (e.g., cold-chain infrastructure, processing capacity, delivery frequency). Own the go-live process for new distributor relationships including cross-functional readiness (Procurement, IP, Store Ops, Finance).
•Identify and evaluate opportunities for strategic 3P partnerships: including exclusivity arrangements, co-investment in processing or logistics capacity, and multi-year supply commitments that create competitive advantage for WFM. Distributor Performance Management & Compliance

Prevent coordination failures that create downstream supply risk.

•Serve as the connective tissue between 3P distributors and WFM's internal functions of Procurement, Inventory Planning, Store Operations, Finance, and Legal. Ensure distributor commitments are operationally real and that internal teams have what they need to execute against them.

jobs.description:
Amazon Business Operations is building a new software development team focused on commercial delivery experience. Our charter covers bulk buying fulfillment for enterprise, and customizing deliveries for commercial addresses. We are looking for a Software Development Manager to build and lead a team of engineers in Hyderabad, own the technical roadmap for these workstreams, and ship the software that enables Amazon to successfully deliver large commercial volume. You will stand up a team from scratch, define the architecture for services spanning reactive procurement, full truckload delivery, last mile driver intelligence, and real-time delivery risk scoring. You will partner with product, science, operations, and existing delivery tech teams to integrate with foundational systems while delivering net-new capabilities. If you want to build a team and a product area from the ground up with a clear commercial mandate and measurable customer impact, this role offers that opportunity.

Key job responsibilities
- Build and lead a team of SDEs. Own hiring, onboarding, and ramping the team to delivery readiness. Define the team's engineering culture, code review standards, and deployment practices from day one.

- Own the technical roadmap for bulk buying fulfillment and OTR delivery quality for AB customers. Translate the 3-year product vision into a sequenced engineering plan with clear milestones.

- Design and own the architecture for services that integrate with existing Amazon systems including supply chain fulfillment platforms (CQE, TMSB, ABDN), last mile driver tools (Rabbit, AMZL routing), geospatial services, and ML inference endpoints. Make build-vs-integrate decisions for each component and ensure the team ships solutions that are operationally sound and maintainable.

- Partner with product management, data science, business intelligence, QA, and operations teams within AB Ops to align on priorities and delivery timelines. Coordinate with partner operations teams where AB-specific customizations will reside as away-team contributions, ensuring alignment on code ownership, testing, and deployment responsibilities.

- Coach and develop engineers across levels by setting clear expectations, providing regular feedback, and assigning ownership of features that stretch their skills. Establish operational excellence mechanisms including CI/CD pipelines, on-call processes, SLA monitoring, and data quality validations for the services your team owns.

A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing operational metrics and system health dashboards to stay connected to the details of what your team owns. From there, you might join a design review where you challenge assumptions and help the team arrive at a stronger technical approach. Later, you meet one-on-one with an engineer to discuss their career trajectory and align on development goals. In the afternoon, you collaborate with partner teams on an upcoming cross-team initiative, working through resource trade-offs and sequencing decisions before wrapping up by refining your team's quarterly roadmap.

About the team
AB Operations is the logistics partner for Amazon Business and owns the delivery experience for commercial customers. Our organization covers supply chain management, product management, data engineering, applied science, QA, and business intelligence, and we are now adding software development to take on new problems that will unlock a new tier of fulfillment for enterprise customers. The engineering work spans backend services, ML model deployment, driver-facing UX changes, and API integrations with 3P carriers. You will report to the AB Ops tech leadership and work alongside an established org that has a presence in 11 countries.

jobs.title: Program Manager Operations - Amazon Financial Services, Payments Business Operations
jobs.description:
Amazon Consumer Payments is looking for a high energy Program Manager to optimize operational processes of its consumer financial services business. These processes include customer inquiries, tax document generation, settlement reconciliation, invoice creation, exception handling and reporting.

You will inherit a documented process inventory, and you will own reducing the manual effort inside it. You will be measured on operator hours returned, cost removed and errors eliminated rather than on projects or programs launched.

This role specifies and drives execution and automation programs. You will decompose processes, decide what should be automated versus redesigned versus eliminated, write the requirements, and deploy automation and generative AI capability that already exists inside Amazon. You will partner with engineering to build what does not exist yet.

To succeed, you must be technically fluent without being an engineer. You baseline a process in hours and cost before touching it, and you can prove the delta afterward. You can read a data flow and write a requirement an engineering team can build from, and you can tell the difference between a step that genuinely needs human judgment and one that only looks like it does. And you are bothered by work a machine should be doing — you would rather ship a smaller fix this month than a perfect one next quarter.

Key job responsibilities
Maintain the process inventory and prioritize it by cost, risk and regulatory exposure; own the baseline of operator hours, cycle time and error rate against which progress is measured.
Own each prioritized process through to delivery, partnering with engineering, product, finance and tax to convert manual work into permanent system capability.
Design and document the SOPs, approval flows and audit trails that must survive once a manual step is removed, including Maker-Checker controls.
Drive adoption with the teams whose work changes, so that a new process is used rather than worked around.
Partner with operations and third-party management owners so process changes land without disrupting live customer operations or partner commitments.
Build the dashboards and reporting that make progress visible, and present results in monthly and quarterly business reviews.

We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

jobs.description:
Launch your career with Amazon by solving complex operational challenges that impact millions of customers worldwide. As an Operations Manager in our Pathways Program — designed for recent MBA or Master's grads ready to make an immediate impact — you'll lead cross-functional teams, manage people, processes, and technology, and drive continuous improvement across one of the most innovative operations environments globally. From Day 1, you'll work on real business challenges, optimizing operations, enhancing the customer experience, and implementing scalable solutions across our global network. This is your opportunity to develop strategic leadership capabilities while building expertise in one of the world's most complex operational environments.

PROGRAM OVERVIEW:
Pathways is Amazon's three-year Operations Leadership Development Program, designed to cultivate the next generation of senior operations leadership at Amazon. Participants will gain high visibility with senior executives while tackling challenging assignments across diverse sites, technologies, and geographies within our world-class operations network. Day to day, participants will collaborate with cross-functional teams to solve complex operational challenges, take on progressively greater responsibilities, and work on real business initiatives that directly impact our operations. Along the way, participants will learn from experienced leaders, participate in cohort-based learning sessions, and build a network of peers who will become their professional community throughout their career at Amazon. This program is designed to build global leadership capabilities and prepare participants for executive-level impact.

- Please note that this posting is for opportunities in Canada only. Ideal candidates are students or recent graduates of an MBA or Master's program in Canada. Students interested in US-based opportunities should apply directly that posting.
- This program is open to external candidates only; current Amazon employees are not eligible to apply. The role appears on Amazon's internal portal solely for employee referral purposes.
- Candidates should be currently enrolled in an MBA or Master's program, or have graduated from one within the past 24 months.
- This role is for Pathways positions at Amazon operations facilities across Canada. Successful candidates will work with their recruiter to be matched to a site prior to receiving an offer.
- Candidates who apply to multiple Amazon MBA roles will only be selected to interview for one.
- Annual Pathways cohorts start between January and July. This application is for opportunities with start dates in 2027.

WHAT TO EXPECT:
Pathways graduates may lead organizations of nearly 4,000 people, manage labor budgets exceeding $2.5 million per week, and oversee $1B+ in capital projects. Here's how the program gets you there:

Step 1: Area Manager - Hit the ground running by leading 50–100 associates on the front lines of one of Amazon's world-class fulfillment, sortation, or delivery centers. This is where you'll build your operational foundation — learning how to lead people and systems at scale.

Step 2: Operations Manager - Take on greater responsibility by leading and developing other managers. You'll drive process improvements and collaborate cross-functionally across your site, region, and network.

Step 3: Senior Operations Manager - Graduate from the program as a senior leader known for operational excellence. In this role, you'll lead through others to execute regional or network-level initiatives — whether that's launching a new business, leading a major project, or running an entire site.

- This is a demanding, hands-on role where hours may vary based on seasonal peaks and operational needs. Candidates should expect to work weekends, holidays, and/or overnight shifts, with overtime as needed.

- Partner with senior leadership to identify and solve complex business and operational challenges, thinking both strategically and tactically

The OPM coordinates planning, material management, site technical, and Contract Manufacturer (CM) resources to deliver factory readiness, production launch, and sustained operations on time and on budget. The OPM partners with Site Technical Managers and Sunnyvale Product Managers to plan new product introductions, and drives cross-functional execution with Engineering, Quality, Automation, and the CM across every phase of the program lifecycle.

Our Program Managers are able to quickly adapt strategies, plans and solutions in response to dynamic business requirements. Successful candidates are natural self-starters who possess the ability to design, develop and deploy innovative solutions to address operational challenges while driving these solutions to completion. This role requires both independent contribution as well as the ability to work within multi-disciplinary teams (internal operations, engineering, legal, finance, procurement, environmental/health/safety, etc.). This individual has strong communication skills, is organized and thrive in ambiguity.

The scope of role encompasses program management of capital expense (CAPEX) and/or operational expense (OPEX) projects within data center operations. The scope of projects will include but not be limited to the improvement of electrical, mechanical, fire detection, building improvements, vendor (partner) management, and cluster wide maintenance coordination. An understanding of these systems is necessary, as the individual will be expected to identify areas for improvement as well as act on data provided from other teams and organizations.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities
Manage requirements, budget, design, and implementation of assigned projects

Assess annual maintenance program requirements and build a rolling 18 month project forecast

Facilitate creation of SOWs with partner teams to be included in contract documents including RFQ/RFPs, change order controls, purchase orders, and invoicing.

Evaluate performance and work product of on-site partners and escalate issues through Amazon leadership.

Identify and communicate needs for design improvements.

Monitor and enforce project schedules and quality with, operational teams, cross functional amazon team members, and partners.

Lead and coordinate design and execution efforts between internal teams and outside partners including equipment specifications, material flow, process design, and site layout.

Evaluate project risks and issues and propose actionable resolutions.

Build strong working relationships with data center leadership teams across multiple sites as well as other internal stakeholders (operations, finance, safety, security, legal, procurement).

General knowledge of data center operations and facility management.

Track record for being detail-oriented with a demonstrated ability to self-motivate and follow-through on projects

Ability to follow accurate and complete support procedures, system documentation, and issue tracking entries.

Proactively and continually improve your level of knowledge about data center relevant technologies.

About the team
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Amazon Customer Excellence System（ACES）チームでは、First MileからLast Mileまでのオペレーションのプロセス改善を担うProcess Improvement Managerを募集しております。

**【役割と業務内容】**

ACESチームは、First Mile（フルフィルメントセンターやソートセンターなど）からLast Mile（デリバリーステーションなど）まで、end-to-endで倉庫内オペレーションの安全、品質、生産性を改善し、お客様の必要な時に商品を届けられる仕組みを構築し、カスタマーエクスペリエンスを高める役割を担っています。倉庫内オペレーションの効率を向上させるため、新規システムや仕組みの導入・改善プロジェクトを推進します。海外のAmazonで新規適用されたシステムや仕組みを日本の各拠点に適合させて導入・展開し、導入後はデータ分析と現場観察の両面から検証して改善します。また、倉庫内オペレーションの全工程を理解し、安全、品質、生産性の向上につながるアイテムを抽出して改善を進めます。改善は、オペレーションのデータや現場観察からムダを定量化し、優先度を決めてPDCAサイクルを回します。すべての拠点に改善施策を適用できるよう、スケーラビリティを考慮した上で標準化し、ネットワーク全体へ展開していきます。これらを、各拠点の管理者や関係者と協業しながら遂行していただきます。

本ポジションでは、業界を問わず、業務プロセスに課題があった場合に自ら課題解決ができる経験がある方を求めております。具体的には、システムから抽出したデータを用いて問題分析を行い、問題を特定するだけでなく、現場訪問などの事実に基づいて対策の推進や改善を、多くの関係者を巻き込みながら主導できる経験がある方を求めております。ACESチームでは、物流業界出身の方のみならず、製造業やコンサルタントなど多様なバックグラウンドのメンバーが活躍しています。勤務日の半分程度、出張も含めた現場での業務が発生します。

**【Team紹介】**

ACESチームは、プロセス設計・改善のスペシャリスト集団です。データ分析とLean（リーン）手法を用いて課題の根本原因を特定し、プロセスの仕組み自体を変えることで本質的な改善を実現します。対象は現場の作業改善だけにとどまらず、入荷計画、人員計画、シフト、要員配置など、倉庫内オペレーションのパフォーマンスに関わるすべての要素をスコープとしています。また、拠点間のベストプラクティス共有と標準化を通じて、ネットワーク全体の継続的な発展を支えています。

自チームの担当領域に閉じないことも特徴です。First MileからLast Mileまで、Amazonのビジネスおよびオペレーション全体が継続的に改善されるよう、事業全体に関わる課題に対しても積極的に関与し、部門横断的な仕組みを構築して改善を推進します。他部署がリードすべき内容であっても、状況やビジネスニーズに応じて自らプロジェクトをリードし、課題解決を加速させます。

チーム内には、役割の異なる3つのサブチームがあります。

**Productivity team**

Productivity(生産性) teamは、人員計画から入荷・仕分け・積み込み・出発までの倉庫内オペレーションの一連の工程を対象に、TPH（Throughput per Hour：1時間当たりの処理量を示す生産性指標）の改善をリードするプロセス改善のスペシャリストです。データ分析と現場観察を通じて、生産性を左右する主要な要因とプロセスを定量的に特定し、恒久的な改善を実現します。パフォーマンスが伸び悩む拠点への改善支援と、上位拠点のベストプラクティスの抽出・ネットワーク展開を担い、プロセスの仕組み自体を変更することで本質的な改善を実現します。また、プロセスへの深い知識を活かして現場が日々の改善に使える分析ツールを開発・提供し、改善効果の大きい領域へ優先順位を柔軟に組み替えながら、スピード感を持って改善を推進します。

**PI team**

PI team（Process Improvement）は、倉庫内オペレーションプロセスの専門家集団として、5ゲン主義を念頭にデータドリブンな分析とプロセス最適化を通じて、Japan Operationsネットワーク全体の継続的な生産性向上と持続可能な成長を実現します。First MileからLast Mileまでのオペレーションに関わるクロスファンクショナルなすべてのイニシアチブについてリードまたは支援を行い、プロセスに精通した深い知見の提供、Lean手法を用いた定量的評価、ムリ・ムラ・ムダが発生しない最適なプロセス設計と標準化を推進します。他部署のイニシアチブであっても、全体を俯瞰して軌道修正が必要な部分を判断し、必要な場合には自らリードを行います。標準が定着するよう現場に必要なサポートを実施し、ネットワーク展開まで責任を担います。さらに、プロセスに影響するすべてのイニシアチブを統合的に把握し、短期・中期・長期の視点で生産性向上の計画を立案し、事業リーダーシップと連携して合意形成を行うことで、持続的成長を支える戦略的ロードマップを作成します。

**Lean excellence team**

Lean excellence teamは、Lean Six Sigmaの知識を有するチームです。プロセスのムダやバラツキを統計的にデータ分析し、DMAIC（定義・測定・分析・改善・管理）による改善プロセスを実行するスキルを持っています。ネットワーク全体のカイゼン活動を計画・マネジメントし、DMAIC手法の浸透や問題解決能力の向上、Quick Winの積み重ねによるカイゼンにつなげます。現場から提出された改善提案をインパクトや難易度に基づいて選別する仕組みを構築・改善し、ネットワークへの展開を推進します。また、Lean PractitionerやSix Sigmaといったトレーニングの教材を整備し、ワークショップへの参画を通じて人材育成を支援するとともに、Kaizen of the YearやAwardといったカイゼン奨励の場を企画・実行することで、カイゼン文化の醸成を実現します。

**【Career path】**

ACESの最大の魅力は、海外（North America、EU）のデジタリゼーションの先端を走るAmazonのリソースを活用した、新たなビジネスモデル（物流領域）の構築をリードし、日本のマーケットに大きな影響を与える事が出来ることです。データ分析による課題の特定から、あるべきプロセスの設計、現場での実行、そして全国の拠点への標準展開など、分析と実行が分断されず、一人の担当者が一気通貫でリードできる環境は、大規模な物流ネットワークの中でも限られた組織だけが持つ特性です。

またACESは、単一拠点や単一機能に閉じることなく、First MileからLast Mileまで、日本全国のオペレーションネットワーク全体を俯瞰しながらプロジェクトを推進します。目の前の拠点にとって最適な答えと、ネットワーク全体にとって最適な答えは必ずしも一致しません。その差を見極め、局所最適ではなく全体最適の視点で意思決定する力が自然と鍛えられます。

さらに、First MileからLast Mileまでのオペレーションに関わるクロスファンクショナルなさまざまなプロジェクトに幅広く貢献するため、オペレーション改善のスキルに加えて、プロジェクトマネジメントを通じたビジネス視点と戦略的思考を身につけることができます。「実行するだけ」ではなく「なぜそれをやるのか」から自ら考え、多くの関係者を巻き込んで形にし切る経験は、プロセス改善の専門家としてだけでなく、将来事業やチームを率いるリーダーとしての成長にも直結します。

加えて本ポジションでは、海外の関係者との連携を通じて、先進的な業界動向、多様性のある考え方、改善のアプローチ手法、そして人的ネットワークを体得できる点も魅力です。各プロジェクトを通じて日本各地の拠点のメンバーと協業し、実際の倉庫内オペレーションや配送業務を観察することで、地域のお客様へのカスタマーエクスペリエンス向上を身近に感じることができます

(Eng)

At Amazon, we actively incorporate the latest AI and generative AI tools into our daily work. Because a culture of continuous learning is embedded at Amazon, resources are available for you to deepen your knowledge of AI at your own pace.

The Amazon Customer Excellence System (ACES) team is hiring a Process Improvement Manager to drive process improvement across our operations end to end, from first mile through last mile.

**Role and responsibilities**

The ACES team improves the safety, quality, and productivity of in-building operations end to end, from first mile sites such as fulfillment centers and sort centers through last mile sites such as delivery stations, building the mechanisms that ensure customers receive their orders when they need them and thereby elevating the customer experience. To raise the efficiency of in-building operations, we drive the introduction of new systems and mechanisms as well as improvement projects. We adapt systems and mechanisms newly deployed elsewhere in Amazon's global network to sites in Japan, lead their rollout, and then validate and refine them through both data analysis and on-site observation. With an end-to-end understanding of in-building operations, we identify the items that raise safety, quality, and productivity and drive improvement. We quantify waste from operational data and on-site observation, set priorities, and run improvement cycles. We standardize solutions with scalability in mind so they can be applied at every site, and scale them across the network. You will deliver this work in partnership with site leaders and stakeholders across the business.

We are looking for candidates who, in any industry, have taken the initiative to solve business process problems themselves. Specifically, experience not only analyzing data extracted from systems to identify problems, but also driving countermeasures and improvements based on facts gathered on site, leading the work while engaging many stakeholders. Our team includes members from manufacturing, consulting, and other backgrounds in addition to logistics. Approximately half of your working days will involve on-site work, including business travel.

**Team introduction**

The ACES team is a group of specialists in process design and improvement. We use data analysis and Lean methods to identify the root causes of problems and deliver fundamental improvement by changing the design of the process itself. Our scope extends beyond front-line task improvement to every factor that drives the performance of in-building operations, including inbound planning, labor planning, shift design, and associate deployment. Through best-practice sharing across sites and standardization, we support the continuous development of the entire network.

A defining characteristic of ACES is that we do not confine ourselves to our own remit. To ensure Amazon's business and operations improve continuously from first mile through last mile, we engage proactively with challenges across the business, building cross-functional mechanisms to drive improvement. Where the situation or business need calls for it, we lead projects ourselves even when another organization is the nominal owner, in order to accelerate problem solving.

The team consists of three sub-teams with distinct roles:

**Productivity team**

The Productivity team leads improvement of TPH (Throughput per Hour, the productivity metric for units processed per hour) across the end-to-end in-building flow, from labor planning through inbound, sortation, loading, and dispatch. Through data analysis and on-site observation, the team quantitatively identifies the key levers and processes that drive productivity and delivers durable improvement. It supports sites whose performance is lagging, extracts best practices from top-performing sites and scales them across the network, and achieves fundamental improvement by changing the mechanism of the process itself. Drawing on deep process knowledge, the team also develops and provides the deep-dive tools operations teams use for day-to-day improvement, dynamically reprioritizing toward the areas with the largest impact and moving with a strong bias for action.

**PI team**

The PI (Process Improvement) team is a group of experts in in-building operational processes who deliver continuous productivity gains and sustainable growth across the Japan Operations network through data-driven analysis and process optimization, grounded in going to the actual place to see the actual thing. The team leads or supports every cross-functional initiative spanning first mile through last mile operations, providing deep process expertise, quantitative evaluation using Lean methods, and optimal process design and standardization that eliminates overburden, unevenness, and waste. Even for initiatives owned by other organizations, the team takes a network-wide view to judge where course correction is needed and leads the work when necessary. It provides the support operations need for standards to take hold, and owns delivery through to network-wide rollout. The team also maintains an integrated view of every initiative affecting our processes, builds short-, mid-, and long-term productivity plans, and secures alignment with business leadership to create the strategic roadmap that underpins sustainable growth.

**Lean excellence team**

The Lean excellence team brings Lean Six Sigma expertise. Members statistically analyze waste and variation in processes and execute improvement through DMAIC (Define, Measure, Analyze, Improve, Control). The team plans and manages continuous improvement activity across the network, embedding the DMAIC methodology, raising problem-solving capability, and accumulating quick wins. It builds and refines the mechanism that screens improvement ideas submitted from the front line by impact and difficulty, and drives their rollout across the network. The team also prepares training materials such as Lean Practitioner and Six Sigma curricula and supports talent development through workshops, and fosters a culture of continuous improvement by designing and running recognition programs such as Kaizen of the Year and improvement awards.

**Career path**

What makes ACES most compelling is the opportunity to leverage Amazon's resources in North America and Europe, at the leading edge of digitalization, to lead the design of new logistics business models with significant impact on the Japanese market. From identifying problems through data analysis, to designing the process that should exist, to executing on the front line, to standardizing and deploying across sites nationwide: an environment where analysis and execution are not separated, and where a single owner can lead the work end to end, is something only a limited number of organizations in a logistics network of this scale can offer.

ACES is also not confined to a single site or a single function. We drive projects with a view across the entire nationwide operations network, from first mile through last mile. The answer that is optimal for the site in front of you is not always the answer that is optimal for the network. Discerning that gap naturally builds your ability to decide for the whole rather than the local optimum.

Because you will contribute to a wide range of cross-functional projects spanning first mile through last mile operations, you will develop business acumen and strategic thinking through project management, on top of your operational improvement skills. Starting from "why are we doing this" rather than simply executing, engaging many stakeholders, and carrying the work through to a finished result is experience that translates directly into growth not only as a process improvement expert, but as a future leader of a business or a team.

Working with international colleagues, you will also gain exposure to advanced industry trends, diverse ways of thinking, improvement approaches, and a broad professional network. Through each project you will collaborate with members at sites across Japan, and by observing actual in-building and delivery operations you will experience first-hand how our work improves the customer experience in local communities.

(Eng)

- Analyze data available across Amazon's network quantitatively and logically to develop a deep understanding of safety, quality, and productivity problems in in-building operations

- Visit sites to verify that the problems identified in the data match what is actually happening on the front line
