A day in the life
本ポジションは、実際の改善活動を各拠点のメンバーと連携をしながらリードしていくため、連携が必要な関連部署は多岐に渡ります。具体的には、

- 海外の同様の活動をしている組織との連携

- プロセス改善を実施するための現場拠点長および現場メンバーとの連携

カイゼン内容が広範囲に渡る場合は、データや事実に基づいた生産性向上およびコスト低減の予測を明確化した上で、関連部署を巻き込んだプロジェクト推進が必要になります。勤務日の半分程度は、出張も含めた各拠点での現場業務となります。

(Eng)

In this role you will lead improvement activities hand in hand with members at each site, so you will work across a wide range of partner functions, including:

- Counterpart organizations running similar activities in other regions

- Site leaders and front-line associates, to implement process improvements

When an improvement has broad reach, you will need to articulate the expected productivity gains and cost reductions based on data and facts, and then drive it as a project that brings the relevant functions along with you. Approximately half of your working days will be spent on site at our facilities, including business travel.

About the team
ACESチームでは、様々な業界からの出身者、多国籍なメンバーで構成されています。多様性の理解と心理的安全性を確保した業務環境の構築を推進しています。Weeklyで、AmazonのOur Leadership Principleについてのdiscussion、情報共有や問題解決を論理的に実践する方法の共有を通じて、日常的なコミュニケーションやリレーションシップの向上だけでなく、お互いの知識や知見を共有し、自己を高め合えるような組織作りにも注力しているチームです。

The ACES team is made up of members from a wide variety of industries and nationalities. We actively build a working environment grounded in respect for diversity and psychological safety. Every week we hold discussions on Amazon's Leadership Principles and share information as well as approaches to practicing logical problem solving. This strengthens not only day-to-day communication and working relationships, but also the way we share knowledge and expertise with each other, creating an organization where members raise their own and each other's capabilities.

jobs.title: Sr. Operations Manager
jobs.description:
The Sr. Operations Manager oversees all budgetary, people development, and operational objectives at the site. This role involves managing and leading a team of Operations and Area Managers, coaching and mentoring them to ensure performance objectives are met. The Sr. Operations Manager is also responsible for building and maintaining positive employee relations and developing leadership strength within the Fulfillment Center (FC). This position requires a strategic leader who can balance operational excellence with team development while driving results across all areas of the facility.

Responsibilities:
• Leads the development and implementation of quality improvement and process optimization initiatives, including Lean methodologies, to enhance operational efficiency within their functional area and enable the FC to consistently achieve and surpass business objectives.
• Responsible for overall performance of either Inbound or Outbound operation, including safety, quality and customer experience
• Sets and clarifies requirements and expectations for Operations and Area Managers. Measures performance, provides feedback, and holds Operations Managers accountable for their performance and the performance of their departments.
• Leverages Operations and Area Managers by sourcing and nurturing ideas, and rolling them into the creation of improvement plans for the functional area.
• Takes proactive steps to ensure that best practices are shared across all departments, shifts and among the network.
• Works closely with support staff (HR, Finance, Facilities, Safety, IT and other Sr. Operations Managers) to build and secure support and resources for projects and initiatives in their area, as well as providing needed support and resources for other staff initiatives.

Additional Job Elements:
• Lift and move totes up to 49 pounds each
• Regular bending, lifting, stretching and reaching both below the waist and above the head
• Walking around the FC with great frequency; FCs are over a quarter mile in length
• Continual standing and/or walking an average of 5 miles daily
• Ability to work in construction/distribution environments that may be noisy, unlit, unheated, not air-conditioned

jobs.title: Masters in Engineering OR MBA – Promotion 2026: Pathways Operations Manager (Leadership Accelerator Program)
jobs.description:
Launch your career with Amazon by solving complex operational challenges that impact millions of customers worldwide. As an Operations Manager in our Pathways Program, designed for recent MBA or Masters in Engineering grads ready to make an immediate impact, you'll lead cross-functional teams, manage people, processes, and technology, and drive continuous improvement across one of the most innovative operations environments globally.

From Day 1, you'll work on real business challenges, optimizing operations, enhancing the customer experience, and implementing scalable solutions across our global network. This is your opportunity to develop strategic leadership capabilities while building expertise in one of the world's most complex operational environments.

PROGRAM OVERVIEW:

Pathways is Amazon's three-year Operations Leadership Development Program, designed to cultivate the next generation of senior operations leadership at Amazon. Participants will gain high visibility with senior executives while tackling challenging assignments across diverse sites, technologies, and geographies within our world-class operations network.

Day to day, participants will collaborate with cross-functional teams to solve complex operational challenges, take on progressively greater responsibilities, and work on real business initiatives that directly impact our operations. Along the way, participants will learn from experienced leaders, participate in cohort-based learning sessions, and build a network of peers who will become their professional community throughout their career at Amazon.

This program is designed to build global leadership capabilities and prepare participants for executive-level impact.

This role is for Pathways positions at Amazon operations facilities across Spain. Successful candidates will work with their recruiter to be matched to a site prior to receiving an offer.

Candidates who apply to multiple Amazon MBA or Masters in Engineering roles will only be selected to interview for one.

WHAT TO EXPECT:

Step 1: Area Manager - Hit the ground running by leading 50–100 associates on the front lines of one of Amazon's world-class fulfillment, sortation, or delivery centers. This is where you'll build your operational foundation: learning how to lead people and systems at scale.

Step 2: Operations Manager - Take on greater responsibility by leading and developing other managers. You'll drive process improvements and collaborate cross-functionally across your site, region, and network.

Step 3: Senior Operations Manager - Graduate from the program as a senior leader known for operational excellence. In this role, you'll lead through others to execute regional or network-level initiatives, whether that's launching a new business, leading a major project, or running an entire site.

During the first three years, candidates should expect to work weekends, holidays, and/or overnight shifts.

BENEFITS:

Benefits can vary by location including but are not limited to:

A relocation package
An Amazon Discount Code
Family care benefits
Life insurance
Employee Assistance Program providing free confidential support encompassing mental health, life events, everyday living and financial matters
Medical Benefits abroad when embarking on international business travel
Employee Led Groups to build communities and bring employees together across the world (read more on https://www.aboutamazon.com/affinity-groups)

Key job responsibilities

jobs.description:
Launch your career with Amazon by solving complex operational challenges that impact millions of customers worldwide. As an Operations Manager in our Pathways Program, designed for recent MBA or Masters in Engineering grads ready to make an immediate impact, you'll lead cross-functional teams, manage people, processes, and technology, and drive continuous improvement across one of the most innovative operations environments globally.

From Day 1, you'll work on real business challenges, optimizing operations, enhancing the customer experience, and implementing scalable solutions across our global network. This is your opportunity to develop strategic leadership capabilities while building expertise in one of the world's most complex operational environments.

PROGRAM OVERVIEW:

Pathways is Amazon's three-year Operations Leadership Development Program, designed to cultivate the next generation of senior operations leadership at Amazon. Participants will gain high visibility with senior executives while tackling challenging assignments across diverse sites, technologies, and geographies within our world-class operations network.

Day to day, participants will collaborate with cross-functional teams to solve complex operational challenges, take on progressively greater responsibilities, and work on real business initiatives that directly impact our operations. Along the way, participants will learn from experienced leaders, participate in cohort-based learning sessions, and build a network of peers who will become their professional community throughout their career at Amazon.

This program is designed to build global leadership capabilities and prepare participants for executive-level impact.

Candidates who apply to multiple Amazon MBA OR Masters in Engineering roles will only be selected to interview for one.

Step 1: Area Manager - Hit the ground running by leading 50–100 associates on the front lines of one of Amazon's world-class fulfillment, sortation, or delivery centers. This is where you'll build your operational foundation: learning how to lead people and systems at scale.

Step 2: Operations Manager - Take on greater responsibility by leading and developing other managers. You'll drive process improvements and collaborate cross-functionally across your site, region, and network.

You will work at the intersection of infrastructure delivery, data engineering, and tooling while partnering with systems engineers, software development teams, Business Intelligence Engineers (BIE), operations leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate complex operational requirements into scalable, reliable systems. jobs.title: Sr. Tech Infra Program Manager, OIS NANO
jobs.description:
Operations Infrastructure Services (OIS) provides the technology infrastructure backbone of  every Amazon fulfillment site globally — and Quick Commerce is rewriting the rules of how that infrastructure gets built. This role will be the single threaded leader Quick commerce tech infrastructure for an entire country.

Quick Commerce demands a fundamentally different approach: frugal, vendor-managed infrastructure that launches at unprecedented velocity while maintaining enterprise-grade availability. As the country's single-threaded infrastructure owner, you will define the network and device strategy that enables Amazon to launch and operate hundreds of sites at speed and at a fraction of traditional cost. You will own the country-level technology roadmap, drive vendor relationships, govern availability and financial outcomes, and partner directly with senior business operations leadership. Quick Commerce is the fastest growth vector for Amazon Stores, and team NANO (Network and Assets for Nimble Operations) shapes its technology backbone.

Key job responsibilities
The NANO TIPM owns the country-level infrastructure strategy — defining architecture standards and readiness criteria against which all site launches execute. For network infrastructure, the TIPM owns end-to-end scope from vendor selection through SLA governance through financial outcome. For End-User Equipment (associate-facing devices such as scanners, workstations, and printers), the TIPM owns identification and recommendation while partnering with Device Tech for certification. The role's responsibilities fall into four themes — Theme 1 sets the framework, Theme 2 executes, Theme 3 governs, and Theme 4 feeds business needs back into Theme 1.

Theme 1 — Strategy, Vendor Management, and Contract Governance: Own the country's network technology roadmap, drive vendor selection end-to-end, and identify end user devices meeting regional cost and performance targets across all applicable site types.

Theme 2 — Site Launch and Network Deployment: Define playbooks, architecture standards, and deployment sequencing for the country, stepping in at escalation points where decisions carry fleet-wide implications beyond execution-level authority.

Theme 3 — Operations Excellence, Governance, and Financial Accountability: Own network availability outcomes, device fleet health, and financial performance across the country's fleet, driving vendor performance through structured governance cadences.

Theme 4 — Partnership with Business Operations Leadership: Translate the country's business growth priorities into infrastructure strategy, surfacing performance insights, capacity risks, and cost tradeoffs that inform decisions across the region.

A day in the life
You own the network and device technology infrastructure of Quick Commerce in India — the fastest growth vector for Amazon Stores. Your day moves between defining regional network strategy that scales from hundreds to thousands of sites, steering technology capability investments toward fleet-scale readiness, evaluating transitions that deliver cost reduction versus legacy models, and presenting infrastructure roadmaps to senior business operations leadership. You make architecture and vendor decisions that determine availability, cost trajectory, and launch velocity for an entire geography

About the team
The NANO (Network and Assets for Nimble Operations) team sits within Operations Infrastructure Services and exists to solve a singular challenge: enabling Amazon Operations to launch and operate thousands of small-footprint sites at speed, at scale, and at a fraction of traditional infrastructure cost. The team owns the full infrastructure lifecycle — network strategy, vendor contracts, site launches, incident management, and financial governance — across India, United States, Middle East, United Kingdom, and Japan. Quick Commerce dark stores represent the overwhelming majority of the use cases today, scaling from ~500 sites to 3,000+ by 2028, with the enablement model extending to every emerging no-capex site type in Amazon's portfolio.
Basic qualifications:
- 5+ years of program management or technical project management experience
- Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
- Knowledge of information technology infrastructure domains such as compute server platforms, storage server platforms, server components, network devices, technologies and architectures, IT service delivery principles and best practices
- Experience managing conflict, escalations, negotiating compromise, influencing others and problem solving with engineering teams
- Experience participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results, or experience communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience managing large-scale projects from end to end
Preferred qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a technology field

jobs.description:
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, innovative, and driven leaders. We are seeking an experienced and strategic leader to own the Business Operations function of our Customer Logistics Security (CLS) organization.

You will own the rhythm of business for CLS, ensuring the right information reaches the right people at the right time so leadership can make better decisions and teams can move quickly. As the Senior Program Manager of CLS Business Operations, you will serve as a strategic partner to the CLS Director and senior leadership, operating across sub-teams to shape organizational strategy and drive execution.

This role owns the development and delivery of short- and long-term business and financial goals, navigating ambiguity to create structure and clarity where none exists. You will manage the full lifecycle of complex, cross-functional initiatives, from problem definition through delivery and iteration, in environments where the business problem and solution may not yet be well-defined. This is a high-impact opportunity within Worldwide Operations, working directly with Directors, VPs, and cross-functional leaders to influence organizational priorities and resource allocation. The position reports directly to the Director, Customer Logistics Security.

Key job responsibilities
• Own the end-to-end business planning and operating cycles, establishing mechanisms and cadences that ensure sub-teams deliver against organizational commitments.
• Define program strategy (mission, vision, tenets) and set objectives that align with broader CLS and Worldwide Operations goals.
• Drive cohesion across sub-teams by creating visibility into current and future initiatives, identifying dependencies, and resolving conflicts in priorities and resources.
• Identify, evaluate, and drive new strategic partnership opportunities that expand the organization's impact across CLS and broader security functions.
• Identify and drive cost reduction and efficiency opportunities, quantifying impact and building the business case for resource reallocation.
• Own and drive the cadence of MBR/QBR mechanisms, defining the narrative, ensuring data integrity, and driving actionable outcomes after every review.
• Deliver data-driven insights and recommendations to senior leadership, translating operational metrics into strategic implications and clear recommended actions.
• Drive organizational communications programs, including all-hands meetings, newsletters, and internal updates, that keep teams informed, aligned, and connected to the CLS mission.
• Streamline or eliminate redundant processes; when you see a missing process, a broken handoff, or a reporting blind spot, take ownership of fixing it.
• Build and maintain dashboards and scorecards that give leadership clear visibility into organizational performance, tracking progress against goals, surfacing risks early, and ensuring data is accurate and actionable.
• Measure and communicate performance against organizational goals, surfacing risks and opportunities to senior leadership with recommended actions.
• Build mechanisms for continuous improvement, using data to identify patterns and drive systemic operational enhancements across the organization.

About the team
Customer Logistics Security (CLS) is responsible for protecting Amazon's customer logistics network, its people, technology, and its operations. We enable the Amazon worldwide operations, including Grocery and Prime Air to securely deliver at speed.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. ROADS is the centralized layer that protects reverse logistics performance across Ship with Amazon (SWA) and Counters Returns. We own real-time intervention, resolve escalations end to end, and — this is the part that matters — we build the mechanisms that make those interventions unnecessary.

• Own outcomes, not status decks.
• Launch, not inherit.
• Automate what you touch.
• Have real cross-functional influence.

Up to 10% travel may be required.

• Manage and oversee various cross-functional programs, ensuring successful delivery.
• Develop and refine program strategies, effectively leading and motivating teams.
• Set clear objectives for programs, leveraging data analytics to drive improvements and achieve metrics.

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager - POD, Pay on Delivery
jobs.description:
We are the cash people!

Cash / Pay on delivery is the largest instrument of choice by customers on Amazon.in (and in other similar emerging markets where we are expanding) – this despite the rapid advances in digital payments technology space. Customers continue to prefer Pay on Delivery (POD), not only because they want to pay by cash (indeed half of our COD customers pay digitally at doorstep!) – but because it solves many other needs for them – Building trust in the Amazon marketplace, peace of mind to only pay when the item is delivered, and not block money until then, ordering for friends and family who are not digitally savvy etc.

On the other hand, POD also has its down-sides: it leads to low-intent purchases, casual rejects and abuse from some customers, which impacts the sustainability of the instrument. Hence there is a need to continuously shape the POD offering, to make it available for the good customers, while reducing its access to the not-so-good customers, and make it an overall more sustainable business lever for Amazon.

Our mission is to make POD a sustainable and profitable payment instrument for Amazon's flywheel, enabling more and better POD access to all Amazon customers providing a first-class payment experience better or at least at par with prepaid instruments.
Our vision is to build POD into an APP that enables customers to pay using cash/ digitally at doorstep seamlessly, for physical goods as well as digital services on Amazon as well as external merchants, helping businesses to scale faster and sustainably.
We work on improving Customer experience and sustainability for POD – across onsite availability and experience, post-order payment experience, doorstep experience, refund experience and managing overall instrument P&L.

This role will own the management of the Cost-to-Serve for Pay on Delivery. You will need to identify and run interventions to reduce cost of offering POD - across reducing rejects, optimizing POD availability to spur growth, and managing POD 3P vendors.

The role will be also be the primary interface for both global and cross-functional, cross-departmental teams to conceptualize, execute, track and report progress on the program interventions - including Product, Machine Learning, Cost of Business Waste, Finance, Last Mile Operations, Shopping Experience and Technology.

Key job responsibilities
• Program interventions to reduce POD rejects: Research on why customers are rejecting on POD, build the right reject attribution to differentiate between customer controllable vs non-controllable rejects and run targeted interventions through Weblabs to reduce POD rejects
• GTM of POD Initiatives: Identify what would increase the adoption of POD Initiatives with customers, run GTM (Go-To-Market) plan, improve customer targeting and iterate through experiments to increase OPS/GMS while keeping POD Rejects in check
• POD PnL: Establish POD PnL and Identify opportunities to increase the bottom-line, increasing revenue and cutting down costs
• Vendor management - Work with POD 3P vendors to optimize the cost of POD operations, communication channels like SMS/ WhatsApp to reduce POD OpEx
• Cross-functional stakeholder management: Work with Cost of Business Waste, Category teams to identify drivers, opportunity areas for POD rejects, track actions through WBR/ MBRs

A day in the life
You start your day reviewing POD performance metrics on POD availability, POD share, POD rejects and POD overall P&L and costs.

Throughout the day, you collaborate with Product, Machine Learning, Cost of Business Waste, Category, Shopping Experience teams to refine customer segmentation models, meet with operations teams to optimize delivery processes, and analyze data to identify trends in customer payment preferences.

You will be required to ideate, research on customer needs/pain points, thoroughly analyze data, generate insights, develop proof of concepts, write compelling business cases and gain agreement from Leaders across levels & functions, to implement the solutions.
Basic qualifications:
- 5+ years of professional or military experience
- Experience influencing multiple stakeholders and leading cross functional teams across geographies and business units
- Experience working with technical and product stakeholders to define requirements, prioritize features, and influence product roadmaps
- Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience structuring and negotiating complex agreements and leading cross-functional groups to orchestrate and successfully complete deals
- Experience working in a fast-moving consumer business
- MBA

The successful candidate will combine strong analytical capabilities with quick commerce operational knowledge, demonstrating experience in fast-paced project environments and a track record of leveraging data to drive site selection and pipeline decisions. Building durable relationships across partner teams and proactively managing risk are just as critical as the analytical work — superior communication skills and the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders are crucial for success in this role.

By concentrating on these areas, the Program Manager will contribute to the ongoing success of our quick commerce expansion through:

• Developing and managing the site pipeline from identification through site selection and handoff, coordinating with multiple stakeholder teams across Real Estate, Operations, Technology, and Finance to source, evaluate, and qualify candidate sites.

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Job summary
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements in productivity and efficiency through data-driven decisions and analytical problem-solving. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

- Lead large-scope projects with site and regional impact

- Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Operations Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
- Experience managing a team of 2+ salaried employees and 70+ indirect employees

jobs.title: Enterprise Strategy & Ops Lead, Amazon Supply Chain Services
jobs.description:
Amazon Freight is a fast-growing business within Amazon Supply Chain Services (ASCS) that provides enterprise shippers with a full-service freight solution. Our Enterprise Account Management team owns the commercial relationships with some of the largest shippers in North America, managing a complex book of business that spans truckload, intermodal, and LTL.
We are looking for an Enterprise Strategic Initiatives Lead to serve as a force multiplier for our Enterprise organization. This role reports directly to the Head of Enterprise Account Management and sits embedded within the sales, account management, and customer success teams. This is an ownership role where you will identify the highest-leverage opportunities to improve our business, build the solutions, and drive outcomes end to end within our organization and across our partner organizations.
The right person for this role is equal parts strategist and operator. You will define new initiatives, build the frameworks, create the tools, and ensure our teams execute against them. You will work across every function that touches our enterprise business: sales, operations, pricing, finance, product, and technology. The work is highly ambiguous, changes frequently, and requires someone who thrives in complexity and moves fast without sacrificing quality.
This role is ideal for someone who wants to own a broad portfolio of high-impact work, operate with significant autonomy, and directly shape the trajectory of a business that is scaling rapidly. It is also a strong development path into a senior customer-facing role for candidates who want to build deep business acumen before taking on direct account ownership

Key job responsibilities
• Strategic Initiative Ownership: Identify, design, and drive end-to-end execution of initiatives that improve financial performance, operational efficiency, and sales effectiveness across the Enterprise book of business. You own the full lifecycle from opportunity identification through scaled implementation.
• Financial Performance: Develop and maintain inspection tools, reporting mechanisms, and analytical frameworks that enable the team to understand and improve margin, revenue, and cost outcomes. Build new approaches to financial visibility that allow leaders to make faster, better-informed decisions.
• Analytics, AI & Tooling: Design and implement new data collection methods, dashboards, and AI-driven solutions that give our teams an edge in managing financial outcomes. Partner with technology and data science teams to translate business needs into scalable tools.
• Process Design & Standard Work: Inspect current processes, define new expectations, and build the training and enablement materials to ensure teams execute at a high bar. Create audit mechanisms and goal structures that drive accountability and continuous improvement.
• Cross-Functional Influence: Work across sales, operations, pricing, finance, product, and technology to drive alignment and action on strategic priorities. Navigate ambiguity and competing priorities to deliver outcomes without direct authority.
• Cost Reduction & Margin Improvement: Identify and execute cost reduction opportunities that improve the economics of our enterprise business. Build business cases, quantify impact, and drive implementation with partner teams.
• Reporting & Communication: Build and own regular reporting cadences (flash reports, financial reviews, initiative updates) that give leadership clear visibility into business performance and initiative progress.

A day in the life
No two weeks look the same in this role, which is what makes it compelling. In a given week you might:
• Analyze P&L data to identify a margin erosion trend, then build a business case and action plan to address it with the pricing and operations teams.
• Design and roll out a new goal structure or audit mechanism to ensure account executives are driving the financial outcomes the business needs.
• Partner with data science or technology teams to build an AI-driven reporting tool that gives your sales team real-time visibility into cost drivers and financial performance.
• Develop and deliver training on a new standard work process you created, ensuring the team understands both the what and the why.
• Lead a cross-functional working group to solve a cost problem that spans operations, carrier management, and commercial teams.
• Build a new inspection or reporting cadence that allows leadership to identify underperforming areas of the business and take targeted action.
• Scope a new cost reduction initiative from scratch: define the opportunity, build the mechanism, pilot with a subset of accounts, measure results, and scale.
You will operate at the intersection of strategy and execution. The expectation is not just to identify what we should do, but to build it, ship it, and make sure it works. You will present regularly to senior leadership, influence teams across the organization, and own outcomes that are measured in dollars.
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience positioning and selling innovative solutions to new and existing customers and market segments
- Experience with sales CRM tools such as Salesforce or similar software
- Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
- Demonstrated ability to independently identify opportunities, build solutions, and drive outcomes end to end without close direction.
- Experience designing and implementing new processes, tools, or mechanisms that drove measurable business improvement.
Preferred qualifications:
- 5+ years of B2B or enterprise sales with a focus on hunting new business experience
- Knowledge of procurement and source to pay processes and solutions or equivalent experience
- Experience identifying trends and needs to improve an already closed large-scale technology deal
- Experience in transportation, logistics, freight brokerage, or supply chain.
- Experience building reporting tools, dashboards, or automated solutions using SQL, Python, or BI platforms.
- Familiarity with AI/ML applications in business operations or sales efficiency.

jobs.title: Data Center Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Manage a team that maintains cloud infrastructure for global data center operations!
AWS is looking for technology managers with experience in people management, strong technical understanding and the drive and vision to take AWS Data Center Operations to the next level. The successful candidate will have experience creating/devising strategies, mentoring people at all levels, sponsoring projects, and proposing technical solutions. This position involves leading teams in hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair and includes participation in an on-call rotation.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Effective May 15, 2017, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States)

Key job responsibilities
The successful candidate will be operationally responsible for a Data Center. Some high-level responsibilities include:

Prioritize and assign trouble tickets to data center technicians and operators
Manage the performance of a diverse team(s) of data center operation professionals with varying skills across different locations
Developing Career Paths for the employees and making updates in our internal tools.
Recruit and train data technicians to ensure appropriate staffing levels
Ensure effective and efficient management of day-to-day data center operations including queue management, 7/24 shift arrangement and hardware logistics
Fast learn or act as the subject matter expert across all aspects in data center operations
Ensure all operational KPIs and metrics are being measured and met
Inspire and guide improvement in team process, technology innovation and automation
Manage Large Scale Events (outages) and act as the call leader
Manage and improve the workflows and through-put for data centers operations
Recommend, document, and oversee policies and procedures to meet industry best practices and to meet required SLAs
Maintain the on-call schedule coordinating absence and vacations
Be passionate about the quality and quantity of services being provided, and continuously strive to improve our Customer Experience

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

A day in the life
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a fast paced technology company and a leader in the world of data centers. The position will help ensure overall availability and reliability to meet or exceed defined service levels of data center operations. We are currently expanding our infrastructure management team and are looking for technology managers with experience in people management, strong technical understanding and the drive and vision to take AWS Data Center Operations to the next level.

The successful candidate will have experience creating/devising strategies, mentoring people in all levels, sponsoring projects and proposing technical solutions. This position involves leading teams in hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair and includes participation in an on-call rotation. All candidates should be willing to work both independently and managing their teams effectively. Work prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful. In addition to strong knowledge in Data Centers, hardware and network repair, candidates will create documentation, innovate solutions, participate in site-level project work, and fix complex problems within the Data Center Space. This team works in an environment that operates 24/7.

About the team
About AWS

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, RBS Brand Experience (BX)
jobs.description:
Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMZN), a Fortune 500 company based in Seattle, opened on the World Wide Web in July 1995 and today offers Earth's Biggest Selection. Amazon.com, Inc. seeks to be Earth's most customer-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they might want to buy online, and endeavors to offer its customers the lowest possible prices. Today, we operate retail websites in nine countries, offering millions of products in more than 40 categories worldwide, and we still like to work hard, have fun and make history!

Retail Business Services (RBS) Brand Experience (BX) leverages technology to improve customer experience and selling partner experience while lowering Amazon’s cost structure. Vision of RBS is to accelerate Amazon’s flywheel by 1) improving the customer experience by fixing detail page catalog defects at scale, 2) improving selling partner listing quality to drive GMS and reducing fulfillment defects to drive profitability and 3) improving store operations efficiency by driving down cost of operations. We strive to eliminate the root cause of the defect and wherever not possible, we leverage machine learning to find and fix at scale or surface to selling partners. RBS has multiple programs/services aimed at reducing the listing friction, improving listing quality, reducing customer returns and improving star ratings of products that are dependent on selling partner support for effective execution.

As the Senior Program Manager, you will own the development and innovation of products and features to improve brand experience for WW brands. You will be expected to identify the brand requirements using primary & secondary research, gather business and systems requirements from internal and external stakeholders, propose and validate solutions, build proof-of-concepts, write specifications, drive roadmap from design to release, and manage the production launch. You will work with our internal/external product, business and technology teams to align on roadmap, prioritization, execution, navigating ambiguity and removing roadblocks while sustaining launch/expansion velocity. You will leverage your team to provide solutions that address peripheral needs (functional, legal, compliance). In addition, you will work closely on driving adoption of the product in your target segments, improving actionability of the insights you share through the initiative, and maintaining the quality of product features. You will own the reporting of metrics, and launches through business reviews at leadership level.

A successful candidate will be an exceptional strategic thinker and will have exposure to customer experience improvement. Key skills for the role include an extraordinary ability to deal with ambiguity, to network effectively and influence partner teams without authority, to overcome unforeseen obstacles, and a passion for developing a deep understanding of the tech product.

Responsibilities:
1. Build deep knowledge of RBS BX offerings, and business requirements.
2. Develop trust-based relationships with program’s key stakeholders.
3. Help define the program strategies, develop program roadmap, and organize work steams and milestones; gain buy-in and interlock across functional and regional leaders.
4. Manage timely and successful delivery of the program, working with program’s product owners and cross-functional teams to manage risks, and measure and report on progress. Gather and analyze data on launch performance results
5. Anticipate and resolve bottlenecks, manage escalations, balance trade-offs, and resolve complex execution and operational issues.
6. Build and deliver program’s operational and management reports. Use data and analytics to make day-to-day business decisions and achieve results
7. Work with global and regional teams to lead program’s adoption efforts. Hold regular business reviews with both internal and external partners
8. Define and manage to program KPIs. Use Voice of the Customer, experimentation, data analysis, to set global quality standards and specifications for all product media for Amazon
9. Present strategic program and user insights and recommendations to stakeholders and cross-functional team.
10. Provide ad-hoc support and analysis to senior leaders on strategy documents and research requests.

- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

jobs.title: Senior Security Program Manager , AWS DC Security
jobs.description:
Applicants must be Australian citizens and hold or be eligible to obtain an Australian Government Security Clearance, with the ability to successfully complete an Organisational Suitability Assessment. For more information visit www.agsva.gov.au.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) Infrastructure Physical Security is seeking a highly talented and motivated Senior Security Program Manager to join our team.

The role is responsible for overseeing physical security design and the installation of security features and systems including Access Control, Intrusion Detection, Camera Surveillance, Passive and Active Barriers, and other security features and capabilities consistent with AWS security standards and public sector requirements. This role will perform security program management in support of new data centers, support facilities, data center expansions, and special security programs and projects.

You will work on a small team of security specialists and will work directly with the Cluster Security Managers (CSMs), the Data Center Engineering Operations Team, and other customers, both internal and external, to integrate business and operations requirements into long-term physical security design and implementation. You will work independently to support the design and deployment of physical security packages and security program enhancements for AWS data centers and supporting facilities. Additionally, you will work across multiple organizations and serve as the subject matter expert to author security design, Concept of Operations (CONOPS), security installation and sustainment contracts, and other security documents. You will both lead and manage multiple projects simultaneously in the physical security program. You and your team will influence and manage vendor contracts to ensure industry leading systems are deployed and sustained.

The ideal candidate for the role has expertise is setting team goals, managing large contractor teams, and motivating peers to achieve program success. Additionally, this candidate has a deep understanding of Security Construction and Equipment Committee (SCEC) physical security requirements and leverages that expertise to make the right decisions for physical security projects and site sustainment. The candidate will handle a complex security and compliance program elements mitigating visible risks or roadblocks to drive timely decisions. The candidate will be comfortable defining program and industry requirements and negotiating resources to achieve priorities and find a path forward on difficult situations. Additionally, the candidate will work across multiple teams within an Amazon Security organization to influence both internal and external customers, system owners, and business leaders. The candidate will effectively communicate with stakeholder audiences across multiple teams and be able to run meetings to drive business and technical discussions and decisions. This candidate will represent AWS in engagements with the internal and external stakeholders to coordinate physical security approvals.

The role will involve some travel for project management and and hand-off of completed projects to local security operations teams.

Key job responsibilities
• Lead physical security design and system installation for new data centers, data center expansions and special projects.

• Provide physical security project lifecycle management including bid packages, specifications, drawings, code compliance, vendor management, budget, change orders, and close-out documentation.

• Manage vendor on-boarding, Request For Proposal / Request For Quote bidding, contracting, contract execution, QA/QC, and support processes.

• Effectively and accurately manage multi-million dollar security project budgets. Own and track the finance and budgeting process for security programs and projects.

• Representative for physical security team acceptance, sign-off, and operational readiness validation for high security facilities in conjunction with other AWS teams.

• Collaborate across teams to drive global, regional, and local security initiatives.

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Job summary
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements in productivity and efficiency through data-driven decisions and analytical problem-solving. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

- Lead large-scope projects with site and regional impact

- Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Operations Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

- 3+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
Preferred qualifications:
- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
- Experience managing a team of 2+ salaried employees and 70+ indirect employees
- Experience scoping, leading, and implementing process improvements through: Lean process, Kaizen, and/or Six Sigma.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager – PMO Lead, Hardware Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
Do you want to shape how Amazon builds its next generation of consumer devices — not by building one product, but by building the system that makes all products better? As the Program Management Office (PMO) Lead and steward of Amazon Devices Product Development Process (PDP) within the Hardware Strategy & Operations team, you will own the framework that every hardware program at Amazon Devices runs on. You will drive the evolution of how we develop devices — from the earliest customer-focused working backwards documents through production validation — ensuring that hundreds of engineers across disciplines and geographies have the clarity, tools, and process they need to deliver on time, at quality, and at scale.

Key job responsibilities
• Own the end-to-end Product Development Process (PDP) for Amazon Devices Hardware, including phase definitions, gate criteria, milestone templates, approver matrices, and associated tools — ensuring the process remains current, scalable, and aligned with how programs actually execute.
• Identify, scope, and lead strategic process improvement initiatives from proposal through implementation, partnering with cross-functional stakeholders across engineering, operations, finance, and product management to drive adoption and measure impact.
• Maintain and evolve the suite of PDP tools and templates — including milestone documents (Product Assessment, Business Requirements Document, Development Commit, xVT Readiness Reviews, Announce Risk Review, OK2Ship), checklists, and the Milestone Manager — to reduce friction and enable program teams to move with speed and confidence.
• Serve as the primary point of contact and subject matter expert for PDP across the Hardware organization, providing guidance to System TPMs and functional leads on process application, change management, and escalation paths.
• Drive cross-functional alignment on process changes, communicating updates clearly to stakeholders at all levels and ensuring the PDP Confluence space reflects the current state of the process at all times.

A day in the life
You start your day reviewing feedback from System Technical Program Managers (TPMs) across multiple device programs about friction points in the milestone review process. By mid-morning, you are in a working session with engineering, operations, and finance stakeholders to align on a proposed update to the approver matrix for the Development Commit gate 4. In the afternoon, you are driving a process improvement initiative — evaluating how the phase-gate methodology can better accommodate programs that blend hardware and software development. You close the day by updating the PDP Wiki page with revised templates and publishing a summary of approved process changes to the broader Hardware organization.
No two days look the same. You operate across teams and functions — partnering with Product Managers, System TPMs, Engineering leads, Operations Program Managers, and executive stakeholders — to keep the process current, practical, and effective 7. You are equally comfortable writing a detailed process specification and presenting a strategic recommendation to senior leadership.

About the team
The Hardware Strategy & Operations team sits at the center of Amazon Devices hardware development. Our mission is to enable the Hardware organization to build the right products, the right way, at the right time. We own the mechanisms, processes, and tools that the broader Hardware organization depends on to execute — from pre-concept through production and sustaining.

- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent
- Experience leading process improvement, systems development, and project management
- Experience managing and maintaining program management tools, templates, or governance frameworks used by large engineering organizations.
Preferred qualifications:

jobs.description:
Are you ready to shape the future of quick commerce in one of the world's fastest-growing delivery ecosystems? Amazon Flex is looking for a results-driven Program Manager to optimize capacity management across our Bengaluru dark store network. In this high-impact role, you'll solve complex operational challenges in real-time, working directly with delivery partners and station teams to ensure seamless last-mile delivery for our quick commerce customers.

This is not a desk job. You'll be at the forefront of operations—tracking capacity sufficiency across multiple dark stores, troubleshooting delivery performance issues on the ground, and building scalable solutions that directly impact customer experience. If you thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments where your decisions drive immediate results, this role offers an exceptional growth trajectory toward regional leadership in our expanding quick commerce business.

Key job responsibilities
- Manage and optimize delivery capacity planning across Bengaluru's dark store network by coordinating with fleet managers and team leads to ensure operational readiness, especially during peak volume periods including weekends
- Drive operational excellence by owning key performance metrics including Delivery Service Rate (DSR) and On-Time Performance (OTP+3), conducting root cause analysis at stations and implementing programmatic solutions
- Collaborate tactically with cross-functional stakeholders including operations teams, delivery partners, and station managers to rapidly deploy capacity and resolve bottlenecks that impact customer delivery experience
- Execute field-based problem solving through gemba walks and ride-alongs with delivery partners to identify systemic issues, understand ground realities, and develop data-driven action plans for performance improvement
- Monitor program performance using relevant tools and mechanisms, communicate status to stakeholders through regular reviews, and escalate critical issues appropriately while maintaining project timelines and minimizing operational disruption

A day in the life
Your day begins with analyzing capacity data across dark stores, identifying gaps, and engaging stakeholders to address shortfalls before they impact deliveries. You'll spend significant time in the field—visiting stations to investigate performance anomalies, conducting ride-alongs with delivery partners to understand their challenges firsthand, and running root cause analysis sessions with station teams. Between site visits, you'll coordinate with fleet managers on capacity deployment, track real-time operational metrics, and build scalable solutions to address recurring issues. This role demands agility as priorities shift with volume patterns and operational needs.

About the team
Amazon Flex serves as the preferred first-party delivery channel for Amazon Now, powering our quick commerce promise to customers. Our team operates at the intersection of innovation and execution, managing one of the most dynamic segments of Amazon's logistics network. We're building the future of ultra-fast delivery in India, and we need talented program managers who excel in ambiguous, fast-paced environments.

This high-visibility role offers exceptional learning opportunities as you work across operations, technology, and strategy. For the right candidate, this role provides a clear path to regional leadership positions as our quick commerce business continues its rapid expansion across India.

As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use.

Just Walk Out (JWO) Technology is a team of entrepreneurial, analytical, and creative builders with innovation at our core. Designed and custom-built by Amazonians, JWO operates with the speed and agility of a start-up while leveraging the scale of Amazon. We use computer vision, sensor fusion, and advanced machine learning to push the boundaries of what is possible in retail technology — enabling customers to shop in engaging, fast, and safe ways.

Our checkout-free shopping experience automatically detects when products are taken from or returned to shelves, maintaining a real-time virtual cart for each shopper. When a customer finishes shopping, they simply walk out. Shortly after, we charge their account and send a receipt — no lines, no checkout, no friction.

Key job responsibilities
1. People Management
• Manage the local support operation of the site
• Manage a team of Group Managers (L5) and Team Managers (L4)
• Responsible for the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of the reporting teams
• Carries out supervisory and management responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and procedures.

2. Operations and Project Management
• Work with the Country/Site Lead – Operations to determine strategy to achieve overall site/network level goals
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to innovate and iterate at pace
• Combine deep cross-functional business understanding with a long-term industry wide strategic context for all decision making. Effectively apply best practices to all strategic decisions.
• Solve complex challenges by proactively identifying and eliminating root cause barriers to accuracy, productivity, and quality.
• Maintain a complete and thorough understanding of technical systems in a complex CXQO business
• Participate in business leadership meetings, helping to develop and drive strategies and programs which improve the competitive position and profitability of the business
•Operate with ownership and bias for action in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment
• Maintain strict confidentiality and follow all applicable Amazon policies for securing confidential information.

3. Coaching
• Use coaching to support the teams to achieve business or organizational results related to quality, productivity, compliance, and development
• Coach and support Managers to build a work environment where Associates are engaged and feel a positive sense of achievement about their role in delivering world class service.
• Coach and develop Managers on career paths for internal promotions and job enrichment opportunities.
• Ensure closure and effectiveness of individual coaching feedback sessions, and one-on-ones that focus on customer experience and operational excellence

4. Performance Management
• Responsible for the overall performance and operational delivery of the teams, this will require to work with key stakeholders to review performance trends and opportunities and take action to improve the service level and quality of performance.
• Perform regular 1:1's with each of your Managers; promptly addressing any help required, performance or conduct concerns
• Ensure successful site execution through tracking, reporting and feedback of emerging issues and associate performance and coordinating the response to various escalations.
• Use established processes to identify individual performance gaps and coach associates to meet and exceed expectations.
• Actively participates and represents team members in the annual performance review cycle.

5. Develop Talent
• Manage the career growth and development of Group Managers/Team Managers by driving focus on Amazon’s Leadership Principles
• Hires, manages, and develops high performing teams

jobs.title: Operations Manager - II, Easyship
jobs.description:
Amazon.com strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience - Amazon.com continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform. Amazon's evolution from Web site to e-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of innovation that is part of the company's DNA. The world's brightest technology minds come to Amazon.com to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.

Amazon Operations

Amazon Worldwide Operations is the underlying fulfillment and customer service engine that ensures Amazon creates the same consistent, world-class customer experience every time. We are looking for high-potential, flexible, innovative, and forward-thinking professionals to join our India Operations team. Are you ready to drive high-visibility, strategic, revenue-generating projects as well as leverage Lean methodologies to lead Operational process improvement initiatives? Are you equally comfortable digging into business requirements as you are drilling into architecture and design with development teams?

We are looking for a creative and goal-oriented Operations Manager-II to join our team to harness the full potential of data-driven insights to make informed decisions, identify business opportunities and drive operational growth.
This role requires an individual with excellent analytical abilities, knowledge of business intelligence solutions, as well as business acumen and the ability to work with various tech/product teams across ES Operations and ES Business. Operations Manager will support the org by owning complex reporting and automating reporting solutions, and ultimately provide insights and drivers for decision making.

You must be a self-starter and be able to learn on the go. You should have excellent written and verbal communication skills to be able to work with business owners to develop and define key business questions, and to build data sets that answer those questions.
As a Operations Manager -II in the ES team, you will be responsible for analyzing petabytes of data to identify business trends and points of seller friction, and developing scalable solutions to enhance customer experience. You will work closely with internal stakeholders to define key performance indicators (KPIs), implement them into dashboards and reports, and present insights in a concise and effective manner. This role will involve collaborating with business and tech leaders and cross-functional teams to solve problems, create operational efficiencies, and deliver against high organizational standards. You should be able to apply a breadth of tools, data sources, and analytical techniques to answer a wide range of high-impact business questions and proactively uncover new insights that drive decision-making by senior leadership. As a key member of the ES team, you will continually raise the bar on both quality and performance. You will bring innovation, a strategic perspective, a passionate voice, and the ability to prioritize and execute on a fast-moving set of priorities, competitive pressures, and operational initiatives. There will be a steep learning curve, adding a fair amount of business skills to the individual.

Key job responsibilities
* Work closely with BIEs, Data Engineers, and Scientists in the team to collaborate effectively with product managers and create scalable solutions for business problems
* Create program goals and related metrics, track progress, and manage through obstacles to help the team achieve objectives
* Identify opportunities for improvement or automation in existing data processes and lead the changes using business acumen and data handling skills
* Ensure best practices on data integrity, design, testing, implementation, documentation, and knowledge sharing
* Contribute to seller operations strategy development based on data analysis
* Lead strategic projects to formalize and scale organizational processes
* Build and manage weekly, monthly, and quarterly business review metrics
* Build data reports and dashboards using SQL, Excel, and other tools to improve business efficiency across programs
* Provide solutions that drive the team's business decisions and highlight new opportunities
* Demonstrate proficiency in Generative AI, LLMs, data modeling, and applying basic statistical methods for difficult business problems
Basic qualifications:
- 2+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- We have a 5-day work week but given the 7 days a week operation, the 2 scheduled days off will vary based on shift patterns and business needs.
Preferred qualifications:
- 3+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience

jobs.title: Sales Operations Analyst, AWS Enterprise Support Strategy & Operations (ESSO)
jobs.description:

To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

AWS Enterprise Support Strategy & Operations (ESSO) is looking for a smart, experienced, and self-directed Sales Operations Analyst with a background working with sales and field organizations to provide visibility, insights, and operations which enable leaders to drive business performance, answer critical questions for decision making, run their business, and plan for the future. This position will be part of the team that leads Strategy and Operations for Strategic Industries and EMEA Business Development and Technical Account Manager field delivery teams.

The candidate in this position will play a foundational role in supporting the stakeholder business' strategy and operations through data analysis and operational reporting. The Sales Operations Analyst will focus on core operational activities including standard reporting, data analysis, and owning day-to-day inspection and execution of operational processes. The analyst will generate and maintain regular cadenced reports including weekly, monthly, and quarterly business metrics for leadership. A critical aspect of the role involves conducting deep dives into business data to answer specific questions that enable Sales Operations Leads and sales leaders to make informed strategic decisions, as well as contributing to rhythm of business activities such as Monthly Business Reviews, quarterly/annual planning cycles, and ad-hoc reporting requests. Other operational responsibilities could include but not be limited to territory management, headcount allocation and planning support, and goal setting, and support in developing and executing the operational strategy. This role has significant opportunity for learning and growth and has the potential for broad exposure across strategy and operations leadership and functional partners.

The ideal candidate for this role will have strong business and financial acumen, broad technical skills (e.g., SQL, Excel, and leveraging AI toolsets), strong analytical and critical thinking skills, have sales and marketing expertise, and must be very comfortable diving deep into data. This is a hands-on position - the ideal candidate must be willing to "roll up their sleeves." The candidate will need to be comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment and able to think big while paying careful attention to detail. The candidate must communicate effectively across both technical and non-technical teams, be a strong collaborator and partner, and work with stakeholders and peers to define requirements and drive delivery of analytical projects end to end.

jobs.title: Principal Program Manager , Selling Partner Trust
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Principal Program Manager to join Amazon's Account Integrity team — the front line of defense protecting sellers from account takeover and fraud. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role where you'll lead the Seller Account Takeover charter, driving risk analysis, executing roadmaps, and delivering customer-facing outcomes that directly safeguard the trust of millions of sellers on Amazon's marketplace.

This role is ideal for a builder and strategic operator who thrives in ambiguity, brings strong program management rigor, and can influence across engineering, machine learning, product, and operations teams. You'll zoom out to shape long-term strategy and zoom in to drive execution — earning trust quickly, influencing without authority, and making the teams around you more effective. You will directly manage and develop a small team of Program Managers, guiding their growth and ensuring program delivery excellence across the charter.

Key job responsibilities
Seller Account Takeover Program Leadership

- Own and drive the end-to-end Seller Account Takeover prevention charter, including risk identification, mitigation strategies, and measurable customer-facing outcomes
- Lead risk analysis and threat assessments to stay ahead of evolving bad actor tactics targeting seller accounts
- Define and execute program roadmaps that balance short-term operational needs with long-term strategic investments
Cross-Organizational Initiatives

- Partner with Machine Learning and Science teams on the latest Generative AI and detection tools to combat bad actors at scale
- Collaborate with Product teams to ensure long-term investments in account security are correctly prioritized and sequenced
- Work closely with Risk Mining Operations to identify emerging threats, close gaps, and continuously improve detection and response mechanisms
Operational Excellence

- Drive operational rhythm for the charter, including goal-setting cycles, business reviews, and leadership forums
- Streamline escalation processes and partner workflows to reduce friction and improve response times
- Build scalable mechanisms and frameworks that improve tool automation and operational efficiency
Communications & Visibility

- Author documents and narratives with up to L10 visibility, translating complex security and fraud topics into crisp, audience-appropriate communications
- Own internal and cross-org communications, including leadership updates, business reviews, and all-hands content
- Represent the Account Takeover charter across Amazon, ensuring consistent and compelling storytelling
People Management

- Directly manage and mentor Program Managers, setting clear goals, providing regular feedback, and supporting their career development
- Delegate program workstreams effectively, ensuring your PgMs have the context, tools, and support to deliver independently

A day in the life
No two days are the same on the Account Integrity team — and that's what makes this role exciting. You might start your morning reviewing a real customer anecdote where a seller's account was compromised, working backward from the incident to identify gaps and drive systemic fixes. By mid-morning, you're in a working session with the ML team evaluating the latest Generative AI model designed to detect and block bad actors before they strike.

After lunch, you're streamlining the escalations process — reducing the time it takes to resolve high-severity seller cases and ensuring the right teams are looped in at the right time. Later, you're drafting a document for an L10 business review, distilling complex risk data into a clear narrative that drives alignment on investment priorities. Before the day ends, you connect with Product to review the roadmap for long-term account security investments, and then check in with Risk Mining Operations on the latest automation improvements that are reducing manual toil and improving detection accuracy.

You also carve out time to manage and mentor experienced PgMs — reviewing their progress, unblocking issues, and helping them grow as program leaders.

Every day, you're operating at the intersection of strategy, technology, and operations — making real, measurable impact on the safety of Amazon's seller ecosystem.

About the team
The Account Integrity team is Amazon's shield against unauthorized access — we protect customers and sellers from account takeover and fraud at massive scale. We combine machine learning, operational excellence, and deep risk expertise to stay ahead of bad actors and safeguard the trust that powers Amazon's marketplace.
Basic qualifications:
- 7+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
- 7+ years of program or project management experience
- 7+ years of managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
- Experience owning program strategy and end to end delivery
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience delivering projects within scope, time, budget and quality
- Experience with tools/systems to analyze data including Excel, Access, SQL or other data management systems
