• Manage multiple concurrent engineering projects (electrical, automation, MHE) across the NA delivery station network, coordinating timelines and deliverables with external contractors

• Track project milestones and completion metrics; identify process gaps through root cause analysis and implement corrective actions that reduce rework and accelerate project delivery

• Own weekly organizational compliance reporting on a strict cadence; monitor metrics including training completion, invoice accuracy, and Correction of Error action item closure

• Administer engineering documentation platforms and develop SOPs that standardize processes across the network; drive document governance including version control, review cycles, and user enablement

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Supply Chain, Startup Execution, Operations, RME, and external contractors; facilitate status meetings and manage escalations from field engineers through senior leadership

A day in the life
No two days look alike in this role. You will move fluidly between analyzing performance data and building dashboards, facilitating cross-functional alignment meetings, and designing scalable process improvements that eliminate rework across the network. You balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution—architecting a new reporting mechanism one hour and removing barriers for field teams the next. We are customer-obsessed, data-driven, and never satisfied with the status quo. We capture lessons learned, incorporate them into our mechanisms, and raise the quality bar with each iteration. Our approach to growth is holistic—we continually learn, develop, and expand expertise across the organization, leveraging subject matter knowledge on a global scale. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

Key job responsibilities
プログラムマネージャーとして、デリバリーサイトでのパートナー運送会社のオペレーションメトリックス管理に責任を持ち、配送品質の向上、サービスの追加、安全の確保、法令順守の担保を実施すると同時にパートナーとの信頼関係を強化します。

- 新規配送パートナーとの信頼関係構築
- 配送サイト訪問を頻繁に行い配送現場の把握
- 配送パートナーをサポートして契約配送品質の実現
- 配送パートナーにとってアマゾン配送ビジネスの継続性（利益性）の実現
- ドライバーの安全と労働環境の向上およびモチベーション向上の施策実施
- サイト運営チームのサポート、チームのオペレーションターゲット到達、同時に配送パートナーやドライバーの声をオペレーションに反映
- 配送パートナーの課題解決調整
- 配送SOPや基準をパートナーに徹底
- 中長期的なカスタマーエクスピリエンスの達成サポート

As a Program Manager/Operations Manager, you will be responsible for managing operational metrics for partner carriers at delivery sites, improving delivery quality, adding services, ensuring safety, and ensuring regulatory compliance, while strengthening relationships of trust with partners.

- Building trusting relationships with new delivery partners
- Frequently visit delivery sites
- Support delivery partners to achieve contract delivery quality
- Achieving continuity (profitability) of Amazon delivery business for delivery partners
- Implement measures to improve driver safety, work environment, and motivation
- Support the site management team, reach the team's operational targets, and reflect the voices of delivery partners and drivers in operations
- Coordination to resolve issues with delivery partners
- Thorough delivery of SOP standards
- Support for achieving medium- to long-term customer experience
- Work on a flexible schedule/shift

A day in the life
1日は毎朝リモート前日の品質レビューから始まります。品質レビューは毎日に加えて、週例、月例で実施してネットワーク全体のレビューで報告します。
次に、ネットワーク拡張のために、トポロジーチームとのミーティングです。拡張エリアの決定をします。トポロジーチームがあなたのインプットに基づき最適なネットワークを設計してくれます。
日々のスムーズな運営、安全性の確保、UTR/OTRアソシエイトエクスペリエンスと顧客エクスペリエンスを担当していただきます。また、新しいドライバーとDSPのオンボーディングも担当していただきます。

Each day begins with a remote quality review from the previous day. Quality reviews are conducted daily, weekly, and monthly and are reported in network-wide reviews.
Next is a meeting with the topology team to expand the network. Decide on the expansion area. Our topology team will design the optimal network based on your input.
You will be resonsible for day to day smooth operations, ensuring safety, UTR/OTR associate experience and customer experience. You will also responsible for onboarding new drivers and DSPs.

About the team
我々はこれからあなたと一緒にチーム作りをしたいと思っています。目指すチームは、個々が独立した個性と能力を持ち職務のエクセレンスを目指しますが常に謙虚に周りから学び続けます。我々はカスタマーエクスペリエンスを貪欲に追及しますが、常にフェアで客観性を保ちます。我々は自由にオープンな討議しますが、常に相手への思いやりを持ち、性別、経験、国籍に頓着しません。我々は個々の仕事を尊重しますが、常にサポートの手を差し伸べる用意があり、「それは私の仕事ではありません」とは言いません。我々は仕事に対する情熱を持っていますが、家族やプライベートを大切にします。総じて、我々のチームは毎日一緒に働くのが楽しくなるチームです。

We would like to build a team with you. The team we aim to create is one in which each member has an independent personality and ability, and strives for excellence in their work, but is always humble and continues to learn from others. We are greedy for customer experience, but always remain fair and objective. We discuss freely and openly, but always with consideration for the other person, regardless of gender, experience, or nationality. We respect each person's work, but are always ready to lend a hand and never say, "That's not my job." We are passionate about our work, but also value our families and private lives. Overall, our team is a fun one to work with every day.
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Japanese
Preferred qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Excited about working in a diverse group and contributing to an inclusive culture

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Production Planning Team, Production Planning Team
jobs.description:
The Production Planning Team (JP-PPT) of the Amazon Japan Operation is looking for Program Managers. Amazon conducts business with “the richest product selection on the planet” and “being the company that values customers the most on the planet.” as mission. The customer experience provided by Amazon has the three pillars of product lineup, low price, and convenience, and we are expanding our business by realizing these customer experiences through continuous improvement activities and the creation of innovations. Amazon is looking for experienced people who can contribute to this business. FNP is a central team launched in 2021 to lead the rapid expansion of Amazon's logistics network. We have more than 100 locations, including the Fulfilment Center (FC) and External Fulfilment (EF), which are the cornerstones of the Operation business. We are continuously improving in terms of operation cost while we maintain the delivery speed and we lead the execution. The Program Manager for this position will be a member of the PPT (Production Planning Team) of the FNP team. In particular, the Program Manager will be required to provide strong leadership in FC labor planning and production planning.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

アマゾンジャパンオペレーションのプロダクションプランニングチーム（JP-PPT）では、プログラムマネージャーを募集しています。アマゾンは「地球上で最も豊富な品揃え」と「地球上で最もお客様を大切にする企業」をミッションに事業を展開しています。アマゾンが提供する顧客体験は、品揃え、低価格、利便性の3つを柱としており、これらの顧客体験を実現するための継続的な改善活動やイノベーションの創出を通じて事業を拡大しています。Amazonは、この事業に貢献できる経験豊富な人材を求めています。FNPは、Amazonの物流網の急速な拡大を牽引するために2021年に立ち上げられた中心的なチームです。オペレーション事業の要となるフルフィルメントセンター（FC）や外部フルフィルメント（EF）など、100を超える拠点を構えています。配送スピードを維持しながら、運用コストの面でも継続的に改善を行い、実行をリードしています。このポジションのプログラムマネージャーは、FNPチームのPPT（生産計画チーム）のメンバーとなります。特に、FCの労働計画と生産計画において、強力なリーダーシップを発揮することが求められます。

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

Key job responsibilities
[Important responsibilities of the program manager]
・Lead labor management for the entire JPFC Network
・Implement short-term production meetings
・Reduce operating costs for short-term (3 months), medium-term (6 months), and long-term (1-3 years) periods.

[プログラムマネージャーの責任]
・JPFC Network 全体のLabor Managementのリード
・短期生産会議の実施
・短期（3ヶ月）、中期（6ヶ月）、長期（1～3年）のそれぞれにおける運用コストの削減。

A day in the life
[Working style] ・Flextime ※ Standard working hours 8 hours/day and business hours is 9-18 (also consider personal circumstances). All business days are spent in the designated office or other company location.

[勤務形態] ・フレックスタイム制 ※標準労働時間帯は1日8時間、営業時間は9:00～18:00（個人の事情も考慮）。 原則すべての営業日で所定の拠点に出社。

About the team
This position works as a member of the PPT(Production Planning Team) within Amazon Japan. Our team is in charge of a wide range of tasks, from short to long-term ranges, so that we can operate our ever-expanding Operation Network more efficiently, and we are making improvements day by day so that we can deliver products with a rich selection of products, sufficient inventory volume, and quick delivery speed to our customers. Amazon aims to create a diverse and inclusive workplace. Amazon complies with the Equal Employment Opportunity Act. We provide equal recruitment and selection opportunities without discrimination based on race, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, disability, age, or other attributes.

このポジションは、Amazon JapanのPPT（プロダクションプランニングチーム）の一員として働きます。私たちのチームは、拡大を続けるオペレーションネットワークをより効率的に運用できるよう、短期から長期にわたる幅広い業務を担当しており、豊富な品揃え、十分な在庫量、迅速な配送スピードでお客様に商品をお届けできるよう、日々改善に取り組んでいます。Amazonは、多様性のある職場づくりを目指しています。Amazonは、雇用機会均等法を遵守しています。人種、出身国、性別、性的指向、障害、年齢、その他の属性に基づく差別をすることなく、平等な採用・選考機会を提供しています。

- Bachelor's degree or higher
- Business Level Japanese proficiency
- Conversational level English proficiency
- MS Excel advance level (data visualization using functions, Pivot Table, Power Query, VBA experience)
- Over 3 years of project management experience involving various challenges
- Over 3 years of process improvement experience using data/metrics
- 学士号以上
- 日本語: ビジネスレベル（問題点の特定、解決策の議論など複雑な会話ができる）

- さまざまな課題を含むプロジェクト管理経験3年以上
- データ/指標を使用したプロセス改善経験3年以上
Preferred qualifications:
- Business level English
- Experience reporting results to senior leadership on an ongoing basis
- Stakeholder management experience involving multiple and varied levels
- Basic SQL skills
- Be positive about contributing to an inclusive culture and working in a diverse group.
- ビジネスレベルの英語力
- 上級経営陣に継続的に結果を報告する経験
- さまざまなレベルの利害関係者を巻き込んだ管理経験

- 包括的な企業文化への貢献と多様なグループでの業務に前向きに取り組めること。

jobs.description:
External Fulfillment Program Manager Analytics is responsible to accelerate program success driving initiatives to accelerate Sellers adoption, track performance and guarantee the best mechanisms to run Seller Flex channel. This role will be responsible to manage data and support with insights and reports how to scale our business and measure channels performance.

Key job responsibilities
- Manage reports and track business metrics in a weekly basis
- Design and generate insights to track business and generate improvements insights
- Accelerate team performance with data simplification
Basic qualifications:
- Knowledge of data engineering pipelines, cloud solutions, ETL management, databases, visualizations and analytical platforms
- Knowledge of general AI tools
- Experience with database management systems

We operate at the intersection of category management, operations, and technology, building the mechanisms and guardrails that ensure each banner delivers a differentiated and complementary customer experience. Our work directly impacts millions of grocery customers and shapes how Amazon's grocery banners coexist and grow together.

This Sr Program Manager role will lead critical workstreams including selection analysis and optimization, banner assortment strategy, and selection governance across banners. The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented self-starter who thrives in ambiguity, can translate complex merchandising problems into structured program plans, and is energized by the pace of grocery retail. You will ensure end-to-end accountability for selection health, from initial strategy and category planning through ongoing optimization, leveraging shared metrics and dashboards across banners

The ideal candidate combines strong business and product sense with a solid understanding of technical concepts. You can think strategically, analyze data, influence without authority, and provide strong customer service support. You must thrive in an entrepreneurial environment and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities. High judgment, analytical talent, ability to influence, and exceptional communication skills are essential to success in this role.

Key job responsibilities
• Develop and execute location and format-driven selection strategies using competitor benchmarking, capacity inputs, sales analysis, and market data to inform market-specific selection across banners, both online and physical stores
• Drive automation and leverage AI Tools to simplify processes and improve operational efficiency
• Coordinate with cross-functional teams and communicate program updates with internal and external stakeholders, including leadership reviews
• Drive automation and leverage AI tools to simplify selection planning processes and improve operational efficiencies
• Collaborate with cross-functional partners to deliver results in an ambitious, fast-paced environment, working across many time zones

- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience with selection strategy, category management, or space planning
- Advanced Excel proficiency and experience with Microsoft Access or SQL
- 5+ years experience in business roles requiring data analysis, process improvements, creative problem solving, and cross-functional collaboration
- High attention to detail and proven ability to manage multiple, competing priorities simultaneously
- Excellent communication (verbal and written) and interpersonal skills with ability to effectively communicate with both business and technical teams
- Passionate and knowledgeable about customer behavior
Preferred qualifications:
- Familiarity with databases and SQL
- Experience leveraging automation and AI tools to streamline operational processes and improve efficiency
- Ability to analyze data quantitatively and use customer research, data and metrics to back up assumptions and identify opportunities

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager , Selling Partner Trust
jobs.description:
The Selling Partner Trust and Store Integrity's (TSI) vision is that bad actors cannot operate in our store while selling partners start and grow their business without fear of disruption, such that customers and selling partners across the globe trust us, and have confidence in the integrity of Amazon’s store. We value individual expression, respect different opinions, and work together to create a culture where each of us is able to contribute fully. Our unique backgrounds and perspectives strengthen our ability to achieve Amazon's mission of being Earth's most customer-centric company.

Lead key initiatives in Amazon's Account Health program supporting sellers, driving operational excellence through policy engagement frameworks, bad actor prevention systems, and seller experience innovations. Manage cross-functional partnerships with policy teams, compliance, and other partner organizations to improve seller experience and decrease unexpected account suspension. Develop and execute strategic initiatives that balance seller protection with customer trust. Drive data-driven decision making through advanced analytics, establish performance metrics and goals.

Key job responsibilities
As the Senior Program Manager for the Account Health Assurance Program, you will lead the development and implementation of a new seller remediation experience.
- You'll partner with policy teams and implement process improvements, driving cross-functional collaboration with legal, policy, and product stakeholders.
- You'll create mechanisms to efficiently identify and track improvement opportunities across multiple teams based on data and anecdotes, and measure the impact of these improvements for all sellers. You'll keep owners accountable to ETAs.
- Analyzing seller feedback and metrics to optimize appeal processes will be crucial, as will managing program strategy and metrics, communicating results to senior leadership.

About the team
You'll be joining a dynamic, mission-driven team focused on seller success and store integrity. Our team combines deep operational expertise with innovative problem-solving to create fair and transparent processes for sellers. We work closely with senior leadership and collaborate across policy, legal, product, and international teams to drive meaningful change in the seller experience. The team culture emphasizes data-driven decision making, intellectual curiosity, and a bias for action.

- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
Preferred qualifications:
- 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

jobs.title: Program Manager, S&OP
jobs.description:
We are hiring Program Managers to run complex and cross functional supply chain projects. This role is a part of the centralized supply chain planning function at Amazon India. The role is very much like an internal consulting role where the incumbent will drive large high impact projects in supply chain. These projects will typically involve designing and building complex new processes, driving technology solutions, driving large cost reduction or efficiency improvement initiatives or launching exciting new supply chain models.

The incumbent will be own the following -
1) They will be responsible for working with finance, supply chain execution, transportation and other Amazon teams to identify pain points and scope out large high impact projects
2) They will be responsible for driving cost benefit analysis and go/no-go decisions on various initiatives
3) Once a go decision is made, the program manager will work to evolve a plan and timeline for execution.
4) The program manager will develop a roadmap and metrics to measure progress of the initiative they own. They will also own writing reports/documents that detail the progress to leadership on a frequent basis
5) They will liaise across functions to drive their project and help clear issues and bottlenecks.
6) They will work with technology teams to scope out and drive any tech changes that are needed

Above all, we expect program managers to be single threaded owners for their initiatives. This is a high ownership position where you directly control your destiny.

Program Managers will be measured on the impact of their project. Depending on the project, clear financial or other impact goals will be set forth. It is the program manager's responsibility to ensure they drive the program towards achieving those goals.

jobs.title: Tax Compliance Program Manager, Tax and Account Compliance
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Tax Compliance Program Manager to support the First Line of Defense (1LoD) for EU/UK tax compliance across Amazon’s Marketplace business. In this role, you will execute against defined risk workstreams, support governance processes, and deliver control activities arising from EU and UK tax regulations. Working within established risk frameworks and under the guidance of senior programme leaders, you will contribute to ensuring the business operates within clearly defined risk appetite and compliance standards.

You will support the identification, assessment, and mitigation of tax compliance risks across Amazon’s Global Selling ecosystem. This includes executing operational controls aligned to EU/UK regulatory requirements, maintaining risk documentation, tracking programme deliverables, and escalating emerging risks through appropriate channels. You will monitor regulatory developments and assess their operational implications, contributing analysis that informs programme-level decisions.

Your focus will be on maintaining preventative controls, supporting data integrity across tax and identity systems, and producing audit-ready documentation. Working cross-functionally with Legal, Policy, Product, Tax, and Data Science partners, you will execute against programme plans, support the resolution of systemic issues, and contribute to risk-based control frameworks. You will ensure compliance activities within your workstreams are proportionate, risk-calibrated, and delivered on time and to the expected quality bar.

Key job responsibilities
• Own defined workstreams within EU and UK tax compliance programmes, delivering risk assessments and control activities on time and to quality standards

• Execute risk assessments using established methodologies, documenting findings clearly and escalating issues that exceed defined thresholds

• Analyze EU/UK tax compliance regulations (e.g., VAT, DAC7, JSL, Deemed Reseller) and their implications for Amazon sellers, translating requirements into actionable deliverables

• Support the development and maintenance of risk models and detection mechanisms to identify non-compliant or fraudulent seller behaviour related to tax obligations

• Collaborate with legal, policy, finance, tax, tech, and product teams to execute programme plans and deliver operational controls for new and existing programmes

• Track key risk indicators (KRIs) and programme metrics, producing status reports and flagging deviations to programme leadership

• Prepare risk assessments, programme updates, and supporting materials for senior leadership reviews

• Maintain audit-ready documentation and contribute to continuous improvement of risk and programme processes

A day in the life
You are joining a global team spread across the US, EU, Japan, and India. You will partner closely with a Tax Governance manager in the UK and collaborate heavily with Risk teams based in India and the EU to ensure Amazon’s compliance controls are in the best possible working order.

Your days will blend regulatory analysis, cross-functional delivery, and stakeholder coordination across multiple time zones. One morning you are reviewing control effectiveness with the 2nd Line of Defence; the afternoon you are in a working session with EU 3P Marketplace partners assessing the impact of a new VAT regulation on sellers. The next day you are preparing materials for a senior leadership review or troubleshooting a data integrity issue with tech partners in Seattle.

No two days are the same, but the constant is pace, impact, and global reach.
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience in compliance program management, legal, governance, audit, risk/loss prevention, or equivalent
- 5+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience
- 2+ years of program or project management experience
Preferred qualifications:
- Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification
- Experience using lean process improvement, six sigma methodologies, or related performance metrics/process improvements to increase efficiency within processes, forecasting, planning, optimization, or logistics
- Knowledge of knowledge of VAT in EU/UK
- Master's degree or equivalent
- - Experience in tax, regulatory compliance, or financial services risk management

jobs.title: Tech Infrastructure Program Manager, AWS Data Center Planning & Delivery
jobs.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Service (AWS) is a comprehensive, evolving, and growing business unit within Amazon.com. Since early 2006, AWS has provided a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost cloud infrastructure platform that empowers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries to innovate and invent.
Do you have the business background, complex cross functional program management experience, financial expertise, legal/regulatory comprehension and technical understanding? Can you communicate effectively, find clarity in ambiguity, and simplicity in complexity ?
If yes, then come and explore this exciting role. This role in Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (ADSIPL) Telangana builds infrastructure that hosts AWS cloud services. It delivers AWS cloud infrastructure in a challenging, high growth, fast paced and customer focused work environment. In this role, you will lead cross functional teams to deliver usable data center capacity. You will partner with senior stakeholders to develop, document, manage and deliver infrastructure designs, implementation schedules and budgets. You will earn trust of your partners in your ability to solve complex issues and steer teams in right direction to deliver results, on-time and at-cost.
You must be an exceptionally strong communicator (both written and verbal), and possess relevant experience in managing technical and strategic programs. If you bring past experience in data center deployment programs, great. If not, then having a background in program and project management, architecture/design, mechanical/electrical engineering, software/hardware engineering with strong urge to learn will be essential.
Come Join us, have fun, and create history!!

Key job responsibilities
Infrastructure TPM owns delivery of new DC across one or more availability zones in India. They manage 5+ projects at any time. They bridge internal customers, business functions, (Planning, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Policy, Operations), and functional delivery teams (Construction, Commissioning, Controls, Fiber and Network) to enable on-time and right sized delivery of new DC capacity.
The scope begins with early expansion planning, which includes a feasibility analysis to approve expansion plans and associated build timelines. They evaluate multiple factors prior to approving a new plan of record, including owned/leased/collocated DC supply, utility delivery (power, water, and fiber), and long lead equipment (LLE) availability. It requires region-wide knowledge and monitoring of in-flight projects, major risks, and remediation efforts to ensure DC delivery is not only on track to meet supply commitments but also to meet customer demand, which is constantly changing.
A successful TPM must be capable of managing a combination of metrics, tools, and mechanisms to remain aware of ongoing risks or issues that require their action, decision, mitigations, or effort to identify alternative solutions communicating up, down, and across the organization to align direction, gain support and drive remediation efforts

About the team
Diverse Experiences:
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Work/Life Balance:
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
Inclusive Team Culture:
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth:
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, JP Fleet (ROW GFP)
jobs.description:
(Japanese & English language skills are required)

At Amazon, we're dedicated to being Earth's most customer-centrist company while pursuing our ambitious Climate Pledge to achieve net-zero carbon emissions by 2040 while expanding all ranges of fleet vehicle possibilities. To reduce carbon emissions while expanding our fleet vehicle variance out of our last mile operations while increasing the vehicle, we're seeking an exceptional Program Manager for our Japan Amazon Fleet Team.

In this role, you will be responsible to conceptualize innovative and disruptive solutions while working closely with operations, tech, finance, and deployment teams to implement customer experience improvements, sustainability initiatives, and cost-saving measures. As Fleet Program Manager you are responsible for the safety, compliance, availability, and cost of the Fleet in Japan, leveraging our Fleet Management and leasing companies as well as vendors, suppliers and manufacturers in the best way and setting up a long term vision strategy with them and our Japan business.

We are making significant long-term investments in building our Fulfillment and Transportation infrastructure in Japan and scaling our last-mile delivery capacity. As Program Manager, you will drive national expansion of strategic on-road programs and work with multiple teams within Supply Chain and Retail functions to deliver a World-Class Customer Experience while working on long term Net-Zero Carbon Initiatives. You will lead fleet projects for Amazon Logistics Last Mile Delivery, partnering with tech, BI, Operations, Program, and analytics teams to create a robust, sustainable and long-term carbon-free infrastructure. That involves conceptualizing, planning, executing, tracking, evaluating and presenting pilot results for different modes of transportation that will be potential enablers for all of our business lines in Japan, with partial focus on micro-mobility solutions.

The role offers extensive collaboration opportunities with internal teams including Delivery Station Operations, Sort Centers and Fulfillment Centers, Delivery Service Provider programs, Tech teams, World-Wide Tech and Fleet teams, and external partners such as OEM manufacturers and leasing companies. You will be responsible for driving programs, partnerships, innovations, and features while creating last-mile service and delivery process improvements and launching new market opportunities.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter with an background in product and/or program management, operations, and cross-functional leadership for large-scale strategic initiatives. You should possess strong analytical and business acumen, exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, and the ability to influence without authority. Success in this role requires proficiency in managing complex logistics challenges, analyzing data, driving process improvements, and creating scalable solutions leveraging technology. Technical background will be of advantage.

You must be able to work independently in a high-speed environment, exercise sound judgment where clear guidelines may not exist, and demonstrate a bias for action and results. This exciting opportunity offers the chance to join a new team building a support function in a rapidly growing area within Amazon, while making a significant impact on our transportation and long term sustainability goals.

Previous success in program management, operations, or final mile transportation, along with experience in matrix organizations and strategic leadership, will be highly valued. The role demands someone who can take ownership of complex business challenges and drive strategy, execution, and successful delivery of results while maintaining our customer-backwards approach.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

More Information (Japanese Only)
・Department: Last Mile(AMZL)
・Job: Project Management
・Location: Tokyo Office

Key job responsibilities
• working closely with vehicle Management companies, manufacturers and internal teams to optimize vehicle selection, deployment, and maintenance across our delivery network.
• Support to develop and manage a vehicle catalog that supports various modes of transport and delivery channels, ensuring appropriate vehicle options are available for both short-term and long-term operational needs.
• Establish and execute a parking strategy that accommodates diverse delivery channels and transportation modes, optimizing resource allocation while balancing cost, compliance, and operational efficiency.
• Lead cross-functional initiatives to transition our fleet toward emission-free vehicles, partnering with internal teams and external stakeholders to pilot sustainable solutions and build supporting infrastructure.
• Manage resources and risks across complex cross-functional programs, ensuring efficient allocation and proactive risk mitigation strategies.
• Enhance customer and partner experience by translating needs into actionable programs while identifying cost-saving opportunities and maintaining service quality.
• Design and manage reporting mechanisms to track program progress, forecast future needs, and optimize fleet, and parking initiatives while clearly communicating impacting programs and project results to leadership.

jobs.title: Warehousing & Transportation Environmental Program Manager, Amazon Manufacturing Operations, Transportation Operations
jobs.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a talented and self-motivated Warehousing & Transportation Environmental Program Manager to support AWS Manufacturing, Test, and Operations (MOTO) facilities. The successful candidate will join the AWS Environmental team — an expanding and dynamic team that is critical to enabling AWS’s growth around the world, as well as ensuring regulatory compliance and the highest-level environmental performance of AWS’s warehousing and transportation operations.
This role sits within the MOTO Environmental organization and owns the Warehousing and Transportation Operations environmental compliance portfolio — a standalone pillar covering Receiving/Distribution Centers (RDCs), Multi-Function Centers (MFCs), and DC/FC facilities (DCFCs) across AMER. This is a new high-impact, ground-floor opportunity to build programs and establish compliance infrastructure from scratch. You will collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards of environmental performance for our warehousing and logistics facilities and our customers, and you will experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
A critical component of this role is supporting infrastructure development through environmental programs — conducting site selection environmental assessments, supporting greenfield permitting for new facility acquisitions, and ensuring environmental compliance during facility buildout and construction phases. This individual will be a key environmental partner to real estate, facilities, and construction teams as MOTO’s warehousing and transportation footprint grows.

This role is based in Herndon, VA (IAD Hub), Seattle, WA (SEA Hub), or Salt Lake City, UT (SLC warehouse).

Key job responsibilities
1. Leadership & Commitment - Own and evolve the MOTO Warehousing & Transportation environmental compliance program to meet changing organizational needs, stakeholder expectations, and regulatory requirements. Champion environmental responsibility across the W&T portfolio and advocate for best-in-class environmental practices at all RDC, MFC, and DCFC facilities.

2. Infrastructure Development & New Facility Support - Lead environmental due diligence reviews for new W&T facility acquisitions, including Phase I/II Environmental Site Assessments and pre-lease environmental screening to identify liability and compliance risk prior to execution. Serve as the environmental compliance owner during facility buildout and construction phases for new W&T sites — Partner with MOTO real estate, facilities, and construction teams to embed environmental compliance requirements into project timelines, contracts, and buildout milestones.

3. Portfolio Compliance Management — RDCs, MFCs, and DCFCs - Establish and maintain environmental compliance coverage for the full MOTO Warehousing & Transportation portfolio — beginning with facility inventory and classification, regulatory applicability screening, and risk-based prioritization across all RDC, MFC, and DCFC sites.

4. Hazardous Materials Management - Manage hazardous materials permitting, monitoring, and reporting across W&T facilities; maintain accurate hazmat inventories and ensure Tier II/EPCRA compliance where applicable.

5. Stormwater Management - Develop, implement, and maintain Stormwater Pollution Prevention Plans (SWPPPs) for all applicable W&T facilities; ensure compliance with industrial stormwater permit requirements under NPDES and applicable state-level general permits.

6. Spill Prevention & Emergency Response -Develop and maintain spill prevention and emergency response protocols for W&T facilities; coordinate with operations teams to ensure response plans are current, trained to, and tested. Manage spill incident reporting and corrective action for W&T sites; conduct thorough incident investigations and develop appropriate corrective and preventative actions.

7. Waste Management - Manage waste characterization, manifesting, tracking, and disposal compliance for all W&T facilities in AMER; ensure compliance with RCRA hazardous waste regulations, universal waste rules, and applicable state-equivalent waste programs. Coordinate with waste haulers and treatment, storage, and disposal (TSD) facilities to ensure proper handling, transport, and disposal of all waste streams generated across the W&T portfolio. Develop waste reduction and circular economy initiatives across the W&T portfolio; establish waste metrics and track performance against reduction targets.

8. Vendor & Contractor Environmental Compliance - Oversee environmental compliance for vendors and contractors operating within W&T facilities; develop and enforce environmental performance requirements in contractor agreements and facility leases. Develop environmental lease language standards for W&T facilities; conduct lease compliance inspections and remediate identified environmental obligations with landlords and tenants.

9. Collaboration - Collaborate with environmental, operations, legal, policy, real estate, and sustainability teams to ensure the W&T environmental program remains relevant, effective, and aligned with evolving regulatory requirements across all MOTO W&T facilities.

10. Performance Evaluation - Establish and manage a robust system for monitoring, measuring, and reporting environmental compliance performance across the W&T portfolio. Conduct regular assessments of environmental tools and processes across W&T sites; collate and analyze compliance data to identify trends, gaps, and areas for improvement. Develop environmental metrics to measure, monitor, and forecast performance across the W&T portfolio; prepare and contribute to performance reports for senior leadership on a regular cadence.

A day in the life
Day-to-day, this role manages environmental compliance across the MOTO Warehousing & Transportation portfolio — reviewing regulatory applicability for new and existing facilities, coordinating DOT hazmat shipping compliance with logistics teams, managing stormwater inspection schedules and SWPPP updates, tracking waste manifests and disposal vendor performance, and supporting facility teams on environmental permit requirements. The role simultaneously works upstream — partnering with real estate and construction teams to conduct site selection environmental assessments, supporting greenfield permitting for new W&T sites, and ensuring environmental compliance is fully embedded in facility buildout timelines before a building goes live.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
Basic qualifications:
- Knowledge of best practices and emerging technologies, related to infrastructure (i.e. network, data center, hardware, software)
- Experience with varying scenarios of infrastructure builds
- Experience in environmental compliance and permitting, waste management, contractual, regulatory, and liability assessments, environmental permit evaluations and applications, EIAs and water discharge requirements
- Bachelor’s degree in environmental science, environmental engineering, sustainability, or equivalent field
Preferred qualifications:

- Experience with increasing responsibilities in environmental compliance programs in warehouse, logistics, distribution, or transportation operations

- Experience with greenfield permitting, SWPPP development, construction-phase environmental compliance monitoring, and pre-operational environmental authorizations for new facilities

jobs.title: Program Manager - Site Operations, Annapurna Labs Silicon
jobs.description:
Annapurna Labs — Amazon's custom-silicon organization — is where a team of world-class engineers is shaping the future of cloud computing and AI. Our Austin site is a high-energy environment that blends the scrappy, move-fast spirit of a startup with the global impact of AWS, whose chips now power millions of customers worldwide. Here, hardware and software engineers collaborate side-by-side to bring Graviton, Trainium, Inferentia, and Nitro from bold idea to production silicon — solving problems no one else in the industry has tackled. The work our team does in Austin directly lowers costs, accelerates AI breakthroughs, and helps build what's expected to be the world's largest AI supercomputer. If you want to see your fingerprints on the infrastructure behind the next era of computing, this is the place to be.

We are seeking a Site Operations Program Manager that partners with site leadership and executive assistants to own the Austin site operations — responsible for both overall development and tactical execution of workplace experience initiatives that keep our engineering teams productive and engaged. You will build scalable site operations from the ground up, defining and implementing workplace experience, site efficiency, vendor coordination, and employee satisfaction while simultaneously executing day-to-day operational tasks.

This is a hands-on role. You'll drive the workplace operations buildout — vendor relationships, event programming, process design, budget optimization, and employee experience — while simultaneously managing the operational excellence of a live, high-velocity engineering site. You'll operate in ambiguous spaces where the problems aren't pre-defined, defining goals, establishing processes, building mechanisms, and partnering with stakeholders across Real Estate, Facilities, HR, Finance, IT, and Security to deliver results that directly impact our engineering teams' ability to ship custom silicon faster.

Key job responsibilities
Own the Austin site operations program end-to-end — workplace experience, facilities coordination, vendor management, event programming, and employee engagement. Partner with site leadership to develop the vision, mission and tenets for the site. Develop roadmap for site operations. Partner with Real Estate, Facilities, HR, Finance, IT, and Security to align site operations with business objectives. Communicate program status, wins, risks, and blockers through regular updates.

Vendor Management
Manage relationships with catering vendors, facilities service providers, and event suppliers. Define SLAs, and pricing to optimize cost and service quality. Establish vendor performance metrics and conduct regular business reviews. Own site operations budget, analyze spending patterns, forecast quarterly and annual needs based on headcount growth.

Event Operations & Execution
Execute site events end-to-end: all-hands meetings, team celebrations, leadership offsites, press visits, intern programming, and social events. Collaborate with Public Relations on press visit plans. Oversee rehearsals, set-up, and breakdown of event spaces. Coordinate with Security for site security and e-waste coordination. Document event history through photos, videos, and archived project plans. Conduct post-event analysis including employee surveys and event-over-event insights. Drive continuous improvement utilizing AI and other tools to streamline reporting.

Process Design & Scalability
Design and document repeatable processes for site events, visitor hosting, meeting coordination, and workplace services. Build self-service mechanisms and tools to reduce manual coordination overhead. Create runbooks, templates, and training materials for future team members or distributed ownership.

Day-to-Day Site & Meeting Operations
Coordinate food and beverage ordering, inventory management, and restocking. Manage seating assignments, desk moves, and workspace allocation. Support leadership meetings: room booking, catering, AV setup, materials preparation. Manage conference room calendars and resolve scheduling conflicts for team events. Coordinate with Amazon shipping for handling incoming shipments. Maintain site communication channels (Slack, email lists, wiki pages). Communicate with Amazon’s global office team regarding all site management-related issues.

A day in the life
No two days look the same. You might start the morning reviewing vendor delivery confirmations and checking inventory levels for the week's food and beverage orders. Mid-morning, you're coordinating with catering and AV teams for an upcoming leadership offsite, confirming room configurations and finalizing the run-of-show. After lunch, you're walking the site with Amazon’s global office team, reviewing a space reconfiguration project and discussing upcoming capacity needs as the engineering team grows. Later, you lead a cross-functional planning session with site leadership on event programming — translating employee feedback data into a concrete calendar of engagement activities. You close the day reviewing your vendor performance dashboard, drafting a cost optimization proposal for the monthly business review, and sending a care package to a team member celebrating a milestone.

- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience managing workplace experience, facilities operations, or site services
- Experience with cross-functional tech and non-tech teams; including collaboration with internal leadership and external vendors and partners
- Proficient in Microsoft SharePoint and M365 tools
- Flexibility to travel

- Experience managing multiple initiatives across locations
- Background in event planning or facilities operations
- Familiarity with budget management and cost optimization
- Bachelor's degree

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager, Fleet Accountability, DSP Compliance & Experience
jobs.description:
Our north star is zero incidents. We deliver results through our accountability flywheel—working backwards to generate actionable insights, creating and leveraging signals to proactively detect risk, and building high-quality mechanisms to change behavior and drive improvements.

Our organization operates globally across NA, EU, MENA, APAC, and LATAM, partnering with cross-functional teams including Global Fleet & Products, Global Road Safety, regional operations, and legal teams.

We are seeking a high-judgment Sr. Program Manager to lead Fleet Accountability. This role will be instrumental in establishing sustainable mechanisms to ensure DSPs maintain safe, functional vehicles across our complex fleet, directly impacting the safety and experience of thousands of DSP Delivery Associates (DAs) worldwide.

We are seeking a candidate who can dive deep into the details, invent scalable solutions, earn trust with cross-functional partners, insist on the highest standards for safety and compliance, and demonstrate cross-functional ownership by building long-term solutions across teams by working backwards from the customer.

Key job responsibilities
As the Sr. Program Manager for Fleet Accountability, you will partner across teams to own the strategy, execution, and scaling of fleet accountability programs across multiple regions.

• Diagnose Fleet Defects End-to-End: Work backwards from driver-reported vehicle issues and safety signals to identify root causes—whether they stem from process breakdowns, data pipeline gaps, misaligned incentives, or behavioral dynamics.

• Build Preventive System Controls: Identify where technology and process redesigns can prevent non-compliance without relying on downstream enforcement. Partner with tech teams to implement proactive mechanisms—such as real-time alerts, automated compliance triggers, or guardrails—that drive DSP action before violations occur.

• Own Fleet Enforcement Mechanisms: Once upstream foundations are validated, support the launch of Monitoring and Enforcement Plans (MEPs) for priority fleet compliance areas. Ensure mechanisms are scalable, data-driven, and integrated into our broader compliance infrastructure.

• Establish Safety Coverage Standards: Define and enforce vehicle condition standards across vehicle types, regions, and delivery programs. Create mechanisms to track compliance, close coverage gaps, and feed insights back into the accountability flywheel.

• Create Detection and Remediation Systems: Design signals and tracking mechanisms to proactively identify fleet safety risks—from HVAC failures to device malfunctions. Build remediation frameworks that drive DSP action and measure resolution effectiveness.

• Drive Leadership Alignment: Manage Director and VP-level reviews, building compelling narratives that frame fleet accountability within our broader compliance strategy. Drive crisp decision-making on prioritization, sequencing, and resource allocation.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing driver-reported vehicle defects to identify emerging patterns, then join a working session with fleet and technology partners to validate whether a data signal is measuring the right thing. After lunch, you could be building a business case for a system control that prevents non-compliance upstream, followed by a leadership review where you present your prioritization roadmap. No two days look the same—you will move fluidly between diagnosing root causes, designing scalable solutions, and driving cross-functional alignment across teams in various stages of maturity.

About the team
The DSP Compliance & Experience team ensures Amazon's Delivery Service Partners maintain the safety, compliance, and performance standards required across our last-mile network. We build monitoring systems that detect risk, enforcement mechanisms that drive corrective action, and self-service tools that give DSPs visibility into their compliance obligations. Our team manages this full lifecycle end-to-end—from identifying policy gaps, to building the mechanisms that change behavior, to delivering the tools DSPs use daily. You will work alongside program managers who own these workstreams while partnering cross-functionally with fleet, safety, operations, and technology organizations.

- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

- Experience working in a matrixed organization

As Program Manager for Automation & Vendor Operations, you'll own the strategy and delivery of automation solutions that eliminate manual touchpoints across vendor management and service delivery. Starting with ServiceNow workflow optimization, you'll design automated ticket routing, SLA monitoring, escalation triggers, and reporting pipelines — then expand into AI-enabled operations like anomaly detection and predictive escalation. You'll partner closely with Service Delivery and Vendor Programs to free Program Managers from operational mechanics so they can focus on strategic vendor accountability.

This is a build-from-scratch opportunity with high visibility to leadership and a direct line to vendor operations impact across the network.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the TOPS Automation Roadmap — maintain a prioritized backlog of automation opportunities ranked by effort vs. impact, and deliver against it
- Map current-state ServiceNow workflows (ticket routing, SLA management, escalation paths, vendor dispatch) and design automated replacements

Your morning starts reviewing the automated overnight SLA monitoring report — three vendors flagged for resolution time drift. The system sent vendor notifications and escalated to the assigned PM. You will translate complex initiatives into clear, actionable documentation that guides teams through high-stakes launches and changes. You will contribute to scalable processes that mitigate risk while flexing across the broader risk vertical as business needs evolve.

This role sits within the Training, Launch, Content (TLC) organization and works at the crossroads of policy, technology, and operations. You will partner with Product Managers, Policy SMEs, Science, ML engineers, automation teams, and Ops workflow leads to translate technical and policy requirements into clear, operational guidance. Your growing business acumen will support timely decisions in ambiguous situations, while your data-driven approach ensures content and process effectiveness through metrics and direct feedback.

· Support the definition of reviewer use cases and processes for new products, tools, policies, or business and risk launches
· Drive content projects through their entire lifecycle

jobs.description:

We are seeking a Senior Program Manager to lead strategic defect reduction programs across the JP AMZL delivery ecosystem. This role owns end-to-end program strategy for a critical pillar of the LMDX defect landscape — driving execution through cross-functional teams and delivering measurable reductions in cost-to-serve and concessions while improving the customer experience at scale.

You will own high-visibility metrics, build mechanisms to detect and eliminate root causes of delivery failures and unnecessary concession spend, and partner with engineering and operations leaders to ship customer-facing improvements. The ideal candidate is a self-directed operator who can structure ambiguous problems, build the analytical case, and drive results through influence — not authority.

Key job responsibilities
### Strategic Ownership & Leadership

- Own strategy and execution for a major defect domain (e.g., OTR Concessions including DNR, Damage, and Driver Scorecard; or Delivery Success), delivering measurable DPMO reductions, cost-to-serve improvements, and customer experience gains

- Define the 3-year roadmap and OP1/OP2 goals for your domain; translate ambiguous customer pain points into prioritized, quantified initiatives with clear success metrics

- Set the strategic direction for your programs and escalate blockers to senior leadership to unblock execution

### Cross-Functional Program Management

- Drive cross-functional programs requiring coordination across Operations, Engineering (REX, ShipTech, LMT), Science, and CX partner teams

- Own intake prioritization and bandwidth negotiation with engineering teams; manage program timelines, dependencies, and trade-offs

- Author and present BRDs and leadership narratives (VP/Dir level) to secure prioritization and funding

### Data-Driven Decision Making

- Build and maintain analytical frameworks (bridges, attribution models, cost-impact estimations) that isolate operationally controllable defects from systemic or upstream issues

- Define metric definitions, validate data pipelines, and ensure single-source-of-truth reporting across WBR/MBR cadences

- Conduct deep-dive analysis on metric movements, spikes, and outliers; convert findings into actionable improvement plans

- Leverage AI/ML-driven tools and automation to identify defect patterns, predict failure modes, and accelerate root-cause analysis at scale

### Mechanisms & Operational Cadence

- Build durable mechanisms (dashboards, escalation paths, station outreach cadences) that sustain improvements without continuous manual effort

- Lead weekly/monthly business reviews for your domain; prepare narratives, callout metrics, and andon-style escalations

- Drive WW parity assessments — identify where JP lags EU/NA on customer experience standards and build the business case to close gaps

### Stakeholder & Partner Management

- Build and maintain strong working relationships with Operations, Engineering, and Science counterparts; serve as the trusted point of contact for your domain

- Represent the customer defect perspective in engineering roadmap reviews and prioritization forums; influence without authority

- Communicate program status, risks, and trade-offs to Director/VP-level stakeholders through crisp written narratives

A day in the life
**Morning** — You review overnight metric movements in your domain dashboards. A spike in Delivered Not Received (DNR) DPMO catches your eye — you pull the data, isolate it to a station cluster, and draft a deep-dive to share with Ops leaders at standup. You follow up with the Operations team on action items from last week's station outreach — confirming process changes are landing.

**Mid-morning** — You join a program sync with the LMT engineering team to track progress on a tech project you've been driving. You walk through the latest A/B test results, flag a blocker on API dependencies, and align on a revised launch timeline. You follow up on an open intake request with another tech team, ensuring the ticket hasn't stalled.

**Lunch** — You catch up on Slack threads from WW counterparts in EU who recently launched a similar initiative. You note a design pattern that could accelerate your JP implementation and share it with your engineering partners.

**Afternoon** — You raise a data reporting request with the BI team to standardize a metric definition that's been inconsistent across dashboards. You then facilitate a brainstorming session with Engineering and Operations partners to evaluate potential solutions for a newly identified defect — whiteboarding trade-offs, assessing feasibility, and narrowing down to 2–3 options worth prototyping. You use AI-driven anomaly detection tools to surface patterns across millions of shipments that inform the solution space.

**Late afternoon** — You present a concise narrative to your Director on a proposed initiative targeting significant concession cost reduction and CX improvement. You field questions, refine the ask, and leave with a clear path to secure engineering bandwidth. You then circle back with the Operations team to share the updated metric reporting format you've been standardizing — ensuring everyone is reading from the same source of truth.

**End of day** — You update your program tracker with tech project milestones, respond to a station manager's question about a metric definition, and prep the agenda for tomorrow's WBR. You send a follow-up to an engineering team on a feature request that's due for design review this week.

About the team
The **LMDX Defect Reduction Programs** team sits within Amazon Japan's Last Mile (AMZL) organization. Our mission is to own delivery quality and speed end-to-end, delivering the best last mile experience for every customer across Japan.

We are a high-impact, data-driven team of program managers that identifies structural delivery defects, quantifies their customer and cost impact, and drives cross-functional solutions to eliminate them at root cause. Our scope spans the full delivery lifecycle — from dispatch through delivery attempt, concession, and return — covering AMZL Core, Amazon Business, and SSD (Same/Next-Day) networks.

The team partners closely with Operations, Engineering (REX, ShipTech, LMT), Science, and CX teams to drive systemic improvements. Our programs span Delivery Success, OTR Concessions, Network Loss, Cost-to-Serve optimization, Customer Experience, and Undeliverable / Late recovery.
Basic qualifications:
- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
Preferred qualifications:
- 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

We're looking for a results-oriented Program Manager to join Amazon's BR External Fulfillment Operational Excellence team — and own the metrics, processes, and launches that define how we scale. This isn't a supporting role; you'll be at the center of how we operate, driving the initiatives that directly shape seller experience, operational efficiency, and marketplace growth across Brazil's external fulfillment network.

You'll lead from problem to solution: identifying what's broken through data, designing what's next, and launching programs that stick. You'll partner with Product, Operations, and Tech teams to turn complexity into clarity — building the measurement frameworks, process standards, and launch playbooks that let us move faster without breaking things.

If you thrive on ownership, love making sense of ambiguity, and want your work to be visible in the numbers that leadership tracks — this is your role.

Drive process improvement — Own end-to-end initiatives that leverage data-driven methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma, statistical analysis) to identify inefficiencies and deliver measurable operational gains.

As a Process Improvement PM, you'll lead process mapping sessions to identify operational bottlenecks and friction points in our external fulfillment network. Your day will involve facilitating workshops with stakeholders to identify process constraints, develop innovative solutions, and implement frictionless processes. The Relay Operations Center (ROC) is Amazon's central command and control center for Transportation Execution across the Amazon Supply Chain network. Program management skills to monitor vendor delivery of physical infrastructure projects and delivering high quality fiber to make ready for circuit and data center turn-up. jobs.title: Program Manager III, DSP Capacity Planning
jobs.description:
Have you ever thought about what it takes to ensure the data behind millions of delivery decisions is accurate, consistent, and trusted worldwide? Have you considered what happens when a Delivery Service Partner disputes their capacity targets and how that resolution shapes their business outcomes and their trust in Amazon? If so, the DSP Capacity Planning team needs you.
We sit at the heart of Amazon's last mile operation, building the models, tools, and processes that help over 4,000 Delivery Service Partners (DSPs - the independent business owners who deliver packages to Amazon's customers) reliably meet customer demand, grow sustainably, and perform at their best.

We are looking for a Program Manager to own worldwide metric fidelity and capacity dispute resolution for DSP Capacity Planning. You will ensure the metrics that drive planning decisions are accurate, consistent, and trusted across all regions. You will own the capacity dispute process end-to-end - managing root cause analysis, driving resolution, and identifying systemic improvements that eliminate recurring issues. This role requires a program leader who can assess the current state of metric health, define the path to green, and drive alignment across engineering, operations, finance, and field teams worldwide while operating with a high degree of independence.

Key job responsibilities
- Own worldwide metric fidelity for DSP Capacity Planning. Maintain and continuously improve the metric framework that underpins capacity planning decisions globally. Drive alignment across regions on metric definitions, calculation methodologies, and reporting standards. Identify discrepancies between regions, investigate root causes, and implement corrections that restore trust in the data. Ensure planners, field teams, and leadership operate from a single source of truth.
- Own the capacity dispute resolution process. Manage the existing mechanism through which DSPs and field teams escalate concerns about capacity targets, volume assignments, or planning inputs. Oversee dispute intake, conduct root cause analysis, and drive timely resolution. Identify patterns across disputes to surface systemic issues and prioritize initiatives that eliminate recurring causes - reducing dispute volume over time through upstream process and tooling improvements.
- Assess current state and define the path to green. No roadmap exists today. You will evaluate metric health across regions, identify gaps and risks, prioritize remediation efforts, and build a clear strategy to achieve and sustain metric fidelity at a worldwide standard. This role identifies the gaps that prevent ideal fulfillment and builds the products and programs that close them, improving cost-to-serve, delivery speed, and customer experience at scale.

You will work at the intersection of data science, operations, and program management to diagnose where the network is leaving efficiency on the table and drive the initiatives that fix it. You will partner closely with SCOT, Supply Chain, Transportation, Retail, and Finance to translate diagnosis into measurable network improvement. This is a high-ownership role with direct impact on JP Stores' unit economics and long-range fulfillment strategy.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

Key Responsibilities
Identify fulfillment gaps (data-driven analysis). Analyze network performance, data, and metrics to pinpoint where ideal fulfillment breaks down, across consolidation (UPB, UPPD), placement (LA, iFCA, iFCIS), regionalization (IRIS, IRA), and peak periods. Understand complex supply-chain mechanisms independently and dive deep into large volumes of data, separating what is controllable from what is structural and quantifying the opportunity. This requires strong comprehension and logical thinking.

Plan and execute efficiency improvements. Based on the analysis, define the issues and build the products and programs that close the gaps, such as consolidation improvements, load-balancing and placement optimization, reactive and holds optimization, transship tuning, and demand de-peaking. Own end-to-end project management and coordinate with all relevant stakeholders to deliver measurable gains in shipping/delivery efficiency and cost.

Own metrics, mechanisms, and reporting. Set goals and build the monitoring and root-cause mechanisms (audits, MBRs, dashboards). Share information with stakeholders and report progress and risks to leadership through clear, data-backed narratives.

Act as the point of contact through to implementation: judging rollout priorities in light of Japan-specific business context, localizing specifications, assessing the impact on JP business and operations, and coordinating with stakeholders. Partner cross-functionally. Align SCOT, Supply Chain, Transportation, Retail, and Finance around a single view of fulfillment trade-offs (cost vs. speed vs. topline), surfacing disconnects early and resolving them.

Drive long-range strategy. Feed fulfillment insights into OP1 / 3YF planning and long-range capacity decisions, ensuring the network is set up to grow without proportionally scaling cost.

jobs.description:
Customer experience is at the heart of all we do at Amazon, as we strive to be Earth's most customer-centric company. Amazon Customer Service (CS) is at the forefront of customer experience, working relentlessly to provide customers a convenient, high quality, and delightful experience — across all of our CS channels — in every interaction.

We are seeking a Program Manager to join the Network Control Center (NCC), Amazon's central incident management function for Customer Service. NCC detects, manages, and resolves high-severity incidents impacting customers, associates, drivers, and brands in real time — coordinating response across dozens of teams to minimize customer impact and restore service. When systems fail at scale, contact volumes spike unexpectedly, or a service disruption threatens millions of customer interactions, the NCC takes command. jobs.title: Sr. ABM Program Manager, ABM Global Practice Team
jobs.description:
The ABM Solutions & Implementation team within the AWS Global ABM Practice is responsible for working cross-functionally to build and scale the tools, channels, and operational models that enable 200+ ABM Marketers to execute high-impact, account-targeted programs. We own the end-to-end delivery of ABM digital capabilities — from precision events and content hubs to agency support models and AI-powered workflows — ensuring our marketers spend less time on manual execution and more time on strategic customer impact.

We are seeking an experienced Sr. Marketing Manager to own and scale our ABM Agency Support operating model. This role will manage the full lifecycle of our 3P Digital Shared Services program — currently supporting 7+ use cases through dedicated agency partners — with a mandate to expand coverage to the Global content and creative agency support model. You will define the strategy, build the mechanisms, negotiate resources, and drive operational excellence across a complex, cross-functional program that touches every ABM marketer globally.

This is a high-visibility role that requires both tactical execution and strategic thinking. You will operate with limited guidance, influence partner teams’ priorities and roadmaps, and build scalable processes that will serve as the foundation for how AWS Marketing engages agency resources for years to come. Success in this role means ABM marketers can focus on customer strategy while agency resources handle execution — with consistent quality, clear SLAs, and seamless coordination.

Key job responsibilities
• Own the end-to-end ABM Digital Shared Services operating model, managing the full lifecycle from intake to delivery to continuous improvement. Define the program strategy, measurement framework, and success criteria with limited guidance.
• Implement continuous improvements to intake processes, SLA tracking, escalation paths, and capacity planning utilizing AI-based tools.
• Drive agency relationship management and performance optimization — own the day-to-day partnership with agency vendors, conduct regular performance reviews, and negotiate scope/resource adjustments as demand evolves.
• Scale support to new use cases and capabilities as the ABM toolkit expands (e.g., Highspot Digital Showrooms, Direct Mail via Sendoso, LinkedIn promotions, Event-in-a-Box automation). Define SOPs, train agency resources, and ensure quality standards are maintained.
• Expand the agency support model to cover the Global content and creative agency program — including content development, localization, and creative services for ABM marketers across all Geos.
• Build mechanisms for cross-functional coordination with ABM marketers, Geo ABM leads, Industry teams, and IDC stakeholders. Ensure the support model is responsive to field needs and aligned to ABM planning cycles.
• Define, track, and report on program KPIs (request volume, SLA adherence, delivery quality, marketer satisfaction, cost efficiency). Use data to identify bottlenecks, drive improvements, and inform investment decisions.
• Drive process improvement and operational excellence — identify and eliminate inefficiencies, create and maintain SOPs, build self-service resources, and establish best practices that reduce dependency on central program management.
• Onboard, train, and quality-assure agency resources on new ABM capabilities, platforms, and processes. Ensure agency teams maintain currency on ABM tooling updates and adhere to quality assurance standards (SplashThat, Marketo, Highspot, Turtl, etc.).
• Manage program budget including vendor contracts, SOW negotiations, and resource allocation. Demonstrate frugality while maximizing impact and marketer coverage.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Content is the foundation of our AI strategy, and this role sits at the center of that vision. Every help article, SOP, and policy document developed here will feed directly into our AI tools, powering personalized, context-aware summaries and real-time guidance for associates managing complex support cases. You will define the taxonomy, structure, and quality standards that make content machine-readable and AI-ready, ensuring our models surface the right information at the right moment. Beyond written content, you will lead the development of interactive video experiences that translate complex operational topics into simple, intuitive formats that drive self-service adoption.

The ideal candidate brings a combination of analytical rigor and creative vision: someone who can build a content measurement framework from scratch, identify gaps through data, and translate ambiguous business needs into structured, scalable programs. You thrive in fast-moving environments, communicate with clarity across all levels of the organization, and understand that great content is not just well-written but strategically designed to move metrics.
