Position Overview
Amazon Transportation Services (ATS) division builds and operates a large-scale linehaul transportation network connecting Amazon fulfillment/delivery centers across Japan, ensuring safe and accurate delivery of products to customers by the promised delivery date. We are seeking a member for the Quality Management (QM) team, which oversees transportation quality within the Relay Operation Center (ROC) - the nerve center of this complex network that manages over 5,000 daily operations.

Team Overview
The ROC QM team's primary functions are divided into three areas:

(1) Quality management and improvement of on-time delivery compliance across linehaul transportation (from ship nodes to delivery stations)
(2) Quality management and improvement of on-time truck departure performance against seasonally fluctuating shipment volumes
(3) Process management for maintaining quality and enabling rapid recovery during irregular events such as weather disasters (typhoons, heavy snowfall)

By elevating these quality standards, we deliver the best possible service to our customers.

- Building protocols/processes used during disasters, reviewing operational flows, and standardizing procedures

Irregular events include reasonably predictable phenomena (e.g., weather forecasts) as well as unpredictable events (e.g., earthquakes, system errors). jobs.title: Sr. Manager, PM - Business Operations and Optimization, Worldwide Ergonomics and Safety Experience
jobs.description:
The Worldwide Ergonomics and Safety Experience (WESE) team is looking for a Senior Program Manager to be the single-threaded owner of operational strategy and program management for a portfolio of safety programs that directly reduce musculoskeletal disorders and drives cultural safety change across hundreds of Amazon fulfillment sites. This is a high-visibility role responsible for defining the multi-year roadmap, driving measurable efficiency gains, and delivering results that scale.
You will own the operating model for how WESE plans, funds, deploys, and measures its highest-priority initiatives. This means partnering with technical SME teams as they identify operational problems and scope solutions (both near-term and long-term). You will lead a team responsible for establishing the PM plan to deploy structural projects end-to-end, document efficiencies and benefits in cost, speed, and quality. You will partner with Directors, VPs, and cross-functional leaders across Operations, Finance, Engineering, and Tech to indirectly influence resources, drive prioritization, and deliver complex programs on time.
The ideal candidate is a high-performing Amazonian with a proven track record of identifying and solving operational problems at scale. You lead a team of Program Managers accountable for program delivery velocity, Capital Appropriation Request (CAR) quality, financial performance, precise narrative business reviews, and driving cross-team progress against established goals. You self-identify areas of opportunity, present solutions to leadership, and drive execution with a close lens on quantitative results and operational outcomes. You are an accomplished Amazon writer who communicates results to senior leadership with precision and clarity.

Key job responsibilities
Business Operations
• Be the single-threaded owner responsible for defining and documenting the operational strategy for WESE program delivery and the initiatives required to uphold that strategy
• Self-identify problem statements and areas of opportunity; present these to leadership and business stakeholders with clear scope, trade-offs, and proposed solutions
• Drive strategic initiatives to continuously improve deployment velocity, cost efficiency, and quality across the portfolio
• Deploy structural projects end-to-end that deliver measurable benefits in speed, cost, and injury reduction outcomes
• Define and execute multi-year program plans (OP1/OP2) with clear milestones, resource requirements, and success metrics

People Leadership & Team Performance
• Lead and develop a team of Program Managers; set clear expectations for delivery velocity, financial rigor, and CAR quality
• Hold the team accountable to outcomes. Inspect progress against commitments, coach on root cause analysis, and raise the performance bar
• Recruit, hire, and retain top-tier PM talent. Deliver career development through stretch assignments, structured feedback, and increasing scope
• Build organizational capability through mechanisms, standard work, and repeatable processes that scale output without linear headcount growth

Financial Performance & Resource Optimization
• Own project financial management across the WESE portfolio: CapEx/OpEx forecasting, budget adherence, variance analysis, and investment justification
• Ensure CARs meet a high quality bar, clearly tying capital requests to measurable business outcomes and cost-efficiency gains
• Partner with Finance to optimize resource allocation, identify cost-reduction opportunities, and make investment trade-off recommendations to leadership
• Create metrics and mechanisms to drive both operational and financial improvements; distinguish between important and urgent

Cross-Functional Delivery & Communication
• Partner with teams across Operations, Finance, Engineering, WHS, and Tech to source, allocate, and coordinate resources by driving critical prioritization discussions
• Manage and deliver results on complex programs across multiple organizations; coordinate stakeholder requirements, track milestones, and ensure alignment with business objectives
• Author high-quality six-pagers, PR/FAQs, and business reviews for Director and VP-level audiences
• Identify risks early, develop mitigation plans, and escalate with clarity when trade-offs require senior leadership decisions

A day in the life
Your morning starts with a portfolio review. You check deployment progress against plan, inspect financial dashboards for variance, and identify which projects need intervention. You run a stand-up with your PM team focused on delivery commitments, blockers, and CAR quality. Two submissions come back for rework because the business case lacks measurable outcomes.
Mid-morning, you lead a cross-functional working session to drive prioritization for the next quarter. You own the agenda: what's launching, what's behind plan, what resources need to shift, and what we stop doing. You then check in with individual PMs to confirm they are on pace, financials are tracking, and stakeholder commitments are being met.
After lunch, you draft a 6-pager for a VP review. You connect efficiency gains to headcount leverage, tie project outcomes to injury reduction, and make the investment case for scaling what is working. You coach a team member on tightening their narrative before it goes forward.
In the afternoon, you work with Operations and Finance on quarterly re-planning, confirming project prioritization against business goals and available funding. You close the day with 1:1s focused on career development and holding the team to the bar on delivery and quality.
You set the pace for this team. You move between strategy, execution, people development, and financial stewardship. The through-line is delivering operational efficiency that directly supports Amazon's vision of being the global benchmark for safety excellence across like industries.
Basic qualifications:
- 10+ years of program or project management experience
- 7+ years of cross functional project delivery experience
- 7+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
- 7+ years of team management experience
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
- Bachelor's degree

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, External Fulfillment
jobs.description:
Imagine designing the logistics network that will define Amazon Japan's next chapter of growth.

We are looking for a Senior Program Manager to join the External Fulfillment (EF) Planning Team within Amazon Japan's Operations Division — a team that sits at the intersection of strategy, execution, and innovation.

What is EF?
External Fulfillment operates fulfillment centers run by 3PL partners and vendors — not Amazon's own FCs. These sites specialize in large, heavy, and temperature-sensitive products that demand unique logistics solutions. By scaling this network, the EF team unlocks product selection that customers never thought they could get delivered fast — and delivers it at speeds that redefine expectations.

What you'll own:
You will own the end-to-end lifecycle of EF sites — launching new logistics centers and managing them as a business after go-live. This isn't project management that ends at launch; you build it, then you run it.

Why this role is special:
Few positions offer this vantage point. You'll see the entire business landscape — from site development to operational readiness to ongoing performance — and translate that view into action. You'll architect logistics centers with capabilities that don't exist yet, enabling Amazon to enter new product categories and business models. If you want to leave a visible, lasting mark on how millions of customers receive their orders, this is the role.

We welcome bold thinkers from diverse industries. Whether your background is in logistics, consulting, manufacturing, or something entirely different — if you thrive on complexity and want to build at scale, we want to hear from you.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

==
アマゾンジャパン オペレーションズ部門のEF（External Fulfillment）プランニングチームにて、シニアプログラムマネージャーを募集します。

EFとは何か

EFは、アマゾン自社のフルフィルメントセンター（FC）ではなく、3PLパートナーやメーカー・卸売企業が運営する物流拠点で注文処理・配送を行う事業です。大型品、重量品、温度管理品など、自社FCでは対応しにくい商材を中心に取り扱っています。このネットワークを拡大することで、お客様に幅広い品揃えと速い配送を提供し、アマゾンの事業成長を支えています。

このポジションが担う仕事

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager, Ergonomist, Global Ergonomics
jobs.description:
We are looking for high-potential, flexible, innovative, and forward-thinking professionals to join the Worldwide Ergonomics and Safety Experience (WESE) Global Ergonomics Risk Programs team. Are you ready to drive high-visibility, strategic, musculoskeletal disorders (MSD) risk reduction programs as well as leverage Lean methodologies to lead process improvement initiatives? We are expanding our team and looking for a talented Senior Ergonomist/Senior Program Manager for our field ergonomics team which support our businesses across the globe. We are looking for a motivated, organized self-starter to join as a Senior Ergonomist/Senior Program Manager for the Global Job Rotations Expansion Strategy and Global Ergonomics Partnerships. In this role you will provide technical expertise by applying a variety of scientific techniques, standardized assessments and problem-solving skills to drive innovative solutions for musculoskeletal disorders and optimize performance.

The Senior Ergonomist/Senior Program Manager will be part of the global ergonomics team to foster a global ergonomics partnership and support job rotations for associates across the globe. This Senior Ergonomist/Senior Program Manager will be accountable for multiple VP and Director goals, and will need to work closely with senior leaders in the WHS as well as key partner organizations (e.g., Operations, ACES, AFT, Finance, Legal and Procurement) to ensure success. The Senior Ergonomist/Senior Program Manager will own job rotations, partnership programs and mechanisms used by operations teams. The Senior Ergonomist/Senior Program Manager will help own and launch Job Rotations for safety in multiple BUs across the globe. The Senior Ergonomist/Senior Program Manager also will support in establishing partnerships and work closely with senior leaders to manage MSD risk reduction projects and programs.

• operate and deliver in a fast-paced environment.

• manage components of the MSD risk reduction projects through visibility across functional partners developing MSD interventions.
• use knowledge and experience in Amazon warehouse operations/industry as well as excellent technical, problem-solving, and communication skills, to support the Global Ergonomics Risk Programs team.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Sales Abuse Prevention
jobs.description:
Have you ever purchased a product on Amazon without checking its star rating and customer reviews? Every day, millions of Amazon customers read customer reviews to decide which products to buy. If you are interested in protecting the integrity of community content like customer reviews, come join the Sales Abuse Prevention (SAP) team.

This is a strategic area of investment for Amazon and the work we do is of paramount importance in preserving the trust customers have in Amazon’s stores. Our environment is dynamic and highly ambiguous as we continuously work to stay one step ahead of those who use various and changing methods to manipulate ratings and reviews.

Key job responsibilities
• Own the program planning and execution of (1) proactive abuse prevention, (2) reactive abuse mitigation using the framework: Measure, Detect, Investigate, Enforce, handle Appeals and cleanup-abuse. (M-DIEAC), and (3) discover new and emerging forms of abuse.
• Deep dive current process to identify gaps and use program management best practices to set a roadmap, execute and iterate to continuously improve
• Lead ambiguous and undefined problems to resolution in constantly changing, multi team-based environment, work backwards from customer needs to deliver high quality outputs
• Communicate effectively across multiple levels of organization, building trust, generate buy-in for the program vision both internally and with key external partners
• Define creative, high quality, simple program roadmaps based on program strategy and vision
• Work closely and collaboratively with design, program and product teams from partner organizations
• Delivering results in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment while driving teams to complete goals

A day in the life
We are seeking a Senior Program Manager, to build mechanisms that help the team to detect and eliminate fake reviews, and stand up mechanisms around abusive brand building. This person will partner with cross functional teams in engineering, data science, legal and other groups to develop automated and manual detection systems and improve our process. You must have a desire to drive change, interpret data for action and constantly be aware that your actions can help improve the shopping experience for tens of millions of Amazon customers worldwide.

About the team
The Sales Abuse Prevention team builds and operates systems that safeguard trust in the Amazon content. We protect shoppers from untrustworthy content and contributors through machine-learned content filters, forensic relationship-detection systems, abusive behavior pattern detection, and investigator tools. We partner with product-development, quality and customer-service teams across the company to make content moderation efficient and effective, deep dive in abuse investigations and respond to customer contacts. Our charter also extends to tools and processes that enable content owners to enforce, manage, and update their policies in cases where sharing resources is necessary.

- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Bachelor's degree

- 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
- Demonstrated experience leveraging generative AI tools to enhance workflow efficiency and productivity, with the ability to craft effective prompts and critically evaluate AI-generated outputs in a professional setting
- Experience identifying opportunities to integrate AI solutions into products and services to drive business value.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager - Decision Platform, Retail Business Services (RBS)
jobs.description:
We are building Amazon's first horizontal self-serve decisioning platform — an intelligence layer that upgrades static rule-based systems into outcome-learning, context-aware decision engines. The platform serves multiple tenants across multiple organizations and domains, each requiring structured onboarding, cross-org coordination, and production launch governance.
We are looking for a Program Manager to own tenant onboarding execution end-to-end — from first contact through production launch and steady-state operations. This role operates at the intersection of platform product, tenant engineering, and business stakeholders — orchestrating complex multi-party programs where each tenant brings a different tech stack, org structure, data readiness level, and decision type.

Key job responsibilities
Tenant Onboarding Execution
• Own the end-to-end onboarding lifecycle — contract → data readiness → prototyping → shadow mode → production launch.
• Manage parallel tracks across multiple tenants simultaneously at different stages.
• Drive timelines against committed milestones, identify blockers early, and escalate decisively across cross-org dependencies.
Cross-Org Stakeholder Management
• Navigate multi-persona commitment structures (builder, system owner, sponsor) across organizational boundaries.
• Coordinate across platform engineering, applied science, BA/RA teams, and tenant-side engineering.
• Serve as the single-threaded owner tenant leadership engages with throughout onboarding.
Process Design & Operational Excellence
• Design and iterate on scalable onboarding processes — playbooks, health dashboards, RACI matrices, milestone trackers.
• Drive process improvements as the platform moves from bespoke onboarding to self-serve at scale.
Data Readiness & Pre-flight
• Drive data readiness (the #1 time sink) by providing clear requirements, checklists, and embedded support.
• Coordinate pre-flight validation: data quality gates, signal checks, and integration testing.
• Ensure contract commitments are met before prototype begins.
Governance & Launch Readiness
• Coordinate shadow mode, launch readiness reviews (circuit breakers, fail-safes, RACI sign-off), and transition to steady-state operations with support handoff and monitoring.
Pipeline & Reporting
• Maintain full pipeline visibility. Report program health with actionable metrics: onboarding velocity, time-to-production, blocker resolution.
• Partner with GTM to convert qualified demand into onboarding-ready tenants.

About the team
We operate at the intersection of product, science, and GTM — building a platform that connects decision systems across Amazon so that one signal makes all of them smarter. The platform is live with founding tenants, scaling to broad GA, and building pipeline for pan-Amazon adoption. This role is critical to ensuring that every tenant that enters the funnel moves through onboarding with velocity, quality, and trust.
You will work directly with platform leadership, applied science, engineering, BA/RAs, and tenant-side stakeholders to drive the operational machinery that turns platform readiness into production impact — one tenant at a time, then many in parallel.

- 5+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
- 5+ years in program management, technical program management, or platform operations roles
- Experience managing multi-party programs with cross-organizational dependencies and competing priorities
- Demonstrated ability to drive programs in environments with ambiguity — where processes don't exist yet and must be built while executing
- Strong stakeholder management skills — comfortable holding senior leaders accountable to commitments and escalating decisively when programs are at risk
- Track record of managing parallel workstreams (5+ concurrent programs) with clear milestone tracking and proactive risk management
- Excellent written communication — able to produce clear program documents, status reports, and playbooks that scale beyond the individual

jobs.title: Program Manager, Fulfillment Center Network Strategy , SCM Capacity Planning
jobs.description:
Amazon JapanのSupply Chain Management (SCM)部門は、AmazonのEnd-to-EndのFulfillment Networkの中核となるFC (Fulfillment Center：倉庫)のNetwork戦略を担当するProgram Managerを募集しています。

お客様により早い配送スピードをご提供しつつ、Operation Costの適性化を通じてより幅広い商品Selectionをご提供することが組織のMissionです。そのために、お客様により近い場所に必要な在庫を配置し、流通過程でのTouch pointと輸送距離の最小化を実現するNetworkをいかに構築するかが重要なテーマです。その中でこのRoleは、Amazon Networkの中核であるFCの配置（Topology）に責任を持ち、長期的なVisionの立案と毎年の成長規模を見定めた毎ピークシーズンでのFC　Capacity拡大の投資計画の立案に責任を持ちます。そして、入荷、配送スピード、在庫配置、FCオペレーション、幹線輸送、ラストマイル配送といった社内の多様なStakeholderと連携をとることが求められます。またVision達成に向けた新たなNetwork戦略の実現に向けた様々な戦略的InitiativeのProject推進も担います。

FCのCapacityとその配置はNetwork全体のPerformanceに大きな影響を与えるだけではなく、その投資規模から全体のCostへの影響が大きいこともあり、非常に重要な役割を果たすことが期待されます。そのため、活躍していただける方の要件としては以下を想定しています。

・戦略立案に向けた抽象度の高い課題を整理し、Data drivenでより具体的な解決に導いていける方
・新しい取り組みや変化を前向きに捉え、常に自分事として主体的に課題解決やアクションに取り組める方
・社内外のStakeholderと協力し合い、議論を通じてより良い解決策に導いていける方

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

Key job responsibilities
AmazonのFC networkは、取り扱う商品サイズ等で複数に分かれており、このRoleはそのFC Networkのいくつかを担当します。1-4年先という中長期の視点で、まず将来の出荷量と在庫量の需要予測と需要の不確実性に対応できる倉庫のCapacityを確保することに責任を持ちます。同時に、お客様への配送スピード向上とSCMトータルのコストの低減を両立するためのFC Network Design（どこに、どの規模で、どのタイミングで、どのような機能の在庫拠点を配置するか）に責任を持ちます。部下は持たずIndividual Contributorとして活動します。

具体的には、以下の大きく3つの業務を推進します。
1. FC Network Strategyの立案
・お客様への配送スピードとCost最適化のために、Networkの考え方を常にUpdateし続ける必要があります。Fulfillment Networkそれぞれにおける変化やNW visionの新しい方向性を踏まえて、最適なFC Networkの在り方をFinancialなどの具体的な数字に基づいて提案します。
2．中長期でのFC Capacity Planning
・将来の需要予測に基づき、FCの準備に必要な期間とその間の需要の不確実性（上振れ、下振れ）を考慮し、FC Capacityの増設とその投資計画を策定します。
・FC新設の意思決定を行うタイミングで、その投資の財務インパクトを財務部門とともに計算し、経営層に投資提案を行います。
3．プロジェクト推進
・新しい戦略を具体的なものにするためのInitiative、例えば既存FCの統廃合や位置づけの変更、全く新しい機能の倉庫の設置といったProjectを推進します。

A day in the life
このRoleは、SCM部門のCapacity Planningチームの一員として活動します。SCM Capacity Planningは、需要を計画するDemand Managementと、その需要に基づいてFC Network Designを行うTopologyチームに分かれていますが、このRoleはTopology ManagerにReportします。

主な仕事とそのサイクルは以下の通りです。
・FC Capacity Planの更新：1年に最低4回は需要予測の更新に基づいて、FC Capacity Planと投資計画を更新します。それぞれAmazon Operation部門のLeardershipの承認を得ます。
・FCの準備期間を考慮し、Prime DayやBlack Friday Weekといったピークに向けて必要なタイミングで実際にFC拡張、増設の投資を実行するかどうかの意思決定を行います。これは投資規模によりGlobal Leadershipの承認を必要とします。
・その他、常に新しいNetworkの考え方を反映したり、Cost改善のためのFC Network見直しというInitiativeが常時動かしているため、上記サイクルとは別にInitiativeの対応を行い、必要に応じてLeadershipのAlighment、承認を得ます。

日常で関係する部門は多岐にわたり、各部門と調整の核としての役割が期待されます。主な関係先は以下の通り
・需要予測とSCM最適化Technology（インド、シアトル）
・FC Engineering
・FC管理
・SCM他チーム（S&OP、Speed、在庫配置、入荷NW等）
・輸送管理
・不動産管理
・財務
・各カテゴリーの販売、マーケティング部門

About the team
本ポジションはAmazon JapanのSCM部門の中でCapacity Planningチームの一員として活動します。当チームは中長期での視点で入荷・在庫・出荷の需要予測を行い、お客様に豊富な品揃え、十分な在庫量そして素早い配送スピードで商品をお届けできるように、適切なタイミングで、適切な場所に、適切な規模で倉庫を準備するすることが主な役割です。この業務を通じて、お客様の購買体験の向上と倉庫投資における投資対効果を最大化する重要な役割を担っています。当チームは、日本のオペレーション部門の中でも最も遠い将来を見て仕事をしているのが特徴です。

Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.
We're at the frontier of space-based internet technology, and with that comes the thrill of building something entirely new, along with the unique challenges of operating a service that spans ground infrastructure, orbital assets, and customer homes. You'll be the calm in the storm, coordinating across Field Services, Engineering, Legal, PR, and Security Operations to protect our customers and our brand in real-time. If you're excited about satellite technology, love solving complex problems under pressure, and want to be part of a venture that's literally changing the world from space, we want to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager - Incident Insights, Global Road Safety
jobs.description:
Amazon's Global Road Safety organization is responsible for driving the safety of our on-road operations worldwide. We are a data-driven team that believes world-class safety performance requires world-class measurement. We hold ourselves to the highest standards and are committed to raising the bar through rigorous measurement, continuous learning, and data-driven action.

To that end, Amazon's Global Road Safety (GRS) organization is seeking a Senior Program Manager to build and lead our incident management system and the data it produces. This role owns the full incident lifecycle, from initial report and investigation through enrichment with internal and external data sources, with the goal of creating an accurate, governed, and actionable record of safety incidents at a global scale. The data this system produces must be complete, consistent, and structured to power the insights and programs that drive meaningful safety incident reduction across Amazon's on-road operations.

You will build programs and processes that improve how safety incidents are reported, investigated, and enriched with supplemental data from internal sources (fleet telematics, driver training records, operational and route metadata) and external sources (police crash reports, insurance claims data, government statistics, industry consortia, peer disclosures, academic research). You will establish data governance standards that ensure consistency, accuracy, and accountability across geographies and business units. You will apply AI and automation to accelerate incident processing and analysis at scale, while keeping safety professionals in the loop to validate findings and ensure data integrity. Partnering with safety, operations, and data science teams, you will ensure that every incident record surfaces the patterns and contributing factors that inform future safety programs. Beyond internal data, you will source and normalize external benchmarks to contextualize Amazon's performance and identify industry best practices that drive measurable improvement.

This role operates globally, requires comfort with ambiguity, and demands the ability to influence senior leaders to act on data-driven findings.

Key job responsibilities
• Design and build programs that improve how safety incidents are reported, investigated, and documented across Amazon's global on-road operations, including establishing standards for investigation rigor, consistency, and timeliness.
• Develop frameworks that enrich incident records with supplemental data from internal sources (fleet telematics, driver training records, operational and route metadata) and external sources (police crash reports, insurance claims data, government statistics, industry reports).
• Establish data governance standards that ensure incident data is consistent, accurate, and accountable across geographies and business units, including clear ownership of data quality at each stage of the incident lifecycle.
• Evaluate how AI and automation can accelerate incident processing, pattern detection, and analysis at scale, while keeping safety professionals in the loop to validate findings and ensure data integrity.
• Define and refine metrics that measure the completeness and actionability of incident data, safety trends, contributing factors, and the effectiveness of incident reduction programs.
• Align cross-functional stakeholders (safety, operations, legal, data science, engineering) around shared processes, standards, and priorities for how incident data is collected, used, and acted upon.
• Source and normalize external benchmarks to contextualize Amazon's safety performance against peer companies, industry standards, and publicly available safety data.

jobs.title: First Deployment Tech Infrastructure Program Manager, RDPI - Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovation
jobs.description:
Amazon is seeking an experienced Technical Infrastructure Program Manager to own the strategy and delivery of complex, first-time automation infrastructure deployments across our global fulfillment network.

Join our Robotics Delivery and Packaging Innovation International team, where we transform complex automation technologies into efficiently deployable solutions on a global scale.

You'll define deployment strategies and plans where none exist, own the full lifecycle of complex cross-functional infrastructure builds from concept through go-live and steady-state handover, and build the mechanisms and predictable process paths that enable downstream teams to scale without direct oversight.
You'll influence within a VP organisation, advise Senior Managers and Directors on deployment strategy and trade-offs, and actively mentor and develop junior engineers. Working across multiple technologies and regions will accelerate your impact through exposure to diverse stakeholders, regulatory environments, and technical challenges.

Amazon's culture encourages an entrepreneurial approach and expects engineers and managers alike to take a high level of ownership in solving complex problems in a fast-paced environment.

The role could be based in Berlin, Düsseldorf, Munich, Barcelona, London or Vercelli with ~50% travel across Europe during peak deployment season, with occasional international travel.

Key job responsibilities
- Define and own the end-to-end infrastructure deployment strategy for complex, first-time automation technologies where deployment plans and build strategies do not yet exist
- Manage the full lifecycle of complex, cross-functional infrastructure builds — unblocking teams, increasing speed of delivery, and negotiating resources and priorities across multiple teams
- Lead cross-functional alignment within a VP organisation, advising Senior Managers and Directors on technical trade-offs, deployment decisions, and infrastructure build prioritisation
- Define infrastructure build requirements and dependencies for new complex technical products; identify when deployment issues stem from technical design issues and provide feedback to engineering teams
- Build scalable deployment mechanisms, frameworks, and tooling that convert first-time deployment complexity into predictable, repeatable process paths adopted organisation-wide

During deployment execution, you'll be on-site leading complex first-time implementations through go-live while simultaneously coaching your team and capturing learnings into scalable mechanisms.

You will interact daily with diverse functional teams across multiple time zones. You'll write effective narratives and present to Directors and VPs, conducting regular meetings with internal teams, stakeholders, and vendors. You'll build consensus on contentious deployment decisions, communicate across an increasing diversity of areas (legal, regulatory, finance, operations), and provide context for business and technology choices with a long-term perspective. jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Networking Operational Excellence
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to join the AWS Networking Operational Excellence team.

The ideal candidate will require proven technical project management, critical thinking and problem solving skills. The candidate should be open to new challenges, extremely good at multi-tasking, innovative, self-directed and a great team player.

Candidates should drive continuous process improvement, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional operational and software engineering teams to solve problems and implement new solutions.

You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards deliverables for network operations. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

If you like to work with new technologies and optimize existing technology, and have experience participating in network/systems support for a large-scale enterprise or a service provider, we encourage you to apply! Your work will play a key role in driving the stability and sustainability of next-generation networking solutions.

Key job responsibilities
• You’ll drive both network hardware and software programs to meet the ever-growing customer demand.
• You’ll manage competing cross-organizational projects/programs on a global scale.
• You’ll interact cross-team Network Managers, cross-team Technical Program Managers, Engineers, and Data Center Technicians and senior management.
• You will run meetings, create and maintain timelines, and keep large, diverse groups informed of progress and obstacles.
• You’ll work with engineers to develop detailed and creative solutions to complex problems, while keeping a watchful-eye on timelines and costs.
• You’ll drive simplification efforts in engineering and project/program management, and architectures to unblock innovation.
• You’ll partner with multiple teams across various locations to ensure priorities are agreed and outcomes are delivered.

A day in the life
Technical Program Managers in the BERE organization have a wide range of responsibilities: we work with internal partners to develop and implement the next gen infrastructures along with the tooling ecosystems to support with these platforms driving efficiency and scalability through the automation of builds, configuration deployment, and the scaling of capacity. As our network is one of the largest in the world, there is no blue print at our scale allowing our engineers to develop solutions to the complex challenges that we face daily. We encourage durable solutions that look around corners while taking into consideration our customer needs from a cost, performance, and reliability perspective. Our team develops tooling that provides the required visibility and control of traffic across the network, while prioritizing the automatic mitigation of events to minimize the impact to our customers during events.

About the team
Within AWS Networking, the Backbone, Enterprise, and Regional Engineering (BERE) organization is responsible for the design, implementation, and operations of a wide array of networking infrastructure that provide global connectivity between all AWS Regions and edge locations. We provide the massive scale required to support our AWS customers and internal services, via a network that grows by 70% annually. In addition, we have teams that are responsible for the design and operation of our global corporate office and data center network, allowing tens of thousands of Amazonians to perform their daily tasks in support of our customers. We provide software tooling that allows the global AWS footprint to scale via new Region and edge location builds, automated systems that control the flow of traffic across devices, and are building our next generation network controllers to drive improved performance and efficiency across the networks that we operate.
Basic qualifications:

Amazon's Retail Business Services (RBS) team is looking for a Senior Program Manager to help expand its Inventory Optimization Program (IOP) . Objective of the Program is to eliminate defects leading to inventory available in our FCs but not available for the customer to buy. We understand root cause for these defects and fix/eliminate the defects , thereby increase their availability and sales by enhancing customer experience. Our end customers are the Buying customer and Selling partner. We work hard to reduce the buying customer’s product non-availability and to improve the profitability of our selling partners.

As the Senior Program Manager, you will own the expansion of IOP program to all defect reasons across WW and driving Defect elimination.
The job involves end to end business planning including but not limited to creating annual plans and strategy for execution, ensuring operational rigor, designing high business impact processes and identifying automation possibilities that drives process efficiency. As a large-program owner, He/she will be the strategic point of contact to business, operations and tech teams of Amazon worldwide and must therefore be comfortable and confident liaising with remote global teams in business and technology at senior leadership levels. He/She will manage business impact via functional activities and will be accountable for designing and delivering on all KPIs of the same. About the Role
Amazon's International Emerging Stores (IES) is a strategic priority, targeting growth from $41.4B to $100B+ by 2029. As IES marketplaces scale, stranded inventory — units suppressed, aged, or blocked from customer purchase — represents a significant and growing cost-to-serve challenge across emerging markets (BR, MX, AU, ZA, TR, SG, MENA).

RBS's Stranded Inventory Reduction Program (SIRP) has delivered $1.3B+ in FCF savings across mature geographies since 2020. We are now expanding this capability into Emerging markets, where regional complexity (data gaps, unique suppression drivers, marketplace-specific workflows) requires dedicated ownership to adapt proven playbooks and drive measurable cost-out impact.

We are looking for a Program Manager to own stranded inventory defect identification, resolution, and upstream alignment across Emerging marketplaces — partnering with country teams, FC operations, and RBS technology to reduce unproductive inventory and unlock working capital.

Key job responsibilities
Emerging countries Defect Identification: Identify, categorize, and size stranded inventory defects specific to IES marketplaces — including Retail Bossed, Hazmat suppression, image non-compliance, expiry, and overstock/deadwood

Amazon is committed to building a sustainable business for our customers and the planet. In 2019, Amazon co-founded the Climate Pledge – a commitment to be net zero carbon across the businesses by 2040, a decade ahead of the Paris Agreement goal of 2050. HVAC and Building sustainability technologies are part of the strategic areas to meet this ambitious goal with a focus on building strategy to deliver pilots and scale solutions across Amazon to accelerate the adoption of clean HVAC technologies.

This individual will initiate and manage multiple programs and projects using effective time management skills and personal impact to drive complex activities across the organization.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Intellectual Property Protection
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about leveraging machine learning to protect Amazon's marketplace at scale? We're seeking a Senior Program Manager who will drive our brand protection detection systems through systematic problem-solving and technical expertise. In this role, you'll own the end-to-end program lifecycle for ML-powered detection systems, going 2-3 levels deeper than surface analysis to identify root causes and build solutions that eliminate entire classes of false positives. You'll work directly with applied scientists and engineering teams to translate complex abuse patterns into engineering-ready specifications that scale to hundreds of millions of product listings globally.

This position sits at the heart of Amazon's brand protection systems, where your decisions directly determine whether hundreds of millions of product listings are correctly identified as legitimate or infringing. You'll partner with applied scientists on ML model performance, manage golden dataset refresh cycles, optimize image enrollment processes, and conduct root cause analysis on false positive drivers. Your strategic impact will be felt across marketplaces, regions, and languages as you balance precision and recall at unprecedented scale.

Key job responsibilities
- Partner with applied scientists to evaluate machine learning model performance for brand protection detection systems, making high-judgment decisions that directly impact detection accuracy across billions of listings WW.
- Manage high-quality training dataset refresh cycles and text workstream pattern identification across multiple marketplaces and languages to ensure detection models have high-quality training data.
- Conduct comprehensive root cause analysis on false positive drivers, going 2-3 levels deeper than surface analysis to identify systematic improvements for detection systems.
- Translate findings into detailed engineering-ready specifications with clear, measurable success criteria that enable engineering teams to build to specification.
- Present strategic recommendations to Directors and VPs on detection system enhancements, establishing metrics and driving alignment across stakeholders.

A day in the life
Your day begins by reviewing overnight detection metrics across marketplaces to identify any emerging patterns requiring attention. You'll meet with applied scientists to evaluate a new model iteration, making judgment calls on its precision/recall balance before implementation. After, you might spend time analyzing text patterns across multiple languages to identify new detection opportunities or coordinate with engineering on implementing your latest false positive reduction blueprint. You'll wrap up by presenting findings from your latest root cause analysis to leadership, highlighting systematic improvements that could eliminate thousands of false positives while maintaining strong brand protection.

The brand protection program team serves as Amazon's systemic problem-solving engine, providing vertical product-program support across discovery, detection, and remediation systems.

Product and engineering teams explicitly prefer working with our team because we deliver detailed blueprints instead of vague problems, enabling engineering to build to specification and validate against clear success criteria.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Whole Foods Market Promotions Analytics
jobs.description:
Whole Foods Market is seeking a sharp, driven, and analytically minded Sr Program Manager to join our Promotions Analytics team. In this role, you will be at the forefront of understanding promotional performance and customer engagement, translating campaign data into strategic insights that directly shape our merchandising initiatives.

This is a high-visibility role with real impact from day one. The right candidate should have a strong foundation in retail merchandising and promotional strategy, possess the ability to dive deep into complex campaign performance metrics, understand the business context behind the data, and continuously strive to find deeper insights. They should be ready to step into a role guiding and developing a small analytics team. The 3 other members of the Promotions Analytics team will look to the Sr Program Manager to interpret leadership's intent, inform priorities, and provide coaching & development.

You will design and execute promotional analytics strategies to capture high-quality insights on retail promotions effectiveness and resulting customer behavior. You will conduct or manage deep-dive analyses on promotional performance, customer segmentation, and engagement patterns, surfacing the "so what" behind the data. Working closely with Merchandising and Marketing leaders, you will develop strategy, launch pilots, and deliver clear, actionable findings. Over time, you will help the team build repeatable, scalable analytical frameworks that improve the team's speed and depth. You will communicate results clearly to senior business leaders, translating complex data into concise narratives, and contribute as a key voice for the 3 other members of the Promotions Analytics team.

We are looking for a candidate who brings a strong foundation in retail merchandising and promotional strategy, with the ability to contextualize business performance data within broader market dynamics. They have a proven ability to work through complex performance metrics and extract meaningful, business-relevant insights. They are comfortable operating at both the detail level and the strategic level, knowing when each is needed. They consistently deliver timely, accurate analyses, build partnerships across business teams, and drive change through insight. They can distill complex findings into concise narratives for a range of audiences.

Promotions analytics is a strategic priority at Whole Foods Market. You'll have the opportunity to shape how we understand and optimize our promotional strategies, with the resources, data, and leadership support to make a real difference.

Key job responsibilities
Program Management: Manage priorities and project deliverable timelines for the Promotions Analytics team. Identify opportunities for the team to pursue supporting organizational goals. Own end-to-end delivery of promotional analytics initiatives from strategy through execution.

Collaboration & Relationships: Maintain close working relationships with Merchandising, Marketing, and cross-functional stakeholder leaders to collaborate on the development of promotional strategy and reporting needs. Work cross-functionally with product teams to design reporting capabilities using in-house tools. Partner with data engineering and business intelligence teams to ensure data quality and accessibility.

Communication: Speak, present, and train team members on promotional strategy, campaign optimization, and customer engagement insights. Manage regular updates to leadership on projects related to promotional performance and strategies. Present findings effectively to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

Analytics and Reporting: Gather and analyze promotional campaign data, customer behavioral data, and transactional data to provide strategic insights. Utilize analytical methods to identify patterns and trends across data sources. Ability to self-serve data with programming skills (SQL, R, Python). Experience in a highly scalable, distributed environment preferred. Analyze data to provide promotional strategy recommendations, highlight opportunities, and inform adjustments to merchandising initiatives. Provide coaching and development to team members on analytical approaches, stakeholder management, and business acumen.

Strategic Leadership: Serve as a go-to resource for Merchandising and Marketing teams on promotional performance questions. Contribute to quarterly program reviews to inform planning and optimization efforts. Drive process improvements and build scalable frameworks for promotional analytics. Provide guidance on work prioritization and analytical quality standards for the Promotions Analytics team.

Stay current with food, retail, market news, and natural products trends. Read popular and trade press widely.

A day in the life
You start your day reviewing promotional campaign performance data in SQL, identifying trends in customer engagement and product performance across multiple campaigns. You build strategic frameworks to evaluate promotional effectiveness and meet with Merchandising leaders to discuss insights for upcoming seasonal promotions. You lead a cross-functional meeting to present quarterly promotional performance results, guiding the team through customer segment analysis and ROI calculations. After managing priorities for your analytics team and addressing an ad-hoc request from Marketing leadership investigating regional promotional performance differences, you prepare a presentation for senior leadership on promotional strategy recommendations. You close the day by facilitating a team retrospective on the quarterly review process, coaching a team member on their stakeholder presentation approach, and documenting follow-up requests.

- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

- Experience with data scripting languages (e.g. SQL, Python, R etc.) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, or Matlab)

jobs.title: 輸送運用管理プログラムマネージャー/Transportation Operation Management Program Manager, ATS ROC
jobs.description:
Amazon Transportation Services（ATS）は、お客様にお約束したお届け日を正確に守るため、日本全国の輸送ネットワークを統括する部門です。 ATSの重要な組織のひとつがRelay Operation Center（ROC）です。ROCは24時間365日体制で輸送ネットワークを管理し、オペレーションをサポートしています。 ROCは複数の専門チームで構成されており、それぞれが輸送ネットワークの異なる側面を担当しています。その中でも、物流倉庫・配送拠点のオペレーション品質と効率性を直接支えるのが、Transportation Operation Management（TOM）チームです。

TOMチームは日本全国の物流倉庫・配送拠点における安全性、品質、生産性の向上を支援するチームです。 私たちは、単にデータを監視するだけではありません。現場で実際に何が起きているのかを理解し、拠点の担当者と協働しながら、実効性のある改善を実現することを大切にしています。

TOMチームが担う3つの領域
1. 品質管理 物流倉庫・配送拠点において定められたオペレーションプロセスが正確に実施され安全や品質が担保されているかを確認します。
2. 資材管理 配送に不可欠な資材（カート他）の在庫を全国規模で管理しています。各拠点に必要な数量を適切に配置し、不足や過剰在庫を防ぐことで、スムーズな配送オペレーションを支えています。
3. プロセス改善 日々のオペレーションから得られるデータを分析し、業務プロセスの標準化・効率化を推進します。

■このポジションで担う役割■
本ポジションはチームの戦略的なオペレーション管理を担います。課題を自ら発見し、チームの影響範囲をさらに広げ、少し先の戦略を考えることが期待されます。

■具体的な責任範囲■
1. 課題の発見と予防的アプローチ
品質管理を担当する場合： 全国の物流倉庫・配送拠点から集まるオペレーションデータを分析し、メトリクスのトレンド分析により潜在的な課題を早期に発見します。表面化する前に根本原因を特定し、影響が拡大する前に予防的な解決策を実行します。
資材管理を担当する場合： 配送に必要なカートの在庫状況を予測的にモニタリングし、需要予測と市場動向を踏まえた中期的な最適配置戦略を立案・実行します。全国規模での資材フローの最適化とコスト効率化を実現します。
2. 戦略的プログラム・プロジェクトマネジメント
チーム主導のプロジェクトにおいて、プロジェクトマネージャーとしてスケジュール、リスクを適切に管理し、目標達成にコミットします。部門横断的なプロジェクトにおいてもPOC（Point of Contact）として参画し、専門知識を活かして貢献します。
3. プロセス改善とイノベーション
標準化・自動化されたプロセスとフローを構築してオペレーションを最適化します。オペレーション上の潜在的な課題を発見し、プロセス改善の提案や新システムの導入検討を行い、POCとしてプロジェクトを推進します。

■働き方■
通常はオフィスでデータ分析、プログラム・プロジェクトマネジメント、関係者との調整業務を行います。しかし、必要に応じて物流拠点を訪問し、実際のオペレーションを見て、現場の声を聞き、一緒に解決策を考え実行します。（宿泊を伴う出張が発生する場合があります）

■求める経験・スキル■
課題発見力： 業界を問わず、業務プロセスにおける潜在的な課題を自ら発見し、率先して解決に導いた経験
データ分析力： システムデータを活用してトレンド分析を行い、予防的な対策を講じることができる能力
プログラム・プロジェクトマネジメント経験： 予算、スケジュール、リスクを管理し、プロジェクトを成功に導いた経験
コミュニケーション力： 多様なバックグラウンドを持つステークホルダーと協働し、組織横断的に影響力を発揮できる力
戦略的思考力： 短期・中期的な視点でソリューションを策定し、実行できる能力

jobs.description:
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company, to be best employer, and be safest place to work on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you'd like to help us build that place, this is your chance to make history.

One focus area of the Amazon Workplace Health & Safety Australia (AU WHS) is to provide tools, resources, and environments that support safe, efficient, and healthy behaviors and encourage employees to proactively manage their health and wellbeing. To support this focus area, Amazon is seeking an experienced and innovative person to serve as our Program Manager for AU WHS to build and execute programs that create a safe workplace and build a world-class safety culture in the midst of Amazon’s growth. In this role, you will dive deep into Operations processes; identify risks through data and first-hand experience; build and execute programs, and improve processes to eliminate risks; and influence Operations to sustain a culture of safety. This role will focus on coordinating and leading large, strategic projects / programs within Amazon Business Units (BUs) and will be strongly focused on injury and accident prevention as well as improvements across health, safety and wellness.

The WHS Program Manager role will challenge you to push boundaries and lead transformative innovation while having the autonomy to make rapid data-driven decisions and invent on behalf of Operators (operation leaders) and Associates. In this role, you will work cross-functionally with members from various teams, including Operations; Human Resources, WHS, Reliability, Engineering and Maintenance, Finance and OpEx to deploy solutions at scale. This role calls for an individual who is technically smart to gain credibility with customers and stakeholders at various levels of the organization.

The role will report into the Senior WHS Manager, and work collaboratively with other partners across all Amazon BUs and regional geographies to provide innovative solutions across our business. This role is based in either the Melbourne or Sydney corporate office or field location.

The ideal candidate has an obsession for customers and a strong interest in building innovative solutions; must have proven analytical capabilities (including ability to deep dive, identify root causes and permanently eliminate hazards and risks); and can thrive in a fast-paced environment with exceptional communication and project management skills. The ideal candidate must have sound judgment, compassion, and interpersonal skills with the ability to work collaboratively with colleagues in many areas across the company.

• Develop, review, approve, coordinate, and lead large, strategic projects / programs within Amazon Business Units (BUs) and across different geographies.
• Build relationships and partner across many organizations to build and execute on new initiatives and roadmaps each year.
• Work and collaborate with stakeholders and partners to align on project /program goals and resources.

In this exciting role, you'll be a key partner to Procurement, Field Workplace, Health, and Safety (WHS), and site support teams such as Reliability, Maintenance, and Engineering (RME), working closely with them to ensure world-class safety standards for our under the roof contractors across Amazon North America Operations. You will be empowered to own and drive safety programs from inception through implementation.
You will also own safety related projects and own the actions needed to deliver them.

Also supporting field operations daily safety routines, you will support rigorous investigations to uncover root causes, develop actions, and share learnings.

Collaborating cross-functionally, you'll scale successful safety initiatives and improvement projects, cementing Amazon's reputation as an industry leader. If you're a motivated safety professional committed to continuous improvement, this is an unparalleled opportunity to make your mark.

Bring your safety expertise and collaborative mindset - together, we'll reinvent what's possible! Apply now.

A successful candidate will be able to own and drive safety programs from inception through implementation.
The candidate will own safety related projects and own the actions needed to deliver them including narrative paper writing for executive leadership audiences.
Ability to assess contractor high risk operations, such as work at heights, hazardous energy, and lifting and rigging and implement strategies to minimize risk.
Serve as a trusted safety partner to senior regional leaders across North America, aligning on strategic priorities and tracking progress against goals.
Conduct regular site visits to Amazon warehouse locations to personally observe safety practices, gather feedback from frontline teams, and identify opportunities for improvement.

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager, RBS Returns Reduction
jobs.description:
Amazon strives to be Earth’s most customer-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they want to buy online. Retail Business Services (RBS) accelerates Amazon's growth by improving customer and Selling Partner (SP) experiences, while optimizing costs across Stores WW. RBS operates at the intersection of retail, operations, technology, and finance, ensuring Amazon’s systems and processes scale reliably while maintaining a high-quality customer and selling-partner experience.

Returns Reduction as part of Cost to Serve (CtS) BU is a specialized program within RBS focused on driving down overall Return Rate for both Retail and FBA channels. Returns Reduction Program focuses on Upstream defect elimination with focus on defect identification and defect elimination and partners with System Owners, Category Teams, FC ACES, Finance, CS, and abuse-related programs to uncover true drivers and remove them systematically. The team builds mechanisms that strengthen upstream defect visibility, and enable consistent governance and contributing directly to improved Free Cash Flow and scalable business growth.

This role will focus on identification and prioritization of high-impact defect opportunities and will own and define the roadmap for elimination of the problem space end to end. They will do this by building trusted partnerships with key stakeholders across technology, finance, operations and earning alignment to pursue defect elimination opportunities and influencing senior leaders through compelling, data-driven business cases. This role requires an individual who is comfortable in diving deep into complex data sets and presenting strategic recommendations to leadership up to three tiers above level. The candidate will bring strong business and supply chain acumen, a bias for action, and the strategic vision by directly contributing to improved cost to serve performance and driving scalable growth across Amazon Stores worldwide.

Why You’ll Love This Role
• Customer Impact: You’ll lead critical projects that remove defects, improves customer experience and directly influence Amazon’s supply chain cost, driving measurable results.
• Strategic Influence: Collaborate across global teams, including technology, finance, operations to shape strategies that focuses on improving customer satisfaction.
• Data-Driven Innovation: Leverage analytics to uncover insights and optimize supply chain performance.

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
• Deliver Results, Dive Deep: You will be accountable for deep research from the ground up and from customer returns data to identify, execute and eliminate top defect opportunities.
• Ability to Influence: Develop business cases and present them to senior leaders, leveraging data to influence roadmaps and make tradeoffs.
• Earn Trust: Develop partnerships with key stakeholder groups and gain their alignment to pursue defect elimination opportunities; present to leaders of all levels to influence roadmap priorities.
• Financial Collaboration: Partner with finance teams to validate impact on returns, forecast savings and ensure alignment with team's financial goals. Make trade-offs between short-term cost reductions and long-term strategic objectives to maximize financial impact.
• Managing stakeholder communication across multiple lines of business on various project milestones, process changes, escalations, etc.
• Provide ad-hoc support and analysis to senior leaders on strategy documents and research requests.

A day in the life
• Roadmap development: Use advanced analytics tools and anecdotes to identify high impact defect opportunities within Returns space; conduct root cause analysis to validate and develop those use cases, applying judgement to prioritize based on customer impact, value, credibility, availability of solutions.
• Cross-Functional Leadership: Collaborate with cross-functional teams across System owning orgs, finance, operations and supply chain to gain alignment on implementation of scalable solutions. Unblock teams to increase speed of delivery and ensure alignment on program goals.
• Senior Leadership Engagement: Communicate effectively with senior leaders, presenting data-driven insights and recommendations to influence decision-making. Trusted to present decisions to leaders up to three tiers above level, driving alignment across diverse areas.

About the team
The RBS is an integral part of Amazon online product lifecycle and buying operations. RBS Return reduction team functioning under CX-Business unit. The primary responsibility of the RBS return reduction team is to reduce returns that result in negative consumer experiences. This includes identifying the causes of returns and collaborating with the appropriate teams to eliminate defects. Launch tech solutions to 'Find' and 'Fix' for non-eliminated root causes, or Build scalable tech solutions for Selling Partners for self-remediation, while refining policies in collaboration with relevant teams.

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager-Network and Security, Amazon Leo, Global Service Compliance
jobs.description:
We are seeking a stellar program manager with operational experience and expertise in Network and Security communications service compliance, specifically across Network Outage Reporting, IP/DNS Blocking, Traffic Routing, and Security Reporting within internet service provider and telecom environments. This role sits within the Global Service Compliance team supporting Amazon Leo, an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

Amazon Leo Global Service Compliance (GSC) is seeking a dynamic, organized, and experienced Program Manager to guide and inform specific communications service compliance obligation workstreams. You are responsible for managing complex compliance programs, from planning through to execution, continuously surveilling the Amazon Leo business strategy and regulatory environment to plan and respond to change across one or more domains. This role focuses on Network and Security compliance and may expand to include things like enterprise deals across multiple countries and service offerings.

You collaborate with business and technical teams to deliver world-class compliance solutions that are highly scalable, secure, and flexible while maintaining a strong organizational focus. You work with stakeholders and multiple business teams to identify, define, and iterate solutions for assigned compliance domains. You are a deep subject matter expert in your assigned compliance workstreams and will be the face of the workstream to external stakeholders. You create dynamic plans and monitor performance and evolution of the workstream as the Amazon Leo business expands and changes, reporting successes, risks, and program status internally (within GSC) and externally (across Amazon Leo) as appropriate. You tailor your communications to specific audiences, communicating clearly and concisely to business, technical, business partner, and leadership audiences.

As a GSC PM, you oversee the compliance program approach, implementation, and optimization for Outage Reporting, IP/DNS Blocking, Traffic Routing and Security Reporting workstreams, while championing program management best practices across the GSC organization.

Key job responsibilities
• Develop and implement comprehensive compliance workstream strategies aligned with Amazon Leo's global service expansion goals and objectives. This involves defining workstream scope, establishing measurable KPIs, and creating mechanisms to monitor compliance performance and efficiency.
• Own ongoing prioritization, resourcing and development of GSC's strategy and plan for assigned compliance workstreams as assigned. Monitor and plan for change against the Amazon Leo Business strategy and the regulatory landscape to scope and implement change. Anticipate and react to feedback/engagement in collaboration with GSC's execution teams to drive operational improvements.
• Plan GSC's roadmap and mechanism structure to ensure growth scales globally by leveraging foundational frameworks and automation.
• Be a subject matter expert and central point of contact for internal and cross-functional stakeholders to accelerate deliverables. This includes providing guidance and expertise to support GSC teams and stakeholders to unblock paths forward in their deliverables across assigned compliance workstreams.
• Own administrative functions for internal coordination, including function-based calendar management, workspace accesses, creation and maintenance of knowledge artifacts and support onboarding and training of personnel.

About the team Leo Global Service Compliance (GSC) manages the implementation and execution of compliance obligations that exist because Leo operates as a communications service provider. These compliance obligations are derived from various sources including license conditions, license commitments, and statutory obligations that may be borne out of regulation, orders, and extra-judicial actions and cover a wide variety of subject matter areas including (but not limited to) consumer protection, privacy, network sovereignty and security, law enforcement requests, regulatory fees, network performance and availability, and marketing/advertising.

This position may be based in Bellevue, WA, or Arlington, VA, Earth. Some travel, domestic and international, may be required. No intergalactic travel is yet required.

- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Foundational telecom network experience

- 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

jobs.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Other requirements include experience with MS Office, MS Project and MS SharePoint. Experience with Tableau, KanBan, Playbook, SQL and systems integration a plus.

Amazon Japan's fulfillment network delivers tons of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. As we continuously work towards our mission of becoming Earth's most customer-centric company, we are looking for a new member who can deliver even more smiles to our customers with us.

As a Program Manager and member of the team responsible for standardizing operational processes, you will be in charge of improving and implementing existing operational flow management at JP Fulfillment Centers. You will focus on optimizing existing processes, implementing established best practices, and managing the execution of standardized operations. Through analysis and process implementation, you will propose improvements to existing processes and execute and manage projects while collaborating with various stakeholders across global and JP departments.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

わたしたちは、カスタマー志向をもち、新たなスタンダードをつくりネットワークに展開していく情熱と意欲をもったタレントを募集しています。

アマゾンジャパンのフルフィルメントネットワークは、アマゾンのカスタマーに毎日多くのパッケージと笑顔をお届けしています。アマゾンは地球上で最もお客様な大切にする企業を目指しており、一緒により多くの笑顔をお客様にお届けできるメンバーを募集しています。

Program Managerは、オペレーションプロセスの標準化を実行するチームのメンバーとして、JP Fulfillment Centerの既存オペレーションフロー・マネジメントの改善と展開を担います。既存のプロセスの効率化、確立されたベストプラクティスの展開、また標準オペレーションの実行管理を行います。分析とプロセスの実装を通じ、既存プロセスの改善を提案し、グローバルとJPの様々な部門のステークホルダーと協力しながら、プロジェクトの実行と管理を行います。

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

Key job responsibilities
The role ensures the reliable execution of processes at established standards within assigned areas. You will be required to identify improvement opportunities through analysis of on-site metrics, data, and understanding of operational conditions. You will be expected to optimize existing process flows and manage their execution while building and maintaining cooperative relationships with both internal and external stakeholders.
Some of the key responsibilities include:
•Design and implement: Identify opportunities to improve existing processes, optimize processes, and execute implementation
•Align and localize: Collaborate with global and local stakeholders to implement established processes in JP operations. Assist in the deployment of proven best practices according to defined guidelines.
•Change and standardize: Establish process procedures and management methods. Drive efficiency improvements and reinforce standard processes
•Control and Sustain: Ensure the execution of standard processes across the network, monitor implementation status, and provide necessary support to enable team members to execute standards effectively

Program Managerは、担当するプロセスの中で、定められた水準のプロセスの確実な実行を図ります。現場での指標やデータの分析、ならびに実務の状況の把握を踏まえて、改善機会を見出すことが求められます。既存のプロセスフローの最適化と実行管理を行い、内部と外部の関係者との協力関係を構築・維持しながら業務を進めることが求められます。

いくつかの主要な役割は以下を含むものとなります。
- Design and implement: 既存のプロセスについて改善機会を特定し、プロセスの最適化を行い、実行していくことが求められます
- Align and localize: グローバルおよびローカルのステークホルダーと協力して、確立されたプロセスをJPの業務に導入する。定められたガイドラインに従って、実証済みのベストプラクティスの展開を支援します。
- Change and standardize: プロセスの手順と管理方法を構築します。イノベーションをもたらし、新たなスタンダードを構築します
- Control and Sustain: ネットワークでの標準プロセスの実行を確実に行い、展開状況をモニタリングし、メンバーがスタンダードを確実に実行できるよう必要なサポートを行います。

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager, Firstmile management, JP AMXL Network Planning
jobs.description:
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Amazon is one of the most recognizable brand names in the world and we distribute millions of products each year to our loyal customers. Amazon has great opportunities to pursue a career as a leader in Operations Planning & Management. We know that learning through experience is what transforms talented people into great leaders. Our roles are designed to accelerate the growth of leaders through challenging field experiences that stretch individual capability. Our operations environment presents the candidates with great challenges in dealing with front line management, and driving scalable and continuous improvements across our Fulfillment Centers, Supply Chain & Transportation execution teams.

As a Sr Program Manager, Firstmile management, you will be the single thread owner in managing 3PL partner including cost negotiation, planning mid-long term network for AMXL Firstmile network, analyzing warehouse/network data for operational improvement, implementing new tech such as warehouse management system, trouble shooting of tech/IT with IT team and launch execution of new site.

You will be a part of the Supply Chain team engaging with leadership on getting it approved, and reviewing the plan vs actual, highlighting and mitigating risks on the way to see your work impact on real world business and end customer satisfaction.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

Key job responsibilities
- Manage overall First mile network including 3PL account management, mid-long term network planning, operational improvement including tech implementation and launch execution.
- Build strong relationship with 3PL partners
- Work in partnership with operations, SCM, product, tech teams to set optimal network plans
- Define a vision and plan to deliver it driving continuous delivery customer experience improvement by collaborating with stakeholders on design of new solutions that enhance business performance and achieve established quality and efficiency goals
- Understand and manage supply chain risks to minimize on-time delivery impact
- Support critical relationships with internal and external business partners

Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) JP team is a single threaded organization that owns Amazon's end-to-end Heavy & Bulky (H&B) logistics network with our willing and equally customer obsessed partners, offering shipping, service & support for consumers and companies in a safe, reliable, seamless, standardized, and sustainable way that surprises and delights our customers. Our delivery partners are experienced in H&B deliveries, providing special handling services such as Room of Choice Delivery, Installation/Assembly and Recycling/Haul-Away.

Our team is made up of a diverse group of individuals across operations, supply chain, tech, finance, planning, customer experience, business intelligence and program management that work closely and collaboratively across Amazon to constantly improve and scale our operations, always insisting on the highest standards and obsessing over delivering bigger smiles for our customers.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Amazon Japan Last Mile
jobs.description:
Amazon Japan is in one of its most exciting growth phases. We are rapidly expanding our core delivery station network at scale — and this year, we are also launching Quick Commerce and Sub Same-Day Delivery, two businesses that will redefine speed and convenience for our customers. With more stations, greater complexity, and an ever-increasing need for operational excellence, this is the perfect time to join our team.

We are looking for a Program Manager to drive delivery quality improvement across assigned regions. You will work at the intersection of data analysis and field operations, partnering with site managers to identify issues, propose scalable solutions, and raise the quality bar across a growing network. The improvements you drive will have a direct and measurable impact on millions of customers.

After reviewing your profile, our recruiting team will carefully assess your background and experience to guide you to the team that is the best fit for you. Below are the teams currently hiring for this role:

ACES Team
The ACES Team leads delivery quality improvement initiatives across delivery stations nationwide in Japan through data analysis and close collaboration with field operations. In this role, you will focus on improving delivery quality metrics and optimizing operations within an assigned region (e.g., Kanto, Kansai). Your work will involve designing and executing improvement measures through data-driven decision-making, driving the introduction and standardization of new systems and processes, and solving operational challenges in close partnership with on-the-ground teams.

Launch Team
The Launch Team operates at the forefront of Amazon's global logistics network expansion. In this role, you will lead projects involving site selection for new facilities, layout design, and budget acquisition — collaborating with a wide range of stakeholders. You will have the opportunity to develop specialized skills across diverse areas, including launch planning, stakeholder management, and capacity optimization for the entire Japan network.

Operations Team
The Operations Team plays a central role at Amazon's Delivery Stations, which form the backbone of the logistics network. In this role, you will support the stable daily operation of delivery processes while driving on-site problem-solving and process improvement to ensure fast and reliable delivery to customers. You will lead operations in close coordination with various stakeholders.

Key job responsibilities
You will be responsible for improving key delivery quality indicators — including on-time delivery rate and redelivery rate — across multiple delivery stations. Through large-scale data analysis, you will identify root causes and prioritize improvement activities, working closely with site managers to align on solutions and drive execution. You will also establish standard work practices that elevate quality across your region and support the onboarding of new delivery stations as the network continues to expand.
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree
- 3+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
