jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, AWS re/Start, Skilling & Social Impact (SSI)
jobs.description:
As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon's unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers' businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon's real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use.

AWS Skilling and Social Impact (SSI) offers AWS re/Start as a workforce development program that helps adults build skills including AI and cloud utilizes AWS certifications to validate those skills and connects graduates with career pathways. The program is free to the learner and delivered through a network of third-party collaborating organizations led by the AWS re/Start Regional Program Manager.

SSI is seeking a dynamic organized and experienced Program Manager who is passionate about skilling and workforce development programs for underserved communities. This individual will join the AWS re/Start team and be focused on building the program and expanding offerings in the Western part of the US and Canada.

The successful candidate will be able to take ownership of the program in the region by sustaining an effective network of delivery organizations. They will earn the trust of the relevant internal stakeholders to support the success of the program across the region.

The candidate will establish solid working relationships with other Amazon teams in order to access local and regional funding mechanisms for workforce development identify underserved communities who could benefit from AWS upskilling and reskilling offerings and monitor impact and seek ways to improve effectiveness across the region. The candidate must have a collaborative work style an entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to manage multiple workstreams.

Key job responsibilities
• Own and grow the AWS re/Start program across the Western US and Canada sustaining an effective network of third-party delivery organizations that run the program at scale.
• Build and manage relationships with collaborating delivery organizations-onboarding enabling and supporting them to deliver high-quality skilling outcomes for underserved communities.
• Establish solid working relationships with internal AWS stakeholders and other Amazon teams to access local and regional funding mechanisms for workforce development.
• Partner with AWS public sector and commercial account teams customers and Partners to identify opportunities to introduce adult skilling programs as a solution to customer needs.
• Identify underserved communities that could benefit from AWS upskilling and reskilling offerings and connect graduates with career pathways.
• Monitor program impact track outcomes and continuously seek ways to improve effectiveness across the region.
• Manage multiple concurrent workstreams with an entrepreneurial collaborative approach earning trust across internal and external stakeholders.

A day in the life
• Use local knowledge to deepen stakeholder network externally and deepen funding channels across public bodies charities and corporate organizations • Engage with AWS account teams in public sector and commercial organizations as well as externally with AWS customers and Partners to identify opportunities to introduce adult skilling programs as a solution to customer needs • Serve as the key AWS point of contact for collaborating organizations answering questions and directing collaborating organizations • Work with local AWS public relations teams to showcase program opportunities and success

About the team
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

jobs.title: Security Tech Operations Manager, Amazon Security Hardware
jobs.description:
The AWS Hardware Supply Chain Security (HSCS) organization is looking for a Hardware Security Operations Manager who has a passion for security and the curiosity to analyze and report conclusions on the integrity of AWS hardware at any stage in its life cycle. You will lead a team of hardware security engineers and work alongside them, both doing the technical work and growing the people who do it. You will partner with professionals around the world to help assess and mitigate risks in partner manufacturing and logistics, contribute to new mechanisms for defense and response, and analyze the ever-shifting threat landscape to help us prioritize continuous improvement. You will have the opportunity to build and lead a team in a supportive, collaborative environment while helping secure the future of the cloud.

The HSCS organization exists to set the bar for AWS hardware life cycle security from design through end of life and drives durable mechanisms to meet requirements. If you have experience in areas such as modern semiconductor manufacturing and test, hardware/firmware analysis, or supply chain security, and you enjoy developing others, your expertise is needed more than ever and we are interested in talking to you.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader with experience diagnosing and troubleshooting electronics PCB assemblies, including proficiency with test equipment such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, X-ray systems, shredders, and decap tools. They will demonstrate strong analytical judgment in interpreting test results and applying findings, supported by a solid understanding of hardware security fundamentals. They will have experience leading engineers or technicians, setting priorities for a team, and holding a high bar for the quality of technical work.

Key job responsibilities
Lead, hire, and develop a team of hardware security engineers, including setting goals, giving regular feedback, and managing performance
Plan and prioritize team workload across projects, balancing customer commitments, operational needs, and long-term capability building
Perform hands-on testing, automation, root cause analysis, and engineering artifact generation alongside the team
Own the development and review of SOPs for operation, equipment, testing, and analysis, and make sure the team follows them consistently
Review and approve engineering reports with the internal team and internal customers before publishing
Serve as the primary point of contact for internal customers and partner teams on the team's work, escalations, and results
Define and track operational metrics for the team and report status and risks to leadership
Drive a security mindset and provide guidance across all functions and operations
Own audits and reviews of operational activities (for example cycle counts, physical security, and inventory management) and drive corrective actions to closure
Manage lab equipment, assets, and resources, including identifying capability gaps and proposing investments
Lead continuous improvement efforts that increase the automation and efficiency of operations

A day in the life
In this role you will lead a team that assesses risks to AWS infrastructure by validating hardware security controls through inspection and testing of devices across the whole lifecycle, from suppliers through decommissioning. You will split your time between leading the team and doing the work. On a given day you might review a test plan with an engineer, troubleshoot a board on the bench, walk an internal customer through findings, and meet one on one with a team member about their development. You will implement, refine, and execute testing plans that use both simple and advanced techniques, oversee their execution, direct revision and follow-on testing, and make sure the analysis and reporting meets the bar before it goes out. You will grow the team's capabilities to protect Amazon and its customers, working with security professionals across Amazon as well as supplier and data center operations teams to keep AWS infrastructure secure.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training and Career growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Basic qualifications:
- 2+ years of maintenance or engineering experience, or experience in Lean Management, Six Sigma and other operations engineer tools
- 2+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience, or Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in computer science or equivalent
- 2+ years of computer hardware troubleshooting and repair experience, or experience in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Networking Engineering)
- Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure, or experience driving collaborative projects from conception to delivery
Preferred qualifications:
- 2+ years of computer hardware troubleshooting and repair experience, or experience in similar technical or vocational roles
- Bachelor's degree or above in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, IT or equivalent
- Master's degree, or experience in hardware lab equipment such as digital scopes, logic analyzers, and soldering tools

jobs.title: Operations Manager, RIVR
jobs.description:
RIVR, part of Amazon is a robotics team pioneering Physical AI through real-world deployment and doorstep deliveries. Founded in 2024 as an ETH Zurich spin-off, RIVR developed wheeled-legged robots designed to operate in complex, unstructured environments such as stairs, gates, doors, and uneven urban terrain. We believe that achieving general physical intelligence requires solving real customer problems in the real world, where robots can learn by gathering rich operational data at scale.

RIVR is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that values every perspective. If you’re passionate about driving innovation in robotics and creating meaningful impact, we encourage you to apply and bring your unique self to our team.

As a Operations Manager, you will be tasked to oversee our RIVR’s daily operations at our Zurich site and ensure our business runs smoothly and efficiently. Our ideal candidate will be a strong project manager with excellent problem-solving skills, a background in autonomous logistics (ideally with a focus on the last mile problem), a deep understanding of business processes, and a commitment to driving continuous improvement. In terms of approach, we are looking for someone who wants to be hands on and work in a dynamic agile way to meet our ambitious goals for deployments and scaling. Finally, this role is crucial for optimizing our operational workflows, managing resources, and ensuring we meet our goals.

Key job responsibilities
Operational Process Optimization: help to design, implement, and monitor operational processes and procedures to maximize efficiency, safety, quality and throughput. Identify and address bottlenecks and areas for improvement in our flows both in the field and remote operations. Supporting testing and release validation processes in partnership with cross-functional teams. Ensure operational and testing spaces are organized including hands on managing the fleet of robots onsite.

Logistics: coordinate flows of robots and spare parts across business sites, including coordination with external shipping providers. Also, coordinate with the logistics needs of the R&D team at the Zurich site and operational teams elsewhere.

jobs.title: Fleet Operations Manager, Amazon Transportation Services
jobs.description:
Join Amazon Transportation Services (ATS) Mexico and help build our growing trailer fleet from the ground up. As a Fleet Operations Manager, you will own the daily tactical execution of Amazon's trailer fleet during a pivotal scaling phase; directly shaping fleet utilization, availability, cost-to-serve, and carrier performance. You will be the single point of contact for fleet operations: asset assignment, yard control, inspections, preventive maintenance, carrier coordination, and incident response. Working cross-functionally with First and Middle Mile site teams, Finance, and carrier partners, you will keep the fleet running reliably today while laying the operational foundation for the sites and regions we expand into tomorrow. This is a high-visibility, hands-on role where your execution and the data behind it inform decisions made at the most senior levels. This is your chance to help build and shape the future of our trailer fleet program from its earliest, most defining stage.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the weekly trailer assignment across sites and drive intra-week reassignments as demand shifts; making the calls that keep the network balanced under pressure.
- Run daily yard status reviews, classify fleet availability, and orchestrate relocations to maximize how hard every trailer works.
- Lead daily performance syncs with the carrier partner operating the fleet, setting the priorities and relocations for the day.
- Be the first responder for operational incidents and resolving within a increasing service level or escalating with a structured, decision-ready proposal.
- Coordinate pre-trip and post-trip inspections and drive preventive maintenance compliance to protect fleet uptime.
- Manage repair tickets end-to-end, tracking out-of-service units and return-to-service dates to minimize downtime.
- Build the daily operational reporting and clean datasets that leadership trusts to make scaling decisions.
- Design and tighten standard operating procedures for check-in/check-out and incident handling as the fleet grows into new sites and regions.

A day in the life
Your morning starts at the yard, one glance tells you which trailers are ready, which are stuck, and where the day's risks are hiding. You act before small problems become expensive ones. When a breakdown hits, the clock starts and you own it: coordinate the repair, keep the sites moving, resolve it fast. The rest of your day, you turn messy operations into the clear signals leaders trust to decide where we grow next. Every trailer you unblock sharpens how this fleet scales; from the sites we run today to the regions we're about to open. You help forge what comes next.

About the team
Amazon Transportation Services (ATS), a high-powered, dynamic team shaping middle-mile transportation execution and developing innovative concepts to enhance the ATS Network, now building and scaling Amazon's own trailer fleet in Mexico to drive the best customer experience, reliably and cost-efficiently, every time.

Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements in productivity and efficiency through data-driven decisions and analytical problem-solving. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Key Responsibilities and Job Elements:
- Support, mentor, and motivate your salaried and hourly workforce
- Lead large-scope projects with site and regional impact
- Build and execute productivity plans through forecast reviews, determining productivity requirements, and partnering with other Leaders to load balance
- Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises
- Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)
Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Operations Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.
Basic qualifications:
- 3+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
Preferred qualifications:
- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
- Experience managing a team of 2+ salaried employees and 70+ indirect employees
- Experience scoping, leading, and implementing process improvements through: Lean process, Kaizen, and/or Six Sigma.
- Demonstrated problem solving skills and analytical skills
- Excellent customer service skills, communication skills and interpersonal skills
- Track record of meeting or exceeding department performance goals
- A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain/Logistics, or a related field.
- Experience in: military, manufacturing, automotive, biotech, electronics, energy, instrumentation, machinery, defense/aerospace, medical, cosmetics, production, or distribution environments.

jobs.title: Data Center Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Manage a team that maintains cloud infrastructure for global data center operations! As a Data Center Manager, you will solve complex technical challenges and drive operational excellence across our global data center network. Manage high-performing technical teams that operate critical infrastructure. Develop and optimize processes to improve operational metrics. Drive performance to meet Amazon's rapid data center growth demands. Build strong relationships with internal teams and external vendors. Implement innovative solutions to complex infrastructure challenges.
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
Effective May 15, 2017, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States)

Key job responsibilities
• Managing and developing teams of engineers, providing both technical and leadership expertise and ensuring the highest levels of performance.
• Maintaining existing Data Centers
• Helping build and bring online new Data Centers
• Constantly improving all our processes and procedures. We believe there is nothing we cannot improve
• Assisting & managing relationships with external vendors & contractors
• Liaising with internal teams & management groups
• Ensuring we adhere to and exceed local Health & Safety standards in all our Data Centers
• Creating and maintaining metrics on all aspects of our Data Centers and utilizing those metrics to drive positive changes
• Assisting in implementing service methodologies including incident management, problem management, change management, capacity management, etc.

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.
Essential Requirements:
• Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
• Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
• Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility
Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.
Basic qualifications:
- Experience creating reports, interpreting metrics and driving overall insights or analysis
- Experience in vendor management
- 4+ years of experience in a data center technology role and/or 4+ years of knowledge in TCP/IP networking, network cabling, fiber, optic types, and test equipment
- 4+ years of experience in management/team lead function
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience with network hardware: copper and optical fiber cabling, switches, routers
- Experience in automation or monitoring frameworks, deployment or development
- Experience with Lean or Six Sigma analytical techniques
- Experience developing operational metrics
- 6+ years of data center design, construction, operations, or facility maintenance experience

jobs.title: Broker Operations Manager II, AWS Cloud Logistics (ACL)
jobs.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The AWS APAC Brokerage Ops Team seeks a motivated Brokerage Operations Manager to drive and optimize our customs operations across the region. In this role, you will lead process improvements, standardize operational procedures, and execute strategic initiatives while maintaining tactical excellence in day-to-day operations. You will operate autonomously in managing customs brokerage operations, developing performance metrics, and establishing best practices.

The ideal candidate will bring strong experience in logistics and transportation operations, with demonstrated ability to learn complex regulatory environments and troubleshoot operational challenges independently. Success in this role requires project management skills to lead operational initiatives, drive process automation, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders. This position offers opportunities to influence regional strategy and drive operational excellence within AWS logistics operations.

Key job responsibilities
VENDOR MANAGEMENT
- Manage customs broker relationships and drive performance improvement initiatives across the region
- Own broker performance metrics and reporting, providing data-driven insights for business decisions
- Coordinate and standardize customs clearance processes across AWS sites/programs
- Resolve complex broker issues and implement preventive measures

OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE
- Analyze operational data to identify and execute process improvements
- Drive cross-functional collaboration to optimize import/export operations
- Lead automation projects and implement solutions for recurring customs clearance challenges
- Develop and track operational metrics to enhance efficiency and reduce clearance delays

A day in the life
In this role, you will manage customs brokerage operations across APAC, working with key stakeholders including Transportation teams, Finance, AWS service teams, and Trade Compliance partners. Your activities include:
- Drive operational performance through daily management of customs brokers, resolving complex clearance issues
- Monitor and analyze clearance metrics, implementing solutions to reduce delays and documentation gaps
- Partner with internal teams to optimize documentation flow and ensure broker compliance with trade requirements
- Lead broker performance reviews and develop action plans to address service gaps
- Own performance reporting and analytics for regional leadership
- Lead process automation initiatives to improve operational efficiency

About the team
This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing, high-impact team. AWS Cloud Logistics manages a continuously evolving portfolio of shipments and warehousing operations through a worldwide supply chain. We deliver the right product at the right time, cost, and place — ensuring our AWS supply chain is reliable, scalable, and cost-optimized. The data governance function is critical to how we operate: every planning decision, every operational escalation, and every system automation depends on accurate, timely data flowing through our ecosystem.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Finance, or a related technical field
- 5+ years of hands-on experience in customs brokerage operations and international logistics
- Demonstrated expertise in customs regulations, documentation, and compliance procedures
- Experience managing cross-border shipments and resolving customs clearance issues
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience in data center, cloud computing, or technology industry operations is preferred
- Strong communication skills with ability to present information clearly to various stakeholders, including leadership
- Familiarity with customs management systems and/or trade documentation platforms
- Experience working in fast-paced, tech-driven environments

We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. - Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach

- Experience managing a team of 2+ salaried employees and 70+ indirect employees

jobs.title: Data Center Facility Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical technical leader who ensures the heartbeat of our global infrastructure remains strong and resilient. In this pivotal role, you'll be the guardian of our data center operations, driving reliability and performance while optimizing operational efficiency across complex technical environments.

Data Center Facility Manger role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including electrical support equipment such as stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems that include but not limited to switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAC units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire suppression systems, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: PDX is an AWS GovCloud region. As required by our contracts with the federal government, effective February 24, 2026, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States).

Key job responsibilities
- Oversee all aspects of the data center’s critical physical infrastructure. Maintain high availability and performance while ensuring that all work performed within the site is done to high quality without impact to internal/external customers and maintain service level agreements.
- Manage on-site teams of 24x7 shift technicians, sub-contractors and vendors ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures and safety protocols.
- Drive safety and security culture and compliance within the team
- Hire, coach, and promote team members. Responsible for team's career development and performance management

jobs.title: Operations Manager, Amazon Logistics
jobs.description:
At Amazon, we are always looking for highly passionate, driven, and customer-obsessed leaders who thrive in fast-paced environments and love tackling complex challenges. Our Operations Managers are the backbone of Amazon Logistics (AMZL), ensuring that every package moves efficiently through our network and reaches our customers on time, every time.

This isn’t just an operations role—it’s an opportunity to lead, innovate, and make a real impact on the way we deliver smiles to millions of customers. If you are someone who loves problem-solving, driving continuous improvement, and leading high-performing teams, this is the role for you!

The Operations Manager (OM) is a critical leadership role responsible for overseeing daily logistics operations, driving process improvements, ensuring safety and compliance, and leading teams to meet Amazon’s customer promise.

As an OM, you’ll be directly responsible for supervising a team of Shift Managers and their direct reports meanwhile, you will report to the Site Lead of your Delivery Station.

This role is available at our Bella Vista site and will be working 01:00-09:00 Monday to Friday

Key job responsibilities
- Manage and develop a team of Shift Managers and their direct reports.
- Proxy duties for the Site Lead.
- Review the operational forecast and determine productivity requirements the delivery station.
- Support all safety programs to ensure a safe work environment for all associates and Delivery service providers.
- Proactively identify and lead process improvement initiatives and Lean tools.
- Analyze shift performance against relevant business objectives, and put in place actions to improve our operational excellence.
- Manage resource (manpower) plan and oversee shifts patterns managed by direct reports including hours booking and staff holiday management.

A day in the life
You will be an inspiring leader within our Delivery Stations, where you will work to continuously improve the efficiency of delivery processes, ensuring that customer orders are delivered as quickly, accurately, and cost-effectively as possible. Along with your peers, you’ll ensure that all workflows run smoothly and that customer expectations are met.

About the team
Amazon Logistics (AMZL) handles ‘last mile’ delivery duties in partnership with third-party distribution businesses. We utilize creative thinking and continuous improvement initiatives to get millions of physical products into the hands of our customers. Our goal is to make our customers’ delivery experience as smooth as possible while focusing on continuous improvement.

There are two sides to what we do. Our ‘under the roof’ (UTR) associates process millions of products for dispatch to our delivery teams. Meanwhile, our ‘on the road’ (OTR) people ensure the safe and timely delivery of packages to our customers.
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- 2+ years of employee and performance management experience
- 2+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
- Experience hiring and developing highly effective and diverse teams.
- Experience developing and managing a high-performing team
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience with process improvements (Lean Six Sigma and/or Kaizen)
- Experience in problem solving and delivering results
- Experience in dealing with contingent workforce

United by our peculiar culture of curiosity, bold ownership and fearless initiative, we channel our customer obsession into making everyday impact—big and small.

Amazon Ads is all about helping brands reach the right audiences in the right places, without causing disruption. Our insights and solutions help advertisers interact and form relationships with customers. As a result, Amazon Ads empowers brands to achieve their objectives, with customers at the heart of every action.

Amazon Ads is seeking a Content & Creative Operations Manager to join the Event Content and Programming team. This role drives the operational backbone of our most high-impact event stages, managing content and creative workstreams from ideation through delivery. This includes stage visuals, sizzle videos, presentations, and supporting creative assets that bring our flagship events to life. The role also extends into content program workstreams such as speaker and talent management. This is a highly cross-functional role that sits at the center of product, marketing, sales, brand, creative, and production teams, along with agencies and external partners. This isn't a role where you run the same playbook year after year. We're looking for someone who actively uses AI to build smarter, faster operations. That means using AI to automate repeatable workflows like invite management, logistics tracking, and delivery status reporting.

The ideal candidate thrives in fast-moving, multi-stakeholder environments. They bring sharp organizational instincts, creative operations fluency, and the ability to hold the full picture while managing dozens of moving parts across content and creative deliverables.

- Use AI to build and maintain automated workflows for operational tasks such as speaker invitations, logistics coordination, asset delivery tracking, and status reporting

- Distribute regular status reports on event deliverables and flag risks early

- Familiarity with stage production workflows including visual content, video assets, and presentation development
- Experience with speaker or talent management programs
- Background in media, entertainment, technology, or advertising industries

jobs.description:
※このポジションの勤務地は福岡県筑紫野市のデリバリーステーションです。

Amazonでは日本のAmazon Logistics （AMZL）チームのデリバリーステーション・オペレーションマネージャーを募集しています。AMZLのゴールはお客様に荷物をお届けする物流の最後の区間、ラストマイルにおいて、世界水準のオペレーションを構築することです。Amazonではお客様により速く、正確に、そして効果的な方法でお届けすることで、お客様の期待を上回るサービスを提供することに重点的に取り組んでおり、日本でもAMZLが急速に拡大しています。
デリバリーステーション（DS）のオペレーションマネージャーは、出入荷、ソートオペレーションに対する責任を負い、大きな裁量を任される仕事です。センター長の右腕として、マネージャーレベルの部下を持ち、ソート（仕分け）やディスパッチ（配送ドライバーへの荷物の引き渡し）のオペレーションを指揮します。また、DSで働くメンバーのエンゲージメントを高め、日々のオペレーションの目標を確実に遂行することに加え、さらなる高みを目指してオペレーションの改善や新しいサービスの導入を進めていく改善スキル、推進力が期待されています。

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

Key job responsibilities
・ソートおよびディスパッチオペレーションのリードおよび監督
・シフト全体の安全性、品質、パフォーマンス、カスタマーサービス向上
・組織の方針と手順に従っての監督責任
・オペレーション目標の達成、および、それを上回る成果の実現
・物量等の予測に基づく、戦略的な計画立案、パフォーマンスの評価、問題の解決および人材配置に関するニーズへの対応
・チームメンバーのキャリア向上、指導、トレーニングおよび育成
・Learning and Talent Developmentチームとのパートナーシップにより、人材の獲得、パフォーマンスとキャリア開発、育成、サクセッションプランに関する計画の立案と実行
・シフトとネットワーク全体にわたってのベストプラクティスの創出・展開
このポジションに求められるのは、経験に裏打ちされたプロセスの改善能力と、アマゾンの成長速度に合わせ、メンバーのモチベーションを高めながらさまざまなチャレンジに対して短期間で成果を出していく能力を持つ候補者です。また、さまざまな経験、バックグラウンドを持つ多様なメンバーと協業していく柔軟性が求められます。
まだ若い組織であり、組織やビジネスとともに成長できる高い意欲とポテンシャルをもった方を求めています。

jobs.title: Sales Operations Manager
jobs.description:
IL EXISTE UN UNIVERS D'OPPORTUNITÉS CHEZ AMAZON

Chez Amazon, votre carrière ne suit pas une ligne droite. Elle accélère, prend des tournures que vous n'auriez jamais imaginées. Dès le moment où vous nous rejoignez, vous faites partie de quelque chose de grand : concevoir des produits ou des services qui touchent des millions de personnes et façonner la manière dont les gens vivent, travaillent et se connectent au quotidien. C'est ici que vos idées se transforment en impact concret.
Vous travaillerez avec des outils de classe mondiale, des plateformes internationales et des systèmes conçus pour fonctionner à grande échelle . Vous avancerez rapidement, expérimenterez et lancerez des solutions qui comptent. Avec d'innombrables opportunités d'explorer différentes équipes et fonctions, vous apprendrez vite, appliquerez vos connaissances et découvrirez des compétences que vous ne soupçonniez pas. C'est un environnement conçu pour les bâtisseurs qui veulent voir l'impact de leur travail dans le monde. Prêt(e) à vivre l'aventure ?

QU'EST-CE QUE CELA VOUS APPORTE ?

Avec des équipes présentes dans tout l'univers Amazon, vous n'avez pas à choisir une voie trop tôt. Vous prendrez des responsabilités, développerez de nouvelles compétences et construirez une carrière qui évolue à mesure que vous évoluez.
Le/La Partner Operations Manager assistera le/la responsable pays sur tous les aspects de l'installation et de la maintenance des produits en France, à mesure que nous poursuivons le développement de l'activité. Le/La candidat(e) retenu(e) établira et entretiendra des relations solides avec les partenaires internes et externes – notamment les prestataires de services, les partenaires hôtes, les équipes technologiques et de gestion de produits, ainsi que l'équipe locale de développement commercial.
La personne devra faire preuve à la fois d'esprit analytique et de créativité, en cherchant des moyens d'améliorer les produits, les processus et les outils, et en concrétisant ces idées. De solides compétences relationnelles sont également importantes, car le poste implique des interactions fréquentes avec les dirigeants d'Amazon et ses entreprises partenaires.
Amazon a ouvert ses portes virtuelles en 1995 et s'efforce d'être l'entreprise la plus centrée sur le client au monde, où les clients peuvent trouver et découvrir tout ce qu'ils pourraient souhaiter acheter en ligne. Amazon Hub PARP (Pick-up And Returns Points – Points de Retrait et de Retour) est en pleine croissance et nous travaillons à créer une expérience de livraison de classe mondiale pour les clients grâce à des options de livraison alternatives – casiers (lockers) et points de retrait. Si vous êtes passionné(e) par les opérations de livraison et que vous savez anticiper pour mieux servir les clients, nous avons besoin de votre aide. Si cela vous enthousiasme, venez construire l'avenir avec nous !

Key job responsibilities
PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITÉS DU POSTE

Leadership stratégique et opérations

• Piloter de bout en bout l'installation, la maintenance et les opérations post-installation (retrait, mise hors service, déplacements, redimensionnement) des Points de Retrait et de Retour sur les marchés assignés.
• Mener des projets stratégiques, notamment le lancement de nouveaux produits (casiers Gen5), l'expansion géographique et l'amélioration des processus, en cohérence avec les objectifs de l'entreprise.

Gestion des fournisseurs et prestataires

• Gérer des relations fournisseurs complexes dans les services d'installation et de maintenance, en négociant les contrats pour atteindre un taux de conformité aux SLA (accords de niveau de service) de 90 % et plus.
• Développer stratégiquement la capacité des fournisseurs, en assurant une redondance sur les services critiques tout en réduisant les coûts.

Optimisation des processus et automatisation

• Tirer parti des outils d'IA et des solutions à faible codage (low-code/no-code) pour rationaliser les processus opérationnels, en visant des gains de productivité de 15 à 30 % grâce à l'automatisation.

Gestion financière

• Gérer les finances du programme, y compris les bons de commande, le traitement des factures et la responsabilité du P&L (compte de résultat) pour les centres de coûts assignés.
• Travailler dans le cadre des budgets alloués tout en identifiant des opportunités d'économies grâce à l'optimisation des fournisseurs et à l'amélioration des processus.

Gestion et influence des parties prenantes

• Collaborer avec des équipes transverses (Ventes aux entreprises, Qualité, Produit/Tech, Finance, Marketing) pour soutenir les objectifs de l'entreprise.
• Influencer les parties prenantes internes et externes grâce à des analyses fondées sur les données et à des recommandations stratégiques.

Analyse des données et gestion de la performance

• Réaliser des analyses approfondies pour identifier les causes profondes des problèmes opérationnels et les opportunités d'amélioration.
• Suivre et rendre compte des indicateurs clés de performance (KPI), notamment les objectifs de disponibilité de 99 % et plus, le DPMO (Défauts par million d'opportunités), le FTDS (Taux de livraison réussie au premier passage), le temps de cycle et la performance des coûts.
• Mettre en place des tableaux de bord et des mécanismes d'alerte pour signaler de manière proactive toute dégradation de la performance.

Excellence opérationnelle et conduite du changement

• Maintenir la fiabilité du réseau grâce à des stratégies de maintenance proactives et à des mécanismes de contrôle qualité.
• Diriger les équipes lors des transformations opérationnelles, des mises en œuvre de nouvelles technologies et des refontes de processus.
• Favoriser l'adaptabilité face aux évolutions rapides de l'activité et aux exigences de montée en charge.
Basic qualifications:
- Diplôme de niveau licence en chaîne d'approvisionnement (supply chain), commerce ou gestion, ingénierie, finance ou dans un domaine technique ou quantitatif connexe.
- Maîtrise du français à l'écrit comme à l'oral.
- Maîtrise de l'anglais à l'écrit comme à l'oral.
- Expérience en opérations, chaîne d'approvisionnement (supply chain), logistique ou gestion de projet (les stages sont pris en compte).
- Connaissance des interactions avec les fournisseurs ou prestataires.
- Expérience de l'analyse de données (par exemple Excel, SQL ou outils de BI) pour identifier des tendances ou des problèmes opérationnels.
Preferred qualifications:
- Diplôme de niveau master en ingénierie, administration des affaires, gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement (supply chain) ou domaine connexe.
- Exposition aux processus de gestion des fournisseurs, y compris le suivi des SLA (accords de niveau de service) et le reporting de la performance.
- Intérêt pour, ou première expérience avec, les outils d'IA, l'automatisation ou les solutions à faible codage (low-code/no-code) pour améliorer les flux de travail ou la productivité.
- Expérience de contribution à des projets transverses impliquant des lancements de produits, une expansion géographique ou une refonte des processus.

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. La protection de votre vie privée et la sécurité de vos données constituent depuis longtemps une priorité absolue pour Amazon. jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Job summary
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements in productivity and efficiency through data-driven decisions and analytical problem-solving. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Key Responsibilities and Job Elements:
- Support, mentor, and motivate your salaried and hourly workforce
- Lead large-scope projects with site and regional impact
- Build and execute productivity plans through forecast reviews, determining productivity requirements, and partnering with other Leaders to load balance
- Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises
- Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)
Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Operations Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.
Basic qualifications:
- 3+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
Preferred qualifications:
- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
- Experience managing a team of 2+ salaried employees and 70+ indirect employees
- Experience scoping, leading, and implementing process improvements through: Lean process, Kaizen, and/or Six Sigma.
- Demonstrated problem solving skills and analytical skills
- Excellent customer service skills, communication skills and interpersonal skills
- Track record of meeting or exceeding department performance goals
- A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain/Logistics, or a related field.
- Experience in: military, manufacturing, automotive, biotech, electronics, energy, instrumentation, machinery, defense/aerospace, medical, cosmetics, production, or distribution environments.

jobs.title: Sr. Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Help shape the future of fulfillment alongside passionate, talented people who are obsessed with delivering for customers. As a Senior Operations Manager at our Charlton, MA Fulfillment Center, you'll be at the helm of a large-scale operation that delivers for millions of Amazon customers every day. This is your opportunity to lead, innovate, and make a measurable impact on one of the world's most customer-obsessed supply chains.

What You'll Do
• Own the operation – Take full accountability for budgetary performance, people development, and operational excellence across your functional area (Inbound or Outbound).
• Lead and develop leaders – Manage, coach, and mentor a team of Operations and Area Managers, setting clear expectations and holding them accountable while building the next generation of Amazon leaders.
• Drive continuous improvement – Champion Lean initiatives, process innovations, and quality programs that push your team and the FC to exceed business goals.
• Deliver a world-class customer experience – Ensure safety, quality, and performance standards are met or exceeded every single day.
• Collaborate cross-functionally – Partner with HR, Finance, Facilities, Safety, IT, and peer leaders to secure resources, share best practices, and drive site-wide success.
• Cultivate ideas – Source and nurture innovative ideas from your team, translating them into actionable improvement plans that raise the bar across the network.
• Share best practices – Take proactive steps to ensure best practices are shared across all departments, shifts, and the broader network.

Additional Job Elements to this hands-on Leadership Role:
• Lift and move totes up to 49 pounds each
• Regular bending, lifting, stretching and reaching both below the waist and above the head
• Walking in the FC and around area with great frequency; facilities are over a quarter mile in length
• Continual standing and/or walking an average of 5 miles daily
• Ability to work in construction /distribution environments that may be noisy, unlit, unheated, not air-conditioned
• Able to access all areas of building (ascending and descending ladders, stairs, gangways safely and without limitation)
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of equivalent experience
- 7+ years direct management experience, including a salaried workforce, in a manufacturing, production or distribution environment.
- Prior experience with performance metrics, process improvement and Lean techniques.
- Prior experience with the full staffing lifecycle, including interviewing, hiring, performance management, promotions and termination.
Preferred qualifications:
- Degree in Engineering, Operations or related field and MBA preferred
- Experience with a contingent workforce during peak seasons
- Ability to handle changing priorities and use good judgment in stressful situations
- Interest in long-term career development through assignments in multiple FCs across the nation

jobs.title: Data Center Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Manage a team that maintains cloud infrastructure for global data center operations!
AWS is looking for technology managers with experience in people management, strong technical understanding and the drive and vision to take AWS Data Center Operations to the next level. The successful candidate will have experience creating/devising strategies, mentoring people at all levels, sponsoring projects, and proposing technical solutions. This position involves leading teams in hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair and includes participation in an on-call rotation.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities
The successful candidate will be operationally responsible for a Data Center. Some high-level responsibilities include:
- Prioritize and assign trouble tickets to data center technicians and operators
- Manage the performance of a diverse team(s) of data center operation professionals with varying skills across different locations
- Developing Career Paths for the employees and to make updates in our internal tools.
- Recruit and train data technicians to ensure appropriate staffing levels
- Ensure effective and efficient management of day to day data center operations including queue management, 7/24 shift arrangement and hardware logistics
- Fast learn or act as the subject matter expert across all aspects in data center operations
- Ensure all operational KPIs and metrics are being measured and met
- Inspire and guide improvement in team process, technology innovation and automation
- Manage Large Scale Events (outages) and act as the call leader
- Manage and improve the work-flows and through-put for data centers operations
- Recommend, document, and oversee policies and procedures to meet industry best practices and to meet required SLAs
- Maintain the on-call schedule coordinating absence and vacations
- Be passionate about the quality and quantity of services being provided, and continuously strive to improve our Customer Experience
This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.
Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility
Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a fast paced technology company and a leader in the world of data centers. The position will help ensure overall availability and reliability to meet or exceed defined service levels of data center operations. We are currently expanding our infrastructure management team and are looking for technology managers with experience in people management, strong technical understanding and the drive and vision to take AWS Data Center Operations to the next level.

The successful candidate will have experience creating/devising strategies, mentoring people in all levels, sponsoring projects and proposing technical solutions. This position involves leading teams in hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair and includes participation in an on-call rotation. All candidates should be willing to work both independently and managing their teams effectively. Work prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful. In addition to strong knowledge in Data Centers, hardware and network repair, candidates will create documentation, innovate solutions, participate in site-level project work, and fix complex problems within the Data Center Space. This team works in an environment that operates 24/7.
Basic qualifications:
- 4+ years of Information Technology (IT) experience, or Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
- 2+ years of people management experience
- 2+ years of operations and on-call support for data center facilities, mission critical plants, or production facilities experience
Preferred qualifications:
- 2+ years of computer hardware experience, including troubleshooting and repairing experience
- Experience in technical writing in a relevant field
- certification in an applicable field like A+, Net+, Sec+, CCNA, LPIC, Linux+, AWS certification, or A+ or CND (Certified Network Defender) or Network+ or Security+
- Experience with system management tools and client/server environments

jobs.title: Transportation Operations Manager
jobs.description:
At Amazon, we are working to become the most customer-centric company in the world. To achieve this, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Amazon is one of the most recognized brands in the world, and we ship over one billion packages each year to our loyal customers. The Transportation Operations Management (TOM) Team is looking for a Transportation Operations Manager. If you thrive in a demanding and dynamic environment, we could be the ideal partner for you. We don't like to stand still, which is why we treat every day as if it were Day One. This is the kind of spirit that drives our success today and in the future. And you could be part of it.

The Transportation Operations Manager is responsible for managing yard operations in coordination with the site's Dock, Inbound, and Outbound teams to ensure first in, first out (FIFO) processing and mitigate risks of impact on the customer experience. The ideal candidate has experience in transportation operations and excellent project management skills. They have the ability to lead and mentor people, analyze data, and make relevant recommendations in an often ambiguous environment. One of the key responsibilities of this role is to standardize and improve processes while analyzing and eliminating root causes of defects in current systems. This position requires exceptional communication skills and the ability to influence change.

The applicable collective agreement (CCNL) for this role is Logistica, Trasporto Merci e Spedizione. The position is classified at Level 1 or above, depending on the candidate’s skills, competences and experience.

Key job responsibilities
- Collaborate with Site leadership to improve the punctuality of inbound and outbound trucks, as well as safety and customer experience metrics
- Streamline communication between the Site, the Network Operations Center, and carriers to optimize truck flow in the yard, ensuring on-time arrivals and departures
- Responsible for reporting yard performance to local Site leadership, identifying root causes of structural issues, and driving resolution with multiple stakeholders
- Support all site safety and compliance programs to ensure a safe working environment for associates in the yard
- Proactively identify and lead process improvement initiatives and Lean tool implementation
- Work within various time constraints to meet critical business needs while measuring and identifying completed activities
- Ability to develop standard procedures and share best practices with our global transportation operations teams
- Ability to work some weekends and/or nights as needed (this team provides tactical support to Amazon's logistics network)

A day in the life
You will be responsible for the motivation, engagement, and performance of your team:
- You will ensure the safety of your team by promoting Amazon's health and safety standards.
- You will lead cross-functional teams dedicated to solving operational problems.
- You will uphold Amazon's high standards for process quality.
- You will ensure the accuracy of information and adherence to operational standards.
- You will focus on improving and streamlining processes.
- You will become fully knowledgeable about the fulfillment center's key processes and activities.
- You will actively participate in sharing and promoting best practices with your colleagues and across the network.
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience managing teams
- Experience communicating with a wide range of stakeholders, including colleagues and leadership
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Italian
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience working with the MS Office suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) in a professional environment
- Knowledge of Lean and Six Sigma methodologies
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience leveraging technology and implementing lean principles / Six Sigma methodologies to drive process improvements or equivalent
- Experience in a logistics/operations environment
- Experience with SQL and Access

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Job summary
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements in productivity and efficiency through data-driven decisions and analytical problem-solving. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

- Support, mentor, and motivate your salaried and hourly workforce
- Lead large-scope projects with site and regional impact
- Build and execute productivity plans through forecast reviews, determining productivity requirements, and partnering with other Leaders to load balance
- Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises
- Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)
Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Operations Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

- 3+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
Preferred qualifications:
- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
- Experience managing a team of 2+ salaried employees and 70+ indirect employees
- Experience scoping, leading, and implementing process improvements through: Lean process, Kaizen, and/or Six Sigma.
- Demonstrated problem solving skills and analytical skills
- Excellent customer service skills, communication skills and interpersonal skills
- Track record of meeting or exceeding department performance goals

jobs.title: Operations Manager, FC
jobs.description:
About Amazon
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Amazon is one of the most recognizable brand names in the world and we distribute millions of products each year to our loyal customers.

Amazon Operations
Operations is at the heart of Amazon business. We are known for our speed, accuracy and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. In these key roles, you’ll come in to help us exceed productivity goals and deliver against our customer promises. Our scale is expansive and our presence is growing. Our goal is simple: to offer the world’s greatest selection of products and services with the world’s best customer experience.

We are seeking an Operations Manager to lead a team in one of our FCs.
Your responsibilities:
- Managing an environment concerning the delivery of Amazon orders direct to our customers, subject to ever rising volume and complexity, operating on a 24/7 basis
- Managing day-to-day relationships with multiple stakeholders
- Driving operational goals and metrics for your area. Communicating the vision to your team
- Presenting operational metrics regularly to the senior leadership team
- Problem-solves for closing gaps between performance and goals
- Hires and develops top talent. Creates and implements a talent plan for the site including talent acquisition, performance and career management, learning and development, succession planning, and employee engagement.

Key job responsibilities
The Ops Manager, leads an operation for +65k packages. Leads a team of 7 managers and +200 Associates, being the owner of solving complex problems and making key decisions and escalations on behalf of their team. Fosters a Culture of Safety. Responsible for protecting service levels monitoring and improving drivers and associates performance.

A day in the life
This manager will be responsible for key metrics include, but are not limited to: Safety Metrics, Quality Metrics, Cost Metrics including lead Savings projects

About the team
Responsible for goals in an area where the strategy may not yet be defined. Establishes workflows, SLAs, and operational excellence mechanisms at the site. Sets the standard for effective Inbound management and is well versed in industry practices and technologies. Has a deep understanding of the business priorities and customer needs, and can proficiently translate those needs into the right solutions. Brings Operations perspective to decision making with strong business acumen (understands contribution to the business and partners with finance for cost-benefit analyses). Broad experience across functional and technical areas, designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining large-scale operations.

Inclusive team culture
At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work Life Balance
We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.
Basic qualifications:
- 3+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience in oral and written communication in English
- 8+ years of Strong Operations Management Proficient in Data Analysis
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience supporting hourly workforces of 50+ employees and leading teams
- MBA, or Master's degree
- 2+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.title: Data Center Facility Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical technical leader who ensures the heartbeat of our global infrastructure remains strong and resilient. In this pivotal role, you'll be the guardian of our data center operations, driving reliability and performance while optimizing operational efficiency across complex technical environments.

Data Center Facility Manger role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including electrical support equipment such as stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems that include but not limited to switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAC units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire suppression systems, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Effective May 15, 2017, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States)

Key job responsibilities
Oversee all aspects of the data center's critical infrastructure. Ensure that all work performed within the space is done to high quality and without impact to internal/external customers

Oversee the safety, security, availability, quality, and performance of the team, while driving a positive customer experience across multiple shift schedules

Manage teams of 24x7 engineering technicians and Facility Managers in all facets of their career

Engage in improvement projects, often requiring reaching out to a variety of support teams, and drive them from conception to completion

Ensure staffing levels are maintained and grow with expansions

Be actively involved in ongoing construction activities

Coordinate daily with a multitude of third-party vendors ensuring adherence to contracted SLAs

Effectively and efficiently manage the operations budget and expenditures
Basic qualifications:
- 3+ years of in industrial electrical or mechanical systems experience
- 5+ years of in a managerial/supervisory role with 5 or more direct reports experience
- 3+ years of electrical or mechanical experience
- 3+ years of engineering, installation, or startup/commissioning of electrical and mechanical systems experience
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience conducting interviews and making effective hiring decisions
- Knowledge of the electrical and mechanical systems involved in critical data center operations including systems such as feeders, transformers, generators, switchgear, UPS systems, ATS units, PDU units, chillers, pumps, air handling units, and CRAC units
- Experience communicating technical details verbally and in writing
- Can work in cramped spaces or in elevated locations while adhering to health & safety guidelines
- Experience hiring candidates, mentoring and developing employees in their careers
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field, or 3+ years of relevant work in a data center or other critical environment experience

As a Data Center Manager, you will solve complex technical challenges and drive operational excellence across our global data center network. Manage high-performing technical teams that operate critical infrastructure. Develop and optimize processes to improve operational metrics. Job summary
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance.
