• Partner with peer leaders within the NCD organization to create and perpetuate a true lifecycle approach.
• Support new activities designed to harvest and recycle components to alleviate supply chain challenges and maximize cost avoidance.

About the team
About AWS

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
At Amazon, we strive to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover anything they want to buy online. We hire the world's brightest minds, offering them an environment in which they can relentlessly improve the customer experience. Innovation and creativity are built into the DNA of the company and are encouraged at all levels of employment. Every day we solve complex technical and business problems with ingenuity and simplicity. We're making history and the good news is we've only just begun.
Amazon is seeking a motivated and experienced Operations Manager to lead a team at our IT Warehouse in Renton, WA. This corporate warehouse supports employees and IT operations throughout the Seattle area and across the U.S., providing direct asset replenishment, logistical support, and inventory management for Amazon's IT infrastructure.
As an Operations Manager, you will directly manage a team responsible for warehouse operations, owning performance, safety, quality, and productivity. You will set and maintain operational standards, develop your team through coaching and mentoring, and drive process improvements using data and metrics. You will function as the operational owner of your area — identifying defects, removing roadblocks, escalating appropriately, and ensuring your team consistently meets service-level commitments.
This role requires someone who can independently manage end-to-end warehouse operations, make sound judgment calls with ambiguous or competing priorities, and build scalable processes. You will partner cross-functionally with IT support teams, InfoSec, and program stakeholders to meet business objectives.
Our team approaches work as seeing no job as too small and no challenge as too big.

Key job responsibilities
Directly manage, mentor, and develop a team handling warehouse operations
Own safety, quality, productivity, and attendance metrics; drive improvements through data-driven decisions
Manage receiving, storage, and inventory control of IT assets and peripherals
Oversee picking, kitting, and preparation of IT assets for configuration and deployment
Drive restocking of IT inventory locations, vending machines, and supply stores
Ensure proper handling of returned IT assets in accordance with compute reuse, reverse logistics, and disposal processes
Manage preparation and packaging of IT assets for transportation in line with IT and InfoSec policies
Coordinate removal and recovery of IT assets from campus locations as required
Support new hire equipment preparation and campus IT support staff at new hire orientation
Identify and implement process improvements; build SOPs and standard work to reduce variability
Partner with cross-functional teams (IT Support, InfoSec, Facilities, Program Management) to meet business objectives
Must be flexible for schedule (able to work nights and/or weekends as needed) and able to stand/walk for 8-10 hours at a time.

A day in the life
You arrive at a warehouse facility in Renton, WA and start by reviewing operations — inbound demand, outbound shipments, overnight escalations. You walk the floor, check in with leads, and catch bottlenecks before they become problems. Some days you're balancing capacity across kitting, shipping, returns, and asset disposition. Other days you're driving process improvements, coordinating with logistics partners, or resolving escalations that need a decision now. You own throughput, SLAs, quality, and safety. You coach leads and make trade-off calls when demand exceeds capacity. The constant: every device shipped on time means someone can do their job Day 1.

About the team
We're Amazon's primary imaging center for North America — a warehouse team that prepares and ships every corporate laptop before an employee's first day. We process thousands of devices weekly across multiple imaging lanes and shifts. You'll work alongside engineers, technicians, and operations specialists who build their own tools, write their own procedures, and own their programs end-to-end. Our culture is hands-on, direct, and team-first. We value people who take ownership, communicate clearly, and look for ways to improve how things work. Every day brings something different.

- 3+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Experience managing teams, or experience in logistics
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
Preferred qualifications:
- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
- Experience with IT asset management, inventory control, or supply chain operations
- Familiarity with ServiceNow or similar inventory/workflow management systems
- Demonstrated ability to build and document scalable operational processes

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Der operative Geschäftsbereich ist das Herz von Amazon. Dieser wesentliche Teil unseres Unternehmens sorgt dafür, dass wir Bestellungen effizient erfüllen und versenden, damit unsere Kund:innen ihre Artikel rechtzeitig erhalten. Getragen wird er von Operations Manager:innen, die das Team zusammenführen, um an allen unseren Standorten hervorragende Sicherheit, Qualität und Produktivität zu fördern. Du koordinierst an Deinem Standort andere Manager:innen und erstellst den Betriebsplan, der Deinen Teams bei der Erfüllung ihrer Ziele hilft. Diese Rolle ist voll darauf ausgerichtet, die Operational Excellence zu unterstützen, um das Amazon von Morgen zu schaffen.

Key job responsibilities
- Leitung und Entwicklung eines Teams von Area Manager:innen
- Schichtleitung von Betriebsteams, Handhabung von Problemen und Förderung der Standortleistung
- Analyse der Schichten laut Unternehmensvorgaben und Umsetzung von Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung unserer Operational Excellence
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Support-Teams, einschließlich derer für die Bereiche HR, Finanzen, Arbeitsschutz und Sicherheit
- Gestaltung und Umsetzung von Initiativen an allen Standorten zur Verbesserung der Betriebsleistung

A day in the life
Du übernimmst die Schichtleitung an einem unserer Betriebsstandorte. Außerdem fungierst Du als Hauptschnittstelle zwischen mehreren verschiedenen Teams, u. a. den Finanz-, Sicherheits- und Betriebsintegrationsteams. Das bedeutet, dass Du die täglichen Betriebsabläufe an Deinem Standort unmittelbar beobachtest und gleichzeitig auch zu neuen Innovationsmöglichkeiten beiträgst.
Ein typischer Arbeitstag umfasst Treffen mit verschiedenen Geschäftsbereichen, eingehende Untersuchungen der Leistungs- und Risikokennzahlen für Standorte sowie Prognosen zur Vorbereitung auf unterschiedliche Nachfragevolumen. Weiterhin bietest Du Deinem Team täglich Mentoring und Coaching. Als Führungskraft unterstützt Du Deine Teammitglieder dabei, ihr Managementpotenzial voll zu entfalten.

About the team
Mit der Erfüllung unserer Kundenbestellungen (Customer Fulfillment oder CF) fing für Amazon alles an. Das Customer Fulfillment Team hat sich mittlerweile von einem Team von Buchhändler:innen hin zu einem hocherfahrenen globalen Team gewandelt, das täglich mehr als 1,5 Millionen Bestellungen bearbeitet. Das Team bildet die Grundlage unseres Geschäfts und hat uns bei der Verbreiterung in neue Regionen und Dienstleistungen geholfen. Mithilfe aufkommender Technologie sind wir stetig auf der Suche nach Möglichkeiten, eine größere und bessere Produktauswahl anzubieten – die schnell und erschwinglich geliefert wird.
Die CF-Teammitglieder sorgen als allererste dafür, dass unsere Kund:innen ihre Bestellungen mit der Geschwindigkeit erhalten, für die wir bekannt sind. Wir arbeiten in Fulfillment-Centern, die das Herzstück von Amazons dynamischem Betriebsnetz bilden. Unsere Fullfilment-Center werden manchmal auch als die „erste Meile“ (First Mile) bezeichnet – hier starten die meisten Amazon-Pakete ihren Versandweg. Wir unterstützen die Verwaltung eines dynamischen Bestands und ermöglichen schnelle Zustellungen rund um die Uhr.
In unseren Fulfillment-Centern sind vielfältige Mitarbeitergruppen beschäftigt. Es gibt zahlreiche Möglichkeiten für Menschen mit den verschiedensten Fähigkeiten. Einige von uns arbeiten mit physischen Produkten. Andere analysieren Daten und helfen unternehmensweit dabei, intelligente Entscheidungen zu treffen.
Basic qualifications:
- Studienabschluss
- Führungserfahrung und Erfahrung im Stakeholdermanagement
- Fortgeschrittene Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
- Relevante Erfahrung in der Verwendung von Daten oder anekdotischer Evidenz zur Begründung von geschäftlichen Entscheidungen
- Relevante Erfahrung in Produktions- und Lieferkettenbereichen
Preferred qualifications:
- Erfahrung mit Lean-, Six-Sigma- und Kaizen-Methoden
- Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Logistikumgebung
- Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit der MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) im beruflichen Umfeld

jobs.description:
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. - Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)
Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Operations Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

- 3+ years of employee and performance management experience

- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
- Experience managing a team of 2+ salaried employees and 70+ indirect employees
- Experience scoping, leading, and implementing process improvements through: Lean process, Kaizen, and/or Six Sigma.
- Demonstrated problem solving skills and analytical skills

jobs.location: Kemps Creek, New South Wales, AUS
jobs.description:
Here at Amazon we're currently seeking for experienced Operations Managers to join our Customer Fulfillment team at our Robotics Fulfillment Center in Kemps Creek.

This is an excellent opportunity to be part of the AU Fulfillment Center (FC) leadership team during its phase of expansion and growth, whereby you get to define the process flows and shape up standard work routines as the operations scale up.

As an Operations Manager, you’ll deliver inspiring, inclusive leadership for the teams you supervise. But at the same time, you don’t shy away from getting involved whenever necessary.

You’ll be directly responsible for supervising a team of Area Managers and their direct reports: meanwhile, you will report to the Site Lead of your Fulfillment Center. The quality of your leadership is key to achievement in this role: you’ll motivate and inspire your teams to do their best work, while planning schedules and activities that balance their needs with that of the business.

Another key aspect of your role will be to coordinate on numerous process improvement projects, with the aim of streamlining all activities, both for yourself and the team members you supervise. The ideas, innovation and leaps out of the status quo that you come up with could very well be rolled out across the Amazon network: this immense opportunity is yours for the taking.

Please note the shift pattern is set based on 4 days on and 3 days off, working at least one weekend day.

Key Job Responsibilities:
- Maintaining Health and Safety standards within your remit area, while promoting an inspiring Health and Safety culture on-site,
- Become a subject matter expert on specific, larger-scale processes and activities within FCs,
- In your inventory control and systems environment, you’ll handle timely data collection, updating operations metrics on an hourly basis,
- You’ll aim to achieve productivity targets, reduce cost per unit, eliminate errors and ensure a high-quality customer experience,
- Work closely with other support teams (HR, Finance, Facilities, Safety and Security, IT) on staffing plans, schedules and performance levels,
- Implement process change and contribute in cross-functional Six Sigma initiatives within your site and the broader Amazon Operations network.
Basic qualifications:
- Proven leadership experience in a similar, innovative logistics, distribution, manufacturing or fast pace retail environment with multi-site/store management experience,
- Previous experience in leading large, diverse teams,
- Experience in employee and performance management experience,
- Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written,
- Proven ability in establishing and carry out root cause analysis, and then extract and analyse the data you generate,
- Experience with performance metrics and process improvement and Lean techniques
Preferred qualifications:
- Completed Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain/Logistics, or a related field,
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities,
- Experience managing contingent workforce in a business with peak season,
- Knowledge of Lean, Kaizen, Six Sigma concepts.

jobs.title: Operations Manager (IDR), Incident Detection and Response, Incident Detection & Response
jobs.description:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

Amazon has built a reputation for excellence with a mission to be the earth's most customer-centric company a company that customers from all over the globe will recognize, value, and trust for both our products and our service. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is carrying on that tradition while leading the world in cloud technologies.

The AWS Incident Detection and Response team is part of the Enhanced Support Services (ES2) organization within AWS Support and is dedicated to offering eligible AWS Enterprise Support customers proactive engagement and incident management to reduce the potential for failure and to accelerate recovery of critical workloads from disruption. We achieve these objectives by working closely with customers to develop runbooks and response plans customized to the context of each workload onboarded to the service. Onboarded workloads are monitored 24x7 by a team of Incident Management Engineers (IMEs) to detect and engage customers on a call bridge within 5 minutes of a critical alarm.

Key job responsibilities
• Lead and develop a high-performing team of Incident Management Engineers across global regions • Drive operational excellence and customer experience improvements through data-driven decision making • Design and implement scalable processes and mechanisms for incident management • Collaborate with senior stakeholders to enhance service delivery and customer outcomes • Partner with AWS service teams to represent the voice of the customer and drive improvements • Manage critical incidents and escalations for enterprise customers • Own recruitment, development, and retention strategies for the team

About the team
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. jobs.description:
This position is for full-time starts at Amazon Japan in 2027.

Selection Schedule:
Application & Assessment Begins: September 2026
Selection Communication Begins: October 2026
Interview Begins: October 2026
Offer Extensions: December 2026 – March 2027

AMAZON OVERVIEW:
At Amazon, we take pride in hiring and developing the best. We are excited to offer MBA and master’s program graduate students the opportunity to launch big careers with limitless possibilities. Are you looking to become a leader in a global Fortune 100 company? Do you want to manage people, process, and technology in one of the most innovative operations environments on Earth? Would you enjoy the challenge of delivering a continuously improving customer experience to millions globally? If so, then the Amazon Pathways Operations program may be right for you.

PROGRAM OVERVIEW:
Pathways is a three-year program with graduation following promotion to the Senior Operations Manager (SOM) role. Through a series of intense, progressively challenging opportunities in the core of our elite operations network, we will stretch your leadership capacity to its full potential. The business lessons you learn and credibility you develop will benefit you over the rest of your career and help prepare you for future executive leadership opportunities.

WHAT TO EXPECT:
Step 1 - Start as an Area Manager, learn Amazon operations on the front line leading people and systems. Kick off your career by managing and directing 50 to 100 associates in one of our world-class fulfillment/delivery centers.

Step 2 - Progress into the Operations Manager role and gain experience leading other managers and teams of 50 to 500 members. Drive improvements in Operational processes and the end-to-end supply chain by working cross-functionally with technology and engineering teams across Amazon.

Step 3 – Promote to a Senior Manager position where you will lead through others to execute on regional or network initiatives. Explore a full range of Operations roles in Supply Chain and Transportation & Logistics.

Step 4 - Graduate from the Pathways Operations Leadership Development Program and emerge as a leader known for operational excellence. Your "Think Big" type ideas that will transform Worldwide Operations. Apply your elite subject matter expertise to lead a new business, project, team or an entire site in a specific region.

Key Responsibilities:
· Coach, manage, and develop large teams
· Partner with senior leadership to think broadly about solutions to the most complex business and operational challenges
· Engage and lead continuous improvement projects throughout the course of the program

Interviews:
Online assessments will be sent in September and interviews will start in October.

Locations & Placement:
· The position will be located in a fulfillment center or delivery station around Japan
· Must be willing to relocate at time of hire (position location is most heavily weighted on business need but will also consider individual location preference)

Amazon is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. For individuals with disabilities who would like to request an accommodation, visit https://www.amazon.jobs/disability/jp
Basic qualifications:
- Currently enrolled in, or completed a full-time MBA program within 24 months.
- 3+ years of full-time industry work experience.
- Business level fluency in English (both written and verbal).
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience in operations management, supply chain, logistics, or related fields
- Demonstrated ability to lead and develop teams in a fast-paced, high-volume environment
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Japanese at a business level or above (N1+)
- Track record of using data to drive operational decisions and improve process efficiency
- Comfortable working in ambiguous environments and managing competing priorities across multiple stakeholders

jobs.title: Pathways Operations Manager Intern – Summer 2027 (Nationwide Opportunities)
jobs.description:
Join Amazon's Pathways Operations internship and tackle real-world operational challenges at one of our dynamic facilities. Over 12 weeks, you'll be embedded within a state-of-the-art Fulfillment Center, Sort Center, Delivery Station, or Amazon Air site, leading impactful projects that drive immediate improvements while developing hands-on problem-solving skills alongside senior leadership. Your days will involve collaborating with operations teams to identify process improvements, analyze workflows, and implement solutions that enhance efficiency. You'll participate in cross-functional meetings, gather data to support your projects, and present findings to leadership. Beyond your core project work, you'll have opportunities to shadow different departments, learn how various teams interconnect, and understand how your contributions fit into Amazon's broader operations network.

- This program is open to external candidates only; current Amazon employees are not eligible to apply. The role appears on Amazon's internal portal solely for employee referral purposes.
- Candidates should be currently enrolled in an MBA or Master's program, and be able to commit to a 12-week summer 2027 internship.
- This role is for Pathways internship positions at Amazon operations facilities across the United States. Successful candidates will work with their recruiter to be matched to a site prior to receiving an offer.
- Candidates who apply to multiple Amazon MBA internship roles will only be selected to interview for one.

PROGRAM OVERVIEW: Pathways is Amazon's three-year Operations Leadership Development Program, designed to cultivate the next generation of senior operations leadership. Full-time participants gain high visibility with senior executives while tackling challenging assignments across diverse sites, technologies, and geographies — collaborating with cross-functional teams, taking on progressively greater responsibilities, and building a network of peers who become their professional community throughout their career at Amazon.

THE INTERNSHIP: As a Pathways intern, you'll spend 12 weeks embedded in one of Amazon's fulfillment, sortation, or delivery centers. You'll split your time between hands-on operations exposure — shadowing managers, leading gemba walks, and participating in business reviews — and owning a strategic project that you'll develop into a white paper and present to senior site leadership. This is your opportunity to experience Amazon's operations firsthand and demonstrate your leadership potential. Successful interns may be considered for a return offer into the full-time Pathways program.

Key job responsibilities
- Collaborate with senior leadership to develop and implement strategic operational improvements
- Lead data-driven projects that optimize supply chain processes and enhance the customer and associate experience
- Analyze complex business challenges and develop scalable, innovative solutions
- Engage in cross-functional teamwork to drive continuous improvement initiatives
- Contribute to operational efficiency and strategic decision-making processes

A day in the life
Your day will be fast-paced and hands-on, immersed in a live operations environment. You'll engage in site-specific projects, analyze operational challenges, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that directly enhance customer experiences. You'll work alongside operations leaders and frontline associates, gaining valuable experience in managing a dynamic workforce.

About the team
You'll join a site operations team that drives results 24/7 to deliver for our customers. Our site teams include Area Managers, Operations Managers, Safety and HR, and front-line associates, all working together to achieve operational excellence. Your site leadership team will mentor you in Amazon's culture of ownership and innovation, while providing opportunities to lead real process improvements. jobs.title: 2027 MBA Pathways Full-time Operations Manager (Nationwide Opportunities)
jobs.description:
Launch your career with Amazon by solving complex operational challenges that impact millions of customers worldwide. As an Operations Manager in our Pathways Program — designed for recent MBA or Master's grads ready to make an immediate impact — you'll lead cross-functional teams, manage people, processes, and technology, and drive continuous improvement across one of the most innovative operations environments globally. From Day 1, you'll work on real business challenges, optimizing operations, enhancing the customer experience, and implementing scalable solutions across our global network. This is your opportunity to develop strategic leadership capabilities while building expertise in one of the world's most complex operational environments.

PROGRAM OVERVIEW:
Pathways is Amazon's three-year Operations Leadership Development Program, designed to cultivate the next generation of senior operations leadership at Amazon. Participants will gain high visibility with senior executives while tackling challenging assignments across diverse sites, technologies, and geographies within our world-class operations network. Day to day, participants will collaborate with cross-functional teams to solve complex operational challenges, take on progressively greater responsibilities, and work on real business initiatives that directly impact our operations. Along the way, participants will learn from experienced leaders, participate in cohort-based learning sessions, and build a network of peers who will become their professional community throughout their career at Amazon. This program is designed to build global leadership capabilities and prepare participants for executive-level impact.

- This program is open to external candidates only; current Amazon employees are not eligible to apply. The role appears on Amazon's internal portal solely for employee referral purposes.
- Candidates should be currently enrolled in an MBA or Master's program, or have graduated from one within the past 24 months.
- This role is for Pathways positions at Amazon operations facilities across the United States. Successful candidates will work with their recruiter to be matched to a site prior to receiving an offer.
- Candidates who apply to multiple Amazon MBA roles will only be selected to interview for one.
- Annual Pathways cohorts start between January and July. This application is for opportunities with start dates in 2027.

WHAT TO EXPECT:
Pathways graduates may lead organizations of nearly 4,000 people, manage labor budgets exceeding $2.5 million per week, and oversee $1B+ in capital projects. Here's how the program gets you there:

Step 1: Area Manager - Hit the ground running by leading 50–100 associates on the front lines of one of Amazon's world-class fulfillment, sortation, or delivery centers. This is where you'll build your operational foundation — learning how to lead people and systems at scale.

Step 2: Operations Manager - Take on greater responsibility by leading and developing other managers. You'll drive process improvements and collaborate cross-functionally across your site, region, and network.

Step 3: Senior Operations Manager - Graduate from the program as a senior leader known for operational excellence. In this role, you'll lead through others to execute regional or network-level initiatives — whether that's launching a new business, leading a major project, or running an entire site.

SITE PLACEMENT & EXPECTED HOURS:
- Must be willing to relocate at time of hire. Placement is driven primarily by business need, with consideration given to individual location preferences.
- The role is based in one of Amazon's operations facilities across the United States, including fulfillment centers, sort centers, delivery stations, Amazon Air, return centers, or other warehouse environments. Successful candidates will work with their recruiter to be matched to a site prior to receiving an offer.
- This is a demanding, hands-on role where hours may vary based on seasonal peaks and operational needs. Candidates should expect to work weekends, holidays, and/or overnight shifts, with overtime as needed.

COMPENSATION:
Total compensation for Pathways Operations includes three elements: (1) Base pay, (2) Sign-on bonus (paid over first two years), (3) Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).

Key job responsibilities
- Lead, coach, and develop your team, fostering a culture of accountability, growth, high performance, and customer obsession
- Partner with senior leadership to identify and solve complex business and operational challenges, thinking both strategically and tactically
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing operational data, identifying inefficiencies, and implementing scalable solutions
- Make real-time decisions in a fast-paced environment, balancing competing priorities to meet safety, quality, and productivity goals
- Collaborate cross-functionally with technology, engineering, and supply chain teams to improve end-to-end processes
Basic qualifications:
- 3+ years of professional or military experience
- Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining, a MBA or equivalent Master's level education degree
- Work flexible hours as business demands, including overnight, weekends and holidays
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience successfully leading and developing a team of direct and indirect reports
- 3+ years of military experience
- Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining, an MBA in supply chain management, operations, engineering, analytics, or a related field
- Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining, a Master of Engineering degree in one of the following disciplines: Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Systems, or Computer Engineering
- Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline, particularly Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Systems, or Computer Engineering

jobs.title: Air Cargo Ops Manager, MX Air ATS
jobs.description:
The Air Cargo Operations Manager is responsible for building and operating Amazon Mexico’s air cargo gateway network, ensuring safe, compliant, and scalable operations across the country, and future airport infrastructure. This role owns end-to-end operational execution at air gateways while developing the capabilities required to support Amazon’s long-term Air network strategy.
The position leads gateway operations, third-party handlers, cargo security, regulatory compliance, and operational performance across multiple airports, enabling rapid network expansion while maintaining world-class customer experience.

Key job responsibilities
- Own end-to-end operational performance across cargo gateways, ensuring safe, compliant, and reliable execution.
- Lead airport operations, cargo handling, warehouse activities, and aircraft turnarounds to meet customer and network commitments.
- Manage airline, ground handler, warehouse, and security partners through clear performance metrics and governance mechanisms.
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives to increase throughput, reduce costs, improve DEA/OTP, and enhance operational quality.
- Ensure compliance with aviation regulations, cargo security requirements, dangerous goods standards, and Amazon safety policies.
- Partner with internal stakeholders to optimize network execution and rapidly resolve operational disruptions.
- Standardize operating procedures and launch readiness for new gateways, carriers, and cargo capabilities.
- Analyze operational data to identify performance gaps, implement corrective actions, and improve customer delivery speed.
- Serve as the primary operational escalation point for gateway performance, ensuring business continuity and successful execution during peak events and network expansion.

A day in the life
No two days are the same. You begin by reviewing the previous night’s network performance, operational KPIs, and safety metrics across multiple air gateways. Throughout the day, you partner with airlines, ground handlers, warehouse teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to resolve operational challenges, optimize aircraft utilization, and ensure on-time execution. You lead performance reviews, drive process improvements, and support new gateway or carrier launches. Whether responding to operational disruptions or planning future network capacity, your focus remains on delivering a safe, scalable, and customer-obsessed air cargo operation.
Basic qualifications:
- 5+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience working with and managing third party vendors
- Experience in transportation or supply chain within a high-volume logistics, manufacturing or engineering environment
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English
- 3+ years of program management, logistics, operations, supply chain, transportation, or related field experience
- Experience in transportation or supply chain within a high-volume logistics, manufacturing or engineering environment
- Experience managing airport gateways, cargo terminals, or airline ground handling operations.
- Knowledge of aviation regulations, dangerous goods, cargo security, and safety management systems.
Preferred qualifications:
- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
- Experience with data analysis and basic Excel skills

Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. As an Operational Manager for Books business, you will lead a team of hourly associates through the daily rhythm of digital book production—from printing through binding, finishing, and ship-ready packaging. A day in the life

Planning & Execution

Run the annual planning mechanism for the Amazon Partner Organization, covering territory and quota planning, process, policy, and tooling, and drive the onboarding of Partner teams to central planning tools including hierarchy and territory tooling.
Define and maintain the annual planning calendar, coordinating milestones across Partner Leadership, Finance, and central planning teams.
Develop and refine territory and quota allocation methodologies, ensuring alignment with business growth objectives and partner maturity stages.
Build scalable reporting and analytics to track planning cycle progress, identify gaps, and surface recommendations to leadership.
Stakeholder & Cross-Functional

Serve as the primary point of contact between Partner teams and central planning tool owners, translating business requirements into tooling enhancements.
Drive alignment across Finance, Partner Management, and Business Operations on planning inputs, assumptions, and outputs.

Identify and resolve planning process bottlenecks through data analysis, stakeholder feedback, and continuous improvement cycles.
Establish governance frameworks for territory and hierarchy changes, including exception handling and escalation paths.
Guide the organization through adoption and change management for new planning tools and processes.

Own data quality and integrity across planning systems, partnering with engineering teams to resolve systemic issues.
Evaluate and recommend tooling improvements to reduce manual effort and increase planning accuracy.
Deploy AI-enabled automation (Amazon Quick, Kiro, etc.) to keep knowledge current, reduce manual upkeep, and scale access without scaling headcount.

Strong analytical skills with a deep analytics background and experience with business intelligence tools
Sales strategy experience with the ability to manage ambiguity

Self-starter with a bias towards independent problem solving and a passion for identifying and eliminating bottlenecks

jobs.title: Data Center Operations Manager (Nights), Data Center Operations
jobs.description:
Manage a team that maintains cloud infrastructure for global data center operations!
AWS is looking for technology managers with experience in people management, strong technical understanding and the drive and vision to take AWS Data Center Operations to the next level. The successful candidate will have experience creating/devising strategies, mentoring people at all levels, sponsoring projects, and proposing technical solutions. This position involves leading teams in hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair and includes participation in an on-call rotation.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Effective May 15, 2017, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States)

Key job responsibilities
The successful candidate will be operationally responsible for a Data Center. Some high-level responsibilities include:
- Prioritize and assign trouble tickets to data center technicians and operators
- Manage the performance of a diverse team(s) of data center operation professionals with varying skills across different locations
- Developing Career Paths for the employees and making updates in our internal tools.
- Recruit and train data technicians to ensure appropriate staffing levels
- Ensure effective and efficient management of day-to-day data center operations including queue management, 7/24 shift arrangement and hardware logistics
- Fast learn or act as the subject matter expert across all aspects in data center operations
- Ensure all operational KPIs and metrics are being measured and met
- Inspire and guide improvement in team process, technology innovation and automation
- Manage Large Scale Events (outages) and act as the call leader
- Manage and improve the workflows and through-put for data centers operations
- Recommend, document, and oversee policies and procedures to meet industry best practices and to meet required SLAs
- Maintain the on-call schedule coordinating absence and vacations
- Be passionate about the quality and quantity of services being provided, and continuously strive to improve our Customer Experience

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

- 2+ years of people management experience
- 2+ years of operations and on-call support for data center facilities, mission critical plants, or production facilities experience
Preferred qualifications:
- 2+ years of computer hardware experience, including troubleshooting and repairing experience
- Experience in technical writing in a relevant field
- Experience with system management tools and client/server environments
- certification in an applicable field like A+, Net+, Sec+, CCNA, LPIC, Linux+, AWS certification, or A+ or CND (Certified Network Defender) or Network+ or Security+

jobs.title: Operations Manager - Lebanon, TN
jobs.description:
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements in productivity and efficiency through data-driven decisions and analytical problem-solving. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Key Responsibilities and Job Elements:
- Support, mentor, and motivate your salaried and hourly workforce
- Lead large-scope projects with site and regional impact
- Build and execute productivity plans through forecast reviews, determining productivity requirements, and partnering with other Leaders to load balance
- Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises
- Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)
Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Operations Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.
Basic qualifications:
- 3+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
Preferred qualifications:
- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
- Experience managing a team of 2+ salaried employees and 70+ indirect employees
- Experience scoping, leading, and implementing process improvements through: Lean process, Kaizen, and/or Six Sigma.
- Demonstrated problem solving skills and analytical skills
- Excellent customer service skills, communication skills and interpersonal skills
- Track record of meeting or exceeding department performance goals
- A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain/Logistics, or a related field.
- Experience in: military, manufacturing, automotive, biotech, electronics, energy, instrumentation, machinery, defense/aerospace, medical, cosmetics, production, or distribution environments.

jobs.title: Sr. Design Operations Manager, Amazon Ads - Brand Innovation Lab
jobs.description:
Brand Innovation Lab's TEX (Technology & Experience) design team is seeking a Design Ops Manager who can make the operational side of our team work as well as the creative technology side. You'll own two things: our operational excellence for campaign workflow that keeps projects moving and our global design system.

The TEX XD team is a group of user experience and interactive designers who move fast, juggle concurrent campaigns for major global brands, and operate with significant creative autonomy. You'll own the operational infrastructure that keeps that possible while also raising the quality bar through consistency, shared standards, and feedback loops that connect what ships back to what gets built next.

The design system is the majority of the job. It will serve most advertising campaigns and prototypes that comes through BIL across categories, markets, and platforms starting with Brand Store pages and extending to surfaces such as FireTV, Alexa and video. You'll partner with global stakeholders to define and operate our governance and standards that scale across all surfaces while staying useful to the designers and engineers building the work.

You'll report to the Experience Design Manager quickly becoming a vital team member who works cross disciplines daily.

Key job responsibilities
Own governance, maintenance, and evolution of the design system, including how designers and engineers contribute to it, how it's versioned, and how adoption is tracked.

Build research and measurement into the system itself feeding usage data, performance, and qualitative feedback directly into what gets built, deprecated, or improved.

Identify what's missing, propose what to build next, and prioritize the roadmap.

Scale mechanisms for workload visibility, capacity planning, and resource allocation across concurrent campaigns.

Evangelize the design system and the team's work through how you communicate, how you show up cross-functionally, and the processes you put in place.

A day in the life
Morning: you're reviewing incoming requests triaging to who has the right expertise for the campaign. Mid-morning, you're running design system office hours a designer requesting a feature for a component and needs guidance. After lunch, you're pulling adoption metrics and campaign performance data to decide which components need iteration and which are ready to scale. Then you're in a working session with analytics team, connecting their findings back to system priorities. End of day you join a sync with the Experience Design Manager about planning for next quarter.

About the team
Brand Innovation Lab (BIL) focuses on the conception, prototyping and execution of branded custom experiences across Amazon properties. This role sit within the Technology and Experience (TEX) team, working across emerging platforms and technologies to create innovative advertising experiences that drive campaign success for the world's biggest brands.
Basic qualifications:
- 6+ years of design experience
- Experience understanding needs of business and end customers and translating them into right solutions
- Experience gathering and analyzing large amounts of data and delivering continuous business improvements
- Experience with asset management, design workflows, or partnering with creative teams
- Experience managing design systems at scale (contribution models, governance, tooling).
Preferred qualifications:
- Knowledge of project management tools and methodologies (agile to waterfall)
- Experience working and contributing to project playbooks, building schedules, managing issues/risks, establishing communication plans and stakeholder management
- Experience in marketing, brand advertising, media sales, or online advertising and close work with senior advertisers and agency stakeholders
- Background in building dashboards or reporting frameworks for creative organizations.

jobs.title: Data Center Operations Manager, SIN InfraOps
jobs.description:
Amazon Web Services is a fast paced technology company and a leader in the world of Data Centers. We are looking for proven Data Center Technology Managers with experience in people management, strong technical understanding and the drive and vision to take Amazon.com Data Center Operations to the next level.

The company's infrastructure consists of various custom built and off-the-shelf applications operating on a variety of platforms and other major technologies. The successful candidate will have experience managing staff on a 7/24 rotating shift, Problem Change & Incident Management, creating & tracking expenditure, devising and implementing improvements, mentoring people in all levels, supporting Infrastructure projects and proposing technical solutions.

Key job responsibilities
- Management of the team of Data Center Technicians; this includes all aspect of people/performance/rotation management.
- Ensuring effective and efficient management of day to day 24x7 Datacenter Operations.
- Manage/Improve the workflows and throughput for data Centers Operations.
- Become a subject master in Data Center Operations.
- Ensure all operational KPIs and Metrics are being measured and met inside his/her Data Centers(s).
- Play a key part in innovation and driving automation within Data Center Operations.
- Be passionate about the quality and quantity of services being provided by the Data Center Operations team and continuously strive to improve our Customer Experience.
- Management of large scale events in the Datacenter(s).
- Part of an on-call rotation for Datacenter Issue escalations.
- Vendor management/monitoring vendor performance.
- Ensuring his/her Data Center is compliant with all relevant security policies and procedures.

A day in the life
The successful candidate will have experience creating/devising strategies, mentoring people in all levels, sponsoring projects and proposing technical solutions. This position involves leading teams in hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair and includes participation in an on-call rotation.

All candidates should be willing to work both independently and managing their teams effectively. Work prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful. In addition to strong knowledge in Data Centers, hardware and network repair, candidates will create documentation, innovate solutions, participate in site-level project work, and fix complex problems within the Data Center Space. This team works in an environment that operates 24/7.

About the team
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and Diversity conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

We are seeking an experienced Support Engineering Manager to lead escalations and incident management team. The ideal candidate will build and lead a high-performing team responsible for resolving critical technical issues across our satellite network infrastructure, while maintaining the highest standards of customer satisfaction.

You'll work closely with cross-functional teams including, Engineering, and Product teams to drive technical solutions and prevent recurring issues. Your team will serve as the escalation point for our most challenging technical problems, requiring you to balance tactical incident response with strategic improvements.
This position demands strong technical acumen leadership skills, and the ability to make critical decisions impacting customer endpoints.
Success in this role requires a leader who can thrive in a fast-paced environment, demonstrate technical expertise in satellite communications or networking (AWS TGW, VPC NETDEV), and maintain composure during critical incidents. • Establish and maintain continuous escalation support with balanced workload distribution across all shifts, including escalation matrices, incident response protocols, and resolution SLAs.

jobs.description:
Job summary
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements in productivity and efficiency through data-driven decisions and analytical problem-solving. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Key Responsibilities and Job Elements:
- Support, mentor, and motivate your salaried and hourly workforce
- Lead large-scope projects with site and regional impact
- Build and execute productivity plans through forecast reviews, determining productivity requirements, and partnering with other Leaders to load balance
- Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises
- Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)
Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Operations Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.
Basic qualifications:
- 3+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
Preferred qualifications:
- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
- Experience managing a team of 2+ salaried employees and 70+ indirect employees
- Experience scoping, leading, and implementing process improvements through: Lean process, Kaizen, and/or Six Sigma.
- Demonstrated problem solving skills and analytical skills
- Excellent customer service skills, communication skills and interpersonal skills
- Track record of meeting or exceeding department performance goals
- A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain/Logistics, or a related field.
- Experience in: military, manufacturing, automotive, biotech, electronics, energy, instrumentation, machinery, defense/aerospace, medical, cosmetics, production, or distribution environments.

jobs.title: Sr. Operations Manager
jobs.description:
The Sr. Operations Manager oversees all budgetary, people development, and operational objectives at the site. This role involves managing and leading a team of Operations and Area Managers, coaching and mentoring them to ensure performance objectives are met. The Sr. Operations Manager is also responsible for building and maintaining positive employee relations and developing leadership strength within the Fulfillment Center (FC). This position requires a strategic leader who can balance operational excellence with team development while driving results across all areas of the facility.

Responsibilities:
• Leads the development and implementation of quality improvement and process optimization initiatives, including Lean methodologies, to enhance operational efficiency within their functional area and enable the FC to consistently achieve and surpass business objectives.
• Responsible for overall performance of either Inbound or Outbound operation, including safety, quality and customer experience

jobs.location: Nova Santa Rita, Rio Grande do Sul, BRA
jobs.description:
Operations is the beating heart of Amazon. This key part of our business makes sure we fulfil and dispatch orders efficiently so that our customers get their items on time. We're seeking an efficient and curious ICQA Manager to take full ownership of our fulfillment center's Inventory Control and Quality Assurance (ICQA) department. Our fulfillment centers are fast-paced, high-reward environments where adherence to policies and procedures is key — and where the right type of leader ensures we deliver reliably to our customers while fostering a culture of continuous learning and innovation.

As an ICQA Manager, you'll make sure your area runs smoothly so we can meet our goals. You will lead a team that keeps our operations safe, efficient, and of the highest quality, while taking on projects across our network to drive productivity. We are looking for someone who embodies Learn and Be Curious — a leader who is never done learning, seeks to improve themselves and their team, explores new possibilities, and acts to discover innovative solutions.

Key job responsibilities
Lead and manage the full ICQA department — including Shift Manager, Operations Lead, Process Assistants, and associates — ensuring safe, efficient, and high-quality operations across the fulfillment center. Drive inventory strategies and execution to achieve department goals.

Own the FC quality strategy in partnership with the Site Leader, delivering results across IRDR, Gross Adjustments, Dwelling Inventory, and Concessions metrics. Lead root cause deep dives holding Inbound and Outbound teams accountable for defect injection.

Manage safety compliance (RIR, SIR, LTR), implement PXT programs and develop team members through structured 1:1s and Career Growth Actions. Cultivate a culture of ownership, excellence, and intellectual curiosity — encouraging the team to continuously seek new knowledge and better ways of working.

Analyze complex data to generate actionable insights, collaborate cross-functionally to drive continuous improvement, and contribute to Network-level Vertical Projects. Proactively explore new tools, methodologies, and best practices, embodying Learn and Be Curious in every aspect of the role.

About the team
Our Inventory Control team is the beating heart of Amazon's Operations. We are a diverse and dynamic team, made up of professionals who are passionate about logistics and innovation. We work tirelessly to ensure our customers receive their orders with accuracy and speed. Our environment is characterized by:

- A culture of constant innovation and intellectual curiosity
- Close collaboration with other operational teams
- Working with innovative inventory management technology solutions
- Frequent opportunities for learning and professional development

A strong emphasis on Learn and Be Curious — we value leaders who actively seek new knowledge, experiment with new approaches, and inspire their teams to do the same.

jobs.title: Area Manager , Operations Lead
jobs.description:
Operations is the beating heart of Amazon. This key part of our business makes sure we fulfil and dispatch orders efficiently so that our customers get their items on time. As an Area Manager, you’ll make sure your site is running as smoothly as it should so that we can meet customer demand. You will be leading a team that helps keep our operations safe, efficient, and of a high quality and taking on a number of projects across our network to drive productivity.

Key job responsibilities
- Create, oversee, and drive a culture of safety and wellbeing
- Analyse and implement changes to keep quality and productivity at a consistently high level
- Oversee projects to streamline processes, optimise productivity and increase quality of service for customers within your area of responsibility
- Analyse shift performance against relevant business objectives, and put in place actions to improve our operational excellence
- Work collaboratively with management-level colleagues to standardise shift practices

A day in the life
You’ll work on a shift pattern at one of our sites, making sure it is as productive as it can be. Your main focus will be to own and drive a culture of safety and uphold quality and shift performance standards. You’ll also oversee process improvements within your area and drive implementation. A typical day is varied, including everything from routine team management and daily operational responsibilities to process improvement and wide-scale operational contingency tasks. You’ll also be a role model and mentor to new managers.

Please note this role may require night shift working. Candidates are expected to be flexible in working hours across days and nights.

About the team
Customer Fulfilment, or CF, is where it all started for Amazon. CF has scaled up from a humble team of booksellers to a sophisticated global team which handles millions of orders every day. The team is the foundation of our business and its efforts have helped us diversify across new regions and services. With the help of emerging technology, we’re always looking for ways to offer a bigger, better product range – delivered quickly and affordably.

The CF team are the first people in the chain that helps customers get products at the speed we’re known for. We’re based in Fulfilment Centres, which are at the heart of Amazon’s fast-paced Operations network. Our centres are sometimes referred to as the ‘First Mile’ because it’s where most Amazon packages start their journey. We help to manage dynamic inventory and facilitate speedy deliveries round the clock.

Lots of different people work in our Fulfilment Centres, so there are plenty of opportunities for every skillset. Some of us work with physical products, while others analyse data to help everyone across the business make smart decisions

- Experience in people management and team development
- Experience engaging, verbally and in writing, with internal and external stakeholders to convey complex ideas in a clear, concise manner
- Experience using data analysis to drive business decisions

- Experience designing AI, Computer Vision, or Mapping products
- Experience within a distribution center, logistics, or manufacturing environment
- Experience working with the MS Office suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) in a professional environment

jobs.description:
Help shape the future of fulfillment alongside passionate, talented people who are obsessed with delivering for customers. As a Senior Operations Manager at our SAT2 building in San Marcos, TX, you'll be at the helm of a high-performing robotics fulfillment center that delivers for millions of Amazon customers every day. This is your opportunity to lead, innovate, and make a measurable impact on one of the world's most customer-obsessed supply chains. Be part of something extraordinary from day one.

What You'll Do
Own the operation – Take full accountability for budgetary performance, people development, and operational excellence across your functional area (Inbound or Outbound).
Lead and develop leaders – Manage, coach, and mentor a team of Operations and Area Managers, setting clear expectations and holding them accountable while building the next generation of Amazon leaders.
Drive continuous improvement – Champion Lean initiatives, process innovations, and quality programs that push your team and the FC to exceed business goals.
Deliver a world-class customer experience – Ensure safety, quality, and performance standards are met or exceeded every single day.
Collaborate cross-functionally – Partner with HR, Finance, Facilities, Safety, IT, and peer leaders to secure support and resources for projects and initiatives in your area, as well as providing needed support and resources for other staff initiatives.
Cultivate ideas – Source and nurture innovative ideas from your team, translating them into actionable improvement plans that raise the bar across the functional area.
Share best practices – Take proactive steps to ensure best practices are shared across all departments, shifts, and the broader network.

Additional Job Elements to this Hands-On Leadership Role
Lift and move totes up to 49 pounds each
Regular bending, lifting, stretching and reaching both below the waist and above the head
Walking in the FC and around area with great frequency; facilities are over a quarter mile in length
Continual standing and/or walking an average of 5 miles daily
Ability to work in construction/distribution environments that may be noisy, unlit, unheated, not air-conditioned
Able to access all areas of building (ascending and descending ladders, stairs, gangways safely and without limitation)

Fun Facts About This Location
SAT2 is an 855,000-square-foot Amazon Robotics (AR) Sortable Fulfillment Center is roughly the size of 14 football fields, where associates work alongside robots to pick, pack, and ship items smaller than a conventional microwave to millions of customers every day
Located at 1401 E McCarty Ln in San Marcos, TX, SAT2 sits on the I-35 corridor between Austin and San Antonio, making it a strategic logistics hub with easy access to two major metro areas
SAT2 launched in August 2016 as one of the earliest AR sortable FCs in the region, and has grown into a key node in Amazon's fulfillment network serving Central Texas and beyond
SAT2 offers public fulfillment center tours where visitors can see Amazon Robotics in action, with associates working alongside robots to pick, pack, and ship items
San Marcos is home to Texas State University, the state's fifth-largest university with more than 38,000 students, and was named the fastest-growing city in the United States by the U.S. Census Bureau in both 2013 and 2014
Founded on the banks of the crystal-clear San Marcos River, the area is thought to be among the oldest continuously inhabited sites in the Americas, with evidence of human habitation dating back over 12,000 years
The San Marcos River, fed by natural springs from the Edwards Aquifer, maintains a constant 72°F year-round and is a beloved destination for tubing, swimming, kayaking, and stand-up paddleboarding — and is home to several rare and endangered species, including the Texas blind salamander
The legendary Cheatham Street Warehouse in San Marcos helped launch the careers of country music icons George Strait and Stevie Ray Vaughan, and the city's unique downtown square features live music venues, restaurants, and murals earning it the nickname "San Marvelous"
San Marcos is home to the San Marcos Premium Outlets and Tanger Outlets, one of the largest outlet shopping destinations in the country, drawing millions of visitors each year
Numerous films and TV shows have been shot in San Marcos, including Boyhood, Friday Night Lights, Everybody Wants Some!!, and Idiocracy
Outdoor enthusiasts enjoy the Purgatory Creek Natural Area trail system for hiking and mountain biking, Wonder Cave for underground exploration, and proximity to the Texas Hill Country's scenic wineries, rivers, and state parks

- Prior experience with the full staffing lifecycle, including interviewing, hiring, performance management, promotions and termination

jobs.title: Area Manager, Operations
jobs.description:
Operations is the beating heart of Amazon. This key part of our business makes sure we fulfil and dispatch orders efficiently so that our customers get their items on time. As an Area Manager, you’ll make sure your site is running as smoothly as it should so that we can meet customer demand. You will be leading a team that helps keep our operations safe, efficient, and of a high quality and taking on a number of projects across our network to drive productivity.

Key job responsibilities
Create, oversee, and drive a culture of safety and wellbeing
Analyse and implement changes to keep quality and productivity at a consistently high level
Oversee projects to streamline processes, optimise productivity and increase quality of service for customers within your area of responsibility
Analyse shift performance against relevant business objectives, and put in place actions to improve our operational excellence
Work collaboratively with management-level colleagues to standardise shift practices

A day in the life
You’ll work on a shift pattern at one of our sites, making sure it is as productive as it can be. Your main focus will be to own and drive a culture of safety and uphold quality and shift performance standards. You’ll also oversee process improvements within your area and drive implementation. A typical day is varied, including everything from routine team management and daily operational responsibilities to process improvement and wide-scale operational contingency tasks. You’ll also be a role model and mentor to new managers.

About the team
Amazon Logistics, or AMZL, handles ‘last mile’ delivery duties in partnership with third-party distribution businesses. We utilise creative thinking and continuous improvement initiatives to get millions of physical products into the hands of our customers. Our goal is to make our customers’ delivery experience as smooth as possible and roll out global delivery solutions for our newest concepts, like Amazon Fresh, Prime Now and Amazon Restaurants.

There are two sides to what we do. Our ‘under the roof’ associates process millions of products for dispatch to our delivery teams. Our team is people-focused and supportive, particularly as lots of our people work through the night. We focus mostly on operations, with 24/7 shifts in most of our locations.

Meanwhile, our ‘on the road’ people work with Amazon Flex - a network of delivery contractors. Every year, we continually raise the bar for customer experience with new, innovative delivery services. We look for new ways to overcome industry wide logistics challenges and new ideas to reduce our carbon footprint, supported by a portfolio of cutting-edge vehicles (including Electric Vehicles) and technology to help us do just that.

- Experience in people management
- Experience working with multiple groups of stakeholders
- Experience using data analysis to drive business decisions
- Advanced proficiency in verbal and written English and Spanish

- Experience with process improvement techniques such as Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma
- Experience in warehouse operations and logistics or equivalent
- Experience using Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint etc.) in a professional environment

jobs.description:
AWS is investing €33.7 billion in Aragón, Spain — one of the largest infrastructure investments in the region's history. As a DCO Cluster Manager, you'll lead the build-out and operation of our compute operations teams in this rapidly growing region.

This is a senior leadership role where you'll own safety, security, availability, scaling, costs, and efficiency across a 24/7 operation. You'll lead the team responsible for installing, maintaining, and decommissioning network and server equipment — but your primary focus is people. You'll build and grow a high-performing organization of managers and technicians from the ground up, shaping a culture of operational excellence as the region scales.

Previous data center experience is not required. What matters most is proven people leadership — specifically, experience managing managers and developing teams through periods of rapid growth. If you've led large, complex operations and know how to inspire, scale, and develop leaders, this is an exceptional opportunity.

Key job responsibilities
- People Leadership: Build, lead, and develop a team of Data Center Managers and 100+ associates. Recruit talent, grow leaders, and foster a culture of ownership and continuous learning.
- Strategic Vision: Define and execute the operational strategy for the Aragón region, aligning with AWS global standards while adapting to local growth demands.
- Operational Excellence: Own all operational KPIs — drive process improvement, automation, and innovation to raise the bar on safety, availability, and efficiency.
- Scaling & Expansion: Plan and execute the operations component of new data center build-outs as the region grows, ensuring readiness from day one.
- Incident Leadership: Manage Large Scale Events and act as call leader, ensuring rapid resolution and clear communication.

AWS Infrastructure Services keeps the cloud running. We own the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure — the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling that give our customers continual access to the innovation they rely on.

In Aragón, you'll be part of something new. With a €33.7 billion investment driving rapid expansion, you'll join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, and operations leaders solving some of the most complex scaling challenges in the industry. This is a rare chance to shape a region from its early days — building your team, your processes, and your career as the operation grows around you.
