jobs.title: Operations Manager - Crest Hill, IL
jobs.description:
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements in productivity and efficiency through data-driven decisions and analytical problem-solving. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Key Responsibilities and Job Elements:
- Support, mentor, and motivate your salaried and hourly workforce
- Lead large-scope projects with site and regional impact
- Build and execute productivity plans through forecast reviews, determining productivity requirements, and partnering with other Leaders to load balance
- Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises
- Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)
Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Operations Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

- 3+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
Preferred qualifications:
- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
- Experience managing a team of 2+ salaried employees and 70+ indirect employees
- Experience scoping, leading, and implementing process improvements through: Lean process, Kaizen, and/or Six Sigma.
- Demonstrated problem solving skills and analytical skills
- Excellent customer service skills, communication skills and interpersonal skills
- Track record of meeting or exceeding department performance goals
- A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain/Logistics, or a related field.
- Experience in: military, manufacturing, automotive, biotech, electronics, energy, instrumentation, machinery, defense/aerospace, medical, cosmetics, production, or distribution environments.

jobs.description:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.

Amazon Leo are seeking a Marketing Operations Manager to own audience management, segmentation, and activation across Amazon Leo's global marketing engine. This role is the primary owner of audience management and systems, managing access, governance standards, and seamless activation across channels. You will enable Marketing, Product, and Leadership teams to reach the right customers with the right messages at the right time.

This is a high-impact role requiring both strategic thinking and hands-on administration. You will own and evolve audience management systems—primarily our Customer Data (Treasure Data)—and across our marketing tech stack, building upon existing foundations as new data sources, channels, and use cases emerge. You will design and maintain audience infrastructure, activation workflows, and governance standards, partnering with Marketing Operations, cross-functional marketing teams, Business Intelligence Engineers, and Marketing Automation teams to ensure accurate, actionable audiences across the full customer journey. As Amazon Leo's marketing expands globally, you will evolve audience capabilities to support new markets, channels, and customer segments, while managing health, roadmap prioritization, and scalability requirements.

Key job responsibilities
* Own the end-to-end audience management strategy for Amazon Leo marketing across B2B, B2C, and B2G customer segments
* Serve as the primary administrator and expert for the Amazon Leo Customer Data (Treasure Data), including data model design, identity resolution strategies, audience activation workflows, and optimization
* Build self-service audience segmentation capabilities and empower marketing teams to independently create and activate audiences through training, documentation, and scalable processes
* Design and maintain audience taxonomy, naming conventions, and governance standards while ensuring data quality and privacy compliance
* Translate complex marketing campaign requirements into technical audience definitions, segmentation logic, and activation workflows across marketing automation (Braze, Marketo, Adobe Experience Manager)
* Create comprehensive documentation, deliver training sessions, and build enablement resources that reduce dependency on technical teams for routine audience creation
* Own the audience management roadmap, prioritizing feature requests and enhancements in partnership with Marketing, Data Engineering, and Product teams
* Monitor audience performance metrics, conduct deep-dive analysis, and provide recommendations for optimization and refinement

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

A day in the life
You will spend part of your day improving the audience management architecture—designing better segments, refining activation workflows, and enabling new use cases in the CDP and marketing automation. Another part of your day will involve partnering with Marketing teams to translate campaign requirements into audience definitions or troubleshoot activation issues. You will also work directly with Data Engineering and BI teams to validate data quality and ensure measurement accuracy. You might conduct a training session for new marketing team members on audience segmentation best practices, or update documentation to reflect new capabilities. You will be a strategic and technical owner ensuring that Amazon Leo Marketing can reach the right audiences with precision and scale.

About the team
The Amazon Leo Marketing team is responsible for building a world-class brand and driving global demand for a transformational connectivity service. The Marketing Ops & Analytics team builds the systems, data flows, measurements, and insights that support a multi-LOB global business. We operate with the agility of a startup inside Amazon, partnering closely with Engineering, Product, Science, and global marketing teams to ensure our decisions are grounded in high-quality data.

- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements

- Experience managing and measuring marketing performance in various channels

External job description
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements in productivity and efficiency through data-driven decisions and analytical problem-solving. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Operations Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

-Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives

-Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach

-Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts

-Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud

Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where customers can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online.

By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience - Amazon continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform, driven by the spirit of innovation that is part of the company's DNA. The world's brightest minds come to Amazon to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.

Amazon Operations is the underlying fulfillment and customer service engine that ensures Amazon creates the same consistent, world-class customer experience every time. We are looking for high-potential, flexible, innovative, and forward-thinking professionals to join our Operations team in South Africa.

Key job responsibilities
As an Transportation Operations Manager you will be working with multiple internal and external stakeholders to achieve timely launches of new programs and capabilities, as well as deliver consistent, high quality operations outcomes for customers.

With strong Customer Obsession and a high sense of Ownership, you will utilize your skills to manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promise. You will collaborate with support teams including Safety and Loss Prevention, Engineering, Quality Assurance, Human Resources and Delivery Experience to develop plans to meet operational business objectives. You will partner closely with Fulfillment Operations, Network Operations Centre and Supply Chain, as well as external delivery partners to ensure smooth daily operations.

Roles and Responsibilities:
• Own deployment of continuous improvement initiatives for network standards
• Monitor and manage operations of assigned sites to deliver to execution goals and drive improvement
• Serve as a liaison between the internal and external stakeholders keeping in mind the objectives, limits, conformance and information privacy
• Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures, weather and volume peaks

A day in the life
* Review daily performance reports and work with sites and delivery partners to bridge performance gaps and implementing corrective actions
* Manage emerging issues that may risk delivery operations, putting in place mitigations to protect customer promise and delivery experience
* Prepare and contribute to weekly, monthly and quarterly business reviews
* Respond to customer and stakeholder escalations

About the team
South Africa Operations are a small, but mighty team powering our vision to be the most loved e-commerce store in South Africa by delighting customers with the best, locally-relevant fulfillment experience. We get stuff done upholding Amazon's Day 1 culture. We are committed to developing our employees. We invent in our communities and innovate continuously. When we fail, we do so quickly, learn and iterate.

- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

Responsable principal des operations du centre de données

Amazon Web Services (AWS) recrute actuellement un Responsable principal des operations du centre de données, pour rejoindre l’équipe d’exploitation de nos centres de données.

En tant que Responsable principal des operations du centre de données, le rôle est central pour assurer l'excellence opérationnelle de nos centres de données. Le Responsable principal des operations du centre de données est en charge de garantir la performance maximale de tous les équipements électriques, mécaniques et de sécurité incendie. Cela englobe la maintenance préventive planifiée, les interventions correctives quotidiennes et la gestion des situations d'urgence. Ces aspects constituent la pierre angulaire de toutes les opérations d'installation au sein d'un centre de données donné.

Le Responsable principal des operations du centre de données est également un pilier dans la gestion de projets de petite et moyenne envergure, de la conception à l'achèvement, incluant l'obtention et le suivi des devis pour tous les coûts associés, ainsi que la documentation rigoureuse des résultats pour optimiser les futures implémentations.

Un aspect fondamental du rôle du TP est son rôle de soutien essentiel. Le Responsable principal des operations du centre de données apporte un soutien crucial aux techniciens des opérations d'ingénierie et à tout fournisseur tiers, en leur offrant une assistance experte pour le fonctionnement et les dépannages d'équipements électriques et mécaniques sur le terrain. Cette aide précieuse couvre une gamme étendue d'équipements, incluant, sans s'y limiter, les génératrices diesel de secours, les appareils de commutation, les alimentations sans interruption (ASI), les unités de distribution d’alimentation (PDU), les unités de traitement d'air (AHU), les tours de refroidissement, les systèmes de traitement chimique, les pompes, les moteurs, les variateurs de fréquence (VFD) et les systèmes immotiques.

Le Responsable principal des opérations du centre de données organise et distribue le travail en soutenant les techniciens des opérations d’ingénierie ainsi que tout fournisseur tiers.
En tant que chef d’équipe, il coordonne et répartit les tâches pour le fonctionnement et les dépannages d’équipements électriques et mécaniques sur le terrain.
Le Responsable principal des opérations du centre de données planifie les interventions et assigne les responsabilités.

Cette équipe opère dans un environnement dynamique, fonctionnant 24 heures sur 24, 7 jours sur 7. Le soutien constant et l'expertise du Responsable principal des operations du centre de données sont donc indispensables pour maintenir la haute disponibilité et l'efficacité de nos infrastructures critiques.

Amazon est un employeur d’action positive pour l’égalité des chances — minorités, femmes, personnes handicapées, anciens combattants, identité de genre, orientation sexuelle, âge.

Ce poste exige que le candidat sélectionné obtienne et conserve une cote de sécurité active du statut de fiabilité auprès du gouvernement du Canada.

**********************************************************

Data Center Senior Operations Lead

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is currently hiring for a Data Center Senior Operations Lead to support our data centers.

As the Data Center Senior Operations Lead, the role is central to ensuring the operational excellence of our data centers. The Data Center Senior Operations Lead is responsible for guaranteeing the maximum performance of all electrical, mechanical, and fire safety equipment. This includes planned preventive maintenance, daily corrective interventions, and the management of emergency situations. These aspects are the cornerstone of all installation operations within a given data center.

The Data Center Senior Operations Lead is also a key player in managing small- and medium-scale projects, from design to completion, including obtaining and tracking quotes for all associated costs, as well as thoroughly documenting results to optimize future implementations.

A fundamental aspect of the Senior Operations Lead’s role is their essential support function. The Data Center Senior Operations Lead provides crucial support to engineering operations technicians and any third-party vendors by offering expert assistance for the operation and troubleshooting of electrical and mechanical equipment on site. This valuable help covers a wide range of equipment, including, but not limited to, backup diesel generators, switchgear, uninterruptible power supplies (UPS), power distribution units (PDU), air handling units (AHU), cooling towers, chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, variable frequency drives (VFD), and building management systems.

The Data Center Senior Operations Lead organizes and distributes work by supporting engineering operations technicians as well as any third-party vendors.
As a team leader, they coordinate and allocate tasks for the operation and troubleshooting of electrical and mechanical equipment on site.
The Data Center Senior Operations Lead plans interventions and assigns responsibilities.

This team operates in a dynamic environment, functioning 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. The PT’s constant support and expertise are therefore essential to maintaining the high availability and efficiency of our critical infrastructure.

This position requires that the candidate selected obtain and maintain an active Reliability Status security clearance with the Government of Canada.

About the team
About the team
Services d'infrastructure AWS (AIS)
Les services d'infrastructure AWS sont responsables de la conception, de la planification, de la livraison et de l'exploitation de toute l'infrastructure mondiale d'AWS. En d'autres termes, nous sommes ceux qui maintiennent le cloud en fonctionnement. Nous soutenons tous les centres de données AWS ainsi que tous les serveurs, systèmes de stockage, réseaux, équipements électriques et de refroidissement qui garantissent à nos clients un accès continu à l'innovation sur laquelle ils comptent. Nous travaillons sur les problèmes les plus complexes, avec des milliers de variables impactant la chaîne d'approvisionnement — et nous recherchons des personnes talentueuses prêtes à nous aider.

Vous rejoindrez une équipe diversifiée composée d'ingénieurs logiciels, matériels et réseaux, de spécialistes de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, d'experts en sécurité, de responsables des opérations et d'autres rôles essentiels. Vous collaborerez avec des personnes à travers AWS pour nous aider à offrir les normes les plus élevées en matière de sécurité tout en fournissant une capacité apparemment infinie au coût le plus bas possible pour nos clients. Et vous découvrirez une culture inclusive qui accueille des idées audacieuses et vous donne les moyens de les mener à bien.

Expériences Diversifiées
AWS valorise les expériences diversifiées. Même si vous ne remplissez pas toutes les qualifications et compétences préférées énumérées dans la description du poste, nous encourageons les candidats à postuler. Si votre carrière débute, n'a pas suivi un chemin traditionnel ou inclut des expériences alternatives, ne laissez pas cela vous empêcher de postuler.

Pourquoi AWS ?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) est la plateforme cloud la plus complète et largement adoptée au monde. Nous avons été pionniers dans l'informatique en nuage et n'avons jamais cessé d'innover — c'est pourquoi des clients allant des startups les plus prospères aux entreprises du Global 500 font confiance à notre suite robuste de produits et services pour alimenter leurs activités.

Culture d'équipe inclusive
AWS valorise la curiosité et la connexion. Nos groupes d'affinité dirigés par des employés et sponsorisés par l'entreprise favorisent l'inclusion et permettent à nos collaborateurs de tirer fierté de ce qui fait notre singularité. Nos événements inclusifs renforcent des équipes plus fortes et plus collaboratives. Notre innovation continue est alimentée par les idées audacieuses, les perspectives nouvelles et les voix passionnées que nos équipes apportent à tout ce que nous faisons.

Mentorat & Développement Professionnel
Nous élevons continuellement notre niveau de performance dans notre quête pour devenir le meilleur employeur au monde. C'est pourquoi vous trouverez ici une infinité de ressources pour le partage des connaissances, le mentorat et le développement professionnel afin de vous aider à devenir un professionnel plus complet.

Équilibre Travail/Vie Personnelle
Nous valorisons l'harmonie entre vie professionnelle et personnelle. Réussir au travail ne devrait jamais se faire au détriment de sacrifices à la maison, c'est pourquoi nous visons une flexibilité dans notre culture de travail. Lorsque nous nous sentons soutenus au travail comme à la maison, rien ne peut nous arrêter.

***********************************************************

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

- 3+ années d'expérience professionnelle pertinente dans un centre de données ou un autre environnement critique
- Compréhension approfondie des systèmes électriques et mécaniques impliqués dans les opérations critiques de centres de données, tels que : générateurs, transformateurs, appareillages de commutation, systèmes UPS, unités ATS, unités PDU, pompes, unités de traitement d'air et unités CRAC
- Les candidats doivent être capables de soulever jusqu'à 23 kg (50 lbs) et/ou travailler en hauteur.
- Capacité à travailler dans un environnement fonctionnant 24h/24 et 7j/7 avec la possibilité de fournir un support en dehors des heures normales selon les besoins.
- Bilinguisme en français et en anglais requis. Doit pouvoir lire et parler/communiquer en français, ainsi que lire/écrire/parler/communiquer couramment en anglais, notamment pour des instructions et concepts techniques complexes.
- Puisque ce rôle nécessite que l’employé interagisse avec d’autres entités d’Amazon à l’échelle mondiale ainsi qu’avec des employés et intervenants dans d’autres provinces canadiennes, la connaissance du français et de l’anglais est exigée pour ce poste.

- Ability to work in an environment that operates 24/7 with an ability to provide after-hours support as needed.

jobs.description:

We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensures our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The ISCaP team is looking for an exceptional Supply Chain Operations Specialist to help us build on this mission as the volume of products, services, and locations continues to grow. The ideal candidate is one who thrives in ambiguity, is very customer obsessed, focused on operational excellence and is willing to take high degree of ownership for their program vision and execution of ideas. The ability to effectively communicate at all levels of the organization, make data driven decisions, and apply good judgement to manage escalations, competing priorities, and deliverables is essential to this role. Successful candidates will be able to balance think big with realities of delivering on customer promises today. They will also have excellent analytical and creative thinking skills, and the ability to break down complex problems with no clear answers (and at times, conflicting data) into simple, innovative solutions and/or clear, measurable implementation plans.

Do you enjoy solving very complex problems while seeking to invent and simplify? Are you excited by large complex supply chain? Do you enjoy leveraging your creativity to solve real world analytical and capacity delivery problems? Come work with smart people and make major contributions towards enhancing our infrastructure for millions of customers world-wide.

Why you will enjoy it:
In this highly visible and critical role, you will be the voice of the customer in developing operational excellence plans and work extensively with AWS teams including operations, engineering, product management, and finance to help grow the business. You will use your operational and analytical skills to set a vision for the future, translate this vision into reality, and innovate on behalf of our customers. You will have ownership, not just responsibility. In addition, you will be part of a growing, fast paced, and fun team.

Role Responsibilities:

- Serve as a key member of the Supply Chain Operational Excellence (POET) team in helping to manage and deliver Infrastructure capacity to select regions around the world..
- Understand the technical requirements of our partners and work closely with the internal development teams to guide the direction of supply chain activities.
- Develop new analytical models for supply chain solutions.
- Execute strategic business objectives while working with key internal stakeholders to improve the supply chain with the latest internal and external information.
- Prepare and give detailed data-driven business reviews to senior management, focused on improving forecasting accuracy and associated impacts.
- You will be a positive influencer across diverse teams, be able to effectively rally support for your initiatives, and be able to help deeply technical teams create simple solutions to meet your program goals.
- Keys to success in this role include exceptional analytics, judgment, and communication skills.

About the team
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree or above in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Math, Business or other related quantitative disciplines
- 2+ years of procurement, supply chain, inventory management, contract management, lease administration or operations experience
- 2+ years of process improvement, operational analysis, and financial analysis experience
- Experience leveraging data through at least one tool such as excel, SQL, Tableau, QuickSight, or Python to influence cross-functional prioritization, identify improvement opportunities, and drive solutions
- Experience managing cross-functional teams in a fast-paced consumer electronics product company
Preferred qualifications:
- Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field
- Experience in data centers, infrastructure service providers, or related technology companies
- Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification
- Experience with value stream mapping or process flow analysis to identify systemic improvement opportunities
- Experience translating defect patterns into requirements for software/automation teams

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits .

jobs.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensures our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The ISCaP team is looking for an exceptional Supply Chain Operations Specialist to help us build on this mission as the volume of products, services, and locations continues to grow. The ideal candidate is one who thrives in ambiguity, is very customer obsessed, focused on operational excellence and is willing to take high degree of ownership for their program vision and execution of ideas. The ability to effectively communicate at all levels of the organization, make data driven decisions, and apply good judgement to manage escalations, competing priorities, and deliverables is essential to this role. Successful candidates will be able to balance think big with realities of delivering on customer promises today. They will also have excellent analytical and creative thinking skills, and the ability to break down complex problems with no clear answers (and at times, conflicting data) into simple, innovative solutions and/or clear, measurable implementation plans.

Do you enjoy solving very complex problems while seeking to invent and simplify? Are you excited by large complex supply chain? Do you enjoy leveraging your creativity to solve real world analytical and capacity delivery problems? Come work with smart people and make major contributions towards enhancing our infrastructure for millions of customers world-wide.

Why you will enjoy it:
In this highly visible and critical role, you will be the voice of the customer in developing operational excellence plans and work extensively with AWS teams including operations, engineering, product management, and finance to help grow the business. You will use your operational and analytical skills to set a vision for the future, translate this vision into reality, and innovate on behalf of our customers. You will have ownership, not just responsibility. In addition, you will be part of a growing, fast paced, and fun team.

Role Responsibilities:

- Serve as a key member of the Supply Chain Operational Excellence (POET) team in helping to manage and deliver Infrastructure capacity to select regions around the world..
- Understand the technical requirements of our partners and work closely with the internal development teams to guide the direction of supply chain activities.
- Develop new analytical models for supply chain solutions.
- Execute strategic business objectives while working with key internal stakeholders to improve the supply chain with the latest internal and external information.
- Prepare and give detailed data-driven business reviews to senior management, focused on improving forecasting accuracy and associated impacts.
- You will be a positive influencer across diverse teams, be able to effectively rally support for your initiatives, and be able to help deeply technical teams create simple solutions to meet your program goals.
- Keys to success in this role include exceptional analytics, judgment, and communication skills.

About the team
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree or above in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Math, Business or other related quantitative disciplines
- 2+ years of procurement, supply chain, inventory management, contract management, lease administration or operations experience
- 2+ years of process improvement, operational analysis, and financial analysis experience
- Experience leveraging data through at least one tool such as excel, SQL, Tableau, QuickSight, or Python to influence cross-functional prioritization, identify improvement opportunities, and drive solutions
- Experience managing cross-functional teams in a fast-paced consumer electronics product company
Preferred qualifications:
- Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field
- Experience in data centers, infrastructure service providers, or related technology companies
- Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification
- Experience with value stream mapping or process flow analysis to identify systemic improvement opportunities
- Experience translating defect patterns into requirements for software/automation teams

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: Operations Lead
jobs.location: Heidenheim an der Brenz, Baden-Wurttemberg, DEU
jobs.description:
Der operative Geschäftsbereich ist das Herz von Amazon. Ein effektiv ablaufender Betrieb trägt dazu bei, dass Artikel bearbeitet und rechtzeitig an unsere Kund:innen versendet werden. Als Operations Lead erlebst Du, wie alle unterschiedlichen Teile des Betriebs funktionieren und trägst zu einem reibungslosen Ablauf bei.
Du fungierst als erste:r Ansprechpartner:in für Teammitglieder während ihrer Schicht und hilfst ihnen beim Befolgen der Prozesse, die Deine Manager:innen eingeführt haben. Du sammelst praktische Erfahrung und benutzt analytische Systeme, die zum Erfolg unseres Unternehmens beitragen.

Key job responsibilities
- Messung und Überwachung von Arbeitsflüssen, Verfolgen der Leistung am Standort und Bereitstellung wichtiger Schichtinformationen an die Schicht-/Bereichsleiter:innen im Betrieb, um für schichtübergreifende Operational Excellence zu sorgen
- Unterstützung und Schulung von Mitarbeitenden, damit diese großartige Leistungen erbringen können, und Beaufsichtigung ihrer täglichen Aufgaben
- Unterstützung des/der Schicht-/Bereichsleiter:in bei Projekten zur Prozessverbesserung, Förderung eines sicheren Arbeitsumfelds und Erhöhung des Mitarbeiterengagements
- Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Abteilungen, um Lösungen für häufige Probleme zu finden oder Bedürfnisse in wichtigen Leistungsbereichen zu erfüllen
- Nutzung von Datenanalysen, um Möglichkeiten zur Optimierung von Sicherheit, Qualität und Produktivität zu finden

A day in the life
Als Operations Lead arbeitest Du an einem unserer Betriebsstandorte. Du unterstützt Deine:n Schicht-/Bereichsleiter:in bei der Durchführung des Schichtplans. Du hilft bei der Vorbereitung von Schichtbesprechungen mit Deinem Team und überwachst Verfahren und Abläufe. Damit stellst du sicher, dass Sicherheitsregeln, Qualitätssicherungsprozesse und die Prioritäten für den Tag befolgt werden.
Probleme, die Du bemerkst, eskalierst Du an Deine:n Manager:in. Gelegentlich agierst Du auch selbst als Schichtleiter:in und bietest Deinen Mitarbeitenden die notwendige Anleitung, um ihre Aufgaben zu erledigen. Bei Bedarf unterstützt Du Deine:n Schicht-/Bereichsleiter:in bei der Schichtplanung und sorgst dafür, dass zu Stoßzeiten genügend Teammitglieder eingeteilt sind.

About the team
Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) ist für schwere oder sperrige Artikel wie Möbel und große Haushaltsgeräte zuständig. Unser Team verantwortet den gesamten Service von der Beschaffung über die Lieferung bis hin zu Produktrücksendungen. Die erweiterte Kundenbetreuung unterscheidet diesen Service von den anderen. Neben der Lieferung von Sperrgut erledigen wir auch das Auspacken, Montieren und Installieren der Neuware und kümmern uns auf Wunsch um den Abtransport der Altgeräte. Unser Fokus liegt auf Sicherheit, Produktivität und Innovation. Wir sorgen dafür, dass Kund:innen sperrige Artikel einfacher und bequemer kaufen und erhalten können.
Wir haben ehrgeizige Pläne, darunter den Ausbau unseres Netzwerks spezieller Logistik- und Verteilzentren im gesamten Vereinigten Königreich und in Europa. Unsere Kolleg:innen an den Logistikstandorten arbeiten gelegentlich auch in der Nachtschicht. Die meisten unserer Teammitglieder arbeiten jedoch tagsüber. Unser Team umfasst Mitarbeitende aus den Bereichen Betriebswirtschaft, Lieferkette, Supply Chain, Business Intelligence und Programmmanagement. Wir alle spielen eine entscheidende Rolle dabei, diesen Teil unseres Unternehmens weiterzuentwickeln.
Basic qualifications:
- Fortgeschrittene Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
- Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Datenanalytik und deren Anwendung zur Problemerkennung
- Erfahrung mit MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) im beruflichen Umfeld
Preferred qualifications:
- Erfahrung im Stakeholdermanagement, einschließlich Aufbau und Pflege professioneller Beziehungen
- Erfahrung in der Arbeit in einem Betriebsumfeld, beispielsweise in Logistik, Einzelhandel, Gastgewerbe oder im Kundenservice
- Fortgeschrittene Englischkenntnisse

jobs.title: Transportation Ops Manager, Amazon Transportation Services
jobs.description:
Join Amazon Transportation Services (ATS) Mexico as a Transportation Manager owning daily tactical execution across two high-growth transport programs: Amazon's trailer fleet, and Pickup by Carrier Program (for FTL/LTL seller deliveries). This role delivers direct impact on fleet utilization, cost-to-serve, carrier performance, and seller experience at scale. You will be the single point of contact for fleet operations (asset assignment, yard control, inspections, carrier coordination, incident response) and PCP transport execution (VRID creation, BOL validation, SLA monitoring, carrier scorecards, WBR/MBR narratives). You will work cross-functionally with First Mile, business team, Finance, and carrier partners to ensure operational excellence. This is a high-visibility role that combines hands-on execution with business review delivery to senior leadership.

Key job responsibilities
Execute weekly trailer assignment using the cascade allocation engine; manage intra-week reassignments based on demand shifts across sites.
Conduct daily yard status reviews and coordinate relocations to maintain zone balance.
Lead daily performance syncs with carrier partner; act as first responder for operational incidents (stranded trailers, damages, collection delays) with resolution SLA of less than 2 hours.
Prepare clean operational datasets for business review WBR/MBR/QBR
Execute daily VRID creation and BOL validation for FTL/LTL sellers; track custody handoffs and ensure documentation completeness.
Coordinate appointment slots with FBA Receiving and monitor SLA compliance.
Build and deliver DBR flash metric reports.
Manage carrier scorecards and penalty calculations; own forecast-to-schedule governance alignment.
Execute new seller onboarding and monitor compliance during ramp-up periods.
Deliver monthly carrier scorecards, seller growth tracking, and strategic recommendations for MBR executive summaries.

A day in the life
Your morning starts at the yard — one glance tells you which trailers are ready, which are stuck, and where the day's risks are hiding. You act before small problems become expensive ones. When a breakdown hits, the clock starts and you own it: coordinate the fix, keep the sites moving, resolve it fast. The rest of your day, you turn messy operations into clear signals leaders trust to make decisions. Every trailer you unblock, every delay you catch, keeps packages moving to customers. You're the reason the network scales without breaking.

About the team
Amazon Transportation Services (ATS), a high-powered dynamic team shaping the middle-mile transportation execution and developing innovative transportation management concepts to improve and enhance the ATS Network to ultimately drive the best customer experience in a reliable and cost-efficient manner, every time.
Basic qualifications:
- 2+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
Preferred qualifications:
- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.title: Operations Lead, éShop Content Services
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Operations Lead to drive operational excellence across our London studio. In this role, you will own the day-to-day operational rhythm of the studio — overseeing workflow, production planning, capacity management, and performance tracking to ensure we consistently meet our quality and productivity targets.

You will lead a team of Operations Associates, ensuring resources are in place to meet daily production goals while coordinating directly with creative teams, production leads, and cross-functional partners. You will be responsible for forecasting volumes, planning capacity against demand, and reacting quickly to shifting priorities — building contingency plans that keep production on track.

You will ensure standard operating procedures are followed, identify inefficiencies in workflow, and drive a culture of continuous improvement. You'll collaborate with regional peers, sharing best practices and delivering scalable operating procedures that maintain rigour as the studio grows.

Key job responsibilities
Lead a team of Operations Associates supporting studio logistics, volume processing, and daily production goals
Own the planning and flow of product and assets through all stages of the studio workflow, from sample intake through to final delivery.
Support annual and quarterly planning cycles for volume, productivity, and goals; track progress through continuous inspection and iteration, working through obstacles and gaining stakeholder support.
Support monthly and quarterly financial analysis for the studio.
Ensure studio KPIs are met on a weekly and monthly basis — inspecting metrics, identifying risks early, and driving corrective action.
Use data and systems to track, forecast, and plan for volume and product flow requiring stills and videos.
Drive a culture of continuous improvement — contributing Kaizen expertise, collecting and analysing data, and testing solutions for process improvements and new initiatives.
Regularly report key productivity and quality metrics to studio leadership and stakeholders.
Build and scale process-related solutions with measurable metric impact through automation and cross-team adoption.
Create and maintain training materials and process documentation to support team ramp-up and operational consistency.
Coordinate with technology and digital teams to unblock production dependencies and ensure systems support operational needs.

A day in the life
Your day starts with a production plan review and morning stand-up, aligning your Ops Associates on priorities, volume targets, and schedule changes. From there, you'll split time between the studio floor and your desk: troubleshooting blockers in real time, coordinating with creative leads, tracking live metrics against targets, and working with tech teams to resolve system issues. In between, you're analysing workflow data, building SOPs, preparing reports for leadership, and planning for upcoming volume peaks. No two days are identical — this role suits someone who thrives equally in the detail of daily operations and the strategic thinking required to scale them.
Basic qualifications:
- 5+ years of experience in a high-volume, high-throughput production or operations environment
- Experience directly managing a team of individual contributors
- Demonstrated experience identifying and implementing process improvements, preferably using LEAN or Six Sigma methodology
- Experience driving multi-stakeholder projects from concept to delivery across different teams and functions
- Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and data analysis tools (SQL, Access, or equivalent)
- Proven ability to manage multiple complex priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
- Experience with capacity planning, volume forecasting, and resource allocation
Preferred qualifications:
- Previous experience working in a high-volume commercial studio environment in an operational capacity
- Experience successfully leading teams through change and scaling operations
- Proficiency using multiple platforms and software to measure productivity and operational metrics
- Project management skills (formal certification a plus but not required)
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into action
- Ability to influence and build effective working relationships across a diverse set of creative, technical, and business partners
- Familiarity with studio production workflows — including scheduling, sample management, and post-production pipelines

jobs.title: Continuous Improvement Manager, Amazon Transportation Services, ACES Outbound Transportation
jobs.description:
Our overall mission is simple: we want Amazon to be the place where our customers can find, discover and buy anything online. Whatever our customers want, we will find the means to deliver it. With your help, Amazon will continue to enable people to discover new worlds and implement innovation.
This is your chance to make history.

We're seeking a strategic leader to drive innovation and excellence in our carrier and driver learning ecosystem. This senior-level position will shape the future of our learning strategy while leading cross-functional teams to deliver best-in-class training solutions.

Key job responsibilities
Process Optimization
- Identify and analyze operational inefficiencies
- Develop and implement process improvement solutions
- Lead Lean/Six Sigma projects
- Create standardized work procedures
- Monitor KPIs and metrics for transportation operations

Project Management
- Lead cross-functional improvement projects
- Develop project timelines and resource allocation plans
- Track project progress and ROI
- Manage change implementation processes
- Document and report project outcomes

Data Analysis
- Analyze transportation metrics and performance data
- Identify trends and improvement opportunities
- Create data visualization tools and dashboards
- Develop predictive models for operational optimization
- Generate regular performance reports

Team Leadership
- Train staff on continuous improvement methodologies
- Facilitate improvement workshops and kaizen events
- Coach teams on problem-solving techniques
- Build and maintain improvement culture
- Coordinate with various departments and stakeholders

A day in the life
Review overnight transportation reports, noting any significant disruptions or issues that occurred.

Attend the daily operations and discuss current performance metrics, ongoing projects, and any immediate challenges.
Facilitate a cross-functional team through problem identification and solution brainstorming.
Analyze data from the Transportation Management System (TMS) to identify trends in route efficiency.
Meet with the finance team to review the ROI of recent improvement projects and discuss budget allocation for upcoming initiatives.
Work on the project plan for an upcoming automation initiative aimed at reducing manual data entry in the dispatch process.

About the team
As part of Amazon Customer Excellence Systems (ACES) team, we work to continually improve the Amazon Logistics experience. We look after high-impact initiatives and help to develop, roll out and look after a range of logistics-focused projects. Using data-driven tools, we’re able to see how we can make processes better and more efficient, or how we can reduce waste across the business.

Our team supports field operations to launch new programmes and technology-based solutions across Mexico, helping them meet customer demand and drive customer-focused innovation.
Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience in oral and written communication in English
- Experience working in an operations, supply chain, transportation, project management or management consulting role
- Experience with Six Sigma tools and Lean techniques
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience handling multiple competing priorities and complex projects with multiple stakeholders (e.g. definition of accurate network expansion plans, vendor development, quality assurance, design and cost improvement, team and stakeholder engagement)
- Master's degree

jobs.description:
Amazon's Reliability and Maintenance Engineering (RME) Workforce Excellence team seeks an experienced and collaborative professional to lead labor planning, cost analysis, and cross-functional workforce programs that deliver measurable financial and operational outcomes. RME maintains and optimizes facilities across our entire value chain—from large, modern, purpose-built warehouses that use robotics and high-volume conveyance systems to sites positioned close to customers. We support technologies across Global Customer Fulfillment, Sort Center/Air, and Delivery Network operations to maximize operational efficiency and budget performance. Join the Amazon RME Workforce Excellence team today!

The Sr. Manager, Biz Ops will develop and deliver OP and OxG labor inputs in partnership with BU leaders, produce consolidated labor cost and variance bridges, and manage key cross-BU and cross-regional workforce programs. This role requires close collaboration with multiple stakeholders, including People Experience & Technologies (PxT), Finance, Procurement, and Talent Acquisition (TA) teams to drive multi-year labor strategies that optimize workforce spend while sustaining talent pipelines. This role demands a strong delivery record and proven program management experience to own strategic, cross-functional initiatives that demonstrate clear return on investment. You will bring extensive experience in labor planning and cost modeling, developing scalable processes, coordinating and driving execution across regions, and communicating status, risks, and financial impact of workforce changes to senior leadership.

- You will manage cross-BU and cross-regional workforce programs by coordinating with PxT, Finance, Procurement, and TA to ensure alignment, resource optimization, and measurable ROI at each program stage.
- You will anticipate labor planning risks and balance cost constraints by making strategic tradeoffs between workforce needs and operational budgets, communicating financial risks and mitigation strategies to senior leadership.
- You will drive continuous improvement through labor cost analysis, identifying efficiency opportunities and analyzing root causes to prevent recurring cost overruns across the network.

The RME Workforce Excellence team is the central arm for the RME field as it pertains to labor planning, cost analysis, and cross-regional workforce programs. Our team partners with business leaders and key stakeholders (PxT, TA, Compensation, Finance, and Central RME) to drive programmatic improvement in the areas of labor costs, workforce efficiency, and organizational goals.

jobs.title: Marketing Specialist, CMHK Marketing Strategy and Ops
jobs.description:
Join AWS Marketing as a Marketing Trainee — a role built for a new generation of marketers who think AI-first and lead with data. This isn’t a traditional entry-level position: you’ll be embedded in real marketing workflows from day one, learning the full lifecycle of cloud marketing while actively reimagining how work gets done through AI-native tools and practices.
With 1+ year of marketing experience, you’ll work alongside experienced marketers to support multi-channel programs that drive AWS marketing initiatives. You’ll gain hands-on exposure to audience targeting, performance metrics, and campaign operations — and you’ll be expected to challenge the status quo by bringing AI-powered workflows, automation ideas, and data-driven experimentation into everything you touch. We’re looking for someone who doesn’t just use AI tools — but thinks in AI.
If you’re ready to launch your marketing career at one of the world’s most innovative technology companies — and help define what next-generation marketing looks like — we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
• Support the planning and execution of multi-channel marketing campaigns — including digital, events, and content programs — that drive AWS tech/AI adoption and customer engagement
• Assist in developing and coordinating campaign assets and materials, ensuring consistency with AWS brand standards and messaging guidelines
• Track, compile, and report on campaign performance metrics, providing clear summaries to support data-driven decision-making by the broader marketing team
• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders — including sales, product, and partner teams — to align marketing activities with business objectives and customer needs
• Conduct research on target audiences, industry trends, and competitive landscape to inform campaign strategy and content development
• Support the coordination of marketing events, including logistics, vendor liaison, and on-site or virtual execution, to deliver high-quality customer and partner experiences
• Assist in managing marketing tools, platforms, and databases to ensure accurate audience segmentation, campaign tracking, and reporting
• Contribute to team projects and continuous improvement initiatives, bringing fresh perspectives and a willingness to learn in a fast-paced, innovative environment
• Champion an AI-first approach in daily work: proactively identify opportunities to replace or streamline existing workflows with AI-powered solutions, and share learnings with the team to raise the collective capability

About the team
AWS Marketing leads the charge in cloud innovation, inspiring and empowering customers and partners to unlock their cloud potential. We shape AWS’s industry perception through compelling narratives that demonstrate our leadership in AI and transformative solutions, while driving customer growth across our vast service portfolio. Our team delivers personalized, connected experiences that foster AWS adoption across diverse industries, continuously adapting our strategy to stay ahead in our digital-first world.
Join our forward-thinking team to help shape the future of cloud computing, contributing to strategic initiatives that respond to evolving technology, industry, and customer requirements. You’ll collaborate globally to translate complex technology into clear, valuable solutions — creating impactful programs that drive AWS’s growth in an inclusive, collaborative environment where diverse perspectives and bold thinking thrive.

- • Demonstrated AI-native mindset — able to show concrete examples of using AI tools (e.g., generative AI, prompt engineering, AI-assisted analytics) to solve real work problems, not just familiarity with concepts
- • Proven storytelling ability — experience crafting compelling narratives that translate complex ideas or data into clear, engaging messages for target audiences
- • Proven ability to support marketing campaigns across multiple channels, including digital, events, and content
- • Strong analytical skills with experience in tracking and reporting campaign metrics
- • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to align marketing activities with business objectives
- • Strong written and verbal communication skills with high attention to detail

- • Foundational understanding of technology, cloud computing, and the AI landscape

- • Track record of building or redesigning workflows using AI tools — e.g., automating reporting pipelines, using AI for content generation at scale, or building AI-assisted research processes that measurably improved efficiency
- • Experience producing multi-format storytelling content (written, visual, video) that drove measurable audience engagement or conversion outcomes
